MPs Palland and Van den Berg asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether STAP training subsidies can fund therapeutic and dropshipping courses, and how the government verifies their labour-market relevance. The minister answered that such courses are not excluded if the provider is accredited and the training is legal, that the Toetsingskamer STAP monitors providers and has ordered the removal of over 2,000 courses, and that an evaluation will follow in early 2023.
The STAP budget is a learning scheme that is continually adjusted and further targeted.
Het STAP-budget is een lerende regeling, die gaande weg wordt aangepast en verder wordt gericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over financiële misstanden bij MartiniZorg

Mr Van den Berg (CDA) asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about alleged financial misconduct at MartiniZorg and its parent company, including a dividend of 550,000 euros paid out against a 10,000 euro investment, and about rules on profit distribution, executive pay via dividends, and the planned Wibz bill. The Minister said excessive profit distribution is undesirable, pointed to planned statutory conditions on profit distribution and to supervisors for the specific case, and gave examples of municipal profit caps and an indicative timeline of 1 January 2025 for the bill.
I do not comment on the specific MartiniZorg case, but I can very well understand the question marks surrounding it.
Over de concrete casus van MartiniZorg doe ik geen uitspraak, maar ik kan mij de vraagtekens bij deze casus heel goed voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Postchaos in ’s-Heer Arendskerke nog niet voorbij: 'Het is nu tijd om verdere stappen te nemen''

Two CDA MPs asked the minister whether she knew of ongoing postal delivery failures in 's-Heer Arendskerke and whether she would work with PostNL and the municipality on a structural fix. The minister said delivery problems are caused by labour shortages and similar factors, that PostNL is recruiting and in direct contact with residents, and that ACM supervises and can enforce.
It is up to ACM to supervise this and to take enforcement action where necessary.
Het is aan ACM om hier toezicht op te houden en om zo nodig handhavend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over herhaalprikken voor mensen onder de zestig jaar

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health whether GGDs wrongly offered second booster shots to under-60s without appointment and how the government implements a motion on booster access for vulnerable under-60s. The minister denied any policy change, described the specialist-referral route for under-60s with comparable immune disorders, and argued that boosters without medical necessity are not justified.
Offering a booster without medical necessity is undesirable to me: vaccination is a medical act that must rest on a careful health assessment.
Een herhaalprik zonder medische noodzaak vind ik onwenselijk: vaccineren is een medische handeling waar een zorgvuldige gezondheidsafweging aan ten grondslag dient te liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Palland, Peters en Bikker over het artikel 'Investeer in preventie en die begint al bij de kinderwens'

MPs from CDA and ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about preconception care such as the Nu Niet Zwanger programme, its reach, and whether it should be part of the Kansrijke Start programme and municipal prenatal advice duties. The state secretary answered that Nu Niet Zwanger is already part of Kansrijke Start, available in 172 municipalities, that 272 municipalities have a local Kansrijke Start coalition, and that structural funding and possible anchoring will be explored.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Aruba heeft geen boodschap aan RMR en Cft: Geld vliegt de deur uit’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about press reports that Aruba is ignoring advice from the RMR and the Cft on its public finances, asking about the consequences of rising debt and whether the government will hold the Aruban cabinet to account. The State Secretary agreed the situation is very worrying, explained the possible financial risks, but declined to judge Aruba's budget policy while a formal Article 11 procedure is ongoing, promising to inform the House once the RMR decision on the Cft advice is taken.
The budget policy pursued by Aruba is currently subject to an Article 11 procedure, with a hearing and rebuttal process, under the adopted 2022 budget.
Over het door Aruba gevoerde begrotingsbeleid loopt in kader van de Vastgestelde Begroting 2022 momenteel een artikel 11-procedure met een hoor- en wederhoor traject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van den Berg over de mobiele netwerkdekking in Kattendijke

MPs Inge van Dijk and Van den Berg asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about poor mobile coverage in Kattendijke, including a 2016 death where emergency messages reportedly failed. The minister acknowledges patchy coverage, says mobile coverage cannot be guaranteed 100% and recommends fixed lines in some cases, and reports contact with the municipality and operators plus a coverage requirement on 700 MHz licences.
At the same time, it is necessary to acknowledge that it is impossible to guarantee 100% mobile network coverage.
Tegelijkertijd is het noodzakelijk om te erkennen dat het onmogelijk is om 100% mobiele netwerkdekking te garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over ziekenhuizen die zich klemgezet voelen door softwarebouwer Chipsoft

MP Van den Berg asked about hospitals feeling locked in by software vendor ChipSoft, including costs, profit margins, switching barriers, market remedies and whether ChipSoft has a works council. The minister answered that procurement is the hospitals' own responsibility, that the ACM oversees competition, that VWS is working on options such as standardisation and bargaining support and will report after the summer, and that works council compliance is a private matter.
I do not have information on the amounts hospitals pay software suppliers per year.
Ik beschik niet over informatie van bedragen die ziekenhuizen per jaar kwijt zijn aan softwareleveranciers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Van der Staaij en Den Haan over zelfvoorzienendheid met betrekking tot geneesmiddelen en medische hulpmiddelen

MPs Van den Berg, Van der Staaij and Den Haan asked the Minister of Health about self-sufficiency in medicines and medical devices, including the Berger report, the IGJ list of production facilities, insurers' purchasing criteria, compounding pharmacy capacity and the investment climate for generic producers. The minister answered that the report will be studied externally with results expected in July, that the IGJ database cannot give the number of Dutch tablet producers, that talks with insurers have not led to mandated local purchasing, and that policy will be shaped after four studies due in summer.
As a result, the number of producers of generic tablet medicines established in the Netherlands cannot be given based on this list.
Daarmee is het aantal in Nederland gevestigde producenten van generieke medicijnen in tabletvorm op basis van deze lijst niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over belemmeringen voor de ontwikkeling van nieuwe geneesmiddelen in Nederland

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about obstacles to developing new medicines in the Netherlands, including the idea of societal royalties, the FAST programme's funding and the Oncode-PACT grant, and university limits on patents and shareholdings. The Minister answered that FAST is a coordinating centre rather than a fund (so the motion cannot be executed as written), that the Oncode-PACT grant was assessed independently, that IP guidelines are under review, and that the societal-royalty idea is interesting but not yet adopted.
Therefore the Van Gerven/Van den Berg motion cannot be carried out as such, because it assumes FAST is a fund from which resources can be allocated for 100% public research.

Daarmee zal de motie Van Gerven/ Van den Berg niet als zodanig kunnen worden uitgevoerd, omdat die motie ervan uitgaat dat FAST een fonds is, waaruit middelen te alloceren zijn voor 100% publieke onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘China ziet DNA als natuurlijke hulpbron en bouwt aan enorme genendatabank’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports of China building a large DNA database and whether Dutch donors' tissue sent abroad is protected, and which Dutch biobanks have Chinese ownership. The Minister answered that Dutch law does not apply abroad but material transfer agreements and the planned Wzl law would require binding agreements and donor information, that he lacks insight into foreign ownership of biobanks, and that Chinese law applies only to material sent to China.
I have no insight into this.
Hier heb ik geen inzicht in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van den Berg en Bikker over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars investeren in fastfoodketens

MPs asked whether health insurers' investments in fast-food chains are a wrong signal given the obesity problem, and whether fast food should be an exclusion category. The minister replied that insurers decide their own investment policy, that the holdings are small (about 8 million euros), that dialogue with chains like McDonald's has produced commitments, and that prevention talks and an upcoming letter will follow.
As private parties, health insurers themselves decide on their investment policy.
Als private partijen gaan zorgverzekeraars zelf over hun beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bisschop, Van der Plas, Bikker, Ceder, Van den Berg, Tielen, Brekelmans en Podt over de toegang tot basiszorg voor Oekraïense vluchtelingen

MPs from several parties asked about access to basic healthcare for Ukrainian refugees, including GP, mental health, pharmacy, dental and maternity care, and about coordination with the LHV, InEen and GGD GHOR, medical evacuations, administrative burden, and interpreters. The government answered that Ukrainian displaced persons fall outside the asylum medical scheme, that JenV leads the organisation of access with insurers, that existing systems are being copied, and that it could not answer all questions before the plenary debate but sent a broader letter.
It has not been possible to answer the questions before the plenary debate.
Het is niet gelukt om de vragen voor het plenaire debat te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Mensen met handicap onterecht dubbel verzekerd'

Two CDA MPs asked the minister whether people with intellectual disabilities receiving care under the Wlz are wrongly double-insured with supplementary dental cover, and what should be done about it. The minister answered that Wlz data may not be shared with supplementary insurers for privacy reasons, that there is no legal double insurance, that the number affected is unknown, and that he will raise the role of insurers with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland.
Data on Wlz clients may, for privacy reasons, be shared only to a very limited extent.
Gegevens over Wlz-cliënten mogen – in verband met de privacy – slechts zeer beperkt worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Van der Woude en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Acta biedt medewerkers 1000 euro bonus voor het aandragen van een tandartsdocent'

MPs asked the ministers about reports that the Amsterdam dental academy (ACTA) had to scale back master's teaching due to a shortage of dental teachers, and about the reliance on foreign-trained dentists and regional distribution of dental programmes. The minister confirmed the teaching cutback was temporary and largely restored, and gave partial answers, promising to raise regional distribution with the Capaciteitsorgaan in its autumn advice.
In consultation with the Capaciteitsorgaan, extra attention will be requested for this aspect in the new advice due to appear in the autumn.
In het overleg met het Capaciteitsorgaan zal extra aandacht gevraagd worden voor dit aspect in het nieuwe advies dat in het najaar zal verschijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Hijink over het artikel 'Zorgbestuurders amper gecheckt op dubieus verleden’

MPs Van den Berg (CDA) and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport whether care directors with criminal records or dubious care histories can still easily start new youth or home-care organisations, and why none of the 1,270 new care businesses reporting in early 2022 were asked for a VOG or subjected to integrity checks. The minister replied that a board ban blocks registration at the Chamber of Commerce, that the licence application asks about board members' past, that the number of new businesses is not alarming, and that the IGJ is still analysing the figures.

The fact that no VOG has yet been requested or integrity investigation started for the Wtza licence only means that, based on the application form and the information sources checked, there has so far been no reason to do so.

Het feit dat bij de Wtza-vergunning nog geen VOG is opgevraagd of integriteitsonderzoek is gestart zegt uitsluitend dat er bij deze zorgaanbieders op basis van het aanvraagformulier en de gecheckte informatiebronnen vooralsnog geen aanleiding is geweest om dit te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Annelies zit al twee jaar in isolatie, maar Nederland is traag met medicatie voor kwetsbaren’

MPs Bikker and Van den Berg asked the health minister about the treatment of immunocompromised people with COVID-19, including medication access and the balance between opening society and protecting the vulnerable. The minister answered that vulnerable groups were consulted, sectors are asked to consider them, and several COVID drugs are or will be available, with Paxlovid procured via the EU because of delays and unacceptable conditions set by Pfizer.

I continuously seek advice on possible new treatments and will assess case by case whether the treatment is a useful addition to the available treatment arsenal and what the best procurement route is.

Ik laat me doorlopend adviseren over eventuele nieuwe behandelingen en zal per geval beoordelen of de behandeling een nuttige aanvulling is op het beschikbare behandelarsenaal en wat de beste aankooproute is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van den Berg over het uitzonderen van sportbeoefening bij mogelijke toekomstige coronamaatregelen

MPs Inge van Dijk and Van den Berg (CDA) asked whether sports restrictions remain possible under the sixth extension of the COVID-19 temporary law, whether sport could be designated essential, and how the long-term plan would protect sport. The minister confirmed sports measures stay available, said sport is a priority though not formally essential, and promised a long-term plan and health campaign by June, but did not answer all questions in time.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to provide the answers at this time.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de beantwoording voor dit moment plaats te laten vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Westerveld, Van den Berg en Bikker over de staat van de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz)

Four MPs asked the minister about financial strain, possible closures, staffing shortages and the new mental health care payment model in Dutch GGZ. The minister answered that insurers and providers must resolve continuity and financial problems through contracting, that the NZa is monitoring and was asked to analyse closures, and that a joint working-arrangement process on freelance staffing was started, while leaving much of the detail to the sector.
I have asked the NZa to analyse the recent closures and inform me about any common underlying causes.
Ik heb de NZa gevraagd om de recente sluitingen te analyseren en mij te informeren over eventuele gemeenschappelijke achterliggende oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over reclame-uitingen voor ggz-zorg

An MP asks the Minister of Long-Term Care about GGZ (mental health) advertising by providers such as Mindler, including whether it medicalises complaints, adds to waiting lists, targets young healthy patients, and whether such advertising can be banned. The Minister answers that advertising is permitted unless misleading (supervised by the NZa), GP referral remains required, the Inspectorate has imposed improvement measures and will re-inspect.
I have no insight into whether this specific treatment offer is profitable for Mindler.
Ik heb er geen zicht op of dit specifieke behandelaanbod winstgevend is voor Mindler.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over ‘Zorgen om medicijnverstrekking op Bonaire

An MP asked why the hospital pharmacy on Bonaire was closed abruptly, whether the Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders and related rules apply, and what action the government will take. The government explained the closure as a move to a new pharmacy with its own entrance to reduce COVID-19 risk for vulnerable elderly, noted delays due to staff shortages, said the Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders does not apply, and stated the new pharmacy opened on 14 March 2022.
The plan was to open a new hospital pharmacy, Botika Playa, on 13 January 2022.
Het plan was om een nieuwe ziekenhuisapotheek Botika Playa te openen op 13 januari 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'Extra coronaprik nu ook voor 60-plussers'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health why households of severely immunocompromised people cannot get an extra booster, and why the ministry promoted boosters to 12-17 year olds despite Health Council advice. The Minister answered that the Health Council sees no medical need for extra boosters under 60, that individual cases will be examined with the RIVM, and that youths were given room for their own choice to protect vulnerable family members.
I am examining together with the RIVM how we can realise the implementation of this for exceptional cases.
Ik onderzoek samen met het RIVM op welke manier we de uitvoering hiervan voor uitzonderlijke gevallen kunnen realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het wissen van patiënteninformatie door het Albert Schweitzer ziekenhuis

An MP asked the Health Minister about the accidental deletion of historical patient records at Albert Schweitzer hospital, including whether standard transition procedures were followed, why the error went unnoticed for a year, and how patients were informed. The minister answered that the hospital reports proper procedures, that the software vendor has issued fixes, that no controls would have caught the error earlier, and that a contact address has been set up for affected patients.
From the hospital's factual account 2 and subsequent intensive contact, it appears there were no possibilities for checks that would have allowed this error to be detected earlier or on time.
Uit het feitenrelaas van het ziekenhuis 2 en daarna intensief contact, blijkt dat er geen mogelijkheden tot controle zijn geweest om deze fout eerder en/of tijdig te kunnen signaleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Kuiken over het bericht dat de kleinschalige huisartsenzorg op het platteland in gevaar is en daarmee de leefbaarheid van kleine gemeenschappen

MPs Van den Berg and Kuiken asked the health minister about reports that small-scale rural GP care, including pharmacy-dispensing GPs, is under threat, and about successor shortages, administrative burden, insurers' distribution plans, and funding. The minister answered that successor problems are widespread and handled regionally with insurers, denied that insurers are studying distribution by national chains, said funding is considered adequate, and offered to discuss the issue further.
I am always willing to discuss this matter.
Ik ben altijd bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van der Staaij over zelfvoorzienendheid met betrekking tot geneesmiddelen en medische hulpmiddelen

Two MPs asked the health minister whether the Netherlands should keep domestic production of generic tablet medicines, given a report that only one large factory remains, and whether tenders should require purchases from local producers. The minister said the report focuses only on the final tableting step, that the whole supply chain matters, that she stands by the earlier commitment to the Leiden factory, and that she will not force insurers to buy a third of tablets locally, while exploring procurement criteria.
In summary, I see no reason to force health insurers to order at least a third of generic tablet medicines from local suppliers.
Samenvattend zie ik geen aanleiding om zorgverzekeraars te dwingen om tenminste een derde van de generieke medicijnen in tabletvorm te laten bestellen bij lokale aanbieders.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Huisartsentekort is doorn in ’t oog voor Gemertse politiek maar die kan het zelf niet oplossen; honderd mensen nu zonder arts'

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about a shortage of GPs in Gemert, where about 100 patients are without a GP, and about the GP-access and insurer duty-of-care framework. The minister says access to GP care is under pressure, points to existing access norms and insurer duties of care, and says the regional GP-training distribution is not available but is being discussed.
I do not have this information available.
Deze informatie heb ik niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Geurts over het artikel 'Huisarts mist ruimte voor uitbreiding'

CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Health and of Housing about the LHV survey showing generalpractice premises shortages, whether municipalities share responsibility, and related questions on costs, inventories and acute care notification rules. The Minister acknowledged the problem, said municipalities share responsibility for adequate premises through land-use planning, declined a separate regional inventory, and pointed to digitalisation and coalition measures.
I will therefore not carry out an additional inventory.
Ik zal daarom geen aanvullende inventarisatie uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Straks kan Zeeland alleen nog een bordje naast de met PFAS-water gevulde Hedwigepolder zetten: 'Geen vis eten!''

MPs Van der Molen and Van den Berg (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about PFAS contamination in the Westerschelde and the planned flooding of the Hedwigepolder, including whether work should wait for the RIVM study, a pending Raad van State request, Belgian coordination and appointing a coordinator. The Minister answered that the flooding will proceed because the sediment PFAS levels do not breach the Waterwet duty of care, that the RIVM study will not change expectations, that a coordinator will be appointed in consultation with Zeeland.

In response to the letter from the Zeeland Provincial Executive, the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management has indicated that he wishes to appoint a coordinator at senior civil service level in both central government and the province of Zeeland.

In reactie op de brief van GedeputeerdeStaten van Zeeland heeft de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat aangegeven bij zowel de rijksoverheid als de provincie Zeeland op hoogambtelijk niveau een coördinator te willen aanwijzen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Inge van Dijk over het mogelijk verdwijnen van de Bredabus n.a.v. het bericht van omroep Zeeland ‘Van Zeeland tot Breda: politici willen Bredabus koste wat k

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary whether he shares concerns about the possible loss of bus line 19 (Bredabus) between Hulst and Breda, the proposal to end it at Antwerp, and what can be done to prevent public transport decline in Zeeland. The State Secretary answered that public transport is important, that the province of Zeeland (the responsible authority) wants to keep the link but faces rising costs, that the province is talking with NS about student travel, and that decentralised authorities bear responsibility for service design.
The responsible public transport authority, the province of Zeeland, has informed me that it also sees the importance of the Hulst-Breda link and therefore wishes to keep it.
De verantwoordelijke OV-autoriteit, de provincie Zeeland, heeft me laten weten ook het belang van de verbinding Hulst-Breda te zien en wil deze daarom ook graag behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over een omstreden middel tegen corona

An MP asked the health minister about an unproven COVID-19 drug (ivermectin) prescribed by doctors and about how the IGJ inspectorate can sanction it, including criminal referral and BIG-register removal. The minister explained the IGJ's fines, disciplinary and criminal routes, and that disciplinary judges decide on removal from the register case by case.
This is for the judgement of the disciplinary judge.
Dit is ter beoordeling van de tuchtrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van den Berg over de boostercampagne voor mensen onder de 60 jaar met een kwetsbare gezondheid

MPs Bikker and Van den Berg asked the minister why the booster campaign for under-60s with vulnerable health moved from the planned 'seventh month after last vaccination' timing to an age-based order and was later accelerated, leaving some people without the promised schedule. The minister answered that rising vaccine effectiveness loss and the omicron variant led to an accelerated, simplified campaign in which everyone aged 18 and over could book a booster from 4 January, abandoning the earlier seventh-month rule.
To enable everyone to get a booster vaccination as quickly as possible, the implementation has been simplified.
Om zo snel mogelijk iedereen in staat te stellen een boostvaccinatie te halen is de uitvoering vereenvoudigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het artikel 'ASR-topman waarschuwt verzekeraars voor tweedeling in de maatschappij'

An MP asks the health minister about an ASR executive's warning that insurers risk a two-tier society, and whether health-based conditions and age-based premiums in supplementary cover should be banned and insurers' profits required to lower premiums. The minister replies that solidarity in basic cover is secured by the acceptance duty and premium ban, that medical selection in supplementary cover is rare (2.4%), and that no extra profit rules are needed since insurers do not distribute profits.
I do not recognise the picture that a two-tier divide is emerging in the health insurance market.
Ik herken het beeld dat er een tweedeling ontstaat op de zorgverzekeringsmarkt niet.

Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Van den Berg, Inge van Dijk  en Van der Laan over het volgens het kabinet benodigde onderzoek om de sportsector toe te voegen aan de groep van essentiële sectoren

MPs asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether the research needed before adding the sports sector to the essential sectors (per the Van den Berg motion) is finished, and what additional research is still required given existing studies on fitness and sport participation. The minister said the government considers sport a high priority, cites its own consideration of existing studies and OMT advice, and reports that a large part of sport was allowed again from 14 January 2022.
That is why the cabinet has stated that sport is a high priority, even though it does not fall under the definition of essential retail and/or services.
Daarom heeft het kabinet uitgesproken dat sport een hoge prioriteit heeft, ook al valt het niet onder de definitie van essentiële detailhandel en/of dienstverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Palland over het bericht ‘Nederlandse zelfredzaamheid productie mondkapjes’

MPs Van den Berg and Palland asked the health minister how the government will keep domestic face-mask production viable, including whether a Sittard firm could be kept on standby and whether the LCH could keep buying masks. The minister said no subsidies were given, the state will not rescue firms at risk of bankruptcy, and a study and innovation competitions are underway, with a ready-stock plan to follow later this year.
It is not for the government to support these companies in case they threaten to go bankrupt.
Het is niet aan de overheid om deze bedrijven te ondersteunen in het geval ze failliet dreigen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van den Berg over de blijvende problemen van het ophalen van de QR-code voor het coronatoegangsbewijs

MPs Paternotte and Van den Berg asked the health minister about persistent problems obtaining QR codes for the coronavirus access certificate, including helpdesk volumes, unresolved cases, staffing, and access for people vaccinated abroad. The minister answered that about 7% of helpdesk calls concerned QR-code problems, most are resolved, capacity is sufficient, and expansion of foreign-vaccination services is under discussion without firm commitments on new locations.
Precise numbers and percentages of the types of problems occurring are not recorded.
Precieze aantallen en percentages van de soorten voorkomende problemen worden niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht dat veel mensen die langjarig medicijnen gebruiken geen tussentijdse beoordelingen aangeboden krijgen

The MP asks the State Secretary about a Radar survey showing many long-term medication users get no interim checks, and about antidepressant duration and pharmacy fees. The State Secretary replies that care is tailored to patients, that pharmacists and GPs monitor medication, and that an annual check for all long-term users is not necessary.
An annual check for all patients using medication long-term is therefore not necessary for everyone.
Een jaarlijkse controle bij alle patiënten die langdurig medicijnen gebruiken is daarom niet voor iedereen noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Aukje de Vries, Van den Berg, Kuiken en Bikker over de afschaling van reguliere zorg en de extra wachttijdproblematiek

MPs asked the Minister of Health about the renewed scaling-down of regular hospital care, uneven burden across hospitals, underuse of independent clinics, digital care, cross-border treatment, and publication of waiting-time data. The minister answered that national allocation agreements apply, that NZa and IGJ monitor compliance, that planned care in all hospitals has been halted under phase 2d, and that waiting-time information is being updated more often, while declining to commit to specific structural changes beyond existing frameworks.
The Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) and the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) monitor that the agreements are being complied with.
De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) en de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) zien er op toe dat de afspraken worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Kuiken over het bericht 'Woede om Ollongren die bevolking Caribisch Nederland maant korter te douchen: 'Wat een dedain''

MPs Van den Berg and Kuiken asked the Minister of the Interior whether her advice to Caribbean Netherlands residents to shower shorter and use air conditioning less, based on a Milieu Centraal survey, was appropriate given local poverty, and about renewable energy investment by utility WEB. The minister acknowledged the survey was non-representative and the wording unfortunate, said the municipalities decide how to use the tips, and said a renewables roadmap for Bonaire will be sent to parliament by January 2022.
I regret the commotion that arose over this initiative to promote awareness and possible savings in households together with the public body Bonaire and the involved agencies WEB and UNKOBON.

Ik betreur de ophef die is ontstaan over dit initiatief om samen met het openbaar lichaam Bonaire en betrokken instanties WEB en UNKOBON tot bewustwording en mogelijke besparing in huishoudens te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over het bericht ‘Tekort aan behandelaren veroorzaakt naast wachtlijsten ook patiëntenstop in de ggz’

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that staff shortages in mental health care cause waiting lists and intake stops, asking about shortages, training numbers, complexity, digital care, cross-regional allocation, ANW duties, sickness absence, external hiring costs and training capacity. The State Secretary answered at length with data and policy measures, but said some figures (shortages per profession, unemployed staff, costs of external hires, complexity trends) cannot be provided, and committed to informing parliament on regional allocation power and new waiting-time figures.
It is not possible to state how large the shortage of specific professional groups in mental health care is at present.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoe groot het tekort aan specifieke beroepsgroepen in de ggz op dit moment is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de bereikbaarheid van testlocaties als gevolg van nieuw beleid van de Stichting Open Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Health about gaps in COVID test-location coverage in rural regions after the Stichting Open Nederland switched to paying per test, and whether this breaches a motion requiring a test within 30 minutes' travel. The minister acknowledged temporary gaps, reported 99% national coverage with new sites opened, said Zeeland was still being addressed, and stated the current system suffices and will be monitored without committing to reinstate per-location payment.
At present the system is sufficient and I will continue to closely monitor the situation.
Op dit moment volstaat het systeem en ik blijf de situatie nauwkeurig volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Aukje de Vries, Kuiken en Van den Berg over doelgroepen die aanzienlijke moeite hebben met het verkrijgen van een coronatoegangsbewijs

MPs from D66, VVD, PvdA and CDA asked the health minister which groups struggle to obtain a COVID certificate, including people vaccinated abroad, people without a BSN, and those medically unable to test, and about waiting times and access at GGD Utrecht. The minister answered that the Utrecht service is limited to non-EU vaccinees resident in the Netherlands or Dutch nationals, that solutions for other groups are being explored, and that additional locations (such as Groningen) are being prepared.
It is currently being explored whether people from this group who can make it plausible that they live in the Netherlands and do not yet have a BSN can also be helped.
Er wordt momenteel verkend of mensen uit deze groep die aannemelijk kunnen maken dat zij woonachtig zijn in Nederland en nog geen BSN hebben, ook geholpen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van den Berg over het artikel 'Bas van den Dungen toezichthouder bij Amphia'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Van den Berg asked the Minister of Interior whether a top civil servant's secondary position on a hospital supervisory board was properly approved. The minister answered that the procedure under the civil service rules and integrity code was followed, with tailored conditions, and saw no obstacle to the role.
I see no obstacle to exercising this secondary position.
Ik zie geen belemmering voor het uitoefenen van deze nevenfunctie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht Nieuw record aan beleggingen in zorgvastgoed

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about foreign investment in healthcare real estate, including the sale of part of Albert Schweitzer hospital's property to NorthWest Healthcare REIT, who supervises such sales, and why foreign investors find the Dutch market attractive. The minister answered that the CSZ supervises sales by Wtzi-approved institutions but the property sale was by a non-Wtzi property BV and so falls outside CSZ oversight, that foreign investors are bound by Dutch rules, and that the reasons for foreign interest are not fully clear.
The recent sale, however, was from the property BV to the new investor, so it does not fall under the CSZ's supervision.
De recente verkoop is echter van de vastgoed BV aan de nieuwe investeerder, waardoor dit niet onder het toezicht van het CSZ valt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de artikelen 'accountantscontrole op 'coronawinst' ziekenhuizen ontbreekt' en 'solidariteit onder ziekenhuizen ontbreekt bij financiële afhandeling coronacrisis'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the lack of accountant checks on hospital 'corona profits' and solidarity among hospitals in settling COVID compensation, including hospital-level compensation figures and whether hospital directors must declare no double funding. The minister said the ministry lacks hospital-level data because insurers call it commercially confidential and 2020 settlements are not final, pointed to insurer contract clauses and NZa rules against double funding, and declined to add a declaration requirement for hospital directors.
VWS does not have an overview of the financial compensation for loss of income and additional costs per hospital.
VWS beschikt niet over een overzicht van de financiële compensatie voor inkomstenderving en meerkosten per ziekenhuis.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van den Berg over het factsheet voor GGD-medewerkers van test- of vaccinatiestraten, van klantcontactcentra (KCC), van bron- en contactonderzoeken en van vaccinatiesessies t.b.v.

CDA MPs Peters and Van den Berg asked the State Secretary for Health about a GGD factsheet for staff at test, vaccination, contact-centre and contact-tracing sites on recognising and reporting child and domestic abuse, questioning under-reporting, the number of reports, and the burden of reports handled by Veilig Thuis. The State Secretary answered that no figures exist on reports from GGD sites, that the factsheet does not steer staff toward reporting, that Veilig Thuis triages most reports to local support, and that a more transparent child protection system is being developed.
There are no figures known on the number of reports made via GGD test or vaccination sites.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend van het aantal meldingen dat via GGD test- of vaccinatiestraten is gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over ventilatie

Two CDA MPs asked the health and education ministers about ventilation in schools and buildings, including past instructions, the SUViS subsidy, the Bouwbesluit compliance, and studies such as the Binnenklimaat label. The minister answered that guidance and webinars were provided, that compliance data is not centrally held, that the SUViS funds were exhausted, and that the RIVM advice has not changed; the research motion on air purifiers is still being scoped.
There is no central picture of how many schools comply with the Bouwbesluit.
Er is dus geen centraal beeld hoeveel scholen voldoen aan het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van den Berg en Kuik over de aanpak van mensenhandel in de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk

MPs asked about the government's approach to human trafficking in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, including prosecutions, victim reporting, information sharing and whether the National Rapporteur's mandate should extend to the BES islands. The government answered that combating trafficking is largely a country matter, gave case and reporting figures for Caribbean Netherlands, declined to extend the National Rapporteur's mandate, and committed to raising the issue at the next Justice Ministers' meeting and evaluating the MoU in 2022.

Are you willing to come to the budget debate for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations with scenarios on how information gathering, information sharing, reception, investigation and prosecution of human trafficking in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom can be improved?

Bent u bereid voor de behandeling van de begroting Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties met scenario's te komen hoe de informatievergaring, informatiedeling, opvang, opsporing en vervolging op het gebied van mensenhandel in de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk kan worden verbeterd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de berichten 'Kamervragen over nachtelijke HAP sluiting in Oostburg?' en 'Koester al het jonge bloed'

An MP asked the Minister about a pilot to close the Oostburg out-of-hours GP post at night, distance to Terneuzen, cross-border care, death certification, GP working hours and training placement rules. The Minister answered that arrangements are the responsibility of local GPs and the insurer, that 92% of residents remain within the 30-minute norm, and declined to disclose confidential data on Knokke providers while promising to explore physician-assistant involvement in death certification.
How out-of-hours care is organised is the shared responsibility of the GPs in the region together with the health insurer.
Hoe het zorgaanbod in de avond-, nacht-, en weekenduren is ingericht, is de gezamenlijke verantwoordelijkheid van de huisartsen in de regio in samenwerking met de zorgverzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het artikel Twee medewerkers Haagse ggz-instelling ernstig gewond bij geweldsincident, verdachte dood gevonden

An MP asked the state secretary about a shooting incident that began at a Parnassia mental health clinic in The Hague, and about weapons checks, prior incident reports, protections for staff and the handling of aggressive patients. The state secretary answered that no weapons checks are done at such low-threshold clinics, that no prior reports were known to the IGJ, and listed existing protocols, training, a sector-wide approach to aggression and a subsidy route, while stating that investigation of the incident is still ongoing.
A shooting incident took place in the Parnassia premises on Leggelostraat in The Hague. I cannot say more about this at the moment, because the investigation into this incident is still ongoing.

Er heeft een schietincident plaatsgevonden in het pand van Parnassia aan de Leggelostraat in Den Haag. Meer kan ik daar op dit moment nog niet over zeggen, omdat het onderzoek naar dit incident nog gaande is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van den Berg over het artikel “Vissen in windpark nu al kansloos” dat onlangs verscheen in de Provinciale Zeeuwse Courant

Two CDA MPs asked the minister why staandwant and jigging were excluded from an experimental fishing project in the Borssele offshore wind farm, and whether this fits a project meant to generate knowledge. The minister answered that these gear types are excluded because safety and ecological suitability have not been shown, that knowledge can be gathered outside the wind farm, and that the government will develop a policy framework and remains open to supporting fishers.
It is only not permitted to experiment in wind energy areas with fishing gear for which it has not been shown that it can be operated safely and included in the BAS.
Het is alleen niet toegestaan in windenergiegebieden te experimenteren met vistuigen waarvan niet is aangetoond dat deze veilig uitgevoerd kunnen worden en hiermee in het BAS kunnen worden opgenomen
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Quin Dokters kampt met een acuut tekort aan huisartsen’

An MP asked the minister about Quin Dokters, a GP practice group facing an acute shortage of GPs that left about 14,000 patients without access, including questions on app safety, the inspectorate's oversight, takeovers of practices and possible NZa investigation. The state secretary answered that the IGJ is monitoring and investigating, that capacity measures have been taken, and that the NZa sees no reason to investigate insurers, while placing most responsibility for quality of care with the provider.
The IGJ has received signals about the accessibility and availability of Quin Dokters' practices.
De IGJ heeft signalen ontvangen over de bereikbaarheid en toegankelijkheid van de praktijken van Quin Dokters.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van den Berg over de uitvoering van de motie jaarverantwoordingsplicht (Kamerstuk 35 830 XVI, nr. 14)

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van den Berg asked the minister how the motion on annual public accountability for primary care providers is being implemented, including whether the government will reconsider the regulation, share the SIRA cost calculation and ATR opinions, and justify the CBS questionnaire. The state secretary answers that the compromise regulation stays, that alternatives proposed by the Eerstelijnscoalitie do not fit the law's purpose, that the regulatory burden for small providers fell 91% to under two hours a year, and that the ATR advice was addressed by shortening the questionnaire and adding a digital decision tree.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de berichten 'Flinke toename aantal nieuwe besmettingen, ook aantal coronapatiënten in ziekenhuis toegenomen' en 'Reizigers verbazen zich over coronacontrole op luchthaven

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports of rising COVID-19 infections and weak checks on travellers at airports. The minister answered that infections among returning travellers rose, that check procedures at Schiphol are mainly random spot checks, and that the GGD vaccination drive for travellers at Schiphol was stopped due to low uptake.
On arrival in the Netherlands, for example at Schiphol, random spot checks are carried out to see whether travellers with a valid corona certificate have travelled.
Bij aankomst in Nederland wordt, bijvoorbeeld op Schiphol, steekproefsgewijs gecontroleerd of reizigers met een geldig coronabewijs gereisd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bekendheidsonderzoek over PGO

A CDA MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a survey on awareness of personal health records (PGO), their role in digitising care, the state of their development, and how best practices are spread. The State Secretary said the survey shows more information is needed, described PGO development and MedMij certification, and outlined the alliance and programme activities promoting PGO use.
The study clearly shows that information about the usefulness and necessity of PGOs is needed.
Het onderzoek laat duidelijk zien dat voorlichting over nut en noodzaak van PGO’s nodig is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over de artikelen ‘Inzet UHR-screening kan jaarlijks 1.800 psychoses voorkomen’ en ‘The Clinical High Risk for Psychosis (CHR-P) Model Is Flawed’

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary about articles claiming UHR screening could prevent 1,800 psychoses yearly and that the CHR-P model is flawed, asking about its origin, age limits, costs, effects and who decides and pays. The State Secretary answered that the Psychose care standard dates from 2017, explained the age range and cost-saving evidence, and argued that the critical article does not oppose screening within the UHR group, with care reimbursed under the basic insurance where it follows the standard.
The Psychose care standard is not a new care standard.
De zorgstandaard Psychose is geen nieuwe zorgstandaard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Neem ons verhaal serieus, scheep ons niet zomaar af’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a newspaper report on relatives of a woman who died after COVID-19 vaccination, who felt dismissed, and about rights to request autopsies, reporting to Lareb and registration of post-vaccination deaths. The minister answered that autopsy requires consent and cannot be enforced, that reporting duties apply to clinicians when a link is suspected, and that Lareb assesses cases with limited information.
It is not always possible to establish the cause of death.
Het niet altijd mogelijk om te achterhalen wat de oorzaak is van overlijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de uitzending van het TV-programma Pointer van 7 juni 2021

An MP asked the state secretary about a Pointer broadcast on ggz patients with complex needs who are refused by providers, including whether such patients can be counted, whether enough treatment exists, whether an acceptance obligation should be investigated, and how to improve identification and provision. The state secretary acknowledged the problems, stated that these patients cannot currently be registered, pointed to regional tables and new funding mechanisms, but rejected an acceptance obligation.
I am not in favour of an acceptance obligation in mental health care.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een acceptatieplicht in de ggz.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht dat vrouwen die een mislukte cosmetische operaties hebben ondergaan, hard onder druk worden gezet om daar geen negatieve recensies over op sociale media te zet

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that women with failed cosmetic surgery were pressured by intermediary agencies, through silence contracts and threats, not to post negative reviews, and asked about IGJ oversight, reporting duties and a campaign. The Minister said such practices are unacceptable and pointed to existing complaint channels, a bill making silence clauses void, and the IGJ's limited reach over foreign-based agencies, while rejecting a mandatory reporting duty for surgeons.
I find such practices unacceptable; silence contracts are therefore highly undesirable.
Ik vind dergelijke praktijken onacceptabel; zwijgcontracten zijn dan ook zeer ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de toekomst van het ziekenhuis in Zutphen

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the uncertain future of the Gelre hospital in Zutphen, its decision-making process, regional demographic data, emergency department figures and the link to the national recovery plan. The minister answered largely by relaying information from Gelre Ziekenhuizen and Zilveren Kruis, stated that no closure is planned, and pointed to a forthcoming ministerial regulation for the motion-based impact assessments.
Your House has meanwhile received a draft of this ministerial regulation.
Uw Kamer heeft inmiddels een concept van deze ministeriële regeling ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Noodkreet: tandarts gezocht voor Rotterdam, laat meer studenten toe’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about regional shortages of dentists in Zeeland and Rotterdam, dental care for children, training capacity and whether regional inventories and policy options will be produced. The Minister acknowledges the shortages and planned monitoring and a 2022 Capaciteitsorgaan forecast, but states no additional funding is available for expanding training places and that new training programmes are a matter for education institutions and the CDHO procedure.
The Capaciteitsorgaan will also map the regional distribution of dentists and dental visits in its next forecast in 2022.
Het Capaciteitsorgaan zal in zijn volgende raming in 2022 ook de regionale spreiding van tandartsen en van tandartsbezoek in kaart brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over longkankerpatiënten die overlijden zonder dat ze de beste behandeling kregen

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that lung cancer patients miss targeted therapy because molecular testing (such as NGS) is not done uniformly across clinics, and about the use of immunotherapy without biomarker testing. The Minister acknowledges uneven testing and inequality, points to ongoing work with the Zorginstituut on molecular diagnostics and centralisation of complex diagnostics, but states no concrete new legal change.
I find it undesirable that patients currently do not have the same access to diagnostics and care.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat patiënten momenteel niet dezelfde toegang tot diagnostiek en zorg hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Joba van den Berg over het artikel 'Een windcoöperatie in een neoliberale wereld. Het grootkapitaal duwt een burgerinitiatief de markt uit'

The CDA MPs Agnes Mulder and Joba van den Berg asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a newspaper article claiming large developers push out local wind cooperatives, including whether public tendering disadvantages citizen initiatives and whether local binding or ownership should be required. The State Secretary answered that tenders on state land aim for 50% local ownership, that municipalities already have instruments to make participation conditional, and that the government will monitor participation and consider additional measures if needed.
I will critically monitor whether participation indeed comes sufficiently to the fore, and consider additional measures if that proves insufficient.
Ik zal kritisch monitoren of participatie inderdaad voldoende uit de verf komt, en aanvullende maatregelen overwegen als dat onvoldoende gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Varen door de Bruse sluizen vraagt planning: al vijf maanden beperkingen door kapotte brug’

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked the minister about the months-long closure of the Grevelingen bascule bridge near Bruinisse, its causes, traffic delays, maintenance backlog and the reopening date. The minister answered in detail, confirming the bridge reopened on 13 May 2021, explaining that technical control-system faults caused the delay and that the budget came from existing maintenance funds.
During testing in 2020 we established that faults could occur simultaneously in two components that act as each other's back-up.
Bij testen in 2020 hebben we vastgesteld dat het mogelijk is dat er tegelijk storingen kunnen optreden in twee onderdelen die als elkaars «back up» functioneren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'Hoe het CBS en T-Mobile de privacy schonden'

MP Van den Berg (CDA) asked the government about press reports that Statistics Netherlands (CBS) and T-Mobile breached privacy through a mobile data pilot, including the agreements, whether customers were informed, and whether CBS should be stopped pending investigation. Minister Blok answered that the regulators (Agentschap Telecom and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens) are investigating, that CBS is independent so the minister cannot direct it, that the agreement has been published, and that CBS's competition safeguards have been implemented with a Competitive Neutrality Officer and a complaints committee, with the results to be shared with parliament.
The Agentschap Telecom and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens are currently jointly investigating, as supervisory authorities, following the NRC article.
Het Agentschap Telecom en de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens doen op dit moment als toezichthouders samen onderzoek naar aanleiding van het NRC-artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over het bericht dat Duitsland Nederlandstalige vaccinatiebewijzen niet accepteert

MPs Van den Berg and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the health minister whether Germany's refusal to accept Dutch-language vaccination certificates is undesirable and whether the government will seek a temporary recognition of Dutch certificates. The minister confirmed the facts, said the choice of languages is for Germany, reported bilateral talks showing the Dutch registration card does not meet German requirements, and said the government will keep pressing Germany and push the EU Digital COVID Certificate forward.
Yes, we will continue to press for this in our contacts with Germany.
Ja, we blijven ons hier in de contacten met Duitsland voor inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over snel internet voor iedereen

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about universal fast internet, the updated broadband map, whether monitoring suffices to reach 100 Mbps coverage by 2023, the role of government versus the market in hard-to-reach areas, and municipal support. The State Secretary answered that the broadband map has been published, that monitoring is combined with consultation with provinces, that the market has largely delivered but some areas need local tailored solutions with provinces and municipalities, and that discussions with provinces and the VNG continue.
I have agreed with the provinces to discuss the progress and results of those actions with each other in the periodic consultations.
Ik heb afgesproken met provincies om de voortgang en resultaten van die acties in de periodieke overleggen met elkaar te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Zorgmedewerkers ervaren vaccinatiedruk'

MPs Palland and Van den Berg asked whether healthcare workers experience pressure to be vaccinated against COVID-19 from employers or colleagues, and what the government is doing about it. The ministers answered that vaccination must remain voluntary, that about 20 reports of perceived pressure reached unions while the inspectorates received almost none, and that the government relies on persuasion and advice rather than coercion.
Due to the confidentiality of the reports, they cannot provide further information about these reports.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de meldingen kunnen zij geen nadere info verschaffen over deze meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'Geen huisartsenpost in Woensdrecht: ‘De reistijd is amper vier minuten langer’'

An MP asked the health minister about plans to move the Bergen op Zoom out-of-hours GP post to Roosendaal, citing a report that the extra travel time is only four minutes. The minister gave estimated travel times (5 to 8 minutes longer by car, 5 to 7 minutes longer by ambulance), said consultations with residents were postponed due to Covid-19, and declined to provide many visit statistics, saying the provider holds them.
Care providers themselves hold this data and can use it in decision-making.
Zorgaanbieders beschikken zelf over deze gegevens en kunnen deze gebruiken bij besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'Tienduizenden jonge, gezonde mensen gesloopt door corona: ‘Ik neem afscheid van wie ik was’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Medical Care about the four-month referral deadline for paramedical recovery care after COVID-19, and whether it is evidence-based and understood by patients. The minister defends the time limit as rarely a problem in practice, points to a C-support case route and ongoing research, and says the scheme's continuation is still under consideration.
The temporary scheme targets people in the recovery phase after COVID-19 who need paramedical support.
De tijdelijke regeling richt zich op de mensen die in de herstelfase na covid-19 behoefte hebben aan paramedische ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van der Molen over opleidingsplekken voor huisartsen, physican assistants en verpleegkundig specialisten

CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Medical Care and of Education about shortages of GP training places and the funding of physician assistant and nurse specialist training, and whether the Capacity Plan advice could be followed. The government answered that more trainers are needed, that intake is growing more slowly than advised, and that about 22.6 million euros structurally would be needed for the GP advice, with no funds currently available.
At this moment no funds are available in the budgets of OCW and VWS to finance this.
Op dit moment zijn geen middelen beschikbaar op de begroting van OCW en VWS om dit te bekostigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'West-Zeeuws-Vlaamse horeca moet voor Pasen open: 'Als dit nog maanden duurt, gaan bedrijven kapot''

Three CDA MPs asked the minister about the West Zeeland-Flemish hospitality sector's demand to reopen before Easter, the lack of economic perspective in the COVID-19 roadmap, and whether sectors such as hospitality and hairdressing were consulted. The State Secretary answered that the epidemiological situation allows only small steps, that sectors are consulted through regular talks and advisory bodies such as the SER and CPB, and that plans for a phased reopening will be integrated into a periodic revision of the roadmap.
That is why the cabinet has started working with VNO-NCW and MKB-Nederland to formulate plans for a smart reopening of sectors.
Daarom is het kabinet met VNO-NCW en MKB-Nederland aan de slag gegaan om plannen te formuleren voor een slimme heropening van sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'Domper voor winkeliers: PostNL verlaagt vergoedingen'

CDA MPs asked the Minister whether PostNL may cut the compensated hours for shopkeepers hosting parcel service points from eight to six, given that the parcel boom boosts PostNL's turnover, and whether this was decided without consulting retailers. The Minister answered that the carriers voluntarily offered temporary extra compensation, that PostNL may freely end it, and that she sees no reason to intervene in company policy or the civil-law relationship with shopkeepers.
I do not consider it desirable to interfere in PostNL's business operations or in the civil-law relationship between the parcel carrier and the shopkeeper who manages a postal and parcel point.
Ik acht het niet wenselijk om mij te mengen in de bedrijfsvoering van PostNL of in de civielrechtelijke relatie tussen de pakketvervoerder en de winkelier die een post- en pakketpunt beheert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Palland over de telefonische bereikbaarheid in Overijssel

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about poor mobile phone coverage in Overijssel, especially around Vilsteren and Hoge Hexel, and the status of a planned KPN mast. The State Secretary agreed coverage should be optimal everywhere, said KPN plans to realise the Hoge Hexel site by the end of the second quarter of 2021, and said coverage in Vilsteren is not optimal but plans there are less concrete, pointing the municipality of Ommen to existing guidance.
Improving coverage has the attention of mobile operators.
Het verbeteren van de dekking heeft de aandacht van mobiele operators.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de verhuizing van een huisartsenpost naar Roosendaal

An MP asked the minister whether the move of the Bergen op Zoom out-of-hours GP post to Roosendaal, which affects Tholen residents, had been properly decided with consultation of affected parties and whether travel times meet the 30-minute norm. The minister answered that the decision is still provisional, that consultation with residents has been postponed due to Covid-19, and that a RIVM analysis shows 97.8% of residents can still reach a post within 30 minutes.

I therefore consider it important that decision-making on changes to acute care provision proceeds properly and that before a final decision a number of process steps are carefully followed, including early consultation of residents, municipalities, health insurers and care providers.

Ik acht het daarom van belang dat besluitvorming over wijzigingen in het zorgaanbod van acute zorg op een goede manier verloopt en dat voor het nemen van een definitief besluit een aantal processtappen zorgvuldig worden doorlopen, waaronder vroegtijdige consultatie van bewoners, gemeenten, zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Kuik over het bericht 'Schrikbarend veel misbruik van ADHD-medicatie onder Nederlandse studenten'

CDA MPs asked the ministers whether they were alarmed by reports of widespread non-medical use of ADHD medication by Dutch students to boost academic performance, what the Trimbos/RIVM monitor shows, and what action will be taken, including about illegal online medicine sellers registered abroad. The minister answered that the monitor results arrive in mid-2021, that signals are being taken seriously and that action will follow if the monitor does not reassure, and that IGJ has no formal power over websites hosted abroad, though it takes part in Interpol's Operation PANGEA.
If the outcome does not provide a reassuring picture, I am prepared to take action to curb the undesirable development.
Als de uitkomst geen geruststellend beeld oplevert, ben ik bereid over te gaan tot actie om de ongewenste ontwikkeling af te remmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over opleidingsplaatsen voor huisartsen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Medical Care about the shortage of GP training places in Zeeland, a basic doctor's placement in Zwolle rather than Zeeland, and whether the placement rules allow exceptions. The minister said the central placement system aims at even regional spread, that no exceptions are possible after formal placement, and that complaints can be filed with the Commissie Uitvoering Selectie.
After formal placement, no exception is possible.
Na de formele plaatsing is geen uitzondering mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van den Berg over de betrokkenheid van Defensie bij de bestrijding van de pandemie

CDA MPs asked the Defence Minister about Defence's role in the COVID-19 pandemic and vaccination programme, including why only 150 of 1,000 standby soldiers were deployed, how 2009 differed, and whether Defence should host innovation offers. The minister answered that civil authorities lead vaccination, Defence supports planning and standby personnel as requested, and innovation offers are routed to the responsible ministries.
The civil authorities are responsible for the vaccination programme.
De civiele autoriteiten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het vaccinactieprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Van den Berg over de beperkte capaciteiten voor vrachtwagenchauffeurs tijdens de avondklok

CDA MPs Postma and Van den Berg asked whether truck drivers' facilities such as fuel stations, toilets and warm food can stay open during the evening curfew, and how the minister views this. The minister answered that sanitary facilities and fuel stations may stay open, shop opening hours were moved forward, warm drinks may be served at fuel stations since 12 February, and a study on truck parking conditions is under way.
Once the study is complete, I will inform the House of its outcomes and the conclusions I draw from it.
Zodra het onderzoek gereed is, zal ik de Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten en de conclusies die ik eraan verbind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Geurts over de berichten 'Polders tijdelijk onder water om Zeeland veilig te houden' en 'Ontpolderen is niet dé oplossing'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports proposing temporarily flooding polders in Zeeland to protect the region, including who funded the NIOZ study, farmland loss, compensation for farmers, and whether the government will implement the plan. The minister replied that the concept was commissioned and financed by WNF, that it is only one option to be explored within a long-term sea-level rise knowledge programme, and that no decision to implement it has been taken.
For now, this concept of 'double dikes', as one of several concepts and plans, will be included in the Sea Level Rise Knowledge Programme.
Voorlopig wordt dit concept van «dubbele dijken», als één van de concepten en plannen, meegenomen binnen het Kennisprogramma Zeespiegelstijging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur van donderdagavond 10 december 2020 'Sterke stijging anorexiapatiënten tijdens coronacrisis'

CDA MPs asked the government about a Nieuwsuur report on a sharp rise in anorexia patients during the coronavirus crisis, rising waiting lists for complex psychiatric care, bed shortages for anorexia treatment, interim care, regional high-complexity care tables, and the Court of Audit's view that long waits worsen conditions. The State Secretary acknowledged the mental health impact, described measures such as a consultation line, transparency rules and an evaluation of high-complexity care, but gave averages rather than specific anorexia waiting-list figures and did not provide case counts.
I will send you this evaluation.
Ik zal u deze evaluatie doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het aantal ziekenhuisopnames op het corona dashboard

An MP asked the Minister of Health about discrepancies between hospital admission figures on the corona dashboard and figures from hospitals, and whether thresholds were crossed late as a result. The minister explained that the dashboard uses Stichting NICE and LCPS data with different purposes, acknowledged a possible time lag and under-reporting from one hospital, and committed to changing the headline indicator to show new admissions reported that day.
That is why we have now also adjusted the core indicator of hospital admissions.
Daarom hebben we inmiddels ook de kernindicator van ziekenhuisopnames aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Bergkamp over het ontbreken van chiropractors en osteopaten op de lijst van uitgezonderde contactberoepen

MPs Van den Berg and Bergkamp asked why osteopaths and chiropractors were left off the list of exempt contact professions during the lockdown, despite some patients needing their care. The Minister answered that exemptions follow existing law (Zvw, Wlz, Wmo, Jeugdwet, BIG), that osteopathy and chiropractic are not basic insured care and have no protected titles, and that patients can be referred to physiotherapists and GPs.

I will therefore bring this group of people to the attention of the national professional organisations of GPs and physiotherapists, so that they can help or refer these people to the right specialist where needed.

Ik ga deze groep mensen daarom onder de aandacht brengen van de landelijke beroepsorganisaties van huisartsen en fysiotherapeuten, zodat zij deze mensen zo nodig kunnen helpen of doorverwijzen naar de juiste specialist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Van den Berg over het bericht dat alle landen om ons heen al vaccineren tegen het rotavirus

Two CDA MPs asked whether rotavirus vaccination for all infants should be introduced or reconsidered early to relieve hospital pressure during the COVID crisis. The State Secretary answered that the Health Council will advise on rotavirus vaccination this year, that a temporary extra vaccination needs the same thorough assessment, and that COVID-related measures and a healthy lifestyle campaign are the current prevention focus.
The advice on rotavirus vaccination will be taken up by the Health Council later this year.
Het advies rondom rotavirusvaccinatie zal in de loop van dit jaar worden opgepakt door de Gezondheidsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'NZa legt Emergis verplichting op voor aanmerkelijke marktmacht'

An MP asks the State Secretary about the NZa's imposition of obligations on mental health provider Emergis due to significant market power, its regional impact, the sector's reaction, and how insurers account for regional circumstances and tariffs. The State Secretary confirms the decision, affirms regional accessibility, declines substantive comment on the decision given the regulator's independence and possible appeal, and explains insurers' duty of care and that tariffs played no role in this case.
Given the independent position of the NZa and the fact that it is for the administrative court to review this decision, I do not give a substantive response to this specific NZa decision.
Gelet op onafhankelijke positie van de NZa en gelet op het feit dat het aan de bestuursrechter is om dit besluit te toetsen, geef ik geen inhoudelijke reactie op dit specifieke besluit van de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Dam over de uitzending het interview met burgemeester Aboutaleb van Rotterdam

Two CDA MPs asked whether people awaiting or with a positive COVID-19 test should be obliged to stay home, and whether mayors can enforce this under the Public Health Act. The minister agreed that such people should stay home, confirmed that stay-at-home is currently voluntary, and explained that mandatory quarantine lies with the safety region chair under the Wpg, not the mayor, so mayors cannot enforce it without amending the law.
Without amending the Wpg, mayors therefore have no powers to make staying at home mandatory after a positive test result and to enforce that obligation.
Zonder aanpassing van de Wpg zijn er dus geen mogelijkheden voor burgemeesters om thuisblijven verplicht te stellen bij een positieve testuitslag en om deze verplichting te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over samenwerking Nederlandse universiteiten met China.

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers about Dutch universities' cooperation with China, including whether contracts are tracked centrally, whether guidelines exist, and whether China-specific rules are needed. The government answered that institutions are autonomous and not obliged to register partnerships centrally, that RVO found faculty-level MoUs sometimes escape university board view, and that landen-neutral knowledge-security guidelines are being drafted for the second quarter of 2021.
I will, together with my colleagues, discuss this with the knowledge sector to explore what (administrative) agreements can be made on this.
Ik ga, samen met mijn collega's, hierover in gesprek met de kennissector om te onderzoeken op welke manier we hier (bestuurlijke) afspraken over kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de uitzending van Kassa over fysiotherapie: 'Duurdere aanvullende verzekering voor minder behandelingen'

An MP from the CDA asked the minister, after a Kassa broadcast, whether people with chronic conditions face high physiotherapy costs, whether the chronic-conditions list is still adequate, and how the government will investigate alternatives for including physiotherapy in the basic package. The minister answered that coverage remains broad, that the government is working with the Zorginstituut on a transition track and will report in Q1 2021, and that evidence for all physiotherapy forms is not yet sufficient.
Of course I will inform the House of Representatives about the progress of the transition track on the system advice.
Vanzelfsprekend informeer ik de Tweede Kamer over de voortgang van het overgangstraject systeemadvies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Van den Berg, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over het bericht 'Misstanden bij koeriers zijn eerder regel dan uitzondering'

MPs asked the Social Affairs minister about reports of widespread abuses at parcel and courier firms, including WW recipients working as couriers, workers without valid residence papers and sham constructions, and how these can persist. The minister acknowledged the serious findings from Inspectie SZW, described its sector programme and enforcement, and said the Inspectorate will confront major clients and evaluate in 2022 whether further measures are needed.
I attach great importance to fair, healthy and safe work for all employees.
Ik hecht groot belang aan eerlijk, gezond en veilig werk voor alle werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van den Berg over koude werkplekken in het onderwijs

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Education and of Health about cold classrooms, school ventilation norms, the SUDS/SUViS funding, UV-C and ionisation research, and air purifiers. The minister answered that school boards must ensure a safe workplace and that funding for ventilation (SUViS, opening 1 January 2021) does not cover specific air purifiers, while stating no research commission on UV-C or ionisation is planned for now.
Yes, but I do not expect the impossible of schools.
Ja, maar ik verwacht niet het onmogelijke van scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de financiële situatie van het Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groningen (OZG)

Mr Van den Berg (CDA) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the financial situation of the Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groningen, its contacts with insurers and supervisors, the cause of the insufficient emergency availability payment, possible effects of closing emergency care, catchment numbers, and consultation with regional stakeholders. The Minister answered that talks between the hospital and insurers are ongoing, that the NZa and IGJ have been informed, that the emergency availability payment is being reviewed with the NZa and NVZ, and that closure is not under discussion, while largely deferring responsibility to insurers and the hospital.
The health insurers must meet their duty of care in doing so.
De zorgverzekeraars moeten daarbij voldoen aan hun zorgplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Geurts over kinderboerderijen, boerencampings en zorgboerderijen die Q-koortsregels schenden

MPs Van den Berg and Geurts asked how the government responds to reports that dozens of petting farms and farm campsites broke Q-fever rules, and how the NVWA inspects and follows up on such violations. The minister replied that compliance is checked at about 10% of such farms with 43-55% compliance over four years, that re-inspections are carried out only where needed, and that farms must document vaccination before allowing visitors again.
The NVWA has started an intensive communication campaign this year to point these businesses to the importance of complying with the rules.
De NVWA is dit jaar een intensief communicatietraject gestart om deze bedrijven te wijzen op het belang van naleving van de regels die zijn gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van den Berg, Palland, Postma en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Keuringsinstantie DCI Joure (NKIP) in Chinese handen'

MPs from the CDA asked the Infrastructure and Environment and Economic Affairs ministers whether the Dutch yacht certification body DCI Joure, which became fully Chinese-owned in November 2019, poses risks, whether the takeover could have been screened, and what monitoring applies. The government answered that the takeover falls outside existing investment screening, that accreditation by the RvA and supervision by the ILT ensure quality and independence, and that it sees no national security risk.
The cabinet establishes that there are no risks to national security from the takeover of this body, which oversees the quality of pleasure craft.
Het kabinet stelt vast dat er voor de nationale veiligheid geen risico’s zijn bij de overname van deze instantie, die toeziet op de kwaliteit van plezierjachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over de mogelijke sluiting van de huisartsenpost in Venray
