MPs Van den Berg and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the possible closure of the Venray GP out-of-hours post, consultation with stakeholders, travel times and patient numbers. The minister confirmed a proposed closure decision by Cohesie, said consultation steps under a draft AMvB would be followed, and cited a RIVM analysis showing 99.9% of residents could reach the Venlo post within 30 minutes, while declining to provide patient numbers and admission splits, referring to care providers.
I therefore have no insight into the wishes of each individual GP in the region.
Ik heb dan ook geen inzicht in de wensen van iedere individuele huisarts in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het de leden Van der Berg en Kuik over het bericht 'Termunten is slecht bereik zat: 'We moeten op de dijk staan om te kunnen bellen'’

MPs Van den Berg and Kuik asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about poor mobile coverage in Termunten and Termunterzijl that reportedly leaves residents, businesses and emergency calls unreachable, and about the broader rollout of fast internet and mobile coverage. The State Secretary answered that no complaints are known to the regulator, that emergency-call success rates are high, that a new mast site is being sought with a provider, and that rollout targets are being monitored with updates promised for early 2021.
I am not aware of that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de dreigende sluiting van de spoedapotheek in Amersfoort

An MP asks the Minister whether insurers abruptly terminated the emergency pharmacy contract in Amersfoort, whether consultation took place, and what the Minister will do given earlier commitments to dialogue. The Minister confirms the termination, explains insurers' reasoning about pharmacy transparency on tariffs, and says supply will be taken over by another pharmacy in Utrecht.
Insurers conclude contracts with pharmacies on a non-competitive basis.
Verzekeraars sluiten op non-concurrentiële basis contracten af met dienstapotheken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'Wildgroei aan «beunhaas-behandelaars» bij populaire traumatherapie EMDR'

An MP asked the state secretary whether anyone can call themselves an EMDR therapist, whether the Netherlands has the most EMDR therapists per capita, and how consumers can verify training, among other questions about psychology registers and training places. The state secretary answered that individual treatment methods are not regulated under the Wet BIG, that quality is safeguarded through the Wkkgz and the IGJ, and that registers and training capacity are being discussed with professional bodies.
It does not fit within the Wet BIG to regulate individual treatment methods.
Het past niet binnen de Wet BIG om individuele behandelmethoden te reguleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van den Berg en Moorlag over pakketbezorging in de ‘last mile’

MPs Van den Berg and Moorlag asked the State Secretary about ACM and TNO findings on last-mile parcel delivery, its sustainability, the share of e-commerce in traffic, the expansion of pickup points, and further research. The government answered that the market functions well, that pickup points can reduce CO2 if consumers collect on foot or by bike, that the matter is largely left to market parties and municipalities, and that existing research and pilots are ongoing.
I am willing to initiate this research.
Bent u bereid dit onderzoek te initiëren?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Amsterdamse universiteiten gaan samenwerken met Huawei'

MPs Van der Molen and Van den Berg (CDA) asked ministers about reports that Amsterdam universities would collaborate with Huawei on AI research, including the role of security services, dual-use concerns, and the need for national-security frameworks. The government answered that universities are autonomous and responsible for their own partnership decisions, that AIVD and NCTV advised on risks without formal approval power, and that the government is developing additional knowledge-security measures.
The Dutch intelligence and security services have no role in approving or disapproving such collaborations.
De Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten hebben geen rol in het goed- of afkeuren van dergelijke samenwerkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Van den Berg over de uitzending van Max meldpunt 'Driekwart mantelzorgers overbelast na coronaperiode'

CDA MPs asked the health minister about a survey finding that many informal carers are overburdened after the first COVID period and that day-care had not fully resumed. The minister says day-care can resume within RIVM guidelines, that municipalities received compensation and agreements were made with VNG and providers, and points to a carer support ladder and local examples.
Where clients indicate they cannot resolve matters with their provider, the Juiste Loket has been asked to help provider and client reach an appropriate solution through consultation.
Daar waar cliënten aangeven er met hun aanbieder niet uit te komen, is het Juiste Loket gevraagd eraan bij te dragen dat aanbieder en cliënt in overleg tot een passende oplossing komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Paternotte en Raemakers over het tekort aan virusremmer remdesivir tegen corona

Three MPs asked the Health Minister how many remdesivir doses the EU allocated to the Netherlands, when shortages became clear, how the EU distributes supply, and whether shortages would persist. The minister answered that the Netherlands received 24,000 doses for October, that EU allocation follows hospital admission incidence, and that a monthly supply contract with Gilead now applies, though precise longer-term supply and the effect of shortages remain unknown.
The Netherlands was allocated 24,000 doses (for about 4,000 patients) for the month of October.
Nederland heeft voor de maand oktober een hoeveelheid van 24.000 doses (voor ongeveer 4000 patiënten) toegewezen gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over de uitzending van Zembla over Apotex

Two CDA MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about the sale of Apotex Leiden to Indian firm Aurobindo, the risks of dependence on foreign medicine production, and related investment screening. The minister answered that the state is willing to provide a loan to help a Dutch takeover by Innogenerics, that no talks with the top of Apotex took place, and that the government is working on EU-level mapping of medicine supply chains and a broader investment screening mechanism.
I am in consultation with sectors and experts to discuss what a good approach is to move further on this.
Ik ben in overleg met sectoren en deskundigen om te bespreken wat een goede aanpak is om hierin verder te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van der Molen en Van den Berg over het bericht dat China wereldwijd 2,4 miljoen sleutelfiguren volgt

CDA MPs asked the ministers about reports that China's Zhenhua Data tracks 2.4 million key figures worldwide, including whether Dutch people are in the database and whether the government will act. The government confirmed it was informed, said Dutch persons with special roles in the democratic order were notified, saw no indications of Chinese security service orders or a link to a social credit system, and pointed to existing resilience measures and telecom security rules.
I have been informed about the database.
Ik ben geïnformeerd over de databank.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Hack bij Apollo Vredestein toont zwakke cyberbeveiliging Nederlandse bedrijven' en het bericht 'Overheid wist wie kwetsbaar was, maar liet bedrij

Two MPs (Van den Berg and Amhaouch, CDA) asked the ministers about reports of a hack at Apollo Vredestein and claims that government knew which firms were vulnerable but did not warn them, raising questions on SME cyber-security, incident reporting duties and NCSC mandate limits. The government answered that cyber-security is a priority, that voluntary measures and the Digital Trust Center cover non-vital firms, and that the NCSC could not lawfully share certain threat data at the time, with a planned DTC expansion and a review of government powers in digital crises.

In addition, the NCSC has a statutory task, insofar as necessary to prevent adverse societal consequences, to pass on information about threats and incidents concerning network and information systems of other organisations, including personal data obtained from analyses for its primary task.

Daarnaast heeft het NCSC, voor zover noodzakelijk ter voorkoming van nadelige maatschappelijke gevolgen, krachtens de wet als taak om informatie over dreigingen en incidenten met betrekking tot netwerk- en informatiesystemen van andere organisaties (waaronder ook persoonsgegevens), die is verkregen bij analyses ten behoeve van de primaire taak, door te verstrekken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Van der Molen, Weverling en El Yassini ten behoeve van het VAO Telecommunicatie

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and Climate about the commercial radio advertising market during COVID-19, including revenue shares, job losses, support measures, litigation over frequency licences, the 2003 auction, and DAB+ penetration and FM switch-off timing. The State Secretary answered on substance in most points, citing SEO, ACM and Dialogic studies, and declined to disclose some figures as commercially confidential.

An exact breakdown between large and smaller commercial stations on the one hand, and between commercial and public broadcasters on the other, is difficult to provide because this concerns commercially confidential information.

Een exacte verdeling tussen grote en kleinere commerciële stations enerzijds en tussen commerciële en publieke omroepen anderzijds is lastig te geven omdat het hier om bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Rog over het al dan niet verplicht dragen van mondkapjes in het leerlingenvervoer

MPs Van den Berg and Rog (CDA) asked why the emergency regulation requires masks for travellers aged 13 and over while official guidance exempts pupils in special secondary education, and asked for clarity before schools reopened. The minister confirmed the regulation prevails over sector protocols, said pupils need not wear masks in school transport, and announced a formal instruction to safety regions ending enforcement of the mask requirement for that transport.
This clarity is provided through an additional instruction to the chairs of the safety regions under the Public Health Act
Deze duidelijkheid wordt geboden door een aanvullende aanwijzing aan de voorzitters van de veiligheidsregio’s op grond van de Wet publieke gezondheid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de stand van zaken rond het testbeleid, laboratoriumcapaciteit en ventilatie

An MP asked the Minister of Health about COVID-19 testing capacity, laboratory bottlenecks, the reagent supply, testing policy, and whether filters or UV/ionisation systems could improve ventilation. The Minister attributed delays to laboratory setbacks and international reagent shortages, stated that testing is limited to symptomatic people as current policy, and said RIVM does not currently study UV-C or ionisation systems while filters are only partly useful.
I will keep your House informed of the progress of the elaboration.
Ik houd uw Kamer op de hoogte van de voortgang van de uitwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Peters, Bergkamp en Diertens over het belang van ventilatie tegen de verspreiding van het coronavirus

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the health minister how seriously the government takes airborne transmission of COVID-19 and ventilation, and whether guidance and enforcement of building ventilation rules are adequate. The minister said the RIVM sees insufficient evidence for additional ventilation measures, pointed to existing guidance and to municipalities and building owners for enforcement, and noted that information has been published.
It is uncertain whether a specific ventilation (threshold) as an additional measure actually contributes to preventing or reducing SARS-CoV-2 transmission.
Het is onzeker of een bepaalde ventilatie(drempel) als aanvullende maatregel een daadwerkelijk bijdrage levert aan het voorkomen of verminderen van SARS-CoV-2-transmissie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over dat kermisexploitanten boos zijn over het annuleren van Park Hilaria

CDA MPs asked the minister why municipalities are not granting fair permits after COVID rules allowed small fairs from 1 July 2020, and whether the government will talk with the VNG and fix delayed SBI business-code changes for fairground operators. The state secretary answered that municipalities cite short notice, location safety, financial feasibility and enforcement, that the SBI-code reassessment process for TOGS/TVL has been handled, and that the VNG was already urged to support the sector, without committing to a new meeting.
It falls under the statutory authority of municipalities to grant permits for events, including fairs.
Het valt onder de wettelijke bevoegdheid van de gemeenten om vergunningen voor evenementen, waaronder kermissen, te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Van den Berg over de webinar ‘Schouwen door PA en VS: Welbeschouwd een goed idee?!’

MPs Regterschot and Van den Berg asked whether physician assistants and verpleegkundig specialisten could be authorised to perform natural-death inspections (lijkschouw) to relieve doctors, and whether the Wlb should be amended. The minister answered that taakherschikking is not opposed if quality can be shown, that research via ZonMw and a further exploration this autumn will be undertaken, and that the need for a Wlb amendment will be considered.
Before taking the step to prepare the necessary amendment of article 3 of the Wlb, thorough research must first be done into the possibilities for task redistribution.

Alvorens de stap te zetten tot voorbereiding van de benodigde wetswijziging van artikel 3 van de Wlb, zal daarom eerst gedegen onderzoek moeten worden gedaan naar de mogelijkheden tot taakherschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘'Terrorbuurman' slaat opnieuw toe, Kees D. zorgt dagelijks voor angst en overlast’

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg asked about a neighbour causing fear and nuisance, reportedly ignoring a court-ordered outpatient care order and a contact ban, and asked what action can be taken. The state secretary declined to comment on the individual case, explained the probation and prosecution route for breaches of conditions, the Wvggz and Wfz coercive-care options, and a new national reporting line, without committing to a specific new action.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Rog en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Haast geboden met ventilatie op scholen’

Three CDA MPs asked ministers whether ventilation rules for schools were known before the school year, how many schools meet current Bouwbesluit ventilation standards, and what measures RIVM, the Belastingdienst and ministries took. The government answered that existing building code rules apply, that school boards are responsible and no data on school ventilation is collected, and that the answers to the questions were delayed.
No data are collected or kept on the ventilation of school buildings.
Er worden geen gegevens verzameld of bijgehouden over de ventilatie van schoolgebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van Helvert en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Viecurie vreest voor zelfstandigheid'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister for Medical Care about the cancelled merger between VieCuri and Laurentius hospitals and its consequences for regional acute care, emergency departments, obstetrics, and decision-making. The minister answered that the government leaves the matter to hospitals and insurers, that quality of care must be safeguarded, and described the regional data, stakeholder views and involvement in the decision.
It is for the health insurers to talk with the hospitals to secure continuity and quality of care.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraars om met de ziekenhuizen in gesprek te gaan om de continuïteit en kwaliteit te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Geluk-Poortvliet en Peters over het bericht ‘Zorgondernemer betaalde zichzelf tonnen uit terwijl zijn bedrijven in zwaar weer verkeerden’

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Health why the inspectorate tolerated Olcea's poor care for years, whether municipalities and insurers were informed, and how a founder could restart a business after bankruptcy. The minister answered in detail on inspection history, the curator's handling of the sale, contract termination, and planned tightening of entry rules, while stating that some questions fall under other responsibilities or cannot be answered for individual cases.
The Tax Authority itself cannot address individual cases because of its fiscal confidentiality obligation.
De Belastingdienst kan zelf vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over met de kankerverwekkende stof PCA vervuilde paracetamol

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Medical Care about paracetamol contaminated with the carcinogenic substance PCA, including the timing of an IGJ investigation, differing EMA/EFSA safety limits, the non-disclosure of the Chinese supplier's customers, and whether shops should be consulted. The minister replied that the CBG and IGJ examined batches with the regulatory limits in mind, that the ICH M7 approach was retained, that supplier names are commercially confidential under the Dutch WOB, and that no product recall or retailer consultation was warranted.
The CBG does not provide data on the basis of joint agreements.
Het CBG verstrekt geen gegevens op basis van gezamenlijke afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het voorkomen van bill shocks bij mobiel datagebruik

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about how mobile operators prevent unexpected high data bills, whether notifications are mandatory, and whether legislation is needed beyond the voluntary 2012 Transparency Code. The State Secretary replied that complaints are few, that the three largest operators follow the code and send 80% and 100% usage notifications, and that legislation implementing the EU Telecom Code is planned to make such information mandatory for all providers.
For market-wide compliance, which can be enforced by the ACM where necessary, legislation is the most effective.
Voor marktbrede naleving, die zo nodig kan worden gehandhaafd door de ACM, is wetgeving het meest effectief.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Directeur Astron over zijn radiotelescoop versus de windmolens: ‘Lofar zou van beschermd nationaal belang moeten zijn’’

Three MPs (CDA and VVD) asked whether large national research infrastructure such as LOFAR deserves national protection, what the effects of 5G are on the Westerbork radio telescope, and whether ASTRON's measurements can be preserved. The minister replied that LOFAR is of national importance and is protected by regional permitting, that a 10 km protection zone with licence conditions shields Westerbork from 5G interference, and that talks with ASTRON and licensees will be arranged.
The Agentschap Telecom, based on internationally used and Dutch-specific calculation models, determined a 10-km protection zone around the radio telescopes at Westerbork.

Het Agentschap Telecom heeft op basis van internationaal gehanteerde en op de specifieke Nederlandse situatie toegespitste rekenmodellen een beschermingszone bepaald van 10 kilometer rond de radiotelescopen in Westerbork.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van den Berg en Von Martels over berichten dat mensen met overgewicht meer risico lopen bij het coronavirus

Three CDA MPs asked the state secretary for Health about links between overweight and severe COVID-19, and about strengthening healthy-lifestyle policy, including UK measures and coordination of local prevention and sport agreements. The state secretary agreed the link is plausible, pointed to existing prevention agreements, promised to monitor UK measures, and announced a RIVM evaluation and further steps on children's marketing and local funding.
By preventively countering overweight, a great deal of disease burden can be prevented.
Met het preventief tegengaan van overgewicht kan veel ziektelast worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over het bericht 'Gommers ziet geen verschil tussen Efteling en kermis: 'Virus niet verspreiden''

CDA MPs asked the health minister whether the NVIC chair's view that fairground visits should be possible under good plans is considered, whether fairground operators' continuity and field labs were addressed, and when clarity would be given. The minister replied that the relaxations announced on 24 June give perspective, that 1.5 metre distancing applies with no maximum headcount including fairs, that the sector will run a field lab and results will be reported to parliament, and that the June relaxations give clarity.
I will inform the House about this.
Ik zal de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over onduidelijkheid rond de voorraad aan mondkapjes

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister for Medical Care about a study showing faulty face masks in care homes, whether supplies are sufficient across care settings, how masks are distributed, the handling of MP Marijnissen's motion on professional discretion, mask quality standards and domestic production. The Minister answers that supply is sufficient for current demand with a reserve stock, that the LCH distributes equipment, that the RIVM guidelines were loosened for professionals, and that EU-level quality standards are being pursued.
I am in favour of good-quality face masks with a good level of protection.
Ik ben een voorstander van kwalitatief goede mondkapjes met een goed beschermingsniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Wie doet na 400 jaar binnenkort het licht uit bij onze financiële sector?'

CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister about a newspaper piece claiming the Dutch financial sector is being handed to foreign parties, and about foreign acquisitions, procurement, government banking, FinTech and critical infrastructure. The minister rejects the premise, says there is no overview of acquisitions by nationality, notes that EU procurement rules bar selecting on location, and states that existing legal tools allow intervention in unwanted foreign takeovers.
There is no overview of how many and which Dutch financial institutions have passed to foreign parties over the past ten years, or the reverse.
Er is geen overzicht van hoeveel en welke Nederlandse financiële instellingen de afgelopen tien jaar zijn overgegaan naar buitenlandse partijen en andersom.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Pandemie zal opmars China niet stuiten, maar juist versnellen’

CDA MPs Van den Berg and Van Helvert asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the COVID-19 crisis would accelerate China's geopolitical expansion in Europe and the Netherlands, and what measures the government would take, including on investment screening and a possible revision of the China strategy. The government replied that it sees no concrete indications of China acting differently than normal, pointed to the FDI screening regulation and planned investment-screening legislation (including a retroactive reference date of 2 June 2020), and said the China strategy's basic approach still holds.
The development of the legislation follows a critical timeline. Introducing the law on an accelerated basis is not desirable.
De totstandkoming van de wet- en regelgeving volgt een kritiek tijdspad. De wet versneld invoeren is niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Volop onbegrip tussen politie en ggz'

MPs Van Dam and Van den Berg asked about reported failures by the police control room and the GGZ-police handover in a fatal Wageningen incident involving a person with confused behaviour. The minister answered that an internal evaluation was published, the handbook was reissued, a new protocol and training were introduced, and a national non-urgent reporting number is due around July 2020.
The police had an initial factual investigation carried out immediately after the incident.
De politie heeft direct na het incident een oriënterend feitenonderzoek laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het effect van het verbod op plastic rietjes op mensen met een beperking

MPs Slootweg and Van den Berg asked the health minister about the effect of the EU-based ban on plastic straws on people with disabilities who depend on them. The minister acknowledges that no adequate alternatives exist yet, points to the medical-device exemption, says a consultation with stakeholders and the ministry of Infrastructure is underway, and offers to organise a meeting with the target group and manufacturers.
I am willing (together with the Ministry of IenW) to organise such a consultation to examine which alternative options exist.
Ik ben bereid (samen met het Ministerie van IenW) om zo’n overleg te organiseren om te onderzoeken welke alternatieve mogelijkheden er zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Dam over het bericht 'Wéér twee gsm-masten in brand, terrorismebestrijder bezorgd'

MPs Van den Berg and Van Dam asked whether arson on phone masts threatens residents' safety and emergency number 112, and how the government will protect masts and 5G infrastructure. The state secretary answered that residents' safety was not known to be at risk, that 112 remains reachable, that 29 arson incidents are registered and the investigation is ongoing, and that ministries are consulting the sector on possible additional measures.
It is currently too early to go into specific security measures.
Het is op dit moment te vroeg om in te gaan op specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de fusieperikelen tussen het streekziekenhuis SKB en het Slingeland ziekenhuis

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the stalled merger between Slingeland and SKB hospitals, including the lack of consultation, transparency, and whether a single hospital was planned. The Minister said the region must keep talking, that Santiz and Menzis have no plan for one hospital, and that the planned regional group has not started; on the joint works council, the Minister said it is for Santiz to decide.
It is for Santiz to establish a works council.
Het is aan het Santiz om een ondernemingsraad (OR) in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over een dakloos gezin dat zich niet kan inschrijven bij gemeenten

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a homeless family reportedly refused registration by several municipalities, and whether the government will enforce the duty to register people without a fixed address. The State Secretary confirmed municipalities have a legal duty to register under the BRP Act, said he was unaware of the specific case, announced a legislative clarification, and offered to look into the situation if the family contacts the RVIG.
Yes, municipalities have the duty to register under the BRP Act.
Ja, gemeenten hebben de plicht tot inschrijving conform de Wet BRP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van den Berg over importheffingen en btw op mondkapjes en andere persoonlijke beschermingsmaterialen, die gebruikt worden in de strijd tegen het coronavirus

MPs Omtzigt and Van den Berg asked the State Secretaries of Finance about import duties and VAT on face masks and protective equipment during the coronavirus crisis, including whether healthcare institutions could be exempted and whether VAT could be lowered and competition rules clarified. The government answered that exemptions are available via EU rules and a Customs permit procedure, that the Netherlands applied for and obtained EU authorisation, that VAT on consumer masks was cut to 0% from 25 May 2020, and that the ACM provides guidance on cooperative purchasing.
The cabinet has decided to temporarily reduce the VAT on domestic sales of face masks to 0%.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om tijdelijk de btw op de binnenlandse verkoop van mondkapjes te verlagen naar 0%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van den Berg over een convenant voor gemeenten en (jeugd)zorgaanbieders om de continuïteit van (jeugd)zorg aan te bieden in tijden van de coronacrisis

CDA MPs asked the health minister about a model agreement between municipalities and youth and care providers to keep care going during the coronavirus crisis, and whether municipalities should guarantee advance payments. The minister confirmed the model was read, said the Rijk and VNG urged municipalities to give financial security until at least 1 June 2020, and said a later April agreement on continued funding superseded the model.
The model agreement dates from March and in its current form is therefore no longer suitable to submit to municipalities.
Het modelconvenant dateert uit maart en is in haar huidige vorm zodoende niet meer geschikt om voor te leggen aan gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over het verlies van het strand bij Zoutelande

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about coastal erosion at Zoutelande after storm Ciara, including whether the periodic sand nourishment approach is adequate, whether the nourishment was delayed by the nitrogen (PAS) ruling, and whether the Spoedwet stikstof could help. The minister answered that the programmatic approach is adequate and climate-resilient, that an accelerated nourishment at Dishoek is being prepared for the 2020 storm season, and that the Spoedwet does not address this situation.
Along the coast of Walcheren, particularly near Dishoek, there was such coastal retreat that an accelerated sand nourishment before the start of the 2020/2021 storm season is necessary.
Langs de kust van Walcheren, met name nabij Dishoek, was sprake van dusdanige kustafslag dat een versnelde zandsuppletie voor aanvang van het stormseizoen 2020/2021 noodzakelijk is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Kuik over de berichten ‘Prestatiedruk in het hoger onderwijs leidt tot misbruik ADHD-medicatie’ en ‘Braindrug modafinil is populair onder studenten, maar ‘je

CDA MPs asked the ministers of Education and Medical Care about reports of ADHD medication and modafinil misuse by students under performance pressure, and about illegal trade, monitoring, prevention and campaigns. The ministers answered that the Amsterdam study is qualitative and not representative, that a RIVM and Trimbos monitor on student mental health and substance use is underway with results expected in 2020 and 2021, that prevention measures will be considered depending on those results, and that the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) is working against illegal online trade within the limits of cross-border enforcement.
The exact scale and extent of trade in ADHD medication and modafinil is insufficiently known.
De exacte schaal en omvang van de handel in ADHD-medicatie en modafinil is onvoldoende bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert en Van den Berg over het Coronafonds van de Europese Commissie en over het Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI)-initiatief van de G20

Three CDA MPs asked the government about the EU coronavirus investment initiative (CRII) allocations per member state, why Poland and Hungary receive large sums while the Netherlands receives very little, and about EU vaccine production and CEPI participation. The ministers answered that the CRII redistributes remaining cohesion funds based mainly on economic prosperity and implementation progress, not on COVID-19 impact, and that the government views CEPI positively and will consider a contribution, with information to follow in the weekly Corona letter.
The size of the available CRII budget per member state is therefore independent of the scale of the COVID-19 crisis in that member state.
De omvang van het beschikbare CRII-budget per lidstaat staat dus los van de omvang van de COVID-19-crisis in de betreffende lidstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Rog over de berichtgeving rondom het coronavirus COVID-19 via de sociale mediakanalen van de Rijksoverheid

MPs Van den Berg and Rog asked why ministry and inspectorate websites lacked school-specific COVID-19 guidance, whether schools were directly informed, and about contingency planning and school trip cancellations. The minister replied that information is centralised on rijksoverheid.nl with a school FAQ linked from the OCW and inspectorate sites, that a central contact point and daily dialogue with education sector bodies exist, and that schools closed until 6 April with contingency planning in place, while declining to provide figures on cancelled trips and referring travel refunds to schools and carriers.
No, I do not have those figures.
Nee, die cijfers heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Vertrouwen tot nulpunt gedaald: ‘We zijn enorm geschrokken, SKB moet zich nu echt afscheiden’’

Two MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about the collapse of trust over a planned hospital merger in the Achterhoek (SKB Winterswijk and Doetinchem), including loss of separate works and client councils, IGJ findings, possible conflicts with NMa conditions, and whether the minister would commission an independent investigation and request sharing of withheld information. The minister answered that the hospital board is responsible for its strategy, the IGJ sees no threat to care quality, a regional picture is due in May 2020, and the board decides what information is commercially sensitive, declining an independent investigation.
No. The Board of Directors of Santiz is responsible for the business operations and strategic direction of its hospital.
Nee. De Raad van Bestuur van Santiz is verantwoordelijk voor de bedrijfsvoering en strategische koers van haar ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van den Berg over onbegrijpelijke ziekenhuisrekeningen

An MP asked the minister why hospital bills based on average DBC tariffs seem unrelated to treatment length and why a 9-hour and a 60-hour rehabilitation treatment can carry the same tariff band, and how insurers check tariffs. The minister defended average DBC pricing as an efficiency incentive, explained the tariff bands and insurers' audit tools, and pointed to ongoing NZa work on price transparency.
I will inform the House of the outcomes of this.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Acuut tekort aan medische hulpmiddelen dreigt, waarschuwt Zwolse klinisch fysicus’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports of looming shortages of medical devices, including neonatal breathing masks, and about EU device regulation delays. The minister said no specific shortage signals were received, pointed to transition periods and stakeholder dialogue, and promised to use the voluntary Eudamed modules.
I have not received any signals about these specific devices no longer being available.
Ik heb geen signalen ontvangen over het niet langer beschikbaar zijn van deze specifieke hulpmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van den Berg en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Exclusief: Interview Citrix CISO, Fermín Sera, waar ging het mis?'

MPs from the CDA asked the Justice minister whether the Citrix vulnerability could have been prevented by timely application of the interim fix, why Dutch government bodies were affected, and whether a legal standoff period before public disclosure should be set. The minister answered that the NCSC advised quickly, government bodies were advised to apply mitigations, no misapplication by government was found, the case is being evaluated, and that a 60-day guideline exists but policy is left to vendors and organisations.
This case is being evaluated on the instructions of the Minister of Justice and Security.
Deze casus wordt geëvalueerd in opdracht van de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert, Van den Berg en Omtzigt over het coronavirus (COVID-19), dat nu in Gangelt is vastgesteld, direct grenzend aan Limburg

MPs of the CDA asked the ministers about COVID-19 cases in Gangelt near the Dutch border, cross-border coordination, quarantine and airport controls, hospital bed capacity, and travel advice. The minister answered that the GGD Zuid-Limburg coordinates with Germany, that airport controls are not considered appropriate, that at least 250 isolation ICU beds exist, and that travel advice follows RIVM risk assessments.
I will answer these questions as soon as possible.
Ik beantwoord deze vragen zo spoedig mogelijk.
Antwoord op de eerste drie vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Kuik en Van Helvert over het coronavirus (COVID-19), dat nu in Noordrijn-Westfalen is vastgesteld, vlakbij Limburg

CDA MPs asked ministers for an update on new COVID-19 infections near the Dutch border, whether German schools had closed, and what advice applies to Dutch schools, firms and travellers. The Minister of Medical Care answered that contact tracing is ongoing in Germany with no need for extra Dutch measures, that German schools closing is noted, and that Dutch schools and workplaces can stay open.
The situation is being closely monitored and measures will follow if necessary.
De situatie wordt op de voet gevolgd en indien nodig volgen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over tekortkomingen van Kustwachtwachthelikopters

MPs Van den Berg and Amhaouch asked about a safety report on the Dutch coast guard SAR helicopters, crew safety, the 2016 OVV findings, crew language skills, the contracting of the Belgian operator, airworthiness oversight and callout figures. The minister referred to the attached research report and response for most substantive points, said the contractor had been awarded the contract on lowest price, placed airworthiness oversight with the Belgian aviation authority, and gave callout numbers for 2017-2019.
I refer you to the research report that I have sent you today.
Ik verwijs u naar het onderzoeksrapport dat ik u heden heb toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Zorginstelling Woerden dreigt gehandicapt stel uit elkaar te halen: Het is mensonterend’

MPs Van den Berg and Slootweg asked the Minister of Health why seven disabled residents of a Woerden care facility must move by 1 February 2020 to distant locations, and whether the process fits the target group. The Minister acknowledged the disruption, said the facility could not keep providing the needed nursing care nearby, and stated that no residents must move to Friesland, Drenthe or Overijssel, while noting some residents still lacked a final choice and that the Inspectorate has followed the developments closely.
Together with the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate I have closely followed developments and consulted with various parties involved.
Samen met de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd heb ik de ontwikkelingen intensief gevolgd en ben ik met verschillende betrokken partijen in overleg gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘MCL legt dataverkeer stil na cyberaanval’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the Leeuwarden hospital's shutdown of external data traffic after a cyberattack, its Citrix server vulnerability, and whether all hospitals have adequate protection and are connected to Z-CERT. The minister answered that patient safety was not endangered, the hospital reported it failed to apply a workaround in time, other hospitals' measures are unknown to him, and mandatory Z-CERT membership is being investigated with a progress report after the summer recess.
Healthcare institutions are themselves responsible for their own ICT and which systems and/or servers they use.
Zorginstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen ICT en welke systemen en/of servers zij gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Omtzigt over het feit dat Italië alle vluchten tussen Italië en China heeft opgeschort

Four CDA MPs asked ministers about Italy suspending China flights, Chinese tourists with coronavirus in Italy, KLM suspending China flights, travel advice, EU coordination, quarantine of returnees, and international support for vulnerable countries. The government answered that Dutch procedures match Italy's, that EU health measures remain with member states, that it follows WHO advice against disproportionate restrictions, and that no additional Dutch funding seems necessary now.
Measures regarding health are reserved to the member states.
Maatregelen ten aanzien van de gezondheid zijn voorbehouden aan de lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Kuik over het Coronavirus

MPs Van den Berg and Kuik asked the government about the new coronavirus, including its mortality compared with Ebola, WHO coordination, Dutch preparedness, travel advice and European measures. The minister answered that mortality is about 2%, that the WHO declared a PHEIC, that Dutch hospitals are prepared with at least 250 isolation ICU beds, and that travel advice and monitoring are being adjusted in line with WHO and ECDC advice.
The Netherlands is well prepared and follows the advice of the WHO and the ECDC.
Nederland is goed voorbereid en volgt hierbij de adviezen van de WHO en het ECDC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Palland over het gelijk speelveld voor fruittelers

MPs Van den Berg and Palland asked whether fruit growers' sales cooperatives can counter buyers, whether market elements create an uneven playing field, whether the ACM has investigated market power in fruit, and when the amended Competition Act and unfair trading practices law take effect. The government answered that growers see themselves as weak, that the agro-nutrimonitor covers six chains but not fruit as a whole, and gave an entry-into-force date of 1 July 2021 for the Competition Act change.
The ACM has so far not conducted any research into the fruit sector as a whole.
De ACM heeft tot op heden geen onderzoek gedaan naar de fruitsector als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van den Berg over het zorginnovatieproject ‘Meer tijd voor de patiënt’ in Afferden

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care why insurer VGZ is not expanding the successful 'More time for the patient' pilot in Afferden, its cost savings, and whether the NZa monitors shifting care to Maasziekenhuis Pantein in Boxmeer. The Minister says VGZ will continue the pilot in four practices in 2020 with possible expansion later, that savings are not yet realised, and that regional data and NZa monitoring results are not yet available.
I do not yet have insight into the outcomes of the NZa monitor.
Ik heb nog geen zicht op de uitkomsten van de monitor van de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Verdachte steekpartij Den Haag gevaar voor zichzelf en omgeving, maar werd niet opgepakt’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that a stabbing suspect, already ordered into forced psychiatric care, was not picked up after failing to appear, and about the chronology of care and police contacts. The government declined to give the detailed chronology, citing ongoing criminal investigation and a parallel IGJ inspection, and only committed to informing the House of relevant findings later.
Since a criminal investigation is ongoing in the case and the trial against the suspect has yet to take place, no statement can be made about the precise sequence of events.
Nu in de zaak strafrechtelijk onderzoek wordt gedaan en het proces tegen de verdachte nog moet worden gevoerd, kan over de precieze gang van zaken geen uitspraak worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Weverling over het bericht 'KPN loopt voor de troepen uit en bouwt ondanks politieke strijd alvast Huawei-zendmasten in de Randstad'

MPs Van den Berg and Weverling asked whether KPN is installing Huawei antennas in its 4G and 5G network despite the parliamentary motions on 5G integrity, and whether this counts as an irreversible step. The State Secretary confirmed KPN began modernising its radio network with Huawei equipment, said several Dutch and EU operators use Huawei gear, and stated the critical components list is confidential while a structural approach with providers is being set up.
The list of critical components is confidential.
De lijst met kritieke onderdelen is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de reorganisatie en het verandertraject van de Gezondheidsraad

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about the reorganisation and change process at the secretariat of the Health Council, including how its director is appointed, the publication record and turnover of staff, and the works council's role. The minister answered that the director was appointed through the regular procedure after the preferred candidate withdrew, that the reorganisation emerged from a change process, and that the works council gave a negative opinion on the reorganisation decision.
The secretariat of the Health Council supports the Health Council in carrying out its advisory task.
Het secretariaat van de Gezondheidsraad ondersteunt de Gezondheidsraad in de uitvoering van de adviestaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Slootweg over "Het bericht dat zorginstelling Pluryn kinderen weigert die specialistische hulp nodig hebben"

MPs Van den Berg and Slootweg asked the Minister of Health about reports that Pluryn, a care institution, is refusing children needing specialist help and is in financial trouble, including rising personnel costs, acquisitions, staffing, property costs and regulator involvement. The minister gave figures on costs, revenue, depreciation, clients and FTEs, declined to discuss governance, acquisitions and property costs as internal matters, and said the NZa had no supervisory role in youth care.
From my position, I do not consider it desirable to intervene in the conduct, relationships and dynamics between the management, supervision and works councils within a specific organisation.
Vanuit mijn positie acht ik het niet wenselijk te treden in het optreden, de relaties en verhoudingen tussen het bestuur, toezicht en medezeggenschap in een specifieke organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de berichten 'Datacenters in Nederland raken in wurggreep van Amerikanen' en 'Nederlandse bouwer van datacenters failliet'

An MP asked ministers whether Dutch data centres and citizens' and companies' data risk falling under US control, who owns government-used data centres, and whether the planned investment screening should be accelerated. The government answered that data centre acquisitions above 40 MW will fall under the draft telecom control law, that the investment screening bill is planned for end-2020, and that the cabinet will examine whether data centres should become vital infrastructure, while deferring details on government-used data centres to a later letter.
At the AO Digitale Overheid of 4 December 2019, the Minister of the Interior committed to inform the House by letter about data centres used by central government.

In het AO Digitale Overheid van 4 december 2019 is door de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties toegezegd uw Kamer per brief te informeren over datacenters die door de rijksoverheid in gebruik zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van den Berg over de financiële toestand van GGZ-instelling Dokter Bosman

MPs Peters and Van den Berg (CDA) asked Minister De Jonge about the financial troubles of GGZ provider Dokter Bosman, including an investor demanding municipal debt write-offs, alleged over-declaration, unfiled accounts, Tax Office claims, and continuity of youth care. The minister answered that profit-taking has no place in care and rules on dividends are being examined, but he lacked insight into the firm's finances, municipalities decide for themselves, the accounts were later filed, and supervisors and the Youth Authority are involved, with the matter now resolved by a takeover.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation under Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, individual cases cannot be addressed.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht, ingevolge artikel 67 Algemene wet rijksbelastingen, kan niet worden ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Slootweg over subsidie voor een nazorgsysteem

MPs Van den Berg and Slootweg asked the Minister for Medical Care why the ministry subsidised a rival aftercare system (HartslagNu) instead of scaling up Hart4all, a proven aftercare system for volunteer first responders. The minister replied that the €1 million subsidy stemmed from the De Lange amendment, required a single alerting network (now achieved) and allowed aftercare innovation, that talks with Hart4all did not yield a joint solution, and that organisations may choose their own aftercare system.
Organisations are free to choose for themselves which aftercare system they use.
Het staat organisaties vrij om zelf te kiezen van welk nazorgsysteem zij gebruik maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'Patiëntenstops bij GGNet voor verzekerden Zilveren Kruis, Interpolis en FBTO'

An MP asks the State Secretary how a patient admission stop at GGNet for insured persons of Zilveren Kruis fits the statutory duty of care, what the insurer is doing to restore care, whether it must contract additional capacity, and whether the NZa monitors and can enforce that duty. The State Secretary answers that the insurer's duty of care is met through referral and extra contracting, that the NZa oversees it and has used only dialogue so far, and that existing enforcement tools are adequate.
Yes, I am of the view that the NZa is adequately equipped.
Ja, ik ben van mening dat de NZa voldoende is toegerust.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels en Van den Berg over het niet exporteren van kernafval naar COVRA maar naar Rusland

MPs Von Martels and Van den Berg asked whether depleted uranium from URENCO is being exported to Russia instead of stored at COVRA, who paid for the storage halls, why exports stopped in 2009, how much is produced and exported, the waste definition, and what Russia does with the material. The government confirmed that URENCO financed the halls, that exports stopped in 2009 with no current plans to resume, withheld export volumes as commercially confidential, explained the waste definition and ANVS supervision, and stated that Russian use is subject to IAEA safeguards and civil end-use guarantees.
The amount of depleted uranium that URENCO Nederland produces and how much of it is exported is commercially confidential information and is therefore not made public.
De hoeveelheid verarmd uranium die URENCO Nederland produceert en hoeveel daarvan wordt geëxporteerd is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en wordt daarom niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Dik-Faber en Van den Berg over het werkbezoek aan het Emma Kinderziekenhuis

MPs asked the minister about problems chronically ill young people face when transitioning to adult care, including loss of parental involvement, financial burdens and DBC billing limits, and about a transition unit and AVG care billing. The minister acknowledged transition challenges, said care providers and insurers should make tailored agreements and that NZa is handling AVG billing, but did not commit to a new transition unit pilot or funding.
I will make inquiries about this in the relevant consultations, such as the regular consultation with the Dutch Federation of University Medical Centres (NFU).
Ik zal hiernaar in de daarvoor in aanmerking komende overleggen, zoals in het reguliere overleg met de de Nederlandse Federatie van Universitair Medische Centra (NFU), navraag doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘NXP verkoopt zijn audiodivisie aan het Chinese Goodix’

An MP asked the economics minister whether NXP's sale of its audio division to China's Goodix, and the resulting national-security risk, warranted government intervention, including the screening criteria used by competition authorities and possible new measures. The government replied that intervention is reserved for direct public interests, that the authority reviews only competition effects, that the telecom ownership bill would not cover this deal, and that it sees no reason yet for new measures beyond planned investment screening.
Only in exceptional cases will the central government consider interventions within the existing frameworks.
Slechts in bijzondere gevallen zal de rijksoverheid binnen de vigerende kaders interventies willen overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'Huisartsenposten zien toename agressie door patiënten'

An MP asked the Minister about reports of rising patient aggression against GP out-of-hours services, including aggression statistics, protocols, sanctions, and comparisons with other countries. The Minister answered that police do not record these incidents separately, that existing guidance and the Eenduidige Landelijke Afspraken apply, and that a joint sector review of aggression prevention will report by end 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Peters en Van den Berg over het gebruik van melatonine als slaapmiddel

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister about calls by about 500 scientists to make melatonin prescription-only, its sale and youth use, the rules under which it is sold, and whether labelling and enforcement are adequate. The Minister answered that melatonin products of 0.3 mg or more are treated as medicines by the IGJ, that jet-lag products sold without prescription are not approved for children, that enforcement is being intensified, but that he does not support making all melatonin prescription-only.
From September the IGJ is intensifying enforcement against unregistered medicines containing melatonin, based on a previously drawn-up enforcement plan that has recently been completed.
De IGJ intensiveert vanaf september de handhaving van niet-geregistreerde geneesmiddelen met melatonine, op basis van een eerder opgesteld handhavingsplan dat recent is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Omtzigt over de sluiting die dreigt voor de spoedpost van de huisartsendienst Twente-Oost

MPs Van den Berg and Omtzigt asked whether the Medisch Spectrum Twente hospital's rent increase, withdrawal of nurses and cooperation changes effectively force closure of the Oldenzaal out-of-hours GP post, and asked about catchment data, regional needs and stakeholder consultation. The minister answered that the post is not financially viable, that partial or full closure is under discussion with a final decision pending, that the RIVM accessibility norm remains met, and that SHT has been asked to hold an information meeting for residents before deciding.
In my view, SHT should organise an information meeting for residents so they can voice their concerns and suggestions before a final decision is taken.

Naar mijn mening zal de SHT een informatiebijeenkomst voor inwoners moeten organiseren om de inwoners de gelegenheid te geven hun zorgen en suggesties te uiten, voordat er een definitief besluit genomen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Apple deelde herleidbare, persoonlijke gegevens bij opnames Siri-gebruikers’

Two CDA MPs asked ministers whether Apple's sharing of identifiable Siri recordings violated privacy, what the Dutch privacy regulator AP had done, which law applies and where citizens should complain, and what the government would do about privacy risks in tech. The ministers answered that the AP is a concerned authority while the Irish regulator leads, that AVG complaint routes exist, that current law is largely adequate with the AVG evaluation to address data volume and profiling, and that a public campaign on privacy will start in spring 2020.
It is up to the competent privacy supervisors in the EU to start an investigation into Apple's conduct.
Het is aan de bevoegde privacytoezichthouders in de EU om een onderzoek te starten naar het handelen van Apple.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de verwachte toename van het aantal geneesmiddelentekorten in 2019

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about the reported increase in drug shortages in 2019, the status of the IGJ and KNMP study on pharmacists breaking rules due to shortages, EU measures and French proposals, and the KNMP call for longer tender periods. The minister confirms notifications nearly doubled, says the inspectorate sees no large-scale re-dispensing so no study is planned now, promises to inform parliament this autumn on stock policy, and notes preferential-tendering periods have already been lengthened.
Given the very small scale of re-dispensing expected by the IGJ and KNMP, it is not advisable to conduct research into the extent of this problem at this time.
Vanwege de door de IGJ en KNMP verwachte zeer kleine schaal waarop heruitgifte plaatsvindt, is het niet aangewezen om thans onderzoek te doen naar de omvang van deze problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg en Geurts over de Nederlandse voorbereiding op een harde Brexit

CDA MPs asked the government about the Dutch preparations for a hard Brexit on 31 October 2019, covering customs staffing and enforcement choices, medicine and medical device shortages, live animal inspection posts and NVWA capacity. The government answered that staffing targets were met, customs and NVWA preparations continue, and that shortages and disruptions cannot be fully ruled out.
The Tweede Kamer was informed about these choices in the cabinet letter dated 18 January 2019.
Over deze keuzes is de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd in de brief van het kabinet d.d. 18 januari 2019
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van den Berg en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politievrijwilliger in ruil voor een weekje aan zee’

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police capacity shortages in holiday areas, including reports that municipalities rent holiday accommodation for volunteer police officers. The minister answered that seasonal peaks are common across holiday regions, that police units support each other and mayors can request assistance, and that the municipal arrangements are an innovative solution he praised, while promising to explore further cooperation with partners such as DJI for prisoner transport.
If local cooperation partners see options for more intensive cooperation, I will investigate what is legally possible.
Indien lokale samenwerkingspartners opties voor intensievere samenwerking zien, dan zal ik onderzoek doen naar wat er wettelijk mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de bijeenkomst op het ministerie met de 'regiegroep Wet BIG II'

An MP asked why the action committee of nurses opposing the BIG-II law was not invited to the planned 10 September 2019 meeting of the BIG-II steering group, and whether the minister would invite them and broaden support for the nurse-splitting law. The minister listed the invited organisations, said the meeting was postponed after some parties asked for that, and that a facilitator would talk with the action committee, while stating that broad support is the priority.
Some parties have since indicated that, given all recent developments, it is wiser to postpone this consultation until further notice.
Inmiddels hebben enkele partijen aangegeven dat het, gelet op alle recente ontwikkelingen, verstandiger is dit overleg tot nader order aan te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de ambulancezorg in Woerdense Verlaat

An MP from the CDA asks the minister about ambulance response times in Woerdense Verlaat, where ambulances often exceed the 15-minute norm, and whether burden-sharing with neighbouring services was used. The minister answers that in 2018 ten of fourteen urgent calls exceeded 15 minutes, that the 95% legal norm reflects practical limits, and that regional steering and a forthcoming quality framework will address the issue.
It is questionable whether patient safety and quality of care would be served by this.
Het is de vraag of de patiëntveiligheid en de kwaliteit van zorg hiermee zijn gediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'ACM: pas eind zomer besluit over overname Apeldoornse Sandd door PostNL'

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports that the competition regulator ACM would only decide in late summer on PostNL's takeover of Sandd, and whether ACM's public timeline communication was appropriate. The state secretary replied that the report contains no new information, that ACM's independent process is governed by statutory deadlines that can be paused by requests for information, and that no hard end date is desirable.
The ACM may request further information from parties in order to reach a proper assessment.
De ACM kan van partijen nadere informatie verlangen om tot een goede beoordeling te kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het huisartsentekort in Zeeland

An MP asked the health minister about the shortage of GPs in Zeeland, the insurer's duty of care, whether the NZa will act against the insurer, the GP action plan with the LHV, and the surplus of basic doctors. The minister answered that the NZa supervises insurers' duty of care and found no reason to act, that a GP action plan is being implemented with long-term timelines, and that the numerus fixus and training places will be reviewed at the end of the year.
It is not for me, but for the NZa, to assess whether the duty of care is being fulfilled.
Het is niet aan mij, maar aan de NZa om te beoordelen of aan de zorgplicht wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de voortgang van het behoud van de zorg in de regio

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister for Medical Care about the planned withdrawal of emergency care in Stadskanaal and Hoogeveen, the Isala plan for Meppel, consultation with regional stakeholders, temporary staffing costs at Treant and the procedure for changes to acute care. The Minister says the regional team is still developing plans in dialogue with the region, that Isala has no plan to change Meppel, and that an AMvB on acute care is not yet in force, so only informal guidance applies, with a handreiking promised for October.
As you know, the AMvB on acute care, in which communication with parties and residents in the region is an important component, has not yet entered into force.
Zoals u weet is de amvb acute zorg, waarin de communicatie met partijen en inwoners in de regio een belangrijk onderdeel is, nog niet in werking getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het toegenomen aantal patiëntenstops als gevolg van drukte op spoedafdelingen

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the doubling of emergency-department patient stops in Noord-Holland and Flevoland, whether consultations with the NZa and LNAZ had produced time-out data, why Zeeland and Twente avoid emergency stops, and whether Amsterdam's stop rate rose after Slotervaart's bankruptcy. The minister said the NZa needs more time to analyse the data, promised a fuller reply by September, and described hospitals' internal measures and regional agreements.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der  Molen  en Van den  Berg over het  bericht 'Universiteiten nemen spionagerisico voor lief'

MPs Van der Molen and Van den Berg asked the ministers whether Dutch universities are exposed to espionage and theft of research findings, whether foreign students should be excluded, and what measures will strengthen security awareness. The government says it is examining broader knowledge-security rules, outlines existing legal tools (Iran and North Korea sanctions screening), declines to give case details or figures, and points to existing platforms and agencies while deferring the outcome of ongoing reviews.
The cabinet does not make public statements about case details that affect the current knowledge level and modus operandi of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over casuïstiek die het actuele kennisniveau en de modus operandi van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Ronnes over het bericht 'KPN legt initiatief voor glasvezel in Beemster lam'

MPs Van den Berg and Ronnes asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about KPN's plan to fiber-connect only the village cores in Beemster, which may undermine the citizen-led Breedband Beemster project. The State Secretary said competition is for the ACM to supervise, that the ACM is running a market study to be published after summer, and that he will invite the initiative to a meeting, but declined to pre-empt the ACM's findings.
I cannot anticipate the outcomes of the ACM's investigation into competition in the fiber market.
Ik kan niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de ACM naar de concurrentie in de glasvezelmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de overbelasting van de spoedeisende hulp in het Leids Universitair Medisch Centrum (LUMC)

MP Van den Berg (CDA) asked the Minister for Medical Care about overcrowding at the emergency department of LUMC in Leiden, the regional distribution of acute care, RIVM regional data and consultations on closing the Bronovo emergency department. The Minister answered that no per-department patient figures are available yet (NZa asked), described the regional-picture approach and the draft AMvB notification and consultation procedure for closures, and listed the consultations held with HMC and with himself.
I do not have an overview per emergency department in the Leiden/The Hague region of the number of persons treated per year.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht met per spoedeisende hulppost in de regio Leiden/Den Haag het aantal personen dat per jaar wordt behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht 'Menzis eist 6 ton van zorgbureau Care Free Twente'

MPs Van den Berg and Geluk-Poortvliet asked the health minister about Menzis's fraud investigation into care agency Care Free Twente, including whether insurers and municipalities check that staff are qualified. The minister confirmed the investigation, described the findings (90 percent unqualified staff and incorrect declarations), explained the insurer's statutory controls, and noted that municipalities set their own contract conditions.
Supervision under the Wkkgz is assigned to the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate.
Het toezicht op de Wkkgz is belegd bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Van den Berg over de stijging van het aantal oxycodonverslaafden

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister about the rising number of oxycodone addicts, the lack of a clear treatment approach, prescribing practices, and patient information. The Minister acknowledged the trend, cited rising NVIC overdose notifications, and described a task force working on a national approach, prescribing guidance and patient information, with a progress letter promised for the second half of 2019.
Unfortunately I cannot give you national figures on the number of users in addiction care because these are not available.
Landelijke cijfers van het aantal gebruikers in de verslavingszorg kan ik u helaas niet geven omdat deze niet voorhanden zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘De behandeldirecteur van de PI Vught die zwaar blunderde bij de overplaatsing van Michael P. is nu bestuurder van Fivoor’

Two CDA MPs asked whether it is acceptable that the prison treatment director criticised for errors in the transfer of Michael P. now leads the clinic Fivoor, and whether the government will act given local residents' distrust of the clinic in Den Dolder. The minister replied that the government does not steer individual appointments at private institutions but on quality and performance, that a broader culture change is being pursued, and that interim measures were agreed with residents, with the inspectorate monitoring the clinic.
Where these performances fall below standard, intervention is possible.
Daar waar deze prestaties onder de maat zijn kan worden ingegrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het doorbreken van het medisch beroepsgeheim bij verdenking van een misdaad

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg asked whether staff at the Mondriaan clinic should have breached medical confidentiality when they suspected a patient was involved in a double murder, and for examples of when a breach is permitted. Staatssecretaris Blokhuis answered that breaching confidentiality requires a careful case-by-case weighing under the conflict-of-duties rules, declined to judge the case while the investigation is ongoing, and gave general examples.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de keuze van Bravis voor Roosendaal als locatie voor het nieuwe ziekenhuis

Mr Van den Berg (CDA) asked the Minister of Medical Care about the RIVM study on ambulance travel times for the Bravis hospital location, consultation with regional stakeholders, and hospital adherence figures. The Minister answered that the RIVM analysis was shared with municipalities and attached, that the hospital consulted stakeholders while the final decision rests with Bravis and its supervisory board, and that the ministry does not hold the adherence figures.
Hospitals hold these data themselves and can use them in decision-making.
Ziekenhuizen beschikken zelf over deze gegevens en kunnen deze gebruiken bij besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Chinese spionnen stelen kostbare bedrijfsgeheimen van ASML'

CDA MPs Van den Berg and Amhaouch asked the ministers about reports that Chinese spies stole trade secrets from ASML, and whether this threatens national security and calls for new measures. The minister answered that the theft by ex-employees of ASML's US subsidiary was serious but showed no direct foreign government involvement, outlined existing legal and advisory protections, and promised an investment screening law in 2019 and a new China strategy.
The aim is to bring such a bill into procedure in 2019 as part of a broader package of measures.
Inzet is om een dergelijk wetsvoorstel in 2019 in procedure te kunnen brengen als onderdeel van een breder palet aan maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Heel zuur dat er door de politie niets aan gedaan wordt’

MPs Van Dam and Van den Berg asked the Justice Minister why police in Zeeland do not pursue thefts of farmers' GPS systems, and how often and where such thefts occur. The minister answered that theft of GPS systems is not separately registered, that investigations follow prioritisation under the Public Prosecution Service and depend on evidence, and that farmers may rely on insurance.
Theft of GPS systems is not registered under a separate code.
Diefstal van GPS-systemen wordt niet onder een aparte code geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over het voornemen van Italië om zich aan te sluiten bij het Chinese Belt and Road investeringsprogramma

CDA MPs asked the government about Italy's planned accession to China's Belt and Road Initiative, its effect on EU unity, Dutch firms and EU screening of Chinese investment. The minister answered that Italy's MoU is a non-binding intention, that EU rules remain fully applicable, that the EU investment screening regulation was being finalised, and that the government would address China in a forthcoming note.
At this moment it is not possible to make an estimate of this.
Op dit moment is het niet mogelijk hiervan een inschatting te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht dat tientallen bedrijven illegaal lipfillers zetten

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of dozens of companies illegally injecting lip fillers, the status of the cosmetic procedures awareness campaign, website visibility, ZonMW-funded research, and the Inspectorate's enforcement powers. The minister answered that a reclame code is in force, the website was updated, research is nearly finished without a publication date, the Inspectorate acts on risk-based supervision and on signals, and no separate data exist on costs of corrective care.
When there are situations where the patient has suffered harm from a treatment and rules are not followed, the inspectorate will intervene.
Wanneer sprake is van situaties waar de patiënt schade heeft ondervonden van een behandeling en waar niet volgens de regels wordt gehandeld zal de inspectie optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de voorgenomen verplaatsing van OK-dagbehandelingen van Woerden naar Utrecht en Nieuwegein

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the planned move of about 3,000 day-surgery patients from Woerden to Utrecht and Nieuwegein, and whether the regional care picture was mapped before the decision. The minister answered that the hospital made the decision, that no complete regional care picture exists yet but an insurer is working on it, and that the Woerden site will be kept and strengthened, while declining to provide detailed adherence figures.
I do not have this detailed information.
Over deze gedetailleerde informatie beschik ik niet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Agnes Mulder over de bescherming van ondernemers uit het midden- kleinbedrijf (mkb) tegen onredelijke energiecontracten en de oproep van de Consumentenbond voor e

MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about protections for small and medium-sized businesses against onerous energy contracts and the Consumentenbond's call for a total ban on telephone sales. The State Secretary answered that small business customers with small connections get consumer protections under energy law, that exit fees are being investigated by the ACM, and that an opt-in regime for telemarketing and an incasso register are being prepared.

Therefore the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate, together with the ACM, will consider after this investigation concludes whether further measures are necessary to better protect small business customers.
Daarom beziet de Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat samen met de ACM na afronding van dit onderzoek of verdere maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn om kleinzakelijke afnemers beter te beschermen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Kuik en Agnes Mulder over het verdwijnen van de spoedeisende zorg in Hoogeveen en Stadskanaal

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about the planned closure of the emergency departments in Hoogeveen and Stadskanaal, including ambulance response times, the role of the ambulance services and regional administrators, and the RIVM accessibility analysis. The Minister replied that the regional core team's plan is not yet a decision, that the RIVM analysis shows the 45-minute norm would still be met, and that the ambulance services are involved in a regional steering group with IGJ and NZa monitoring continuity and quality.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het advies over protonentherapie bij kinderen

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the Health Council's advice on proton therapy for children, including the composition of the advisory committee, its ties to the Prinses Máxima Centrum, the hospital-based requirement and whether the Delft centre can be used. The Minister answered that the committee was carefully composed, that the chair is independent, that the hospital criterion is maintained for safety and care quality, and that the Delft centre's capacity can be used without child patients.
The Health Council proceeded carefully to ensure sufficient expertise was present on the committee while preventing conflicts of interest from playing a role in formulating the advice.

De Gezondheidsraad is zorgvuldig te werk gegaan, om te waarborgen dat er voldoende deskundigheid in de commissie aanwezig was en tegelijkertijd te voorkomen dat belangenverstrengeling een rol zou spelen bij het formuleren van het advies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Pieter Heerma en Van den Berg over de last onder dwangsom werkgeversportaal UWV

MPs Van der Molen, Heerma and Van den Berg (CDA) asked about the Dutch Data Protection Authority's penalty order against the UWV employer portal, the choice of eID assurance level (eHerkenning substantial versus eIDAS high), the role of UZI cards, and cost estimates for employers. The minister answered that UWV's 2018 risk analysis found the substantial level appropriate, that the cost estimates were not too low, and that the UZI card is only for patient identification.
I do not share the view that eHerkenning means were prescribed at the wrong level.
Ik deel niet de mening dat sprake is van het voorschrijven van eHerkenningsmiddelen op een verkeerd niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Van Gerven en Ploumen over de ambulancezorg in de gemeente Gennep

MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about the closure of the Gennep ambulance post, response times against the 15-minute norm, the role of insurers VGZ and CZ, cross-border mutual aid, and whether regional mayors must be consulted before closures. The Minister said the norm applies regionally, insurers did not fund the Gennep post directly, mutual-aid arrangements were tightened, and a national action plan and an AMvB on acute care availability are in progress, but no binding consultation duty for ambulance post closures.
This norm relates to the level of the (safety) region and not to the level of individual municipalities.
Deze norm heeft betrekking op het niveau van de (veiligheids)regio en niet op het niveau van individuele gemeenten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de brandbrief inzake een dichte dienstapotheek
