An MP asked the health minister about a letter from pharmacists in the Hoeksche Waard concerning the night closure of the on-call pharmacy, the use of doctors' medicine bags, and reported calamities. The minister said falling prescriptions do not imply doctors dispensing widely, that doctors may dispense from their bags without notifying pharmacies, and that the inspectorate treats the three reports through its regular procedure.
The report is assessed by the inspectorate under the regular procedure and taken up where necessary.
De melding wordt volgens de reguliere werkwijze door de inspectie beoordeeld en zo nodig in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over korte termijn gevolgen van het faillissement van het MC IJsselmeerziekenhuizen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Medical Care about short-term consequences of the bankruptcy of MC IJsselmeerziekenhuizen, including whether Sint Jansdal hospital refuses talks with the local action group, when care arrangements for the region would be known, and whether Antonius hospital in Sneek has had a rheumatology patient stop since July 2018. The Minister answered that Sint Jansdal is engaging with stakeholders, referred to a separate letter on the status of the hospitals for incidents and arrangements, and described alternative rheumatology care options and a pending insurer decision.
For the answer to these questions I refer you to my letter to the House today on the state of affairs regarding MC Slotervaart and the MC IJsselmeerziekenhuizen.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik graag naar mijn brief van heden aan de Kamer met betrekking tot de stand van zaken van MC Slotervaart en de MC IJsselmeerziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Topambtenaar kreeg ruim 40.000 euro voor achttien dagen Curaçao’

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary and Minister of Internal Affairs about a press report that a senior civil servant received over 40,000 euro in allowances for eighteen days on Curaçao, asking about the contracts, legality, tax treatment, and whether the Auditdienst Rijk should investigate. The government answered that all questions were addressed in a separate letter (Kamerstuk 35 000 VII and 35 000 IV, nr. 89), so this document itself gives no substantive answers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de sluiting van de nachtapotheken in Goes en Terneuzen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Medical Care whether the closure of night pharmacies in Goes and Terneuzen was caused by EU state-aid rules, how the decision was reached, whether the robot pharmacy in Oostburg is adequate, and what patients will pay for courier delivery. The minister denied the state-aid link, said the subsidy was withdrawn for lack of efficiency, defended the local decision-making, and gave the other answers mostly by referring to local arrangements and existing practice.
However, the organisation of out-of-hours pharmaceutical care locally is a local matter, for the health insurer and care providers.
De inrichting van de ANZ-zorg ter plaatse is echter een lokale aangelegenheid, van zorgverzekeraar en zorgverleners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het artikel ‘Zo had ze beter kunnen sterven’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a newspaper article on care for patients with prolonged disorders of consciousness after coma, and about the status of conditional reimbursement for early intensive neurorehabilitation (VIN). The minister answered that conditional admission was not pursued, that a clarified standard of usual care now allows insurers to reimburse VIN, and that further bottlenecks and a prospective study are being addressed.
Ultimately, no choice was made for a Conditional Admission.
Uiteindelijk is er niet gekozen voor een Voorwaardelijke Toelating.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Von Martels over regels en procedures die mogelijk onderzoek van gentherapie hinderen

MPs Van den Berg and Von Martels asked whether outdated EU and Dutch environmental-risk rules (GGO directives, implemented in the Besluit GGO 2013) hinder gene therapy research, and whether the Netherlands interprets EU rules more strictly than Belgium. The minister explained the permit procedure, denied stricter interpretation, defended the environmental risk framework as necessary, and said the government pushed the Commission for harmonisation and reduced burdens, though the Commission ruled out amending the GGO directives.
The Netherlands does not apply a stricter interpretation of the EU regulations.
Nederland hanteert geen striktere interpretatie van de EU-regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht Moordenaar Romy (14) twee keer eerder verdachte: 'Haar dood kon voorkomen worden'

An MP from the CDA asked whether treating clinicians should have informed the school about a 14-year-old who was later convicted of killing a girl, and whether an independent body rather than the institution itself should investigate. The minister replied that the inspectorates found no shortcomings, that the clinicians' confidentiality duty was properly applied on the information available at the time, and that the institutions and inspectorates investigated the case, with the inspectorates judging that self-investigation is preferable except in closed-setting deaths.
The inspectorates are of the opinion that the professional considerations made were in line with the applicable standards and traceable.
De inspecties zijn van oordeel dat de professionele afwegingen die zijn gemaakt, conform de geldende standaarden waren en navolgbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Omtzigt en Van den Berg over voorbereidingen om mogelijke medicijntekorten te voorkomen door een harde Brexit

MPs Slootweg, Omtzigt and Van den Berg asked how medicine shortages from a hard Brexit would be prevented, including supply continuity, registration, stockpiling, patient coverage and Dutch doctors' diploma recognition. The minister answered that the CBG is mapping critical medicines dependent on the UK, IGJ exemptions and alternatives are planned, and the rules for approval and healthcare coverage would be adjusted in a no-deal scenario.
To secure the supply reliability of the critical medicines on the list, several steps will be taken.
Om de leveringszekerheid van de kritieke geneesmiddelen op de lijst te borgen, zullen verschillende stappen worden doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Van den Berg en Ronnes over het bericht 'Zorginstelling omzeilt winstverbod'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Health whether the affiliated property, service and management structures of DeSeizoenen BV circumvent the profit ban in care and whether the WNT pay rules were respected. The minister answered that the IGJ and NZa are investigating and that they will share no further information for now, so he awaits the outcome.
The inspectorate and the NZa have indicated that, in the interest of their investigation, they are not providing further information at this time.
De inspectie en de NZa hebben aangegeven om in het belang van hun onderzoek op dit moment geen nadere informatie te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over gebrekkig toezicht op medische implantaten

An MP asked the health minister about weak oversight of medical implants, including patient access to implant safety information, reporting of incidents and calamities, and a European reporting policy for breast implants. The minister answered that the Implant Register and reporting centre are being strengthened, that manufacturers must report incidents, that a campaign for care providers and a working group on post-market surveillance will follow, and that barcoding agreements are in progress but not fully implemented.
In 2019 I will start a campaign on implants for care providers.
In 2019 start ik een campagne implantaten voor zorgverleners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Von Martels over het feit dat ASML in België medische isotopen gaat ontwikkelen

MPs from the CDA asked why the Lighthouse medical isotope project, named a Dutch National Icon, is being developed in Belgium instead of the Netherlands, and what financing was tried. The government answered that Lighthouse keeps its icon status, that Dutch private investors judged the risk too high, and that the Belgian IRE is now the partner, with the state-aid compliance left to Belgium.
It is up to the Belgian government to ensure that the agreements comply with the European state aid rules.
Het is aan de Belgische overheid om te zorgen dat de afspraken voldoen aan de Europese staatssteunregels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Von Martels over de staat van onderhoud van het Kanaal van Gent naar Terneuzen en wateroverlast Sluiskil

MPs Van den Berg and Von Martels asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the maintenance of the Gent-Terneuzen canal and groundwater flooding in Sluiskil, including follow-up to earlier questions, causes, responsibility and remedies. The minister listed completed and ongoing maintenance actions, attributed the moisture problem to high groundwater and pre-Bouwbesluit housing, denied shared responsibility with the municipality and North Sea Port, and said Rijkswaterstaat will not directly consult the parties but will help if maintenance recurs.
Rijkswaterstaat has agreed with North Sea Port and the municipality of Terneuzen that the municipality maintains contact with those involved.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft met North Sea Port en gemeente Terneuzen afgesproken dat de gemeente contact onderhoudt met betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de dreigende sluiting van de huisartsenpost in Delfzijl

An MP asked the minister about fears that the Delfzijl out-of-hours GP post would close, the commitments made when the hospital closed, and how municipalities are involved. The minister said the post will stay open under the current proposal, that the organisation of care is primarily the responsibility of providers and insurers, and that a consultation duty for regional care is not yet settled.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het alarm over risico’s van ‘mooimakende’ semipermanente fillers

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister for Medical Care about alarm over risks of semi-permanent cosmetic fillers, the timeline and results of the RIVM/Maastricht and VUmc/Erasmus MC research, the Inspectorate's complaint data, the new EU device rules, and the status of the cosmetic care quality framework. The minister answers that research results are expected in early 2019, preliminary findings show few complications from semi-permanent fillers, the Inspectorate has received 101 reports over five years, and a quality framework and competence requirements are being developed.
With the overview of the number of reports, I am keeping my commitment.
Met onderstaand overzicht van het aantal meldingen geef ik de toezegging gestand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het bericht  'Inspectie: Arduin moet direct stoppen met behandelen van cliënten in Aagtekerke'

MPs Slootweg and Van den Berg asked about the Inspectorate's order that Arduin stop treating clients at Aagtekerke, including whether only seven clients were affected, how care is guaranteed, the board's responsibilities, and board and supervisory pay and profit since 2014. Minister De Jonge answered that the Inspectorate found acute danger in coercion-related care, four of six involuntarily admitted clients were transferred and the order has ended, responsibility lies with the board and supervisory board under the Wkkgz, and provided pay and profit tables.

The Inspectorate considers that, although the conditions for good coercion-related care are currently insufficiently secured, the shortcomings no longer pose an acute danger to the safety or health of the clients.

De inspectie is van oordeel dat, hoewel op dit moment de voorwaarden voor goede bopz-gerelateerde zorg onvoldoende zijn geborgd, de tekortkomingen geen acuut gevaar meer vormen voor de veiligheid of gezondheid van de cliënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Tarieven zorg nog altijd geheim’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van den Berg asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that healthcare tariffs remain secret, arguing patients should be able to choose providers on price, especially where the own risk applies. The minister answered that patients should have insight into costs, outlined existing disclosure obligations enforced by the NZa, and said the NZa is working with the sector on greater price transparency, initially in medical-specialist care, while declining for now to impose a statutory obligation.
I have called on the parties to take this seriously and asked the NZa to report on this point and to consider obligations if progress lags in 2019.
Ik heb partijen opgeroepen dit serieus op te pakken en heb de NZa gevraagd op dit punt te rapporteren en verplichtingen te overwegen indien de voortgang in 2019 achterblijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Personeel Arduin slaat alarm'

MPs Slootweg and Van den Berg asked the health minister about staff shortages at Arduin, a disability care provider, after staff raised alarm, and how the Inspectorate (IGJ) monitors it. The minister says the Inspectorate follows Arduin intensively, including unannounced visits and an order at one location, and points to the national 'Werken in de zorg' programme and Arduin's participation in the regional plan.
The inspectorate follows Arduin intensively, as also appears from my answer to earlier parliamentary questions.
De inspectie volgt Arduin intensief, zo blijkt ook uit mijn beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van den Berg over de bodemverontreiniging en explosieven op terrein marinierskazerne Vlissingen

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Defence about soil contamination and unexploded WWII ordnance on the planned Vlissingen Marines barracks site, including whether earlier agreements exist and how much land is affected. The State Secretary answered that contamination was known since 2012, only about 2 of 70 hectares will be remediated, the rest carries use restrictions, and clearance and cost-sharing agreements with the region exist and are largely public.

These agreements were shared by the province with the provincial states and are publicly available, except for the agreements on the buy-out sum for preparing the land, which the province shared with the provincial states under confidentiality.

Deze overeenkomsten heeft de provincie gedeeld met de provinciale staten en zijn openbaar in te zien, met uitzondering van de afspraken over de afkoopsom voor het bouwrijp maken van de grond, die de provincie onder geheimhouding heeft gedeeld met de provinciale staten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het stoppen van magistrale bereiding door het Amsterdam UMC

An MP asked the Minister whether the inspectorate's investigation of Amsterdam UMC followed a manufacturer's enforcement request, how quickly the inspectorate responds, and why the hospital was not allowed to continue compounding with a clean batch. The Minister confirmed the enforcement request came from Leadiant, explained the inspectorate found unknown impurities above the Pharmacopoeia limit, and said further regulation for compounding is not yet needed while promising an update by end of October.
Because of the parliamentary questions and publicity around this case, the inspectorate is examining whether it can actively make its decision public in due course.
Vanwege de gestelde Kamervragen en de publiciteit rondom deze casus onderzoekt de inspectie de mogelijkheid om haar besluit te zijner tijd actief openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van den Berg en Ronnes over het bericht ‘Centrale Bank van Curaçao plaatst Ennia onder curatele’

MPs Van den Berg and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister whether DNB had earlier warnings about Ennia, what steps it took, whether policyholders were informed, and about Ennia's market share and hurricane claims. The minister declined to give details on DNB's warnings and actions citing its statutory confidentiality duty, said Curaçao's central bank (CBCS) is responsible for prudential supervision of Ennia, and refused to comment on consequences for policyholders in another country.

Partly because of this statutory confidentiality duty, and because as Minister I in principle do not receive information on individual institutions supervised by DNB, it is not possible to answer the questions about the content of warnings and any steps taken.

Vanwege onder meer deze geheimhoudingsplicht -en vanwege mijn systeemverantwoordelijkheid als Minister – waarbij geldt dat ik in principe geen informatie over individuele onder toezicht staande instellingen van DNB ontvang – is het niet mogelijk om de vragen over de inhoud van waarschuwingen en eventueel genomen stappen te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van den Berg over de steekpartij in Den Haag

CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister why a Den Haag stabbing was quickly attributed to confused behaviour, what the asylum status of the suspect was, what support exists for asylum seekers with confused behaviour, and what the state of policy on such persons is. The minister answered that the suspect has a residence permit with no prior IND warning signs, described existing care and reception facilities, and promised a letter on the policy this autumn.
The foreign-national legal aspects of this individual case will not be discussed further.
Er wordt niet verder ingegaan op de vreemdelingrechtelijke aspecten van deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het plan om brievenbussen weg te halen in Gorinchem

An MP asked the state secretary why PostNL plans to remove eight letterboxes in Gorinchem, including ones that disability advocates consider essential, and whether PostNL will re-engage local organisations. The secretary answered that PostNL follows a legally based locatiebeleid with a consultation process, that the regulator ACM supervises it, and declined to ask PostNL to re-engage, saying existing rules are sufficient.

In my firm conviction, PostNL carries out this process with great care, provides timely communication to the local representatives and administrators concerned, and already tries to deliver as much tailored service as possible.

Naar mijn stellige overtuiging doorloopt PostNL dit proces uitermate zorgvuldig, verzorgt zij tijdige communicatie met betrokken lokale vertegenwoordigers en bestuurders en tracht zij reeds zoveel mogelijk maatwerk te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van den Berg over het bericht dat Noord-Holland opheldering eist over uitspraken Wiebes over Pallas-reactor

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government will act quickly so that Noord-Holland's final 40 million euro loan tranche to the Pallas reactor foundation is released and isotope supply delays are avoided. Minister Bruins answered that a go/no-go decision is expected soon, that the province is responsible for the loan decision, and that intensive contact with Noord-Holland is ongoing, without committing to a specific new step.
I am not responsible for the decision-making of the province of Noord-Holland.
Ik ben niet verantwoordelijk voor de besluitvorming van de provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het voorkomen van wangiri-fraude

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg asked how wangiri phone fraud via Dutch and foreign numbers can be prevented and whether operators can block high-tariff numbers. The government answered that no reliable figures exist, that operators and the ACM have some blocking and anti-fraud options, and that enforcement is difficult because it is international, while promising to inform the House if relevant developments arise.
I am willing to inform the House further if relevant developments occur in the consultations with the telecom sector.
Ik ben bereid de Kamer nader te informeren als zich relevante ontwikkelingen voordoen in het overleg met de telecomsector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van den Berg over kinderrechten in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Diertens and Van den Berg asked whether funding exists to support families with children in Caribbean Netherlands, how child poverty will be tackled there, and how the social minimum and the 1 July 2018 deadline will be met. The government replied that the claim of no funding is premature, that a benchmark study on subsistence security is pending with a reaction to follow, and that BZK is involved through its coordinating role.
A study into a benchmark for subsistence security in Caribbean Netherlands has been promised to both chambers of the States General.
Aan de beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal is een onderzoek naar een ijkpunt voor de bestaanszekerheid in Caribisch Nederland toegezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over late betalingen door en marktmacht van Nederlandse supermarkten

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked the government about late payments by Dutch supermarkets to suppliers, bank-financed payment schemes, and whether rising market power and concentration threaten competition. The State Secretary answered that existing payment-term rules apply to supermarkets, a Commission proposal on unfair trading practices is being assessed, a ban on assignment clauses is planned, and that the ACM already polices abuse of dominance case by case, while declining to speculate on causes or commission a broad market-power study.
It is not for me to speculate on the underlying reason for supermarkets' conduct.
Het is niet aan mij om te speculeren over wat de achterliggende reden van het handelen van supermarkten is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de voorgenomen sluiting van de dienstapotheek in de Hoeksche Waard

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about CZ's plan to close the out-of-hours pharmacy in the Hoeksche Waard, including a target date of 1 September and whether subsidy and doctor's-bag alternatives are permissible. The Minister answered that talks are ongoing with no final decision, that closure would only proceed once local criteria are met, and that the government is concerned with efficient arrangements rather than keeping one pharmacy open.
What matters to me is that the pharmaceutical acute care is organised efficiently, with patients having access at all times to emergency medication and the necessary pharmaceutical care.
Het gaat mij erom dat de farmaceutische ANZ-zorg doelmatig is ingericht, waarbij patiënten te allen tijde toegang hebben tot spoedmedicatie en de noodzakelijke farmaceutische zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Agnes Mulder over de voorgenomen sluiting van de acute verloskunde in Stadskanaal en Hoogeveen

MPs Van den Berg and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the minister about Treant's plan to concentrate acute obstetrics and paediatrics in Emmen, closing Stadskanaal and Hoogeveen, including the insurer's objections, paediatrician recruitment, regional impact and consultation. The minister declined to take sides between insurer and provider, described recruitment efforts, said the decision is not yet final, and referred the remaining questions to a separate letter to parliament.
I do not wish to interfere in a discussion between the health insurer and the care provider.
Ik wil mij niet mengen in een discussie tussen de zorgverzekeraar en zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de voorgenomen sluiting van de dienstapotheek in onder andere de Hoeksche Waard

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Medical Care about CZ's plan to close on-call pharmacies during unprofitable hours, notably in the Hoeksche Waard, and about the end of the state subsidy capping emergency drug prices. The minister said the subsidy will end on 1 January 2019, that closing pharmacies is not an adequate solution and alternatives such as vending machines and delivery should be explored, and that talks with insurers are ongoing with nothing decided.
Simply closing on-call pharmacies is not an adequate solution; alternatives will have to be sought for obtaining medicines and pharmaceutical care.
Het simpelweg sluiten van dienstapotheken is geen adequate oplossing, er zal naar alternatieven moeten worden gezocht voor het verkrijgen van geneesmiddelen en farmaceutische zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Verouderde strafwet BES hindert veroordeling seksuele delicten’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether an outdated Penal Code for the Caribbean Netherlands (BES) caused an acquittal in a sexual offence case and why it was not modernised like the Caribbean Kingdom countries' codes. The minister confirmed one acquittal, admitted that articles 249 and 253 were mistakenly not updated in 2010, and said a bill to fix this will be submitted before the summer recess.
Correction of the omissions in articles 249 and 253 of the BES Penal Code will take place in the bill amending the BES Code of Criminal Procedure.
Herstel van de omissies in de artikelen 249 en 253 Wetboek van Strafrecht BES vindt plaats in het wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van het Wetboek van Strafvordering BES
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de mogelijkheden van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt om in te grijpen bij excessieve prijzen voor medicijnen

An MP asked the minister whether the competition authority ACM could use abuse-of-dominance rules against excessive medicine prices, and why it had not done so, and asked about cooperation with foreign regulators and the status of a European Commission investigation. The minister answered that such rules have never been applied to patented medicines, that the ACM is only beginning to examine the issue, that cooperation runs through the European competition network and bilateral contacts, and that the Commission's Aspen investigation is still ongoing.
However, the prohibition on abuse of a dominant position has in practice never been applied to patented medicines.
Het verbod op misbruik van een economische machtspositie is echter in de praktijk nog nooit toegepast voor geoctrooieerde geneesmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Agnes Mulder over de enorme stijging van elektriciteitstarieven op Bonaire

CDA MPs asked why electricity tariffs on Bonaire rose about 24% from January 2018, whether they are cost-covering, and whether there is protection for vulnerable consumers. The minister said tariffs were previously kept artificially low by a subsidy funded by Dutch taxpayers, that the rise is mainly due to oil prices and network costs, that a subsidy will lower network tariffs and a bill for drinking water is being prepared, and that a usage-independent tariff is introduced on 1 April.
I am in discussion with WEB about how to deploy the subsidy.
Ik ben in gesprek met WEB over hoe de subsidie in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over oogstramingen CBS

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked why provisional onion and potato harvest estimates by CBS were sometimes revised down, whether provisional figures distort prices, and whether publication could be limited to final figures. The minister disputed the premise that revisions were mainly downward, said CBS publication is a legal duty and serves transparency, and noted there is no EU obligation to publish provisional estimates.
The claim that final estimates generally came out lower in the period 2010–2017 is therefore not correct.
Het gestelde dat de definitieve ramingen over het algemeen lager uitvielen in de periode 2010 – 2017 is dus niet juist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Pia Dijkstra over zorgverzekeraars die beleggen in farmaceutische bedrijven

Two MPs asked the Minister whether health insurers investing in pharmaceutical firms charging very high drug prices creates a perverse incentive, and about insurers' invested capital and reserves. The Minister replied that exposure is small (under 0.1% in named firms), that ESG exclusion and engagement policies apply, and gave invested capital of 13.2 billion euros and equity of about 11 billion euros at end-2016.
I do not fear a perverse effect.
Ik vrees niet voor een pervers effect.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over validatie van 80%-norm arbeidsovereenkomst postsector

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how the ACM verified that postal carriers employ at least 80% of their couriers under employment contracts and whether external validation was required. The government answered that the ACM checked contracts directly without requiring external validation, but committed to re-checking compliance this year and to examining complaints at any time.
The ACM has however committed to me that it will still examine this year whether the postal carriers still comply with the 80% norm.
Wel heeft de ACM mij toegezegd dat ze dit jaar nog zal onderzoeken of de postvervoerbedrijven nog steeds voldoen aan de 80% norm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg-Jansen over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek, uitgevoerd in opdracht van de LHV: werkdruk huisarts bedreigt kwaliteit van zorg

An MP asked the minister about an LHV-commissioned study finding that rising GP workload threatens care quality, linked to more elderly people living at home, and about solutions for shortages and insurer responses. The minister acknowledged the signal, pointed to a planned study with the LHV on GP location motives, existing measures such as practice managers and task transfer, and said insurers pursue varied regional approaches.
The LHV study shows that this is at stake for a part of the GPs.
Het onderzoek van de LHV laat zien dat dit bij een deel van de huisartsen in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van der Lee over de overname chipbedrijf NXP door Qualcomm

MPs Van den Berg and Van der Lee asked the minister about the US block of Broadcom's bid for Qualcomm, whether the Qualcomm takeover of NXP warrants investigation on national-security or critical-infrastructure grounds, and related EU competition and battery questions. The minister declined to judge the US decision because the CFIUS advice is confidential, found no reason to treat chip design and manufacturing as a vital process, and said the EU supports 5G development.
Because the CFIUS report is confidential, it is not known on what grounds CFIUS reached its advice to the President.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van het CFIUS-rapport is niet bekend op welke gronden CFIUS tot het advies aan de President is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de forse toename van cosmetische ingrepen zoals behandelingen met botox en fillers

An MP asked the minister about the rise in cosmetic botox and filler treatments, including reports of unsafe practices at hairdressers and tanning salons, and whether there should be a total overview and an information campaign. The minister said the Inspectorate sees few such reports, that non-registered providers are only overseen reactively, that a legal amendment will clarify cosmetic injections are reserved acts, and that a quality framework and a consumer information tool are in progress.
I have asked the Inspectorate to draw up the overview you requested and will send it to you as soon as possible.
Ik heb de Inspectie verzocht om het door u gevraagde overzicht op te stellen en zal dit op zo kort mogelijke termijn aan u doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over een stopgezet medisch onderzoek in het AMC

An MP asked why a medical study on bile duct cancer patients was stopped after 14 of 54 participants died, whether it should have been reported to the inspectorate, how patients were informed, and why results were communicated late. The minister answered that serious events were reported to the METC, that the inspectorate lacks enough information to judge whether a calamity occurred, and that the CCMO is analysing the file with results expected in May.

At this moment the inspectorate has insufficient information to establish whether there was a calamity or irregularities during the conduct of the study, and whether this should have been reported to the inspectorate.

Op dit moment heeft de inspectie onvoldoende informatie om vast te stellen of hier sprake was van een calamiteit of van onregelmatigheden tijdens de uitvoering van de studie en of dit bij de inspectie gemeld had moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over het weigeren van de VVV-cadeaukaart, de positie van het lokale mkb en de geldigheidsdatum bij cadeaukaarten

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about shops refusing the new VVV gift card, the position of local SMEs, and unclear expiry dates on gift cards. The State Secretary answered that retailers and issuers set acceptance and validity terms themselves, that the consumer law framework applies with ACM oversight, and that no further rules are planned.
I am aware of reports like the above about the refusal of the VVV gift card in its new form, but I do not have precise data on its extent.
Mij is berichtgeving zoals bovenstaande over de weigering van de VVV-cadeaukaart in zijn nieuwe vorm bekend, maar precieze gegevens over de omvang hiervan heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en De Lange over het onderzoek van Reporter Radio op radio 1 zondag 18 februari 2018 jl.

Two MPs asked the state secretary for health about a radio investigation showing that many mental health providers exceed the waiting time norms, and about regional differences, autism and personality disorder waiting lists, and the 1 July 2018 target. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, described the regional taskforce approach and the NZa monitoring, and committed to sending an updated NZa report to parliament in April.
I have no insight into what percentage of the total number of people on waiting lists these specific groups make up.
Ik heb geen inzicht in welk percentage de hierboven genoemde specifieke groepen vormen van het totaal aantal wachtenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Toename van spoedposten voor ouderen in ziekenhuizen'

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about a press report on growing numbers of geriatric outpatient clinics and trauma units in hospitals, asking about their working method, volumes, regional distribution and effect on emergency departments. The minister said there is no fixed model, the clinics are not separately registered, their effect on emergency room pressure is expected but not measured, and regional partnerships (ROAZ) are the main vehicle for tackling acute care pressure.
This concerns acute care; treatments at geriatric outpatient clinics or geriatric trauma units are not registered separately.
Het gaat hier om acute zorg, de behandelingen op ouderenpoli’s of geriatrische trauma units worden niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Zorg over groei geweld door verwarde mensen in Rotterdam’

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers about rising incidents involving confused persons in Rotterdam and the police's role, training and the Schakelteam approach. The minister confirmed rising registered incidents (12% in 2017), said data cannot show unique persons or offences, and pointed to prevention, police training and Rotterdam's existing programmes without committing to new steps.
The police registration does not show the number of persons who committed or are suspected of a criminal offence while in a confused state.
Bij de politie is uit de registratie niet het aantal personen af te leiden dat in verwarde toestand een strafbaar feit heeft gepleegd of daarvan wordt verdacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en  Van der Lee over het definiëren van de markt met betrekking tot marktmacht

MPs Van den Berg and Van der Lee asked the State Secretary how market definition by the ACM affects findings of market power, whether new or existing law is more effective against dominant tech firms, and whether the ACM can use consent agreements like the US FTC. The State Secretary answered that existing competition law should be used first with new EU rules where needed, that market definition is an important but not decisive step, that the ACM already has binding commitment decisions, and that an EU proposal on platform-business relations is expected in April.
I will inform the House after publication via a BNC fiche about the proposal and my position in Europe.
Ik zal uw Kamer na publicatie per BNC-fiche informeren over het voorstel en mijn inzet in Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Omtzigt over het bericht 'PGGM wil samen met Apollo een bod doen op chemietak AkzoNobel'

MPs Van den Berg and Omtzigt asked the minister about reports of a PGGM and Apollo bid for AkzoNobel's chemicals division, its job and R&D impact, and whether the government would intervene. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that divestment is a company strategic decision outside government's role, noted the company's sustainability record, and said the ministry will monitor developments without committing to action.
However, the sale of the Specialty Chemicals division is a strategic decision of AkzoNobel.
Verkoop van de divisie Specialty Chemicals is echter een strategische beslissing van AkzoNobel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Diertens over het bericht ‘Kwetsbare gezinnen op Bonaire dupe van bezuinigingen’

MPs Van den Berg and Diertens asked whether Bonaire's planned 13% cut to housing foundation FCB's subsidy would hit vulnerable tenants and jeopardise plans for 500 social rental homes. The State Secretary confirmed the cut would raise rents for the lowest-income tenants, said it is a Bonaire island responsibility, and promised continued talks with the parties involved.
Housing market policy is an island-level task.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over het bericht dat cijfers CBS ervoor zorgen dat de prijs van uien laag blijft

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked whether CBS onion harvest estimates, repeatedly revised, depress onion prices and whether mandatory CBS survey participation is enforced with fines. The minister answered that CBS figures inform market prices without determining them, provided five years of revision data, and that no fines apply for 2016 and 2017 under a letter of intent.
The CBS does not have data on the onion prices that growers receive.
Het CBS beschikt niet over uienprijzen die de telers ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Door ziekteverzuim lekt half miljard weg uit de zorg'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Health about a report that sick leave in healthcare is costing half a billion euros, including questions on long-term absence by subsector, function, institution and management turnover. The minister confirmed that sick leave in health and welfare care is structurally higher than average, that the half-billion figure appears plausible based on Vernet data, and that no breakdown by function or institution is available, while pointing to existing programmes and a broader labour market action plan.
The CBS statistics do not break down sick leave by individual care institution.
In de statistieken van het CBS wordt geen uitsplitsing gemaakt van het ziekteverzuim per zorginstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van der Molen over het verdwijnen van de brievenbus in Tichelwurk

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the removal of the letterbox in Tichelwurk, which would leave residents six kilometres from the nearest box in winter, and whether ACM and PostNL could reconsider. The State Secretary said the rules allow removal but PostNL has decided to keep the box given the geographic circumstances, and that ACM has signalled no gaps in the supervisory framework.
The advisory process preceding a change, as PostNL applies it, ensures that account is taken of vulnerable groups and any special geographic circumstances.
Het adviesproces voorafgaand aan een wijziging zoals PostNL dat hanteert borgt dat er rekening wordt gehouden met kwetsbare groepen en eventuele bijzondere geografische omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg-Jansen over het bericht dat de bloedvoorziening mogelijk in problemen komt

Members of parliament asked whether blood supply continuity is threatened by possible financial losses at Sanquin Plasma Products, and about pricing and monopoly concerns. The minister denied imminent financial trouble, said continuity is safeguarded by agreements and a pending bill, and defended the Dutch price level by citing lower usage and fixed costs.
My predecessor already asked Sanquin in 2012 to place the most risky non-statutory activities outside the foundation.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft in 2012 Sanquin reeds verzocht de meest risicovolle niet-wettelijke activiteiten buiten de stichting te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de overname chipbedrijf NXP door Qualcomm

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NXP's chip business is critical infrastructure, why nine regulators reviewed the Qualcomm takeover, and why the eight-year licensing remedy was chosen. The minister answered that chip design and manufacture have not met the critical-infrastructure criteria, that competition review does not cover such grounds, that jurisdictions review where a deal may affect their markets, and that the eight-year term was set by the European regulator without Dutch involvement.
These three impact criteria have so far given me no reason to classify the design and manufacture of chips as a vital process.
Deze drie impactcriteria hebben mij tot op heden geen aanleiding gegeven het ontwerpen en maken van chips aan te merken als vitaal proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van der Molen over het klaar maken van Nederland voor de uitrol van 5G

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate how the Netherlands can prepare for 5G, including the 3.5 GHz band, the 700 MHz alternative, trials such as the Leidseplein antenna, and whether Amsterdam can host the first 5G stadium for Euro 2020. The government answered that 700 MHz will be available nationally from 2020, the 26 GHz band is being prepared pending EU decisions, other European states are further along on 3.5 GHz, and it will facilitate experiments in Amsterdam without committing to a result.
I am already working on making the 700 MHz band available nationwide from 2020.
Ik werk reeds aan het landelijk beschikbaar stellen van de 700 MHz-band per 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over kindermishandeling op Aruba

An MP asked the State Secretary about child abuse on Aruba, including reported prevalence, a planned Aruban commission on domestic violence, and Dutch support for child protection. The government confirmed awareness, referred prevalence to a prior answer, noted Aruba adopted an integrated social plan with a crisis chapter on domestic violence, and said Dutch help would be considered on request and discussed during a January visit.
If the Aruban government makes a request for help and/or assistance, the Dutch government will examine how to appropriately follow up on it.
Indien de regering van Aruba een verzoek voor hulp en/of bijstand doet, zal de Nederlandse regering nagaan hoe op gepaste wijze daaraan opvolging te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Ouderen dupe van opdoeken brievenbussen'

MPs Weverling and Van den Berg asked about reports that letterboxes were removed in Leidschendam-Voorburg, harming elderly residents, and how accessibility rules protect vulnerable users. The State Secretary answered that complaints are few, that PostNL's consultation process with advocacy groups and local representatives governs changes, that legal rules require considering vulnerable groups, and that PostNL already agreed not to remove letterboxes at care institutions.
Before a planned change in the number of letterboxes, this is announced in writing and meetings are organised for interest groups about the relocation plans.

Voorafgaand aan een voorgenomen wijziging van het aantal brievenbussen wordt dit schriftelijk aangekondigd en worden bijeenkomsten georganiseerd voor belangenorganisaties over de herplaatsingsplannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van den Berg over erfpacht in Amsterdam

MPs Ronnes and Van den Berg (CDA) asked whether leaseholders in Amsterdam and on the Wadden islands are adequately protected, whether the eternal-lease conversion scheme is understandable for consumers, and whether UK and Norwegian legislative developments should be followed, and asked about a request to annul Amsterdam council decisions. The minister answers that existing civil law (BW title 5.7, reasonableness and fairness, informational duties) and administrative law principles provide sufficient protection, that the Amsterdam scheme is transparent enough, that no change to Dutch law is needed, and that the annulment request was rejected.
For leasehold in Amsterdam and on the Wadden islands, the leaseholders are moreover generally bound by the general principles of good administration.
Voor de erfpacht in Amsterdam en op de Waddeneilanden geldt bovendien dat de erfverpachters veelal gebonden zijn aan de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de uitzending van Kassa ‘Nabestaanden dupe van niet-transparante uitvaartondernemers’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care and the State Secretary about a Kassa broadcast on funeral undertakers and mortuary costs imposed on bereaved families without prior agreement. The Minister acknowledged communication failures, said the sector will tighten working agreements and transparency, and pointed bereaved families to the funeral provider and the Stichting Klachteninstituut Uitvaartwezen for complaints.
Once bereaved families have been informed by the funeral undertaker, they must receive full openness and have freedom of choice regarding the further care of the deceased.

Op het moment dat nabestaanden geïnformeerd zijn door de uitvaartondernemer, dienen zij volledige openheid van zaken te krijgen en hebben zij keuzevrijheid ten aanzien van de invulling van de verdere zorg voor de overledene.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Ronnes over onvoldoende mobiel bereik in delen van Brabant

MPs Van den Berg and Ronnes asked the minister about poor mobile coverage in parts of Brabant, including whether the 112 emergency number is unreachable in Olland and what Agentschap Telecom has done. The state secretary answered that primary responsibility lies with operators and municipalities, that Agentschap Telecom forwarded the provincial letter and offers technical support, and that it is in contact with three other municipalities.
The province of Noord-Brabant acknowledges that primary responsibility for mobile accessibility lies with mobile operators and municipalities.
De provincie Noord-Brabant erkent dat de primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor mobiele bereikbaarheid bij mobiele operators en gemeenten ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Bosman over het bericht ‘Sint-Maarten wijst voorwaarden hulp af’

MPs Van den Berg and Bosman asked whether Sint Maarten rejects the Dutch conditions attached to hurricane Irma reconstruction funds, how the lawful and efficient use of funds will be ensured, and whether conditions unrelated to transparency should be dropped. The State Secretary replied that Sint Maarten's parliament backed the conditions (an integrity chamber and stronger border control) on 2 November, that further safeguards will be elaborated, and that the conditions are directly related to integrity and effective use of funds.
The conditions set relate to the integrity of the use of financial resources for reconstruction.
De gestelde randvoorwaarden zien op een integere benutting van de financiële middelen voor de wederopbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het inspectieonderzoek naar de stroomstoring van Amsterdam en omstreken van 17 januari 2017

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked why the 1-1-2 emergency line's intake arrangements date from when mobile phone use was limited, why about 19% of callers got no contact during the January 2017 Amsterdam power outage, and what is being done about mobile reachability, waiting times and standards. The Minister answered that a national intake structure and a renewed technical infrastructure are being introduced, that a cost-benefit analysis on a standard for outage-resilient 1-1-2 access will be sent to parliament in early 2018, and that the Agentschap Telecom has advised several municipalities.
As indicated in the policy response, a thorough cost-benefit analysis will first be carried out to determine what a reasonable standard is.
Zoals aangegeven is in de beleidsreactie, wordt eerst een gedegen kosten en baten analyse uitgevoerd om te kijken wat een redelijke norm is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Bruins Slot over nationale veiligheidseisen bij aanbestedingen van cruciale communicatiediensten van de overheid

MPs Van den Berg and Bruins Slot asked about national security requirements in government tenders for critical communications services, including the IWR2017 mobile communications tender won by CM Telecom and privacy safeguards. The minister answered that the tender concerns public-network SIM services without classified communication, that privacy is protected by the Wbp and Telecommunicatiewet, and that the new security risk instruments could not yet be applied to this tender.
IWR2017 Mobile Communication Services concerns a tender for telephony services (SIM cards) for use on the public telephone network.
IWR2017 Mobiele Communicatiediensten betreft een aanbesteding van telefoniediensten («simkaarten») voor gebruik op het publieke telefonienetwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Berg over de aanbesteding fotografie in relatie tot de naleving van het clusterverbod

MPs Kuiken and Van den Berg asked the Prime Minister about the non-public tender for photography services, how selection criteria protect small firms and freelancers, and the current contracts with about 30 freelance photographers. The Prime Minister confirmed a two-stage non-public EU tender, explained that 101 firms applied and 40 contracts are planned from March 2018, and gave total spending of 2.935 million euros while withholding per-photographer turnover as commercially confidential.
The turnover per photographer concerns commercially confidential information.
De omzet per fotograaf betreft commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht van PostNL dat goede bezorging op het platteland binnen enkele jaren onmogelijk wordt

MP Van den Berg (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about PostNL's warning that rural mail delivery would become impossible without relaxed rules, including questions on mailbox removal, market decline, the AMM cost estimate and takeover risk. The minister said the UPD's financial sustainability is under pressure, that policy choices are for the next cabinet, that about 26% of 2,082 net mailbox removals were rural, and that volume decline exceeded earlier forecasts.
The choice for new policy is for the next cabinet.
De keuze voor nieuw beleid is aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van den Berg over het bericht dat een huurkorting van 170 euro niet wordt toegestaan in Zeeland

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the Autoriteit woningcorporaties (Aw) may block a one-off rent reduction of 170 euro agreed in a housing merger in Zeeland, and why it approved the merger containing it. The Minister answered that the Woningwet bars corporations from providing such financial means outside listed exceptions, that the Aw had not objected at merger approval but could have earlier, and that structural rent reductions remain possible.
Because this specific point is not part of the assessment of merger proposals, the Autoriteit woningcorporaties gave permission for the merger.
Omdat dit specifieke punt geen onderdeel van beoordeling van fusievoorstellen is, heeft de Autoriteit woningcorporaties toestemming gegeven voor de fusie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Helvert over de staat van onderhoud van het Kanaal van Gent naar Terneuzen en wateroverlast Sluiskil

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about the maintenance state of the Ghent-Terneuzen canal near Sluiskil, sheet-pile rust, water nuisance for residents, water-level agreements with Belgium and legal responsibility. The minister answered that renovation is underway, a joint study into the water nuisance is planned, water-level agreements were respected, and responsibility is divided among Rijkswaterstaat and Zeeland Seaports.
Rijkswaterstaat, as manager of the canal, is responsible for the water level.
Rijkswaterstaat is als beheerder van het kanaal verantwoordelijk voor het waterpeil.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg-Janssen over nationale veiligheidseisen bij aanbestedingen van cruciale communicatiediensten van de overheid

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about national security requirements in government tenders for critical communication services, including price as a selection criterion, openness of the tender, Brexit-related hacking risks, foreign ownership and oversight capacity. The minister replied that quality including security is an important criterion, that security and privacy requirements apply, that the government sees no need for a locality requirement or extra capacity, and that cross-departmental ex-ante analyses of national security risks are underway.
For communication of state-secret information, the Government Information Security Instruction 2013 requires ministerial approval, advised by the Working Group on Special Information.
Voor communicatie van staatsgeheime informatie is in het Voorschrift Informatiebeveiliging Rijkdienst Bijzondere Informatie 2013 (VIRBI 2013) bepaald dat ministeriële goedkeuring noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van den Berg, Omtzigt, Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven en Dik-Faber over lekkages bij AKZO-Nobel in Twente

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about new well leaks at AkzoNobel in Twente, the number and effects of leaks, SodM's enforcement and projects, and liability for leak damage. The minister answered that lists of leaks are published and checked by SodM, that the effects appear limited to the immediate vicinity of leaking wells, that enhanced supervision continues with a research programme due by end 2017, and that liability stays with the party responsible at the time of the leak.
SodM urged AkzoNobel to give appropriate urgency to the investigation and remediation of leaks and possible contamination in Twente.
SodM heeft bij AkzoNobel aangedrongen op gepaste urgentie bij het onderzoek en de sanering van lekkages en mogelijke verontreinigingen in Twente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van den Berg over een inschattingsfout van Rijkswaterstaat bij de A58

CDA MPs asked the minister whether Rijkswaterstaat misjudged traffic on the A58 when scheduling roadworks on 6 June 2017, and how holiday traffic is factored into planning. The minister answers that the Pentecost traffic pattern differed from past years, that holiday peaks are considered in planning, and that no further commitment beyond taking the experience into account is made.
This experience will of course be taken into account in the future planning of works.
Deze ervaring zal uiteraard wel worden meegenomen bij de toekomstige planning van werkzaamheden.

m: Motie Verdonk en Aptroot over voldoende strooizout
Asks the government to commit to ensuring enough road salt for the rest of the winter after a shortage was reported.
requests the government to commit that there is enough road salt for the rest of the winter
verzoekt de regering toe te zeggen dat er voor de rest van winter genoeg strooizout is
Motie Verdonk over het stimuleren van het gebruik van winterbanden
Asks the government to present a plan to encourage the use of winter tyres.
requests the government to present a plan before summer to encourage the use of winter tyres
verzoekt de regering vóór de zomer een plan te presenteren om het gebruik van winterbanden te stimuleren
Motie Verdonk en Aptroot over het functioneren van de directies en de raad van commissarissen van ProRail en NS
Asks the government to include the management and supervisory boards of ProRail and NS in the evaluation of the snow-period failures.
requests the government, when assessing the evaluation, also to include the functioning of the board and supervisory board of ProRail and NS
verzoekt de regering bij het beoordelen van de evaluatie ook het functioneren van de directie en de raad van commissarissen van ProRail en de NS te betrekken
Motie Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink c.s. over schrappen van de éénlocatie-beperking
Asks the government to drop the one-location restriction for child-minders and adjust GGD inspection accordingly.
requests the government to remove the one-location restriction from the regulations
verzoekt de regering de één-locatiebeperking uit de regelgeving te schrappen
Motie van het lid Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink c.s. over schrappen van de terugbetalingsplicht voor vraagouders
Asks the government to scrap the obligation for parents using childcare-by-host arrangements to repay childcare allowance if the host does not meet quality requirements by 2011.
requests the government to remove the repayment obligation for parents from the scheme
verzoekt de regering de terugbetalingsplicht voor vraagouders uit de regeling te schrappen
Motie Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink c.s. over uitstel van invoering van regelgeving
Asks the government to postpone by one year the introduction of new childcare host (gastouder) regulations due to uncertainty.
requests the government to pause and postpone the intended introduction of regulations by one year
verzoekt de regering pas op de plaats te maken en de beoogde invoering van regelgeving met een jaar uit te stellen
Motie Verdonk over een administratieve boete voor het beledigen en bedreigen van politieagenten
Asks the government to introduce a €10,000 administrative fine for insulting or threatening police officers on duty.
requests the government to introduce an administrative fine of € 10,000 for insulting and threatening police officers
verzoekt de regering een administratieve boete van € 10 000 in te voeren voor het beledigen en bedreigen van politieagenten
Motie Verdonk c.s. over inzetbaarheid van "blauw op straat"
Asks the government to report before the Christmas recess on how many police officers in uniform are actually deployable.
requests the government, using already known data, to indicate before the Christmas recess the deployability of the various functions
verzoekt de regering met gebruikmaking van reeds bekende gegevens, vóór het kerstreces de inzetbaarheid bij de verschillende functies aan te geven
Motie Brinkman en Verdonk over operationele sterkte en "blauw op straat"
Asks the minister to report quarterly to parliament on police operational strength and the 'blauw op straat' allocation, with specific measures if numbers fall.
requests the government to send the House a quarterly report on operational strength
verzoekt de regering de Kamer een driemaandelijkse rapportage te sturen over de operationele sterkte
Motie Verdonk over 500 extra wijkagenten voor 1 januari 2011
Motion asking the government to guarantee that 500 additional neighbourhood police officers are in service by 1 January 2011.
requests the government to guarantee that the 500 neighbourhood officers are in service by 1 January 2011
verzoekt de regering te garanderen dat voor 1 januari 2011 de 500 wijkagenten in dienst zijn getreden
Motie Verdonk over probleemgericht beleid voor Somaliërs
Asks the government to develop problem-oriented integration policy specifically for Somalis given serious integration problems.
requests the government, given the very large integration problems in this group, to develop especially problem-oriented policy
verzoekt de regering gezien de zeer grote integratieproblemen bij deze groep, speciaal probleemgericht beleid te ontwikkelen
Motie Verdonk over concrete maatregelen om integratie te bevorderen
Asks the government to inform the House by year-end about concrete measures taken to promote integration.
requests the government to inform the House before year-end about the concrete measures taken
verzoekt de regering om voor het eind van het jaar de Kamer te informeren over de genomen concrete maatregelen
Motie Dibi c.s. over strafbaarstelling van huwelijksdwang
Motion asking the government to legislate criminal penalties for forced marriage.
requests the government to provide criminal legislation making forced marriage punishable
verzoekt de regering om te voorzien in strafwetgeving waardoor huwelijksdwang strafbaar wordt gesteld
Motie Verdonk over overdragen van mensen aan Griekenland die daar een eerste asielverzoek hebben gedaan
Motion asks the government to transfer 1000 asylum seekers to Greece under the Dublin agreement because Greece already received their first application.
requests the government to transfer these 1000 people to Greece on the basis of the Dublin agreement as proof of good European cooperation
verzoekt de regering deze 1000 mensen, als bewijs van goede Europese samenwerking, op basis van de Dublinovereenkomst over te dragen aan Griekenland
Motie Verdonk over geen verlof voor pedoseksuelen
Asks the government to abolish the possibility for convicted paedophiles to receive leave from prison, citing risk of reoffending.
requests the government to abolish the possibility for paedophiles to obtain leave
verzoekt de regering de mogelijkheid voor pedoseksuelen om verlof te krijgen af te schaffen
Motie Gerkens c.s. over de landelijk coördinator georganiseerde en financieel-economische criminaliteit
Asks the government to give the national coordinator for organised and financial-economic crime binding authority to enforce solutions rather than only discuss them.
requests the government to ensure the national coordinator for organised and financial-economic crime receives sufficient powers to bring about solutions and push through

verzoekt de regering ervoor te zorgen dat de landelijk coördinator georganiseerde en financieel-economische criminaliteit voldoende bevoegdheden krijgt om oplossingen te bewerkstelligen en door te pakken
Motie Verdonk over het opzeggen van het vertrouwen in de minister
Expresses a vote of no confidence in the Minister of Justice for presenting two budgets with different content, which the motion says misled the House.
expresses no confidence in the Minister of Justice
zegt het vertrouwen op in de minister van Justitie
Motie De Krom en Verdonk over het ongedaan maken van de aanstelling van een imam die een reeks radicale uitspraken heeft gedaan
Asks the government to immediately reverse the appointment of an imam who made radical statements, as a government appointment.
requests the government to immediately undo the appointment of this imam
verzoekt de regering de aanstelling van deze imam onmiddellijk ongedaan te maken
Motie Verdonk / Brinkman over het opzeggen van het vertrouwen in de minister van Defensie
Motion states that parliament withdraws its confidence in the Minister of Defence after clumsy conduct undermined authority over the troops.
withdraws confidence in the Minister of Defence
zegt het vertrouwen in de minister van Defensie op
Motie Dibi c.s. over het betrekken van alle geledingen bij afspraken die de gehele sector aangaan
Asks the government to involve all sector groups, not only sector organisations, in agreements affecting the whole education sector and to inform the House.
requests the government to structurally involve all sector groups in agreements affecting the whole sector and to inform the House about it
verzoekt de regering om voortaan bij afspraken die de gehele sector aangaan ook structureel alle geledingen uit de sector te betrekken en de Kamer daarover te informeren
Motie Slob c.s. over verlaging van de stichtingsnormen
Asks the government to map how many newly founded schools cannot meet current foundation norms and to inform the House on lowering the norms and extending the compliance period to eight years.
requests the government to make clear how many schools are involved
verzoekt de regering: – inzichtelijk te maken om hoeveel scholen het hier gaat
Motie Bosma/Verdonk over een verbod op het dragen van hoofddoekjes voor het onderwijzend personeel
Asks the government to ban headscarves for teaching staff, extending a proposed police ban on grounds of authority and neutrality.
requests the government to also ban the wearing of headscarves for teaching staff
verzoekt de regering ook voor het onderwijzend personeel het dragen van hoofddoekjes te verbieden
Motie Verdonk over opheffing van de ANBI-status van de As-Soennah moskee
Asks the government to instruct the Minister of Finance to revoke the ANBI charity status of a specific mosque because an imam urged Muslims not to integrate.
requests the government to call on the Minister of Finance to revoke the ANBI status.
verzoekt de regering de minister van Financiën op te roepen, de ANBI-status op te heffen
Motie Verdonk over de toezegging dat 60.000 mensen op 31 december 2009 het inburgeringsexamen hebben afgelegd
Asks the government to promise that 60,000 people will have taken the civic integration exam by 31 December 2009.
requests the government to promise that on 31/12/2009, 60,000 people have taken part in the civic integration exam
verzoekt de regering toe te zeggen dat op 31/12/2009, 60 000 mensen hebben deelgenomen aan het inburgeringsexamen
qa: Vragen van het lid Verdonk (Verdonk) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de dood van een Nederlandse moslimextremist (ingezonden 12 mei 2010).

An MP asked the foreign and interior ministers about a Dutch Muslim extremist reportedly killed in Pakistan, and about radicalisation, jihadist training and foreign funding of radicalisation networks in the Netherlands and Europe. The minister answered that the answers are classified and available only for inspection by Members, placed with the Tweede Kamer's central information point.
The answer to these questions is available for confidential inspection, for Members only, deposited with the Tweede Kamer's central information point.
Het antwoord op deze vragen is ter vertrouwelijke inzage, alleen voor de Leden, gelegd bij net Centraal Informatiepunt Tweede Kamer.
Vragen van het lid Verdonk (Verdonk) aan de minister van Justitie over de handelswijze van curatoren (ingezonden 15 april 2010).

Vragen van het lid Verdonk (Verdonk) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Saoedi-Arabië (ingezonden 6 april 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that Saudi Arabia funds Wahhabist and Salafist spread in the Balkans and whether the relationship should be reconsidered. The minister rejected the claim that Islamic extremism is flourishing there, said the EU addresses extremism through the accession process, and said there was no concrete evidence of Saudi state support for jihadist extremism, so no reason to review the relationship.
There are no concrete indications that the government of Saudi Arabia supports jihadist extremism.

Vragen van het lid Verdonk (Verdonk) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over veiligheid in het openbaar vervoer (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

An MP asks the ministers about the lack of action against aggression on public transport: whether new safety measures have been implemented, camera coverage on buses, budget for Taskforce recommendations, incident figures, and a national travel ban for offenders. The ministers answer that Taskforce measures will be implemented largely in 2010 with progress reports, that remaining buses lacking cameras are being addressed, that EUR 4 million is available, that incidents are not uniformly registered, and that a national travel ban law amendment will be submitted to parliament as soon as possible.

Vragen van het lid Verdonk (Verdonk) aan de minister van Justitie over het feit dat gemeenten hun noodopvang voor uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers willen heropenen (ingezonden 7 april 2010).

MP Verdonk asks the Justice Minister whether municipalities plan to reopen emergency shelters for rejected asylum seekers, whether this violates the 2007 Rijk-VNG agreement, what powers exist to enforce it, and whether illegal residence will be criminalised. The minister denies that municipalities are considering reopening shelters, says the agreement is being implemented through joint measures, admits a fully watertight approach is not possible, and rules out criminalising illegal stay.

The aforementioned administrative agreement stipulates that municipalities will neither directly nor indirectly cooperate in sheltering unlawfully residing foreigners and will end existing emergency shelter.

qa: Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Jadnanansing van uw Kamer inzake de huur van een skybox door Consent

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister about reports that school board Consent rented a FC Twente skybox using education funds, asked staff to volunteer there, and closed a deficit by enlarging classes. However, I do not want to anticipate the findings of the Inspectorate.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Van Dekken over de uitwerking van de fusietoets in krimpgebieden

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister how the merger test (fusietoets) affects schools in shrinking regions that want to merge to safeguard quality. The minister said the test's justification grounds already allow such mergers, declined to soften the test for now pending an interdepartmental study due in spring 2013, and pointed to existing financial compensation for merging primary schools.
This year it will still be considered whether these signals should lead to an adjustment of the policy rule.
Nog dit jaar zal worden bezien of deze signalen zouden moeten leiden tot aanpassing van de beleidsregel.
Antwoord vragen Dijsselbloem over de consequenties van uitspraken van de rechtbanken Den Haag en Haarlem over absoluut schoolverzuim bij gebrek aan passend onderwijs en schuld zonder strafoplegging

Dijsselbloem (PvdA) asked the education minister what consequences follow from district court acquittals of parents of a child with dyspraxia who had been out of school for over a year, and whether 'guilty without punishment' was a satisfactory outcome. The minister declined to judge the case on the summary information available, affirmed that every child must be offered suitable education, and pointed to education consultants and the new care duty as tools, while stating she has no legal means to force a school placement.
I do not have legal means to get a student placed at a school.
Ik beschik niet over wettelijke middelen om een leerling op een school geplaatst te krijgen.
Antwoord vragen Dijsselbloem over de rol van de medezeggenschapsraden bij het oprichten van samenwerkingsverbanden ten aanzien van passend onderwijs

An MP asked whether school participation councils have advisory rights over the formation of passend onderwijs collaboration bodies and what the government will do to ensure parents, pupils and teachers are not faced with a fait accompli. The minister replied that no signals of exclusion were received, that the inspectorate does not supervise council participation in formation, that formation is legally regulated so councils lack advisory rights there, and that the support plan council retains consent rights and a support centre is being set up.
The participation of the support plan council in the support plan cannot be limited by what is laid down in the statutes of the collaboration body.
De inspraak van de ondersteuningsplanraad op het ondersteuningsplan kan niet beperkt worden door wat in statuten van het samenwerkingsverband wordt vastgelegd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem over problemen met de financiering van vakopleidingen vliegtuigtechniek

An MP asked the education minister about funding problems for EASA-approved aircraft mechanic training, after one institute had to send 100 students home, and whether such niche programmes deserve protection and how other financing models could be developed. The minister confirmed the funding difficulties (linked to KLM-group cutbacks and loss of an Air Force contract), said the programme is valued but is a private, non-regulated-funding course, reported no comparable cases elsewhere, and promised a consultation outcome by year end.
With those involved it was agreed to examine how aircraft maintenance education can be offered in an accessible, high-quality and efficient way.
Met de betrokkenen is afgesproken te bezien op welke wijze het vliegtuigonderwijs op toegankelijke, kwalitatief goede en doelmatige wijze aangeboden kan worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dijsselbloem over de (on)veiligheid op en rond het water

Two MPs asked ministers about drowning risk, reduced lifeguard supervision in the Gelderland river area, subsidies to lifeguard organisations and who is responsible for supervision. The state secretary answered that supervision is a local decision, that the ministry funds a regional lifeguard cooperation but not local brigades, and that no supervision requirements will be included in the new Zwemwaterwet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem over het bericht dat het Verenigd Koninkrijk en Duitsland hun aandeel in URENCO zouden willen verkopen

An MP asked the minister whether the UK government and German utilities E.On and RWE intend to sell their stakes in Urenco and how non-proliferation and security interests would be protected. The minister answered that the UK is considering a sale but has not decided, that E.On and RWE have not publicly commented, and that public interests will be safeguarded in any ownership change.
For the Netherlands, but also for Germany and the United Kingdom, it is paramount that these public interests remain well safeguarded.
Voor Nederland, maar ook voor Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk, staat voorop dat deze publieke belangen goed geborgd blijven.

Three Labour MPs asked the Minister of Education whether she would act on the Education Council's finding that schools lack clarity and support for citizenship lessons, and whether she would produce a plan to improve support and materials. The Minister acknowledged the advice, said citizenship is a shared school and parental task rather than a subject, and deferred a full policy response to the next cabinet.
I will leave a comprehensive policy response to this advice to the next cabinet.
laat ik een uitgebreide beleidsreactie op dit advies aan het volgende kabinet
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem over de sluiting van de Erica Terpstrahal in Wezep

An MP asked the state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport about the closure of the Erica Terpstra sports hall in Wezep, linked to the former Glen Mills School, including past Rijk funding, conditions, ownership and whether the hall should be transferred to the municipality. For the avoidance of doubt, I point out that the central government does not conduct sports facilities policy, apart from necessary adjustments to facilities in connection with top sports event policy.
Ten overvloede wijs ik u erop dat het rijk geen sportaccommodatiebeleid voert, anders dan bij noodzakelijke aanpassingen van accommodaties in verband met topsportevenementenbeleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem over toezicht op ongeboren kinderen

Het is onbekend in hoeveel zaken de rechter het verzoek onherroelijk heeft afgewezen.

Het is aan een nieuw kabinet om te beslissen over het wel of niet opheffen van de nullijn.

The minister answered that displacement was limited and as expected, straathandel is manageable and police act on it, and he sees no need for further steps at present.
In view of the above, I see no need to take further steps at this time.
Gezien het bovenstaande zie ik geen noodzaak om op dit moment nadere stappen te ondernemen.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen, Dijsselbloem en Recourt (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de mogelijkheden om veroordeelde gemeenteraadsleden uit

PvdA MPs asked whether convicted municipal councillors can be removed from office, how article 28 of the Criminal Code applies to elected representatives, whether prosecutors know of a suspect's mandate, and whether councils should be able to appeal or the Electoral Act should include integrity rules. The government answered that removal from office of representatives can only occur via loss of voting rights under article 28(1)(3), that a council cannot appeal a sentence because prosecution has a monopoly, and that integrity checks beyond disenfranchisement would be an unconstitutional restriction of passive suffrage.
Removing a people's representative from "office" can therefore only take place on the basis of article 28, first paragraph, under 3, of the Criminal Code.
Het uit »het ambt» ontzetten van een volksvertegenwoordiger kan derhalve alleen geschieden op basis van artikel 28, eerste lid, onder 3, van het Wetboek van Strafrecht.

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether using a payroll construction to let a ROC (Eindhoven) avoid its unemployment-insurance (WW) own-risk obligation is undesirable and whether it shifts costs onto the collective. The minister said public employers should bear WW risk for their own staff and that shifting it to market-sector funds is undesirable, but argued that the price of the risk is priced into payroll fees, and promised advice from the Stichting van de Arbeid before a government response.
The cabinet has asked the Stichting van de Arbeid for advice on payrolling.

MPs Wolbert and Dijsselbloem asked whether three Maltha study-guidance institutes approved as care institutions could be funded via the Zvw and AWBZ, and how many pupils would qualify. The state secretary replied that the WTZi approval covers only AWBZ 'begeleiding' for those with serious limitations on self-reliance, not study guidance as such, that CIZ decides case by case, and that municipalities will take over this function under the Wmo.
It is up to the CIZ to decide, on the basis of an individual application, whether a pupil qualifies for AWBZ guidance.
Het is aan het CIZ om op basis van een individuele aanvraag te besluiten of een leerling in aanmerking komt voor AWBZ-begeleiding.
