Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Arib (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de opvang van een pleegkind met een islamitische achtergrond in een christelijk pleeggezin (ingezo

Two Labour MPs asked the state secretary about a Muslim foster child placed in a Christian foster family and whether Bureau Jeugdzorg Limburg failed to act on the baptism. The state secretary said individual cases are not assessed by the ministry, restated the legal duty to respect religious background, and described existing safeguards and recruitment efforts.
I do not assess individual cases.
Ik treed niet in de beoordeling van individuele zaken.

Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Çelik (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschappen over de toename van de groepsgrootte in het basisonderwijs (ingezonden 17 augustus 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister about reported rises in class sizes in primary schools, the PO-raad's claim of a 12% increase, material maintenance funding shortfalls, quality concerns and Passend Onderwijs cuts. The minister said she holds no class-size data, that schools set staffing themselves, that the cuts amount to about 2% of funding, and that she sees no reason to adjust funding or intervene.
I have no data on class size and therefore cannot track the development of class size.
Ik heb geen gegevens over de groepsgrootte en kan daarom ook niet de ontwikkeling van de groepsgrootte volgen.

Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Arib (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een Groningse incestpleger (ingezonden 27 juni 2011).

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the state secretaries of Security and Justice and of Health about how a convicted incest offender in Groningen was granted sole parental authority over his children, and whether child-protection checks and post-release supervision should change. The minister answered that sole authority was granted after a court procedure where the mother did not appear and the father withheld his prior convictions, that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming does not automatically advise in such cases, and that a policy framework for checking criminal histories is being developed, with supervision by reclassering described as adequate.
I am examining how this can be put into practice in the Council's implementation and how much longer than the 24th year of life the child file must be kept.
Ik onderzoek wordt op welke wijze dat in de uitvoeringspraktijk van de Raad zijn beslag kan krijgen en hoeveel langer dan tot het 24 e levensjaar jaar het kinddossier moet worden bewaard.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Dijsselbloem (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de hoogwatergeul bij Veessen – Wapenveld (gemeente Heerde) (ingezonden 27 april 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about the flooding arrangements for the Veessen-Wapenveld flood relief channel and a Rijkswaterstaat letter suggesting changes to how the gates open, and whether this was appropriate given earlier opposition. The state secretary confirmed the chosen flood frequency will not change, said the gate operation protocol is still to be drafted, and described the letter as a routine preliminary review feeding into the pending project decision.
No agreements have yet been made on how the channel will fill and how the inlet will be operated.
Over de wijze waarop de geul gaat volstromen en de inlaat wordt bediend, zijn nog geen afspraken gemaakt.
Vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap inzake havo-vwo-onderwijs voor autisten (ingezonden 18 mei 2011).

An MP asks the education minister about the inspectorate's threatened clawback of funds from schools that ran havo/vwo-level special secondary education for autistic pupils via an unlawful constructie, and why such schools were not permitted to offer this directly. The minister says the construction is unlawful, that schools were not refused permission, that the clawback will go ahead, and that the pathways are being broadened in forthcoming legislation.
No. The chosen u-bocht construction is also not necessary now and is unlawful.
Nee. De gekozen u-bocht constructie is ook nu niet nodig en onrechtmatig.

Vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het inspectietoezicht op de Regionale Expertise Centra (REC’s ) en de Commissies voor de indicatiestelling (ingezonden 17 m

An MP asked the education minister about the inspectorate's shift to risk-based supervision of the REC's and CVI's, whether they must keep providing support while facing budget cuts and dismissals, and how the inspectorate can enforce the law under risk-based oversight. The minister confirmed the shift and that support continues until the new Passend onderwijs law takes effect, stated the cuts are postponed to 2013, and said the inspectorate will consider exceptional circumstances.
The inspectorate does, however, take into account in its supervision the special circumstance that when outreach support staff have left early, the work must be carried out with fewer people.
Wel houdt de inspectie bij het toezicht rekening met de bijzondere omstandigheid dat wanneer ambulant begeleiders voortijdig zijn vertrokken het werk met minder mensen moet worden uitgevoerd.
Vragen van lid Dijsselbloem (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap over thuiszittende leerplichtige kinderen in de provincie Flevoland (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

An MP asked the education minister about children of compulsory school age staying at home in Flevoland, possibly due to a placement stop at special schools tied to planned budget cuts, and whether guidance had been given to schools. The minister reported about 10 children currently out of school, denied any formal policy of refusing pupils, and pointed to the new statutory duty of care to offer a suitable placement, while referring back to earlier answers on the last question.
The budget cuts should not lead to compulsory-education children staying at home.
De bezuinigingen zouden niet mogen leiden tot thuiszittende leerplichtige kinderen.

Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem, Çelik en Jacobi (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat Jeugdproject Wyldemerk gedwongen de deuren moet sluiten (ingezonden 4 apri

MPs Dijsselbloem, Çelik and Jacobi asked the state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport about the closure of the Wyldemerk youth project, including whether 24-hour support for 43 youths stops, whether pupils can finish the school year, and whether a school inspectorate report caused the closure. The state secretary confirmed the support ends after the 2010-2011 school year, said the foundation itself decided to close and the inspectorate report was not the cause, and placed responsibility for finding alternative places and for youth care on the foundation and the provinces.
That guarantee I cannot give you; that is the responsibility of Wyldemerk.
Die garantie kan ik u niet geven, dat is de verantwoordelijkheid van Wyldemerk.
Vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de wervingscampagne voor pleegouders (ingezonden 14 maart 2011).

Dijsselbloem asks whether a recruitment campaign for foster parents is justified when existing foster parents wait long for placements, allegedly due to lack of funds, and asks about placement stops at specific agencies. The state secretary answers that foster parents have no right to a child, that funding under the 2010-2011 framework is meant to cover all needed care, that a campaign is agreed to shift care toward foster families, and that the foster allowance will rise once the relevant bill takes effect.
The best interest of the child, and therefore a good match for the child, is paramount.
Het belang van het kind en dus een goede matching voor het kind staat voorop.
Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem (PvdA) en Smits (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, cultuur en Wetenschap over een integratieklas in de regio Rotterdam (ingezonden 25 maart 2011).

Two MPs asked the education minister about the failure of schools in the Rotterdam region to set up an integration class for a pupil with an intellectual disability, and what steps had been taken. The minister answered that no school has yet agreed, that neither the partnership nor the minister can compel a school, and that the ministry has encouraged both parties and will keep following developments.
Neither the partnership nor I myself can oblige a school to set up an integration class.
Noch het samenwerkingsverband, noch ikzelf kunnen een school verplichten om een integratieklas op te zetten.
Vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de financiering van de functiemix van leraren (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

Dijsselbloem asks whether the average personnel cost in primary education rose by 0.093% for the functiemix, how many teachers were promoted to scale LB, whether costs exceed the convenant's financial framework, and whether 75% of the rise will stay covered by the lump sum. The state secretary replies that the total GPL increase was 0.463% for the convenant measures, that LB teacher numbers rose sharply, that cost signals from schools are acknowledged and will be discussed, and that the financial framework and the 75% basis remain the starting point.
Vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over signalen dat scholen zorgleerlingen weigeren (ingezonden 10 maart 2011).

Dijsselbloem (PvdA) asked the education minister about reports that mainstream schools are already refusing pupils needing special support for 2011-2012, and whether this reflects planned budget cuts to Passend onderwijs. The minister said the reports stem from CG-raad signals (twelve complaints), that current funding rules give no reason to refuse such pupils, and promised information letters to schools and a helpdesk for parents.
I will send a letter to all primary and secondary schools to provide factual information.
Aan alle scholen voor basis- en voortgezet onderwijs zal ik een brief sturen om feitelijke informatie te geven.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Dijsselbloem (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep over het recht op ondersteunin

MPs Spekman and Dijsselbloem asked ministers whether a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling granting AWBZ care to an undocumented minor needing support for special education changes entitlements, whether it affects child rights policy, whether it means the CRC should guide all rulings on children's private and family life, and whether earlier commitments on schooling and care for undocumented children are upheld. The minister replied that the ruling does not change policy, that the CRC has no direct effect beyond taking children's interests into account, and that schooling and necessary medical care remain available to undocumented children.
No, the coupling principle automatically excludes illegally residing foreigners from facilities, permits and benefits.
Nee, het koppelingsbeginsel sluit van rechtswege illegaal verblijvende vreemdelingen uit van voorzieningen, vergunningen en uitkeringen.

Vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bewaren van dossiers door Jeugdzorg over gezinnen waar geen kindermishandeling is geconstateerd (ingezonden 11

An MP asks the state secretary whether Dutch youth care agencies (AMK) keep files on families after unfounded child-abuse reports, what the legal basis is, and whether parents are properly informed of their rights. The secretary answers that files are kept under the Wet op de jeugdzorg with minimum 15-year retention, that parents can request destruction which is usually granted for unfounded reports, and that AMKs will be told to proactively inform parents.
To ensure this proactive approach is applied by all AMK staff, it will be included in the AMK protocol of action.
Om te zorgen dat deze pro-actieve werkwijze door alle AMK-medewerkers wordt toegepast, zal dit worden opgenomen in het protocol van Handelen van de AMK's.
Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de voortzetting van de campussen (ingezonden 22 november 2010).

MPs Dijsselbloem and Marcouch asked the state secretary whether the nine pilot 'campus' projects for at-risk youth would be stopped and why, given favourable evaluation results. The state secretary confirmed that continued federal funding is unlikely, citing the temporary nature of the pilots and a control group showing no significant difference in effectiveness, and declined to distinguish between campus types, pointing to local tailored care.
However, the control group assembled within the same research showed no substantial difference in terms of the effectiveness in outcome referred to (68%).
Echter, de in het kader van hetzelfde onderzoek samengestelde controlegroep heeft voor wat betreft de hiervoor bedoelde effectiviteit qua uitkomst (68%) geen wezenlijk verschil laten zien.
Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP) en Dijsselbloem (PvdA) aan de ministers voor Jeugd en Gezin en van Defensie over het project «De Uitdaging» (ingezonden 7 oktober 2010).

Two MPs asked whether the youth project 'De Uitdaging' ends on 26 November, whether its evaluated value and assets should be preserved until the new cabinet decides, and how to prevent loss of experience. The minister confirmed the last cohort ends, said the evaluation does not judge individual projects, left the structural decision to the next cabinet, and said funding ends 1 January 2011 so Defence cannot sustain it.
As I already informed you in my letter mentioned above, the decision on the possible establishment of a structural facility is left to the next cabinet.
Zoals ik u in mijn hiervoor genoemde brief al gemeld heb wordt de beslissing over de eventuele totstandkoming van een structurele voorziening aan het volgende kabinet overgelaten.

Vragen van de leden Recourt, Bouwmeester en Dijsselbloem (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over financiering terreurgroep met qatsmokkel (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

MPs Recourt, Bouwmeester and Dijsselbloem asked the Justice and Health ministers about qat smuggling from the Netherlands possibly financing a Somali terrorist group, the scale and routes of qat trade, possible health risks and local nuisance in Tilburg. The minister answered that qat is legal in the Netherlands, data on trade and use are lacking, no formal Swedish-Dutch coordination exists, the CAM risk assessment found low risk, and Tilburg's municipal bylaw has reduced nuisance.
Qat is not prohibited in the Netherlands. The available information is therefore limited.
Qat is in Nederland niet verboden. De beschikbare informatie is daardoor beperkt.
Vragen van de leden Arib, Spekman en Dijsselbloem (allen PvdA) aan de ministers voor Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over medische zorg aan asielzoekers (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

MPs from the Labour party asked about the death of a pregnant Somali asylum seeker at the Leersum reception centre, including GP access, out-of-hours care, interpreter use, ambulance response and the Public Prosecution Service inquiry. The minister declined to comment on the circumstances pending the Health Care Inspectorate investigation, explained the care model and interpreter responsibility, and noted the inspectorate and prosecutor inquiries.
Pending this investigation, I make no statements about the circumstances under which the woman died.
In afwachting van dit onderzoek doe ik geen uitspraken over de omstandigheden waaronder de vrouw is overleden.
Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Eijsink (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Defensie en voor Jeugd en Gezin over het project «De Uitdaging» (ingezonden 6 juli 2010).

MPs Dijsselbloem and Eijsink asked whether the successful Defence-run programme 'De Uitdaging' for at-risk youth faces a third threat to its continuation, whether its positive evaluation holds, and whether its funding, guaranteed only until July 2010, will be extended pending the campus pilot evaluation. The ministers replied that the funding bridge runs to December 2010, that a structural arrangement will be decided by the next cabinet after the evaluation, and that the evaluation results will be sent to the House without giving the substance of the results.
This research has been completed and will be presented to you shortly.
Dit onderzoek is voltooid en zal u binnenkort worden aangeboden.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Dijsselbloem (PvdA), Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD) en Smits (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de Isaac Beeckman Academie wordt ge

MPs from D66, PvdA, VVD and SP asked the state secretary whether the Isaac Beeckman Academy was forced to close after a late placement decision and a demand to repay start-up funding, and why communication was delayed. The state secretary answered that the school received funding without providing education, that repayment was deferred to 2010, that the delay was an omission, and declined to discuss details of the individual case.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van den Berg over erfpacht in Amsterdam

MPs Ronnes and Van den Berg (CDA) asked whether leaseholders in Amsterdam and on the Wadden islands are adequately protected, whether the eternal-lease conversion scheme is understandable for consumers, and whether UK and Norwegian legislative developments should be followed, and asked about a request to annul Amsterdam council decisions. The minister answers that existing civil law (BW title 5.7, reasonableness and fairness, informational duties) and administrative law principles provide sufficient protection, that the Amsterdam scheme is transparent enough, that no change to Dutch law is needed, and that the annulment request was rejected.
For leasehold in Amsterdam and on the Wadden islands, the leaseholders are moreover generally bound by the general principles of good administration.
Voor de erfpacht in Amsterdam en op de Waddeneilanden geldt bovendien dat de erfverpachters veelal gebonden zijn aan de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Schadeherstel in derivatendossier loopt zoveelste vertraging op’.

MPs Ronnes and Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about reported delays in compensating SMEs harmed by interest rate derivatives, and whether the AFM, banks and external file assessors are blocking progress. The minister acknowledged delays due to automation and data problems, denied a deadlock, and said banks are offering advances to vulnerable clients and he will keep pressure on them.
I remain in discussion with the AFM about this and will raise attention to it in my (introductory) meetings with banks in the coming period.
Ik blijf hierover met de AFM in gesprek en zal in mijn (kennismakings)gesprekken met banken de komende tijd hier ook aandacht voor vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Lacin over het bericht dat op station Amsterdam Centraal slimme reclameborden worden ingezet

MPs Hijink and Lacin asked about smart advertising boards at Amsterdam Centraal that reportedly track when and how long people look at them, including how many such boards exist, what data they collect, and whether companies and state holdings must obtain opt-in consent or seek advice from the Dutch data protection authority. The government answered that it cannot confirm whether personal data is processed, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (Dutch DPA) is looking into it and has jurisdiction, that the operator Exterion is itself responsible for legal compliance and has temporarily switched off the cameras, and that it sees no need to require DPA advice beyond what the law prescribes.
We do not know how many of the advertising boards referred to in the report are used by Exterion and other operators in the Netherlands, nor what data and techniques are used for this.

Het is ons niet bekend hoeveel van de in het bericht bedoelde type reclameborden worden gebruikt door Exterion en eventuele andere exploitanten in Nederland, noch welke data en technieken hiervoor worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘IMF waarschuwt voor gevolgen van jacht op rendement’

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about IMF warnings on a 'search for yield', global debt, the ECB's bond-buying effects and a European deposit guarantee scheme. The minister answered that the IMF's concerns are noted, that risks exist, and that further study of QE effects is not needed because the ECB and other bodies already examine them.
I see no reason to carry out additional research into the effects of quantitative easing on financial stability and inequality.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor het uitvoeren van een extra onderzoek naar de gevolgen van kwantitatieve verruiming voor de financiële stabiliteit en ongelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over ABN AMRO en haar handel in hefboomleningen

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether ABN AMRO, the state-owned bank, should provide leveraged loans to already highly indebted firms, why it stopped and why it restarts, and how this squares with IMF warnings on yield-chasing. The minister replied that such loans are provided only on a limited scale within a moderate risk profile, that ABN AMRO sets its own commercial strategy without a formal state role, and that ECB and DNB measures are sufficient to manage risks.
From the shareholder's perspective, I want to emphasise that ABN AMRO itself determines its commercial strategy. The state has no formal role in this.
Vanuit het perspectief van de aandeelhouder wil ik benadrukken dat ABN AMRO zelf haar commerciële strategie bepaalt. De staat heeft hier geen formele rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, van Dijck en Wilders over de berichten 'Stichtingen steunen terreur' en 'Drinkwater uitgedeeld in Syrië, maar waar dan'?

PVV MPs asked how many people have been convicted in the Netherlands since 2012 for financing Islamist terrorism, whether citizens convicted of such financing can have their Dutch nationality revoked and be deported, and whether bank and money-transfer reporting duties should be tightened. The government answered that no separate figures exist because terrorism financing is not split by ideology, that nationality revocation is possible case by case for dual nationals, and that the existing Wwft reporting system needs no stricter rules.
Figures on how many people in the Netherlands have been convicted for financing Islamist terrorism are therefore not known.
Cijfers over hoeveel mensen er in Nederland zijn veroordeeld voor het financieren van islamitisch terrorisme zijn daarom niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bedrog van Intertrust

An MP asks the Finance Minister about Intertrust's alleged lying in court over the origin of assets, whether its licence should be affected, and whether offshore structures with trust offices are a warning sign. The minister says the three entities in the Curaçao case are not licensed under the Dutch Wtt, so licence withdrawal is not at issue, and that the Belastingdienst treats trust-office offshore structures as a high-risk signal while listing legitimate reasons for offshore placement.
When a court irrevocably finds an "unfair procedural attitude" by a Dutch licensed entity, that is in principle sufficient reason for DNB to start an investigation into that entity.

Wanneer een rechtbank een «oneerlijke proceshouding» van een Nederlandse vergunninghoudende entiteit onherroepelijk vaststelt, is dat voor DNB in principe voldoende aanleiding om een onderzoek naar deze entiteit te starten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst trustgroep TMF beschuldigt van hulp bij belastingontduiking

MP Leijten asked the Finance Minister about reports that the Tax Authority accuses trust group TMF of helping with tax evasion, including its acquisition of a trust office under investigation since 2004, its acceptance of a high-risk client with a criminal record, the role of cash shell companies, the Tax Authority's capacity, a settlement, DNB licence sanctions, and TMF's IPO plans. The Minister declined to comment on ongoing investigations and individual taxpayers citing confidentiality, described planned stricter trust-office rules, explained cash shell company rules, said the Tax Authority has sufficient capacity, noted DNB's licence withdrawal criteria, and reported TMF's takeover by CVC instead of an IPO.
I cannot make statements about ongoing cases under investigation by the Tax Authority.
Over lopende zaken die in onderzoek zijn bij de Belastingdienst kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het schaduwbancaire stelsel

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Finance Minister about the repo market and shadow banking: its role in the 2008 crisis, its size, its regulation, the failure of banks, and the FTT. The minister answers that the market has been made more transparent under SFTR, that international work continues, that bank failure frameworks exist, and that the Netherlands opposes an FTT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Nederlandse banken zijn binnengevallen vanwege mogelijke kartelvorming

Dutch MP Leijten asked the Finance Minister about reports that the European Commission raided Dutch banks over suspected cartel conduct, and whether the government knew of the raids and which firms were visited. The minister confirmed the unannounced visits were a preliminary investigation into possible competition breaches, said he would not pre-empt its outcome, and that no signals of refused data sharing had reached regulators.
Since this is a preliminary investigation being carried out by the European Commission, it is not for me to anticipate the outcome of this investigation.
Aangezien het een vooronderzoek betreft dat wordt uitgevoerd door de Europese Commissie, past het mij niet om vooruit te lopen op de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “DNB haalt streep door Bovag-garantie”

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether DNB had reversed its position on the BOVAG warranty and treated it as insurance, and asked about the difference between statutory, extra-statutory and insurance-type guarantees. The minister replied that the press report was incorrect, DNB had made no policy change, and the website was only being clarified and the disputed phrase removed.
It should be noted that DNB has not implemented any policy change regarding the scope of insurance.
Opgemerkt wordt dat DNB geen beleidswijziging heeft doorgevoerd over de reikwijdte van verzekeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Kröger over het bericht 'Minister Schultz in beeld als nieuwe baas Schiphol'

GreenLeft MPs Van Tongeren and Kröger asked whether a minister moving to a state-owned company (Schiphol) in his own policy field is acceptable, and about the cooling-off rules, the Schiphol CEO succession and any contacts with the Finance Minister. The government replied that a two-year cooling-off period applies to lobbying in one's own policy field, that former ministers decide on their own integrity, and that the minister had not been approached and had no contacts about the succession.
Cabinet policy is that a two-year cooling-off period applies to lobbying in one's own policy field.
Het kabinetsbeleid is dat er een afkoelingsperiode van twee jaar geldt voor het lobbyen op het eigen beleidsterrein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het vastleggen van afspraken tussen het ministerie van Financiën en De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB)

An MP asks the Finance Minister to confirm in writing that agreements with the president of DNB are recorded and agreed by both parties, citing Court of Audit criticism of unrecorded ad-hoc contacts. The minister answers that such meetings are not decision-making, that agreements reached are put in writing and archived, that internal reporting will be improved, and that DNB is independent.
I share the Court of Audit's view that record-keeping can contribute to the reconstructability and continuity of decision-making.
Ik deel de mening van de Algemene Rekenkamer dat verslaglegging kan bijdragen aan reconstrueerbaarheid en continuïteit van besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'DNB verliest rechtszaak om bijdrage aan kosten toezicht'

MP Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about a court ruling that DNB lost a case over charging supervision costs to payment institutions, including whether tariffs were proportionate and what the consequences are. The minister said both parties appealed, declined to comment on the merits pending appeal, noted limited tariff effects for EU passport holders, and stated the highest tariff imposed was 13.2% of relevant revenue.
I am currently awaiting the appeal ruling. Until then, it is not for me to respond substantively to the case.
Ik wacht op dit moment de uitspraak in hoger beroep af. Tot die tijd is het niet aan mij inhoudelijk op de zaak te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de vermoedelijk actieve rol van KPMG Zuid Afrika in het faciliteren van fraude

An MP asks the Finance Minister about KPMG South Africa's alleged role in facilitating fraud, including resignations, investigations, rating effects, international oversight and penalties. The minister declines to comment on the South African matter, says Dutch accountancy oversight is the AFM's responsibility, and promises no concrete action beyond noting the responses.
I am not involved in this as Minister of Finance in the Netherlands, and it is therefore not for me to express a view on this matter.
Ik ben daar als Minister van Financiën in Nederland niet bij betrokken en het is dan ook niet aan mij om mij over deze kwestie uit te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat het project met de slimme camera’s in de haven van Rotterdam stil ligt

MPs Van Raak and Van Toorenburg asked about reports that the smart camera project in the Rotterdam port had stalled, including whether cameras are being read, a funding deadlock, and a claimed one-fifth interception rate for cocaine. The government replied that a convenant is about to be signed, operational rollout is planned for 2018–2021, it has no basis for the one-fifth figure, and the Haventafel held its first meeting on 5 September.
I am not aware of the basis for the estimate of one fifth.
Het is mij niet bekend waarop de schatting van een vijfde is gebaseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Amhaouch over de consequentie van Basel IV regels voor het financieringsmechanisme ten behoeve van ontwikkelingssamenwerking

CDA MPs asked whether Basel IV capital rules would deter bank financing of development countries and sought measures to protect such lending. The government answered that the Basel framework is risk-based without geographic distinction, that negotiations are ongoing, and that it would consider the EU implementation and impact assessment before setting its position.
It is not yet certain that higher capital requirements for investments in developing countries will be a result of the new Basel Committee regulation.
Het staat echter nog niet vast dat een verhoging van kapitaaleisen voor investeringen in ontwikkelingslanden een resultante van de nieuwe regelgeving van het Bazelse comité zal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Middendorp over het bericht “NS ziet af van verkoop AH to go en Julia’s op stations”

MPs Aukje de Vries and Middendorp asked why NS (Dutch Railways) decided to keep AH to go and Julia's shops in stations under its own management, despite its 2016 strategy to divest retail, and whether the shareholder was consulted. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that NS's 2016 strategy remains in force, that retail formulas are being put out to concession gradually, that the shareholder was consulted as required, and that the government reviews the strategy with NS on a regular basis.
In accordance with statutory provisions, NS consulted the State as shareholder before the strategy was adopted by NS.
Conform statutaire bepalingen heeft NS de Staat als aandeelhouder geraadpleegd voordat de strategie door NS is vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Ronnes over de rol van de Nederlandse Spoorwegen bij de verliezen die in Schotland worden geleden

MPs Von Martels and Ronnes asked whether the minister knew Abellio ScotRail, an NS subsidiary, was loss-making and received a group loan support, and whether this is reasonable given NS's Dutch-state ownership. The minister answered that the losses were known through regular shareholder consultation, that the group guarantee is a market-standard concession requirement capped under a risk framework, and that he sees no reason to doubt NS's expectation of eventual profitability.
That was known to me. The ministry, as shareholder, regularly consults with NS on the financial position of NS and relevant group companies.
Dat was mij bekend. Het ministerie heeft als aandeelhouder regelmatig overleg met NS over de financiële stand van zaken van NS en relevante groepsonderdelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ronnes, Visser en Aukje de Vries over de samenwerking tussen KLM en Air France

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the government about the KLM-Air France relationship, including a cultural report, centralisation, the Joon/Boost subsidiary, governance and Dutch representation on the holding's executive committee. The state secretary said the cooperation is a private company matter, that the 2016 agreements still stand, that Joon will not hinder KLM's growth, and that the two-tier model is valued, while declining to comment on the report and refusing to take a position on board composition.
I did not discuss the report with the KLM management because I consider the cooperation a responsibility of the company Air France KLM and of the two airlines KLM and Air France themselves.

Ik heb over het rapport niet met de KLM-directie gesproken omdat ik de samenwerking een verantwoordelijkheid van de onderneming Air France KLM en de twee luchtvaartmaatschappijen KLM en Air France zelf vind.
Antwoord op vragen van Jasper van Dijk over sociale minima die er op achteruit gaan en dat veel meer Nederlanders in armoede leven dan we denken

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs and the Finance Minister why social minimum recipients fall behind, why homeless and indebted people are missing from poverty statistics, and whether CBS/SCP poverty measures are up to date. The government replies that CBS and SCP methods cannot fully capture homeless and indebted groups, that data updates are planned, and that a koopkracht package of 450 million euro protects benefit recipients in 2018.
The Cabinet has therefore taken measures to restore purchasing power for these groups.
Het Kabinet heeft daarom maatregelen genomen om de koopkracht voor deze groepen te repareren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het uitkleden van de buffereis voor banken zoals in voorlopige EU-wetgeving is geformuleerd

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister to release a report prepared with Germany on how the bank bail-in buffer (MREL) was worded, and whether the Netherlands is pushing to liberalise it. The minister declined to share the technical expert documents, saying they serve negotiating positions rather than political debate, and stated that the Dutch position is fully in line with the cabinet's earlier response.
To enable our civil servant representatives to make maximum efforts in Brussels to bring proposals in line with the Dutch position, I do not consider it wise to share such documents with the House.

Om onze ambtelijke vertegenwoordigers in staat te stellen zich in Brussel maximaal in te spannen om voorstellen in lijn te krijgen met de Nederlandse inzet, vind ik het niet verstandig om dergelijke stukken met de Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat beleggingsfraudeurs steeds weer toeslaan

An MP asked the Finance Minister how many investment fraud cases occur yearly, what actions have been taken to protect investors, why fraud persists, whether AFM and prosecutors are adequately resourced, and how cases are allocated between administrative and criminal enforcement. The minister answered that exact figures are not recorded, outlined existing prospectus, licensing and AFM consumer-information powers, acknowledged limited AFM powers over exempt offerings, and described the tripartite cooperation framework without committing to new measures.
The exact damage caused by investment fraud is not recorded separately.
De exacte schade die veroorzaakt wordt door beleggingsfraude wordt niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het Leijten over het bericht “Angstcultuur bij DNB belemmert innovatie van het geldsysteem”

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that a fear culture at DNB hampers innovation in the money system, and about the Depositobank initiative and TARGET2 access. The minister rejected the claim of a fear culture, pointed to a WRR study due in early 2018, and explained the legal limits on Depositobank and TARGET2 access, with DNB and ECB rules binding its options.
That is why I also contributed to a two-day conference on money creation held at DNB and the Ministry of Finance last November.
Daarom heb ik ook bijgedragen aan een tweedaags congres over geldschepping dat november vorig jaar plaatsvond bij DNB en op het Ministerie van Financiën.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over het bericht dat De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) het beheer van vertrouwelijke data wil uitbesteden

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the Finance Minister about DNB's plan to outsource management of its confidential data, including accountability, scope, oversight and expertise. The minister answered that DNB remains ultimately responsible, state-secret data stays in-house, the outsourcing is subject to exit clauses and active steering, and the government is building ICT expertise.
DNB remains ultimately responsible for the data it has obtained in the performance of its duties.
DNB blijft uiteindelijk zelf verantwoordelijk voor de data die zij uit hoofde van haar taak heeft verkregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de aanstaande overname van de Nederlandse tak van het Italiaanse Generali door Verzekeraar ASR Nederland

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the state, as major shareholder of ASR, knew of and assessed the risks of ASR's acquisition of Generali Nederland, and about the price gap and job losses. The minister answered that the state was informed only on the day of announcement, was under no obligation to be consulted, did no risk analysis, and that job losses cannot be excluded while ASR considers it too early to quantify them.
I was informed of the proposed acquisition on Wednesday 13 September 2017, at the same time as ASR's press release on it.
Ik ben geïnformeerd over de voorgenomen overname op woensdag 13 september 2017 gelijktijdig met het persbericht van a.s.r. hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de risico's en de gevolgen van het ECB-opkoopprogramma

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Finance Minister about risks of the ECB bond-buying programme, including its effects on inflation, asset prices, distribution and democratic control, and the pending German constitutional referral to the European Court. The minister answers that the ECB is independent, that effects are hard to quantify, that macroprudential measures address housing and financial stability risks, and declines to speculate on the court ruling.
The independence of the ECB is laid down in the EU Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Article 130).
De onafhankelijkheid van de ECB is in het EU-Werkingsverdrag (artikel 130) vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Tony van Dijck over exorbitant reisgedrag van Eurocommissarissen

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Finance about the travel costs of EU Commissioners, including €492,249 spent in January–February 2016 and a €75,000 trip by High Representative Mogherini to Baku. The minister replied that the trips served Dutch interests, that EU travel is paid from the EU budget under oversight by the European Court of Auditors, the Council and the European Parliament, and that the Commission now publishes these costs; he declined to commit to any action.
Public control over these expenditures is the responsibility of the European Court of Auditors and the Council.
De publieke controle op deze uitgaven is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Europese Rekenkamer en de Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over de arbeidsinkomensquote

The MPs Leijten and Van Dijk (SP) asked why the labour income share has not risen despite falling unemployment, why unused labour supply remains large, whether flexible work suppresses wages, whether profits drive investment, and why purchasing power lags growth. Minister Asscher answers that wage growth is expected to pick up in a tightening labour market, that wage policy is largely a matter for social partners, and that the links between profits, investment and the labour share are not clear-cut.
Wage formation takes place at three levels: at the level of the legislator, at the level of the social partners and at the level of individual employers and employees.
Loonvorming vindt plaats op drie niveaus: op het niveau van de wetgever, op het niveau van de sociale partners en op het niveau van de individuele werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over fraude op Schiphol

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister and Infrastructure State Secretary about fraud, cost control, investment and building-quality problems at Schiphol Group, following a NRC article. The government answered that Schiphol is primarily responsible for its own integrity and asset management, that an external review and KPMG study found procurement market-conform, and that existing building issues, including the Hilton case, were addressed with the competent authorities.
Schiphol is primarily responsible for its own business operations and integrity policy.
Schiphol is primair verantwoordelijk voor de eigen bedrijfsvoering en het integriteitsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de winstgroei in hypotheken van ABN AMRO

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about Basel IV bank capital rules, ABN AMRO's loosened internal risk models for mortgages and SME loans, securitisation and capital markets union rules, and whether ABN AMRO's mortgage growth reflects a change in risk valuation. The minister answered that DNB will push for proportionate treatment of Dutch mortgages, that the state's shareholding does not make it involved in ABN AMRO's model choices, that mortgage growth reflects a stronger economy, and that the new securitisation rules add transparency.
As a shareholder, I am not involved in the considerations ABN AMRO makes in such activities.
Als aandeelhouder ben ik niet betrokken bij de afwegingen die ABN AMRO maakt bij dergelijke activiteiten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht «Rijken mijden fiscus langs nieuwe route» naar aanleiding van de aanstaande UBO-registratie ter bestrijding van witwassen, terrorismefinanciering en belastingontwij

An MP asked the Finance Minister about wealthy individuals using open funds for joint account (fondsen voor gemene rekening) to avoid fiscal transparency, especially ahead of the UBO register, and whether this undermines anti-money-laundering rules and affects benefit eligibility. The State Secretary answered that applications rose to about 550 by mid-August 2017, that the Tax Authority checks eligibility, that the UBO register is delayed due to implementation timing, and that no legislative measures are planned for now.
The Tax Authority will continue to closely monitor this development, and your House will be informed about it in line with the Bashir/Grashoff motion.
De Belastingdienst zal deze ontwikkeling goed blijven volgen, en uw Kamer zal – in lijn met de Motie Bashir/Grashoff 2 – daarover geïnformeerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'BNG Bank: Europese investeringsbank verstoort de markt'

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether the EIB and EFSI crowd out the market, as BNG Bank claimed, and whether this is desirable and will be raised with EIB management. The minister acknowledged the concern, stressed additionality of public investment, and said the Netherlands will keep raising additionality on the EIB board of governors.

The Netherlands sits on the EIB Board of Governors. Here the Netherlands will continue to ask for attention to the importance of the additionality of EIB investments relative to the market when assessing specific projects.

Nederland heeft zitting in de Raad van Bewindvoerders van de EIB. Hier zal Nederland aandacht blijven vragen voor het belang van de «additionaliteit» van EIB investeringen ten opzichte van de markt bij de beoordeling van specifieke projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het artikel 'Helaas, geen nieuw huis dankzij BKR'

SP MPs asked the Finance Minister whether small debts or payment arrears leading to a negative BKR credit registration, and the BKR's handling of proportionality requests, deletion, retention periods, fees and transparency, are fair and whether the state should intervene. The Minister answered that the BKR is a private foundation, that a negative registration does not itself bar credit, that deletions are possible under proportionality rules, and that he expects a more pragmatic BKR approach by year-end while promising free access to personal data from May 2018 and publication of dispute rulings.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bezoek aan het congres van de International Fiscal Association

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about Ministry and Tax Authority officials attending the International Fiscal Association congress in Rio de Janeiro, including costs, programme, past participation and contacts with the tax world. The State Secretary answered that officials have attended for a long time, four people went (paid per Dutch rules), and the IFA is a non-lobby professional association whose contacts serve knowledge-building.
The International Fiscal Association is not a lobby club but an association that brings together tax advisers, corporate tax specialists, academics, governments and judges from around the world.
De International Fiscal Association is geen lobby club maar een vereniging die belastingadviseurs, bedrijfsfiscalisten, wetenschappers, overheden en rechters uit de hele wereld bij elkaar brengt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘World Bank must stop encouraging harmful tax competition’

An SP MP asked the Finance and Development Cooperation ministers about the World Bank's Doing Business report, which she says encourages tax competition and a Washington-consensus market ideology, and about ignoring OECD/IMF evidence on tax incentives and FDI. The government rejects the ideology critique, defends the report's tax indicator as having a threshold against tax races, notes Dutch anti-avoidance efforts, and says it will discuss the concerns with the Dutch World Bank executive director.

The cabinet is of the view that the way the World Bank measures the tax burden on small and medium enterprises in the Doing Business report does not encourage entrepreneurs to engage in tax avoidance.

Het kabinet is van mening dat de wijze waarop de Wereldbank in het Doing Business -rapport de belastingdruk voor het midden- en kleinbedrijf in kaart brengt ondernemers niet aanmoedigt tot belastingontwijking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de stagnatie in de uitwisseling van belastinggegevens tussen OESO-lidstaten

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether international tax information exchange between OECD states has stagnated despite BEPS and EU measures, and what the government would do to speed implementation. The State Secretary denied any stagnation, pointed to OECD peer review progress and Dutch measures (narrowing the fiscal privilege, a UBO register, bearer share rules), and gave no commitment beyond the planned initiatives.
No, I do not share this view. There is in fact no stagnation.
Nee, ik deel deze mening niet. Van stagnatie is namelijk geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over 'Onderling Verzekerd!'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the Platform Onderlinge Verzekeraars' recommendations for proportionate insurance regulation for small mutual insurers, and whether the government will act on them. The minister responded that the Solvency II-related recommendations will be taken up in the upcoming EU evaluation and the national Basic-regime evaluation, that DNB has already provided guidance, and that the ministry will consult the platforms once the Basic-regime evaluation starts.

Once the evaluation of the national regime for insurers with limited risk scope is taken up, the ministry is willing to consult with the Platform Onderlinge Verzekeraars and the Platform Kleine en Middelgrote Verzekeraars

Zodra de evaluatie van het nationale regime voor verzekeraars met beperkte risico-omvang ter hand wordt genomen, is het ministerie graag bereid met het Platform Onderlinge Verzekeraars en Platform Kleine en Middelgrote Verzekeraars in overleg te treden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over het bericht “AFM waarschuwt voor cryptocurrencies als bitcoins en ethers”

Two Socialist Party MPs asked the Finance Minister about AFM warnings on cryptocurrencies, including bubble risks, investor information, regulation, money laundering and a possible DNB or virtual euro. The minister answered that the risks are largely borne by holders, that supervisors have warned consumers, that crypto assets fall outside financial supervision apart from anti-money-laundering rules, and that research is ongoing.
I will ask DNB to keep me informed about the development of a virtual euro and to inform the House when there are relevant developments.
Ik zal DNB vragen om mij op de hoogte te houden van de ontwikkeling van een virtuele euro en de Kamer informeren wanneer er relevante ontwikkelingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over Nederlandse pensioenfondsen die beleggen in de kerncentrales van Tihange en Doel

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether Dutch pension funds, including ABP which civil servants must join, should stop investing in the Belgian nuclear plants Tihange and Doel, and about iodine tablets sent to civil servants in the south. The government replied that ABP's investment policy is for the fund's board, that employee representatives and the accountability body can influence it, and that ABP raises safety with the operator Engie as a shareholder without committing to divestment.
The ABP board is responsible for implementing the pension scheme, including investment policy.
Het ABP-bestuur gaat over de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling, inclusief het beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de handel in probleemleningen

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about the trade in non-performing loans, including investor interest, supervision of buyers and risks for ECB and Italian public finances. The minister replied that the secondary market is small and mainly for professional investors, that banks and supervisors remain responsible for pricing and provisioning, and that the EU action plan includes insolvency and transparency measures.
Given the high risk profile and the expertise required, it seems to me that only professional investors should enter into such transactions with risk-bearing capital.
Gezien het hoge risicoprofiel en de benodigde kennis, ligt het wat mij betreft ook voor de hand dat alleen professionele investeerders dit soort transacties aangaan met risicodragend vermogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat werkenden een steeds kleiner deel van de koek krijgen

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government would act on reports that workers receive a shrinking share of market-sector income, including what it could do to raise the labour income share and whether public-sector pay could influence private wages. The minister replied that the labour income share is a wage-room indicator, that wage-setting is left to social partners and decentralised bargaining, and that the government gave no concrete new measures, leaving flex-contract and other choices to the next cabinet.
The main conclusion, however, was that wage policy requires tailoring and is therefore a matter for decentralised (collective agreement) parties.
Belangrijkste conclusie was echter dat loonbeleid maatwerk vereist en (dus) aan decentrale (cao-)partijen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over de problemen bij Anbang en de gevolgen daarvan voor de polishouders van VIVAT

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the ministers about problems at Anbang and the risks to Vivat policyholders, including the regulator's handling and possible capital extraction. The ministers answered that DNB's supervisory information is confidential, that the regulator monitors compliance and that the EUR 1.35 billion capital injection strengthened Vivat, while declining to comment on Anbang's internal affairs or future licence applications.
Information about the supervisor's assessment of the holder of a declaration of no objection is supervisory-confidential and therefore not public.
Informatie over de beoordeling door de toezichthouder van de houder van een verklaring van geen bezwaar is toezichtvertrouwelijk en daarmee niet publiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht “Accountants moeten sneller hervormen”

Labour MP Nijboer asks the Finance Minister about criticism by Everts that audit firms implement promised quality improvements too slowly, that their business model fails to serve the public interest, and that team composition hampers audit quality. The minister replies by referring to the AFM report on quality at audit firms (Kamerstuk 34 677, nr. 7), without answering the questions in substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat NS een miljoenenboete moet betalen

An MP asked the government about the ACM fine imposed on NS for abuse of market power in the Limburg tender, including the administrative costs, the effect on the dividend, whether the fine is tied to criminal proceedings, and whether tendering in public transport is viable. The minister answered that ACM is independent and costs are not known, the fine lowers the dividend by 35 percent, the fine is separate from criminal proceedings, and NS has taken steps to prevent recurrence with a letter promised.
ACM carried out the investigation in its responsibility as an independent administrative body (ZBO). A ZBO does not fall under the direct authority of a minister.
ACM heeft het onderzoek vanuit haar verantwoordelijkheid als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan (ZBO) uitgevoerd. Een ZBO valt niet onder direct gezag van een Minister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht “Oplichtersnetwerk roofde ongestoord tientallen miljoenen”

An MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers how a network defrauding private investors through investment schemes could operate undetected for years, what victims can recover, and whether the AFM and prosecution have enough resources. The minister answered that prosecution and AFM action were taken in specific cases (Centurion, Hollandsche Wind), that the AFM's powers over exempt offerings are limited, and that enforcement and prevention are adequate, with planned tightening of the exemption threshold.
I cannot provide information on the number of victims and the amount of damage per individual case.
Ik kan geen mededelingen doen over het aantal gedupeerden en de omvang van de schade per individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het laten verwijderen van de registratie vanuit het Bureau Krediet Registratie (BKR) door bedrijven

MP Peters asked whether BKR credit registrations can only be removed when technical errors were made, whether courts have removed registrations, whether a BKR registration blocks mortgages, and what will be done about firms claiming they can delete registrations. The minister answered that removal is possible only for unlawful registrations, sometimes via settlement or courts, that a registration alone does not bar credit, that lenders must lend responsibly under AFM supervision, and that firms promising deletion without technical errors are misleading consumers.
It is not known how many mortgage applications are rejected or what part of them is (partly) rejected because of a BKR registration.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel hypotheekaanvragen worden afgewezen of welk deel daarvan (mede) vanwege een BKR-registratie is afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over OneCoin en OneLife

An MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about OneLife and OneCoin, a multi-level marketing scheme suspected of being a pyramid game, and whether authorities are investigating it. The Finance Minister answered that virtual currencies fall outside supervision, that the assessment is for regulators, prosecutors and courts, and declined to give participant numbers or confirm ongoing Dutch investigations.
No statements are made about any ongoing investigations in the Netherlands.
Over eventuele lopende onderzoeken in Nederland worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Maeijer en Wilders over het bericht dat Griekenland geld krijgt uit het noodfonds

MPs Van Dijck, Maeijer and Wilders asked the Finance Minister about reports that Greece would receive 8.5 billion euro from the bailout fund, what the Dutch share is, and why Dutch taxpayers should keep funding Greece. The minister confirmed the ESM proposal is subject to a Raad van Bewind decision, explained how ESM loans are funded and the Dutch capital contribution, and referred to earlier letters for the government's position.
You were recently informed of the cabinet's position in the Eurogroup report of 15 June and a letter to the House on the progress report of the second progress mission of the ESM programme.

U bent recent over het standpunt van het kabinet geïnformeerd in het verslag van de Eurogroep van 15 juni en een Kamerbrief over de voortgangsrapportage van de tweede voortgangsmissie van het ESM-programma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de bankenredding in Italië, waarbij Italië de regels voor de bankenunie aan zijn laars gelapt heeft

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether Italy's rescue of two banks, Banca Popolare di Vicenza and Veneto Banca, breached the banking union rules, questioning the bail-in, state guarantees, the role of the ECB and SRB, and the lack of private investors. The minister answers that shareholders and subordinated creditors bore losses, the SRB found no public-interest resolution so national liquidation applied, the Commission approved the aid, and the full Commission decision is still awaited.
Although the rules were followed in this case, I consider it important that the European Commission explains its considerations for approving this substantial state aid.
Ondanks dat de regels in deze casus zijn gevolgd, vind ik het van belang dat de Europese Commissie uitleg geeft over haar overwegingen om goedkeuring te geven aan deze forse staatssteun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Deutsche bank verliest vertrouwen in Europese bankensector”

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister how he views Deutsche Bank's downgrade of European banks to 'underweight' and its implications for growth, bank buffers, ECB policy and eurozone integration. The minister replied that growth forecasts are stable, banks have strengthened capital, further prudential tightening is pursued at EU level, the eurozone is better placed than before the crisis, and no treaty change is currently on the agenda.
It is not for me to judge the valuation of (individual) shares.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over de waardering van (individuele) aandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten over wapenexport naar landen die betrokken zijn bij de oorlog in Jemen

Two SP MPs asked the government about arms exports to Yemen coalition states (Egypt, UAE navies), Airbus's tax ruling, investments by pension funds and banks in Airbus, and tax facilitation of Airbus. The government said it refuses export licences for coalition states where goods may be used in combat in Yemen, declined to disclose sales volumes and tax ruling details citing confidentiality, and said banks and pension funds are addressed through due-diligence and OECD guideline frameworks.
However, under the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, no information about individual taxpayers can be provided.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de AWR kan echter geen informatie over individuele belastingplichtigen worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Landen zetten belastingconcurrentie voort met nieuwe middelen'

SP MP Leijten asked whether international anti-avoidance measures encourage countries to create new tax breaks, whether capital is taxed less and labour more, and whether the government will act against tax competition in the EU and OECD. State Secretary Wiebes answered that agreed international measures are the most effective tool, that corporate tax revenue has risen since 2014, and that he sees no need for new initiatives yet, while promising no concrete new step.
At this moment I see no reason to take new initiatives in this regard.
Ik heb op dit moment geen aanleiding daarbij nieuwe initiatieven te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het artikel “Het kostte veel meer tijd dan ik dacht”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a pilot for a new permanent education model for accountants, including whether courses like Spanish or articulation can count, and whether dropping minimum hours weakens the system and how the NBA fulfils its public-interest role. The minister said the pilot is positive but not yet evaluated, that the NBA must supervise compliance, and that enforcement via a regulation and disciplinary action will be introduced with the new model.
The NBA board has not yet carried out a final evaluation of the whole pilot because it is still running, so no definitive decision has been taken on whether to introduce the new model.

Het bestuur van de NBA heeft echter nog geen eindevaluatie over de totale pilot gedaan omdat deze nog loopt en daarom ook nog geen definitieve beslissing genomen over de wenselijkheid om het nieuwe model in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over het bericht “TiSA and the threat to public banks”

Two SP MPs asked the trade and finance ministers about a report claiming the TiSA services agreement threatens public banks and government regulatory room. The minister rejects this, arguing TiSA contains prudential and public-service carve-outs and leaves governments free to regulate.
The cabinet does not share the thrust of the publication.
Het kabinet deelt de strekking van de publicatie niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het Openbaar Ministerie verdachte transacties bij een trustkantoor onderzoekt

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Finance and Justice about reports that the Public Prosecution Service is investigating suspicious transactions at trust office BK Group, and about sanctions compliance, integrity, supervision capacity and related leaks. The Minister replied that trust offices must freeze assets of sanctioned persons and report to DNB, that a tightened trust-office supervision bill is planned, and that ongoing investigations cannot be commented on.
With the draft bill for a Trust Offices Supervision Act 2018, the aim is to make the regulatory framework for trust offices stricter.
Met het concept wetvoorstel voor een Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018 wordt beoogd het regelgevend kader voor trustkantoren strenger te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de uitzending van Radar over te hoog berekende boeterente

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a Radar broadcast alleging banks miscalculate early-repayment penalties on mortgages, and whether banks apply the AFM guideline and disclose the data needed for customers to check it. The minister answered that the MCD rules and AFM guideline are in force, banks committed to follow the guideline and compensate customers, and the AFM will examine compliance in Q4 2017 with enforcement possible.
The AFM will investigate in the fourth quarter of this year whether lenders indeed adhere to the new standards.
De AFM zal in het vierde kwartaal van dit jaar onderzoeken of kredietverstrekkers zich inderdaad houden aan de nieuwe normen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Kops over het bericht “Banken rekenen nog steeds te veel boeterente bij hypotheek”

PVV MPs asked the Finance Minister whether banks still charge excessive early-repayment penalties on mortgages despite the AFM guidance, how many people are affected, what compensation is planned, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges possible overcharging since July 2016, says lenders have pledged proactive compensation, and sees no need for further measures on competition and mobility.
I consider it important that all customers who after 14 July 2016 paid too high a fee under the new rules and the AFM guidance are compensated with retroactive effect.

Ik vind het belangrijk dat alle klanten met terugwerkende kracht worden gecompenseerd die na 14 juli 2016 op grond van de nieuwe regels en de leidraad van de AFM een te hoge vergoeding hebben betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers en Aukje de Vries over de resolutie van de Banco Popular Español

MPs Harbers and Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about the resolution of Banco Popular Español, its takeover by Santander, compliance with BRRD and banking union rules, the state of the Spanish banking sector, and the handling of Italian banks. The minister answered that the case was a resolution with bail-in under the BRRD/SRM framework, that no taxpayer money was used, that Spanish banks have strengthened since 2012, and that Member States may still choose preventive recapitalisation within EU rules.
The chosen solution for Banco Popular Español did use a bail-in, consisting of writing down capital instruments and converting subordinated debt.
Bij de gekozen oplossing voor Banco Popular Español is juist wel gebruik gemaakt van een bail in, bestaande uit het afschrijven van kapitaalinstrumenten en het omzetten van achtergestelde schulden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Aanpak van derivatendossier loopt nog meer vertraging op'

MP Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister why the handling of interest rate derivatives compensation for SME clients is delayed beyond mid-2017, and what is causing it. The minister answers that the framework is complex, banks expect to need 2017 and some clients may only receive offers in 2018, and he will receive an AFM progress report in June.
In the first progress report that I expect from the AFM in June this year, more insight will be given into the planning and progress.
In de eerste voortgangsrapportage die ik in juni dit jaar van de AFM verwacht, zal meer inzicht worden gegeven in de planning en de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Veel minder Oekraïense miljoenen bevroren dan gedacht”

An SP MP asked the government about reports that far fewer Ukrainian funds were frozen than previously claimed, and about sanctions, the Cyprus route, IMF and EU loans, and a Rostec-linked joint venture. The government answered that about EUR 380 million was reported frozen under the EU Ukraine/Russia sanctions, that the EU list is adequately identifying, that Ukraine must proceed with corruption cases, and that it cannot disclose individual tax positions.
This amount can be broken down into funds and assets.
Dit bedrag is onder te verdelen in middelen en tegoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de overname van uitvaartorganisatie De Facultatieve

An SP MP asked the Economics and Finance Ministers about the acquisition of funeral organisation De Facultatieve, including share rules, valuation, the shared accountant, and member involvement. The government declined to judge the private transaction, pointed to the civil code, accountant independence rules and public company records, and noted Hermans' Senate side-functions.
The cabinet has no involvement in the ownership and business transactions of individual private enterprises and organisations.
Het kabinet heeft geen bemoeienis met het eigenaarschap en de zakelijke transacties van afzonderlijke private ondernemingen en organisaties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het Telegraaf artikel "ING-topman sluit spaarrente van nul niet uit"

Leijten (SP) asked the Finance Minister whether ING's CEO was right that negative savings rates cannot be ruled out, and about related effects on savers, banks and ECB policy. Minister Dijsselbloem replied that banks set their own rates, a negative rate on retail savings is not currently on the agenda, and that the causes and welfare effects of low rates and ECB policy are hard to quantify.
ECB monetary policy is not a direct input variable in the forecast of purchasing power of European and Dutch households.
Het monetaire beleid van de ECB is geen directe inputvariabele in de raming van de koopkracht van Europese en Nederlandse huishoudens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over de leidraad vervroegd aflossen hypotheken bij rentemiddeling

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the AFM's guideline on early repayment of mortgages under the MCD applies to rate-averaging (rentemiddeling), and whether the government will clarify this with the AFM and consumers. The minister answered that under current law the early-repayment rules do not apply to rate-averaging, but that he is preparing a regulatory change so that only the actual financial loss may be charged in such cases, with parliament involved via a pre-consultation procedure.
I am therefore preparing an amendment to the regulations so that even with rate-averaging no more than the financial disadvantage may be charged.
Ik ben daarom een wijziging van de regelgeving aan het voorbereiden, zodat ook bij rentemiddeling niet meer dan het financieel nadeel in rekening mag worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Ronnes, Omtzigt, Jetten en Van Weyenberg over het bericht in de Trouw van 4 mei 2017 “Staatsbedrijf NS ontwijkt fiscus weer”

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the government about reports that state-owned NS avoids Dutch tax via an Irish leasing subsidiary, including whether the 2015 agreements were honoured and how much tax is lost. The minister defended the arrangement as consistent with a 'level playing field' for foreign concessions, and refused to give tax figures citing secrecy rules and business confidentiality while promising phase-out of the Irish route on Dutch lines.

A more detailed specification of amounts I cannot give because under article 67 of the AWR I cannot make statements about the taxes of individual taxpayers, as business confidentiality precludes this.

Een nadere specificatie van bedragen kan ik niet geven omdat ik op grond van artikel 67 van de AWR geen uitspraken kan doen over de belastingen van individuele belastingplichtigen omdat bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid zich hiertegen verzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over ‘de ongekend hoge winstuitkeringen van bedrijven’

SP MPs asked the Finance Minister about record corporate dividend payouts, takeover fears, whether the strategic-takeover screening law should be widened, employee involvement in takeovers, ECB bond purchases and investment. The government answered that dividend decisions rest with companies, outlined existing takeover and works-council rules, proposed a telecom-focused control bill under consultation, and deferred tax and public-investment choices to a future cabinet.
The Minister of Finance meant by extending the law the bill on preventing undesirable control in telecommunications that the Minister of Economic Affairs put into consultation in February 2017.

De Minister van Financiën doelde met uitbreiding van de wet op het wetsvoorstel voorkoming ongewenste zeggenschap telecommunicatie dat de Minister van Economische Zaken in februari 2017 in consultatie heeft gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de verkoop van een bedrijfstak door Unilever

An SP MP asked ministers whether the government would respond to Unilever's plan to sell its margarine division, its effect on jobs and R&D, subsidies received, and whether a takeover cooling-off period proposed by Hommen should be supported. The minister said the government is talking with Unilever to keep the activities in the Netherlands, respects the company's own commercial decisions, explained the existing takeover rules supervised by the AFM, and said subsidy recovery is not possible because no traceable commitments were made.
The cabinet is in talks with Unilever to keep the company and its activities in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet is in gesprek met Unilever om het bedrijf en zijn activiteiten voor Nederland te behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Harde woorden over hoogleraren accountancy”

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether accountancy professors are independent and critical enough, following criticism that they stay silent on the sector, and what commitments universities and the sector have made to guarantee their independence. The minister replied that codes of conduct and the VGBA safeguard independence, that outside roles are desirable for practical knowledge, that conflicts of interest cannot be fully excluded, and that accountants have acknowledged shortcomings in their public task.
From the conversations I have had with universities it appears that a large number of codes of conduct have been drawn up that must both safeguard independence and prevent conflicts of interest.

Uit de gesprekken die ik heb gevoerd met universiteiten blijkt dat er een groot aantal gedragscodes is opgesteld die zowel de onafhankelijkheid moeten waarborgen als belangenverstrengeling dienen te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht “Ons land ‘witwasrisico’”

The MP Nijboer asked the ministers of Finance and Justice about a Transparency International report finding that the Netherlands still lags on beneficial ownership transparency and whether they would adopt its recommendations, plus questions on bank and trust-office client screening, foreign trusts, UBO registration, and a ban on dealing with shell companies. The government answered that most recommendations are already covered by pending legislation and EU negotiations, declined to commit to some (e.g. public access to the shareholder register, extending UBO registration to foreign entities), and noted existing supervision and sanctions.
The draft bill aims to fully align Dutch rules on bearer shares with FATF international standards.
Het concept-wetsvoorstel beoogt de Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving met betrekking tot aandelen aan toonder volledig in lijn te brengen met de internationale standaarden van FATF.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het achterblijven van het bestrijden van witwassen

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers why the Netherlands lags internationally on combating money-laundering risks, including ING and trust office cases, Panama Papers follow-up, capital controls, UBO and shareholder registers, and Algemene Rekenkamer recommendations. The minister responded at length, largely describing existing supervision, risk-based rules, DNB/AFM enforcement and planned monitors, while disputing the claim that financial institutions take due diligence insufficiently seriously and declining to comment on individual institutions due to confidentiality.
Due to the statutory duty of confidentiality, DNB cannot make further statements about individual institutions under its supervision.
In verband met de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht kan DNB geen verdere uitspraken doen over individuele instellingen onder haar toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over stijgende winsten en haperende investeringen

Opposition MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers why profits are rising while business investment lags, and whether corporate tax cuts would spur investment. The government answered that lower interest rates and cyclical factors explain tax revenue, that investment levels are not structurally low, and that investment decisions are primarily for firms, leaving further measures to a future cabinet.
It is up to a future cabinet to decide on any measures to further promote business investment.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om te besluiten over eventuele maatregelen om investeringen door het bedrijfsleven verder te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Koerhuis over hypotheken, echtscheiding en maatwerk

Two VVD MPs asked whether mortgage lenders can and do provide case-by-case flexibility (maatwerk) after divorce or relationship breakdown, and how NHG, AFM rules and debt release work in such cases. The minister answers that the Platform Maatwerk has found no new bottlenecks, that the rules already allow justified deviations, that lenders vary in practice, and promises to inform the House before summer.
I will inform you before the summer about the outcomes of this.
Ik zal u voor de zomer informeren over de uitkomsten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Salarissen topbankiers gaan door strengere EU-regels juist hard omhoog”

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister how to respond to reports that top European bankers' fixed salaries rose after stricter EU bonus rules, and whether bonus caps and fixed pay should be restricted. The minister acknowledged the signal is negative, stated the Netherlands applies a stricter 20% bonus cap than the EU's 100%, noted fixed pay is not capped under EU rules, and promised an evaluation of the Wbfo by 1 December.
An evaluation of the effects of the Wbfo is currently being carried out.
Momenteel wordt er een evaluatie uitgevoerd over de effecten van de Wbfo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht “Aandeleninkoop optie voor ABN Amro”
