MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about ABN AMRO seeking shareholder authorisation to buy back shares, whether this concerns NLFI shares, the bank's capital buffers, and what the government will do to prevent buffers from being lowered. The minister answered that the authorisation is a standard, capped (10%) buy-back mandate that still requires prior supervisor approval, that capital is currently well above requirements, and that DNB supervises buffers while the government pursues a 4% leverage ratio.
In addition, prior approval from the supervisor must always be obtained before shares are actually bought in practice.
Daarnaast dient altijd voorafgaande toestemming van de toezichthouder te worden verkregen voordat in de praktijk aandelen zouden worden ingekocht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Öztürk en Azarkan over het bericht dat de Algemene Rekenkamer het kabinet steeds minder goed kan controleren

MPs Öztürk and Azarkan asked whether budget cuts threaten the Algemene Rekenkamer's ability to check the executive, including financial functions in ministries and other Hoge Colleges van Staat. The minister replied that the colleges manage their own budgets under agreements, that finance capacity has fallen about 30% since 2009 with programmes to strengthen it, and that no current review of ministry finance departments is needed, while agreeing to a further analysis of the colleges' finances.
In the period 2009–2015 the capacity of the financial function fell by almost 30%.
In de periode 2009 – 2015 is de capaciteit van de financiële functie met bijna 30% afgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de verantwoordingsstructuur van het ESM en de ECB

Ten MPs' written questions (Leijten, SP) ask the Finance Minister about the accountability of the ESM and the ECB, including a Transparency International report, austerity assumptions, treaty integration, the veto system, and ECB secret letters. The Minister answers that existing evaluations and parliamentary consultation suffice, that treaty integration is not urgent, that no further ECB inquiry is needed, and that several recommendations fall to the member states or the ECB itself.
The cabinet nevertheless sees it as a positive development that the ECB, where possible, gives openness about its decisions, recommendations and views.
Het kabinet ziet het evenwel als een goede ontwikkeling dat de ECB, waar mogelijk, openheid geeft over haar beslissingen, aanbevelingen en zienswijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat spaarders geen rente meer krijgen op hun spaargeld

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about banks cutting savings rates, including Triodos to zero, whether negative rates should be banned, whether savers could be pushed to hold cash, and whether lower rates on loans offset the loss. The minister answered that low rates stem from structural and cyclical factors beyond ECB policy, that he sees no need to ban negative rates, that the tax system now tracks actual returns, and that customers should pay for services.
For these reasons, I do not intend to take measures now to prohibit negative savings rates.
Om deze redenen ben ik niet van plan om nu maatregelen te nemen om negatieve spaarrentes te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het CBS meer ongelijkheid meet maar het als minder verkoopt

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that CBS measures higher inequality than previously assumed while presenting it as lower, including revisions, top-income censoring, dividend-tax effects and the Quote 500 comparison. Minister Dijsselbloem answered at length, explaining that revised methods and full population data raised measured inequality, that the Netherlands remains relatively low-inequality internationally, and committing only to possibly publishing supplementary figures on retained business profits.
The CBS is however examining the possibilities of making retained profits visible at household level as a supplement to the income concept used.
Het CBS onderzoekt evenwel de mogelijkheden om de niet uitgekeerde winsten wel op huishoudenniveau inzichtelijk te maken in aanvulling op het gehanteerde inkomensbegrip.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de uitzending van Argos over flitskredieten

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a broadcast on flash-credit lender Ferratum, which offers loans from the UK at very high rates, and how Dutch consumers are protected. The minister said the AFM's powers over foreign online lenders are limited under the country-of-origin principle, and announced that flash credit will be designated under the advertising ban so the AFM can act, with monitoring of effectiveness.
The power to designate financial products is assigned to the AFM so that the supervisor can intervene quickly if necessary.
De bevoegdheid tot aanwijzing van financiële producten wordt neergelegd bij de AFM zodat, indien nodig, snel kan worden ingegrepen door de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de betrokkenheid van staatsbank Fortis bij omkoping van Italiaanse politici

An MP asked whether state-owned Fortis Bank failed to report unusual transactions by Francesco Corallo that may have funded bribery of Italian politicians, and what role KPMG and supervisor DNB played. The Minister of Finance explained the Wwft reporting duties, said compliance is assessed by DNB and the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, and declined to comment on individual institutions.
It remains the institution's own responsibility to report all unusual transactions.
Het blijft de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van een instelling om alle ongebruikelijke transacties te melden.
Vragen van het lid Nijboer (PvdA) aan de Minister van Financiën over het bericht «Boeterente aan banden» (ingezonden 22 maart 2017).

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about reports that some mortgage lenders still charge excessive early-repayment penalties when refinancing, asking which lenders, what sanctions apply, whether pre-July 2016 overcharges will be refunded, and the tax consequences. The minister answered in a supplementary reply, correcting an earlier answer on how refunded penalties must be reported in the income tax return (in the year of repayment, not 2016).
I have found that an error crept into the answer to question 8, which leads to unclarity in practice.
Ik heb geconstateerd dat in het antwoord op vraag 8 een fout is geslopen die in de praktijk tot onduidelijkheden leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de aanleg van een pijpleiding in de Verenigde Staten

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the government about bank financing for the Dakota Access pipeline, the status of the project, concerns of the Sioux tribes over environment, drinking water, sacred land and treaty rights, and whether ING remains involved. The government answered that the permitting is a US sovereign matter with courts open to objectors, that the Dutch government respects indigenous rights, and that ING has agreed to sell its loan following dialogue with the Standing Rock Sioux.
The decision to grant a permit for the construction of infrastructure projects is a national and sovereign competence of the United States.
De afweging om een vergunning te verlenen voor de aanleg van infrastructurele bouwprojecten is een nationale en soevereine bevoegdheid van de Verenigde Staten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘boeterente aan banden’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that mortgage lenders still charge excessive early-repayment penalties, and whether affected consumers are compensated. The minister said lenders will compensate post-14 July 2016 overpayments under AFM guidance, that pre-July 2016 cases must go to Kifid or courts, and that the AFM will investigate compliance.
The AFM will investigate in the second half of this year compliance with the rules on early repayment costs and will enforce if providers violate the law.
De AFM gaat in de tweede helft van dit jaar onderzoek doen naar de naleving van de regels over de kosten bij vervroegde aflossing en treedt handhavend op als aanbieders de wet overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Albert de Vries over de aankoop van een huis zonder financieringsvoorbehoud of bouwtechnische keuring

MPs Nijboer and De Vries asked whether buyers are increasingly dropping financing and building-inspection conditions to compete for homes, and what risks and remedies exist. Minister Plasterk answered that such conditions are advisable, that data is limited, that brokers should advise against risky bids, and that the government will research the scale of the problem before considering further steps.
The cabinet will therefore conduct research into the scale of this problem and will consider follow-up steps based on the outcomes.
Het kabinet gaat daarom onderzoek verrichten naar de omvang van deze problematiek en zal aan de hand van de uitkomsten vervolgstappen overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over de doorverkoop van de Fyra’s aan een andere vervoerder

MPs Aukje de Vries and De Boer asked whether reported resale of the Fyra trains to Trenitalia was accurate, whether AnsaldoBreda had contacted the minister, and what compensation NS and the state would receive. The minister replied that no sale has yet occurred, that NS is not party to any resale contract, and that NS would receive up to EUR 3.5 million per train if resale succeeds, with the proceeds going to NS profit rather than the state.
If there is an actual sale, NS will be informed of it by AnsaldoBreda/Finmeccanica under this agreement, and NS will inform me of it.
Ingeval er sprake is van een daadwerkelijke verkoop, zal NS hierover conform deze overeenkomst door AnsaldoBreda/Finmeccanica op de hoogte worden gesteld en zal NS mij hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van Laar over het grote tekort aan betaalbare huurwoningen op Bonaire

MPs Recourt and Van Laar asked whether the government will provide the guarantee needed for the Bonaire housing association FCB's plan to build 500 social rental homes, and whether a national mortgage guarantee will be introduced for Bonaire. Minister Plasterk answered that FCB lacks the financing for a viable project, that his ministry is still exploring options including with NIA before deciding on any state guarantee, and that the Waarborgfonds Eigen Woningen is preparing a temporary mortgage guarantee for Caribbean Netherlands with an operational scheme targeted for mid-2017.
Before the (im)possibility of a guarantee from the central government is on the table, I want to complete that exploration.
Voordat de (on)mogelijkheid van een garantie door het Rijk aan de orde is, wil ik die verkenning afronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat NS dreigt met afbraakbeleid tweede KLM te worden

MP Smaling asks whether NS's plan to divest its shop and retail activities, and withdraw from regional rail tenders, is justified, and how it affects staff, dividends, station offerings and political pressure. Minister Dijsselbloem answers that the strategy is NS's responsibility, that shop activities are profitable but profit figures are confidential, that dividends are expected to stay stable, and that no political pressure was applied, while declining to give some financial details.
Information on the amount of profit per business unit is commercially confidential and for that reason cannot be provided.
Informatie over de omvang van de winst bij bedrijfsonderdelen is bedrijfsvertrouwelijk en kan om die reden niet verstrekt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over uitspraken van de minister in de Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung van 19 maart 2017

MP Thieme asks the Finance Minister whether he said eurozone crisis states should not have spent their money on women and drink before seeking help, and questions the factual basis and moral responsibility of such a remark. The minister denies the quote is accurate, gives the correct German text stressing solidarity with obligations, and calls the link to programme countries unfortunate, neither said nor meant.
It is very unfortunate that a link was made with the mentioned programme countries; I neither said nor meant this.
Het is zeer onfortuinlijk dat er een link is gelegd met de genoemde programmalanden, dit heb ik noch zo gezegd noch zo bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Onderzoek witwas via geldautomaat’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports of money laundering through cash machines run by shopkeepers, including opaque exchange margins and whether YourCash is supervised. The minister answered that such machines need no licence under the Wft, DNB supervises euro note recirculation rules and bank clients, and the issue would be shared through the FEC without committing to a new investigation.
The exact exchange margins applied are not known to me. In principle, no supervision is exercised over exchange margins or choice menus.
De exacte wisselmarges die worden gehanteerd zijn mij niet bekend. Op wisselmarges of keuzemenu's wordt in beginsel geen toezicht gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over erfpacht in Amsterdam

The MP Ronnes (CDA) asks the ministers whether Amsterdam's municipal erfpacht buy-out offers and its residual land-value method warrant extra protection for homeowners, and what the tax revenue effects are. The minister replies that erfpacht is a private property right governed by the Civil Code with recourse to civil courts and general principles of good governance, that the Wft cannot apply, that the revenue effects cannot yet be estimated, and that no consultation with Amsterdam on revenue effects took place because the matter is municipal.
For municipal erfpacht, the municipality is moreover bound by the general principles of good governance.
Voor gemeentelijke erfpacht geldt bovendien dat de gemeente gebonden is aan de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de astronomische ontslagvergoeding voor NS-managers

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister why two former NS managers received multi-million-euro severance payments, whether state ownership allows preventing such excesses, and whether NS should become a ZBO like ProRail. The minister replied that the severance agreements were concluded by NS's board, that as shareholder he only controls appointment, dismissal and pay of board and supervisory members, and that the current NS company structure is preferred over ZBO status.
In my role as shareholder I have no involvement in that.
In mijn rol als aandeelhouder heb ik daar geen betrokkenheid bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Hoge NS bazen kregen half miljoen oprotpremie’

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether the government approved and knew the reasons for severance payments of about EUR 600,000 to two NS managers, and whether these were linked to the Limburg tender irregularities. The minister answered that NS restructured its top structure, that the board needs no approval for non-board severance, that the departures are unrelated to Limburg, and declined to share supervisory board minutes.
I do not have access to the minutes of the meetings of the supervisory board.
Ik heb geen beschikking over de verslagen van de vergaderingen van de raad van commissarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over ontslaguitkeringen voor NS-managers

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the 565,956 euro in termination payments for two NS managers was justified, on what criteria, and whether the state as sole shareholder could approve, limit or prevent such payments. The minister answered that the payments were agreed individually due to the loss of suitable posts, that the shareholder only has powers over appointment, dismissal and pay of board members, and that the WNT does not apply to NS.
Under company law, as shareholder I only have powers regarding the appointment, dismissal and remuneration of the members of the executive board and supervisory board.

Op basis van het vennootschapsrecht komen mij als aandeelhouder alleen bevoegdheden toe op het gebied van benoeming, ontslag en beloning van de leden van de raad van bestuur en de raad van commissarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Harbers en Van der Linde over het bericht 'Brusselse eis zet Rotterdamse haven in financiële klem”

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the Rotterdam port's financial squeeze after the European Commission ended the corporate tax exemption for ports, and about the level playing field across EU ports. The minister replied that port investment room is not currently under pressure, that the Commission's state aid procedures against Belgium and France and the port regulation are on track, and that the Netherlands continues to press for fair competition.
At present the investment room of HbR is not under pressure and the port company is able to carry out the planned investments.
Op dit moment staat de investeringsruimte van HbR niet onder druk en is het Havenbedrijf in staat de geplande investeringen uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Smaling over een mogelijk tekort aan accountants die gemeentelijke jaarrekeningen controleren

MPs Merkies and Smaling asked whether a shortage of accountants auditing municipal annual accounts threatens timely audit opinions, and whether decentralisations and the Omgevingswet strain municipal staff. The government acknowledges some tender failures and capacity pressure, relies on market forces and new entrants, and says municipalities bear responsibility for their own staffing.
The equipping of the civil service is, within the administrative relations, the responsibility of municipalities as independent tier of government.
Het toegerust zijn van het ambtenarenapparaat is binnen de bestuurlijke verhoudingen de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten als zelfstandige bestuurslaag.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Merkies over het bericht 'Nederlandse banken vanaf nu vaag over kapitaaleis'

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether the ECB had asked banks to stop disclosing the overall capital requirement (guidance) and what risks non-disclosure poses to financial stability. The minister denied any ECB request, said only the MDA-relevant requirements must be published, that DNB will inform banks they may disclose guidance voluntarily, and that transparency generally helps; he gave no list of past panic cases.
I do not have all these occurring cases available.
Ik heb al deze voorkomende gevallen niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Bank is voortaan vaag over kapitaaleis'

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister whether the ECB asked banks not to disclose their total capital requirement, how the legal minimum differs from the guidance buffer, and whether supervisors can enforce extra capital and whether guidance should be enforceable or mandatorily published. The minister denied that the ECB asked banks to withhold guidance, explained that guidance is advisory unless converted into a hard Pillar 2 requirement, and said Dutch authorities will raise publication and communication issues in EU negotiations.
The ECB, however, did not ask the banks not to disclose the guidance.
De ECB heeft de banken echter niet verzocht om de guidance niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Merkies en Smaling over de mate waarin Nederlandse verzekeraars zich inzetten voor toegang van mensen in arme landen tot medicijnen

SP MPs asked why Dutch insurers score poorly on health and access to medicines in responsible investment rankings, and what the government will do about it. The minister said several insurers have not signed the Access to Medicine Index investor statement, but that the sector is being engaged through a planned IMVO covenant and that DNB oversees insurers' prudential risk management without setting investment policy.
The investment policy of insurers is primarily the responsibility of those insurers themselves.
Het investeringsbeleid van verzekeraars is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van die verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over de berichten 'the Secret Debt Plan?, 'Is there a secret debt plan?' en 'Commission confirms work on securitisation of EU sovereign bonds'?

An MP asked the Finance Minister about press reports of a secret EU debt plan (European Safe Bonds, securitisation of sovereign bonds) and whether Germany objects. The minister answered that no concrete proposal exists yet from the ESRB or the Commission, the topic is not on Eurogroup or Ecofin agendas, and the government values private bearing of risk without giving a substantive assessment.
If the topic is put on the agenda, the House will be informed as usual in the annotated agenda for these meetings.
Indien het onderwerp wordt geagendeerd zal de Kamer zoals gebruikelijk hierover geïnformeerd worden in de geannoteerde agenda voor deze overleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat president Trump van de Verenigde Staten nieuwe bankenregels terugdraait

MP Merkies (SP) asked the Finance Minister how Trump's executive order reviewing Dodd-Frank bank rules would affect Dutch consumers, derivatives regulation, Basel IV and EU banking supervision. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the order only tasks the FSOC with a review, that no concrete changes exist yet, and that Dutch and EU rules are not directly affected, while DNB has sufficient tools to respond.
The decree itself contains no concrete measures and is for now mainly a signal about the principles the new American government values.
Het decreet zelf bevat geen concrete maatregelen en is vooralsnog vooral een signaal ten aanzien van de uitgangspunten waaraan de nieuwe Amerikaanse regering waarde hecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Yücel en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Armsten opgelicht’

MPs Recourt, Yücel and Nijboer asked the ministers about reports that bailiffs at BSR charged duplicate costs to vulnerable debtors, and what oversight, compensation and action would follow. The minister declined to prejudge the pending tuchtrecht case, said BFT oversight is risk-based and sufficient for now, that creditors should be compensated as far as possible via the bankruptcy estate, and that ACM and AFM are acting against malafide collection agencies.
It does not befit me to anticipate a case that is still before the court.
Het past mij niet vooruit te lopen op een zaak die nog onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over het omzeilen van de bonuswetgeving

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether London banks relocating to Amsterdam could circumvent the Dutch bank bonus cap, and whether the exceptions in the bonus law invite misuse. The minister answered that the rules apply equally to all Dutch-seated firms, that the cap rules for foreign-seated groups and branches are set out in law, and that he sees no adverting or encouragement of misuse, so no amendment is planned.
All financial undertakings with a seat in the Netherlands are subject in equal manner to the rules on controlled remuneration policy, including the exceptions and conditions laid down in the law.

Op alle financiële ondernemingen met zetel in Nederland zijn op gelijke wijze de regels voor een beheerst beloningsbeleid, inclusief de in de wet opgenomen uitzonderingen en voorwaarden daarvoor, van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over rentemiddelen bij Finqus

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Finqus, the successor name of the bankrupt DSB, should offer its mortgage customers interest-rate averaging and whether the minister would engage the curators to make it do so, given the bank's profits and remaining customers. The minister replied that Finqus has decided not to prioritise rate averaging, that the minister will only encourage it to offer the option, and that creditor repayment and the bank's results are reported by the curators.
Because I consider it important that the provider puts the customer first, I will draw Finqus's attention to the desirability of offering rate averaging.
Omdat ik het belangrijk vind dat de aanbieder de klant centraal zet, zal ik Finqus attenderen op de wenselijkheid om rentemiddeling aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Swapgeld duurt even'

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether waiting times of up to 1.5 years for swap compensation at Rabobank and other banks are acceptable, and whether the government will ensure all victims receive a reassessment in 2017. The minister answered that the pilot phase was extended for careful implementation, that Rabobank may need into 2018 while other banks expect to finish in 2017, and that the AFM supervises the process and banks are expected to offer redress to all clients by year end.
The AFM supervises the proper application of the recovery framework by banks.
De AFM houdt toezicht op de goede toepassing van het herstelkader door banken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de gevolgen van het handelsverdrag tussen de EU en Canada (CETA) en het handelsverdrag voor de handel in diensten (Trade in Services Agreement, TiSA)

Two SP MPs asked the Ministers of Foreign Trade and Finance about financial-sector risks, regulatory room, investor rights, TiSA services liberalisation and ILO standards under CETA and TiSA. The minister answered at length, largely defending the agreements, while committing to continued attention to ILO standards, a Broad Trade Consultation, and quarterly overviews of trade negotiations.
To increase transparency, the cabinet sends the House of Representatives a quarterly overview of all ongoing EU trade agreement negotiations with third countries.
Om de transparantie te vergroten stuurt het kabinet de Tweede Kamer elk kwartaal een overzicht van alle lopende onderhandelingen over handelsakkoorden van de EU met derde landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Cegerek over het bericht 'Drie Chinezen blijven over in strijd om Attero'

MPs Nijboer and Cegerek asked about the 2013 sale of waste processor Attero to private equity firm Waterland, including dividends, environmental aftercare obligations and whether the sale price was too low. The state secretary answered that competition supervision applies as for any concentration, environmental aftercare is handled by the provinces, the sale was a decentralised decision, and a Zuidelijke Rekenkamer inquiry is due in May 2017.
The agreements form part of the confidential sale agreement.
De afspraken zijn onderdeel van de vertrouwelijke verkoopovereenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Ronnes over de rol die de Raad van Commissarissen van NS gespeeld heeft bij de fraude bij de aanbesteding in Limburg

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about the role of NS's supervisory board in the Limburg tender fraud, including when he learned of it, access to board minutes, discharge granted for 2014 and 2015, and damage claims. The minister answered that he was informed in April 2015 by the supervisory board, denied knowledge of board incitement to crimes, refused to release board and shareholder meeting minutes, and pointed to ongoing court and regulatory proceedings.
It is also not usual for such reports to be shared with the general meeting of shareholders.
Het is ook niet gebruikelijk dat dergelijke verslagen met de algemene vergadering van aandeelhouders worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over Nederlandse banken die investeren in de aanleg van de omstreden North Dakota oliepijpleiding

An MP asks the government about Dutch banks financing the contested Dakota Access pipeline and whether they should halt the project, respect Sioux rights, stop protest repression, and end fossil fuel lending. The minister answers by citing the OECD guidelines and UN principles, saying banks must use their influence and that the decision on permits and bank relationships is up to the US and the banks themselves, while the government will not take a position against the pipeline.

I expect Dutch banks to use their influence, in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, to prevent and address potential violations.

Ik verwacht van Nederlandse banken dat zij conform de OESO Richtlijnen voor Multinationale Ondernemingen en de UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP's) hun invloed gebruiken om (potentiële) schendingen te voorkomen en aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over Target2

MP Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about the size and drivers of DNB's Target2 position, private-sector exposures, the mitigation of Target2 risks and the state's maximum exposure. The minister answered that DNB's Target2 balance was EUR 99.6 billion, that it is a claim on the ECB rather than on other national central banks, that rising balances stem mainly from the ECB asset purchase programme, and that the state's risk is limited because the ECB has adequate buffers.
DNB's Target2 balance currently (as of end November 2016) amounts to EUR 99.6 billion.
Het Target2-saldo van DNB betreft momenteel (per eind november 2016) EUR 99,6 mrd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Europese banken luiden noodklok over nieuwe regels”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a report that European banks object to new Basel capital rules, including whether the rules reflect real risks, their impact on mortgage and agricultural lending, and when EU implementation will be clear. The minister answered that the Basel talks were postponed, EU implementation is not yet decided and Dutch implementation will be used to flag disproportionate effects on Dutch banks.
The Basel Committee carried out an impact assessment of the various proposals. Its outcomes have not been made public, because this concerns supervisory-confidential information.

Het Bazelse Comité heeft een impact assessment uitgevoerd om de impact van de verschillende voorstellen in kaart te brengen. De uitkomsten hiervan zijn niet openbaar gemaakt, omdat dit toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het bericht ‘Italy’s cabinet approves Monte dei Paschi bailout’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that Italy's cabinet approved a bailout of Monte dei Paschi, including its compatibility with BRRD and state aid rules, Commission approval, compensation of retail bondholders, budget and Stability Pact effects, and commitment to banking union. The minister answered that the Commission has not objected to liquidity support, that a final Commission view on recapitalisation is still pending, that compensation details are unknown, and that the budget impact is uncertain.
No final judgement has yet been given by the European Commission on this.
Hierover is nog geen definitief oordeel door de Europese Commissie gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over het bericht “ABN Amro zegt duizenden klanten de wacht aan”

MP Koolmees asked the Finance Minister about ABN Amro's decision to require about 15,000 private clients living permanently outside Europe to close their accounts, and whether this is desirable, whether regulation can be simplified, what happens to affected clients and whether they can still bank in the Netherlands. The minister answered that banks set their own strategy and risk profile, acknowledged that ABN Amro's decision reflects regulatory complexity and its own strategy, pointed to FATF and ministry guidance, said the NVB knows of no signals that such clients cannot bank elsewhere, but could not guarantee it.
Banks themselves determine their business strategy and the risk profile they desire, and tailor their customer base accordingly.
Banken bepalen zelf hun ondernemingsstrategie en het door hen gewenste risicoprofiel en stemmen hun klantenbestand daar op af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over de vervolging van een Griekse statisticus en de onafhankelijkheid van de Griekse statistiek

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the prosecution of former Greek statistics chief Andreas Georgiou and whether Syriza is intimidating independent institutions such as ELSTAT and the central bank. The minister said he had no further information on the incidents, stressed the importance of judicial independence, and noted that Eurostat has validated ELSTAT's data and that the court process should run its course.
I attach great importance to the independence of the judiciary, also in Greece.
Ik hecht sterk aan de onafhankelijkheid van de rechtelijke macht, ook in Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over de positie van de aandeelhouder bij faillissementen

MPs Nijboer and Recourt asked the Ministers of Finance and Justice about shareholders' position in bankruptcies, including debt-financing of firms, shareholder-creditors, pre-pack sales and carve-outs for suppliers. The government answered that the issues will be examined within the WCO I-III reform programme and a consultation draft is planned for summer 2017, while declining to assess specific cases.
It is not for us (as Ministers of Finance and Justice) to assess specific practical situations and to state whether employees or creditors may have been harmed.

Het is niet aan ons (als Ministers van Financiën en Veiligheid en Justitie) om specifieke praktijksituaties te beoordelen en ons uit te spreken over de vraag of werknemers of schuldeisers daarbij mogelijk zijn benadeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat er alarm wordt geslagen over het geweld en corruptie in de cocaïnehandel

An SP MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about police and prosecution warnings over rising cocaine trade violence, port capacity and customs corruption. The state secretary answered that the signal is taken seriously, points to the integrated one-government approach and customs' smart supervision, says shootings may be indirectly linked to drug imports, and refers to earlier answers on anti-corruption measures at customs.
The regional triangle and Customs are examining which consultation model can best be given shape for this.
De regionale driehoek en de Douane onderzoeken in welk overlegmodel dit het beste vorm gegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Nijboer over het klimaatbeleid van banken

MPs Jan Vos and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about poor climate scores of Dutch banks, their climate commitments, supervision and standards for non-financial reporting. The minister acknowledged the criticism, said banks should be more transparent and do more, and pointed to existing platforms and EU rules, committing to support international standards and to an accountant audit of non-financial information.
Unambiguous and enforceable international standards for presenting non-financial information, without too much discretion, would be an important step forward.
Eenduidige en afdwingbare internationale standaarden voor de weergave van niet-financiële informatie, zonder te veel vrijheidsgraden, zouden een belangrijke stap voorwaarts zijn.
Antwoord op van de leden Ronnes en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Inkomen niet in Euro’s? Dan geen hypotheek!’

MPs Ronnes and Koolmees asked the Finance Minister whether borrowers with foreign-currency income can no longer get mortgages, and whether an investigation will follow. The minister confirmed signals from the sector, pointed to the EU Mortgage Credit Directive's currency-risk rules, and saw no reason for further investigation since ABN AMRO resumed such lending, though he will raise the issue with the European Commission.
Given the consultation held with the sector and the fact that ABN AMRO again offers mortgage credit in foreign currency, I currently see no reason for further investigation.
Gezien het overleg dat is gevoerd met de sector en het gegeven dat ABN AMRO weer hypothecaire kredieten in vreemde valuta aanbiedt, zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding voor verder onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het vervolgen van een statisticus en de onafhankelijkheid van de Griekse statistiek

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the hearing where former ELSTAT head Georgiou warned of pressure on Greek statisticians, the prosecution of Georgiou, and a Greek minister's call to investigate deficit figures. The minister answered that ELSTAT was set up as an independent authority, that Eurostat has no open reservations on Greek deficit data, that politicians should not question official statistics, and that the court case must run its course without comment.
Of course it is important to keep monitoring this under the programme.
Het is uiteraard van belang om dit onder het programma te blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de onrust bij de douane

An MP asked the Finance Minister about unrest among customs staff over his working visit, including whether surveillance staff were deliberately skipped and whether he would inform parliament. The minister denied skipping surveillance, said he met staff and union representatives, committed to pursuing customs weapons and emergency-vehicle exemptions, and referred further detail to a separate letter.
It was my explicit wish to speak with those employees, and there was ample time for this during the visit.
Het was mijn uitdrukkelijke wens om met die medewerkers in gesprek te gaan en tijdens het bezoek was er ook ruim de tijd voor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Tony van Dijck over de te hoge buffers van zorgverzekeraars

Two PVV MPs asked the Finance and Health ministers about health insurers' excessive capital buffers, the EU Solvency II rules, insolvency risk and consequences for insured persons, and whether premium money is effectively being stolen. The ministers replied that Solvency II already accounts for the Dutch system, that the insolvency probability is about 0.5% per year, that insured persons are protected under Article 31 Zvw, and that insurers may choose their own safety margins, with excess solvency returned via lower premiums.
Should a health insurer go bankrupt, insured persons will look for a new health insurer and take out new health insurance.
Mocht een zorgverzekeraar failliet gaan, dan zullen verzekerden een nieuwe zorgverzekeraar zoeken en een nieuwe zorgverzekering afsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over verborgen kosten bij autoverzekeringen, naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Autoverzekering wordt duurder’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether hidden fees such as policy, cancellation, change and prolongation charges on car insurance, and the difficulty this creates in comparing policies, should be ended through agreements with insurers. The minister answered that disclosure rules under the Wft already require all costs to be stated clearly and not hidden, that the AFM supervises this, and that additional agreements with insurers are not necessary.
I do not consider additional agreements with insurers necessary. The AFM supervises compliance with information obligations.
Aanvullende afspraken met verzekeraars acht ik niet nodig. De AFM houdt toezicht op informatieverplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘ABN Amro-adviseurs in de fout met hypotheken’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that ABN AMRO advisers copied client signatures to close mortgage files without clients' knowledge, and about disciplinary consequences, supervisory policy and adviser pay. The minister confirmed the supervisors were notified and an internal investigation started, called the director's remark on client harm unfortunate, said the bankers' oath disciplinary regime may apply depending on timing, and described the bank's pay structure and the commission ban.
Because of their duty of confidentiality, the supervisors make no further statements about their role in this investigation.
De toezichthouders doen vanwege hun geheimhoudingsplicht geen verdere mededelingen over hun rol bij dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Fiscus legt ABN Amro forse naheffing op’

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about reports that the tax authority imposed a EUR 142 million additional assessment on ABN AMRO over two structured finance entities kept off its balance sheet, and about cum/ex dividend tax practices under German investigation. Minister Dijsselbloem declined to discuss the individual case citing tax secrecy, said the consolidation question is for the accountant and separate from tax liability, and stated that tax assessments are not negotiable though contact with the tax authority exists.
The Tax Authority is bound by a tax secrecy obligation. Therefore I cannot make any statements about actions the Tax Authority does or does not take regarding individual taxpayers.

De Belastingdienst kent een fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht. Derhalve kan ik geen mededelingen doen over de handelingen die de Belastingdienst al dan niet uitvoert ten aanzien van individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Merkies over betrokkenheid van ABN Amro bij de aanleg van de Dakota Access-oliepijpleiding en het neerslaan van protesten daartegen

MPs Gesthuizen and Merkies asked the Finance Minister about ABN AMRO's involvement in the Dakota Access pipeline, whether the state (via NLFI) is liable, whether it will investigate alleged human rights abuses against protesters, and how the banking CSR covenant applies. The minister answered that ABN AMRO is not in the financing consortium, that NLFI is not responsible for its investments, that the US legal system is the proper forum, and that complaints can go to the OECD National Contact Point.
It is not for the Dutch government to investigate this.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse overheid om hier onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over het bericht ‘Overname levert NXP-topman 391 miljoen op’

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the Minister of Finance about reports that the NXP executive would receive about 391 million euros from the takeover, questioning the pay level, short-termism, pay ratios, possible repayment of about 50 million euros in subsidies, variable pay limits, and whether the Tang-Irrgang conflict-of-interest rules apply. The government replied that it has no opinion on the amount, points to existing corporate governance code rules and pending EU and Dutch legislation on pay transparency, explains that NXP received 96 million euros in innovation subsidies with no grounds for repayment, notes financial-sector pay rules differ from other sectors, and states the conflict-of-interest provision in Article 2:129a BW bars executive directors from deciding on their own pay.
Reclaiming the subsidy is therefore not an issue.
Terugvordering van subsidie is daarom niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Creditcardbedrijf van ABN gaf klanten te veel krediet’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that ABN AMRO subsidiary ICS extended excessive credit to card customers for at least five years, charging up to 14% interest. The minister confirmed the AFM's investigation, stated that breaching a bank's own norms does not automatically breach the statutory duty of care, noted that ICS is preparing customer compensation, and said the AFM supervises creditcard providers risk-based and will focus on whether credit matches customer needs.
On that basis the AFM started a formal investigation, since the earlier irregularities and the reported incidents together point to serious violations.
Daarop is de AFM een formeel onderzoek gestart, aangezien de eerdere onregelmatigheden en de melding van incidenten tezamen duiden op ernstige overtredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Verhoeven over de zeer hoge uitkering aan de topman van NXP bij de verkoop van het bedrijf

MPs Gesthuizen and Verhoeven asked whether the reported USD 428 million payout to NXP's chief executive from the company's sale, and the risks of such exorbitant pay, were acceptable, and whether the clawback rules and NXP subsidies would be reviewed. The minister, on behalf of the economic affairs minister, declined to judge the amount, said pay assessment is for shareholders and the company, referred to earlier answers on clawback and subsidies, and gave no new commitments.
I have no opinion on the amount reported in the media that the NXP chief executive would keep from the takeover if he exercised his options and sold his shares.
Ik heb geen oordeel over de in de media genoemde hoogte van het bedrag dat de uitvoerend bestuurder van NXP zou overhouden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over de berichten ‘Curator stapt vaker de ring in’ en ‘Pandrechten leiden tot meer rechtszaken bij faillissement’

Two MPs asked whether creditors, especially banks holding pledges, are unfairly privileged in bankruptcy, whether curators are pressured, and whether shareholders misuse bankruptcy to take over assets and shed staff. The minister answered that pledge holders have legitimate priority under existing law, that worker protections exist via UWV, that curators have a central role in any doorstart, and that the issues will be addressed in the forthcoming WCO III bill after consultation with interest groups.
Within the bankruptcy law review programme, work is underway on a proposal for the Business Continuity Act III (WCO III).
Binnen het programma herijking faillissementsrecht wordt gewerkt aan een voorstel voor de wet continuïteit ondernemingen III (de WCO III).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Middenbedrijf weet kapitaalmarkt onvoldoende te vinden’

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports that medium-sized businesses struggle to access capital markets, and about measures such as SME growth markets, prospectus rules, FinTech and alternative financing. The ministers answered that existing financing instruments, the action plan on SME financing and EU capital markets union measures address the problem, and that the prospectus exemption threshold will be raised and further FinTech steps reported before year-end.
The cabinet considers it of great importance that sufficient financing is available for enterprises with a sound business plan.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat er voldoende financiering beschikbaar is voor ondernemingen met een gezond bedrijfsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Yücel over het terugtreden van de enige vrouw in de RvB van ABN AMRO

MPs Nijboer and Yücel asked the government about the departure of the only woman on ABN AMRO's management board, the gender diversity shortfall in the financial sector, and what the state as shareholder will do to reach the 30 percent target. The minister answered that the state will press ABN AMRO to nominate a woman, has asked NLFI to discuss diversity measures, and points to the reinstated statutory target and monitoring in 2019.
If a board does not meet the target, I as shareholder request that the company make an effort to nominate a woman.
Indien een raad niet voldoet aan het streefcijfer, vraag ik als aandeelhouder een inspanningsverplichting van de onderneming om een vrouw voor te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over wurgkredieten

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister about 'wurgkredieten' (revolving credit where high interest leaves consumers unable to repay), whether the AFM enforced sufficiently, and whether intermediaries and debt advisers need licences and whether the commission regime is adequate. The minister confirms such cases persist, describes AFM-driven remediation plans due by end 2017, and defends the licensing and commission rules while deferring any change until the 2017 evaluation of the commission ban.
The AFM closely monitors the progress of market parties and will, where necessary, proceed to formal enforcement.
De AFM houdt de voortgang van marktpartijen scherp in de gaten en zal indien nodig overgaan tot formele handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht "Woonbootbewoners tussen wal en schip"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked about ING ceasing mortgages for houseboats, leaving only one provider, and whether banks should be able to offer tailored products. The minister says the market is commercially unattractive due to complexity and low volume, sees no regulatory obstacles in financial rules, notes a forthcoming houseboat mooring-tenancy law, and will monitor developments.
I have actively followed developments in recent months and will continue to do so in the coming period.
Ik heb de ontwikkelingen de afgelopen maanden actief gevolgd en zal dit de komende periode ook blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht “Bank straft trouwe klant”

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked whether banks refuse bridging loans to retirees who no longer need a mortgage, and whether regulation causes this, plus solutions and whether NVB claims regulation hinders tailored service to seniors. The minister says no standard bridging loan exists without a mortgage, regulation does not block it, some banks offer it case by case, and a study and a maatwerk platform will examine the practice.
As far as I am aware, no lender offers a bridging loan as a standard product when no mortgage product is attached.
Voor zover mij bekend biedt geen enkele kredietverstrekker standaard de mogelijkheid om een overbruggingskrediet af te sluiten indien er geen hypotheekproduct aan is verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Nijboer over hulp bij pinnen voor mensen met een beperking

MPs Volp and Nijboer asked whether ING's new security policy, which requires a companion when a customer with a disability withdraws cash, conflicts with the Dutch disability equality law and the UN Convention. The State Secretary answered that banks set their own security rules, that the Wgbh/cz obliges providers to make effective adjustments with the College voor de Rechten van de Mens judging specific cases, and that the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer will discuss accessibility.
The College voor de Rechten van de Mens can investigate whether there is prohibited discrimination and whether article 2 has been violated.
Het College voor de Rechten van de Mens kan onderzoeken of er sprake is van verboden onderscheid en of er in strijd met artikel 2 is gehandeld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over een vermeende geheime fiscale compensatieregeling voor het Koninklijk Huis

An MP from 50PLUS asked the ministers of Interior and Finance about an alleged secret tax compensation arrangement for the Royal House, covering ten questions on its legitimacy, legality, parliamentary knowledge and possible recovery of benefits. The government's answer, given by Prime Minister Rutte, refers the MP to an earlier letter answering a related request from another MP, rather than answering the questions on substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over het bericht dat leden van de Koninklijke familie al tientallen jaren compensatie krijgen voor het betalen van belasting

Pechtold (D66) asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister, after reports that royal family members received tax compensation for decades, about the amounts paid, the secrecy of the agreements, archiving and disclosure, cabinet decisions, and why a 2015 evaluation report omitted the arrangement. The answer refers the MP to a separate letter responding to a Van Klaveren request, without answering the questions on substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de conceptbeleidsregel “Veilig stellen geldmiddelen betaalinstellingen en elektronische geldinstellingen”

The MP asks the Finance Minister about DNB's draft policy rule on safeguarding funds of payment and e-money institutions, including FinTech criticism, competition, costs, and alternatives such as a quality account. The Minister answers that DNB is independent, the rule clarifies existing practice without blocking alternatives, and the final version will incorporate consultation input.
A policy rule is not a generally binding regulation, but elaborates a statutory power and binds the administrative body itself.
Een beleidsregel is geen algemeen verbindend voorschrift, maar werkt een wettelijke bevoegdheid uit en bindt het bestuursorgaan zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Bosman over de aangekondigde sluiting van de Windward Island Bank (WIB) op Saba

MPs Aukje de Vries and Bosman asked whether the Windward Island Bank will close its Saba branch, what the consequences are, and whether the resulting single-bank situation and the stricter BES financial regulation are justified. The minister confirmed the closure, said the remaining bank RBC would hold a de facto monopoly that may be undesirable, attributed the decision mainly to poor financial results rather than regulation, and committed to ongoing consultation with the island government and supervisors to keep ATMs and at least one bank operating.
I am considering, in consultation with the parties involved, whether there are options to keep this ATM operational next year as well.
Ik bezie, in overleg met betrokken partijen, of er mogelijkheden bestaan om deze geldautomaat ook volgend jaar operationeel te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over 'gratis geld voor bedrijven' als gevolg van het ECB-beleid

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about ECB bond-buying (CSPP) giving large firms cheap credit, its fairness to SMEs, which firms' bonds were bought, and whether the program amounts to subsidy and conflicts with the ECB mandate. The minister answered that the ECB policy is not sector-specific, that the bond list and purchase volumes per security are not published as market-sensitive, and that the Treaty mandate is for the ECB to assess, not the cabinet.
No list of corporate bonds bought under the CSPP is published, because this is market-sensitive information.
Er wordt geen lijst van onder het CSPP opgekochte bedrijfsobligaties gepubliceerd, omdat dit marktgevoelige informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over de beloningen bij de Bank Nederlandse Gemeenten

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the Finance Minister about the high pay of BNG Bank's board chair, the 2009 pay policy, and whether semi-public banks should pay less. The minister said the 2009 policy applies only to newly appointed board members, that a new policy cutting the maximum to EUR 301,000 was adopted on 5 October 2016, and that state holdings are private companies whose pay must reflect specialist labour markets.
For the level of pay of the chair and other members of the board of BNG Bank, I refer you to the public annual reports of BNG Bank.
Voor de hoogte van de beloning van de voorzitter en overige leden van de rvb van BNG Bank verwijs ik u naar de openbare jaarverslagen van BNG Bank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Koers Deutsche Bank fors onderuit na weigering miljardenschikking met Amerikaanse justitie’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that Deutsche Bank faced a multi-billion settlement demand from US justice over RMBS sales, and whether this threatens its capital position and Dutch banks. The minister answered that the settlement is a matter for US authorities, that Deutsche Bank meets minimum capital requirements though faces structural challenges, and that the government sees no direct threat to Dutch banks while stressing the importance of strict supervision.
It is up to the American authorities to reach arrangements with banks that in their jurisdiction are reported to have carried out activities that did not comply with the applicable rules.
Het is aan de Amerikaanse autoriteiten om regelingen te treffen met banken die in hun jurisdictie activiteiten zouden hebben ontplooid die niet strookten met de toepasselijke regels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de berichten 'Europa botst met VS over zwaardere regels voor banken,' en 'Niet vreemd dat het wringt tussen Europa en VS'

The MP asks whether the Dutch government will push for stricter Basel bank capital rules and a higher leverage ratio, given US-EU disagreement and DNB's stance against a significant rise in capital requirements. The Minister answers that Basel reforms aim to improve internal-model risk weights rather than broadly raise capital, that Netherlands will seek a leverage ratio of at least 4%, and that EU deviations from Basel (e.g. sovereign bond treatment) will be addressed later, without committing to a specific new DNB intervention.
The aim of these reforms is not to further substantially raise capital requirements across the board.
Het doel van deze hervormingen is niet om over de hele linie de kapitaaleisen verder fors te laten stijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het rapport ‘Zorg tussen wal en schip’

An MP asked several ministers about the OVV report on medical assistance at sea by the Kustwacht, covering staffing, investment, coordination with healthcare, and whether the Kustwacht annual report is sent to parliament. The minister defers substantive answers on most questions to a forthcoming full response to the OVV report, providing only partial information on summer incident patterns and the state of helicopter talks.
The answer to the above questions 2, 3, 4 and 5 I will include in my response to the OVV report.
Het antwoord op bovengenoemde vragen 2, 3, 4 en 5 neem ik mee in mijn reactie op het OVV-rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Nijboer over het bericht ‘België verbiedt cfd's en binaire opties voor particulieren’

MPs Ronnes and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether Belgium's ban on marketing CFDs and binary options to consumers applies to EU-passported firms, how many complaints the Netherlands has received, and whether the Netherlands will follow suit. The minister confirmed the Belgian rule covers cross-border firms, reported about 50 complaints since 2014, and committed to work with the AFM on a comparable advertising ban for the Netherlands ahead of MiFID II.
I consider it appropriate to introduce in the Netherlands a ban comparable to the Belgian or French situation.
Ik acht het opportuun om een met de Belgische of Franse situatie vergelijkbaar verbod ook in Nederland te introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat banken maar beperkt inzetten op rechten van werknemers in hun relaties met grote bedrijven

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a report finding that major Dutch banks do too little to promote workers' rights among large corporate clients, and whether they meet OECD guidelines. The minister acknowledged mixed results, endorsed the report's call for more active banking engagement, and pointed to the IMVO covenant and ongoing dialogue, without committing to new binding measures.
My ministry is in dialogue with the banks in various places and ways on corporate social responsibility.
Mijn ministerie is op verschillende plekken en manieren met de banken in dialoog over maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over mogelijk etnisch profileren van ondernemers

An MP asks several ministers whether inspection and licensing bodies may be ethnically profiling entrepreneurs through risk models, large joint enforcement teams and the 'slecht levensgedrag' licence criterion. The minister answers that ethnicity is not a selection variable, that the government opposes profiling and points to existing measures, but declines to provide lists, case-level quickscans or a fundamental investigation, pointing to municipal responsibility.
No, a list of fined companies alone cannot support any conclusion about how companies are selected.
Nee, uit alleen een overzicht van beboete bedrijven valt geen conclusie te trekken over de selectie van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Bankiers schikken Euribor-fraude' en het bericht Tuchtrecht banken werkt niet'

An MP asked the Minister of Finance whether the Dutch Securities Institute's light fines (750 to 3,000 euro) for Rabobank bankers in the LIBOR/EURIBOR scandal and the low number of royements show that self-regulatory discipline in banking fails. The minister defended the self-regulatory disciplinary system as serving different functions from criminal law, noted the new benchmark-manipulation rules and AFM powers, and declined to comment on the tribunal's independent judgments while promising no new structural change.
For the handling of the case by the DSI Disciplinary Committee and the DSI Appeals Committee, I refer to the answer to question 5.
Voor de behandeling van de zaak door de Tuchtcommissie DSI en de Commissie van Beroep DSI verwijs ik naar de beantwoording van vraag 5.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over het mogelijk maken om een hypotheek met hoge rente stapsgewijs en boetevrij om te zetten in een hypotheek met een lager rentepercentage

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked whether existing mortgage holders could convert high-rate mortgages stepwise and penalty-free to lower rates, and whether banks may still charge early-repayment fees under the new EU Mortgage Credit Directive. The minister explained that fees must now reflect actual losses for new mortgages, that the AFM is still investigating compliance for existing contracts, and that no standardised stepwise conversion guide will be published.
There is currently no overview available showing how the various mortgage lenders in the Netherlands calculate the early repayment compensation.
Er is op dit moment geen overzicht voorhanden waarin wordt weergegeven op welke wijze de verschillende hypotheekverstrekkers in Nederland de vergoeding bij vervroegde aflossing berekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over verzekeraar Ennia op de Antillen

MP Van Raak asked the ministers of Finance and Interior about the Ennia insurer in the Caribbean: the valuation of the Mullet Bay resort, conflicts of interest, auditing by KPMG, remedies for policyholders, and who screened Hushang Ansary. The ministers declined to answer the valuation and conflict questions citing DNB's confidentiality duty, answered the audit and screening questions only partly by pointing to the former Bank Nederlandse Antillen and the CBCS, and referred to earlier answers on policyholder remedies.
For these reasons I do not have the information to answer these questions.
Om die redenen beschik ik niet over informatie om deze vragen te kunnen beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de aanpak van de Griekse schuldencrisis door het IMF naar aanleiding van het evaluatierapport van het IEO (Independent Evaluation Office)

An MP asked the Finance Minister how to respond to the IEO evaluation criticising the IMF's handling of the Greek and eurozone crises, including alleged political pressure from the European Commission, the debt restructuring decision, and whether an independent review of the Dutch role is needed. The minister rejects the claim of political interference, defends the IMF's independence and debt analysis, welcomes the IEO recommendations, and declines a separate independent inquiry, pointing to existing audits and evaluations.
I welcome the IEO report on the eurocrisis and the recommendations the evaluation office has formulated.
Ik verwelkom het IEO- rapport van de eurocrisis en de aanbevelingen die de evaluatiedienst geformuleerd heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Spaarpolis verzekeraar ongedekt’

Nijboer asked whether mortgage savings products backed by insurers are really savings, and why deposit guarantee (DGS) protection applies to bank savings mortgages but not insurer-based ones. The minister explained that only deposits fall under the DGS, that insurer-based savings mortgages are not deposits and so are excluded, and that he sees no reason to assume consumers are confused about the difference.
Only deposits are eligible for protection under the deposit guarantee scheme (DGS).
Alleen deposito’s komen voor bescherming door het depositogarantiestelsel (DGS) in aanmerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Italiaanse banken en “plannen” voor een EU-noodpakket van 150 miljard euro

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports of a proposed EU 150 billion euro rescue package for Italian banks, Italy's high non-performing loan rate, and whether Italy could be allowed exceptions to EU rules or leave the eurozone. The minister replied that no EU rescue package is planned, that bank problems must be solved by banks first under the banking union bail-in rules, that no exceptions to EU rules will be made, and that leaving the eurozone is not a solution.
There are no European plans for such an EU rescue package, and as far as I am concerned there will not be one.
Er zijn geen Europese plannen voor een dergelijk EU-noodpakket en wat mij betreft komt dat er ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus, Aukje de Vries en Moors inzake vmbo-leerlingen die aangeven onvoldoende kennis van geldzaken te hebben

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Education and the Minister of Finance about a survey showing vmbo pupils feel insufficiently informed about money matters, and what schools, the curriculum and the Wijzer in Geldzaken programme do about it. The government answers that money management is embedded in existing curriculum goals and subjects, that monitoring of school practice is not done centrally, and that prevention is preferred to municipal debt write-offs.
However, it is not monitored nationally in what way and with what intensity schools pay attention to societal themes such as managing money, nor why they do so.
Er wordt echter niet landelijk gemonitord op welke wijze en met welke intensiteit scholen aandacht besteden aan maatschappelijke thema's zoals omgaan met geld, en ook niet waarom zij dat zo doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over grote persoonlijke problemen bij doorlopende kredieten

An MP asked the Finance Minister about consumers trapped in long-running revolving credit from Interbank, including whether they were properly informed, how many are affected, whether lenders may refuse to refinance, and whether variable rate increases are permitted. The minister answered that such 'locked-up' situations arise from combined circumstances, that the AFM has required lenders to review portfolios and restructure credits, and that the minister expects providers to offer suitable solutions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Nijboer over het bericht “Nog geen uitspraken vanwege schending bankierseed”

MPs Mei Li Vos and Nijboer asked why the banker's oath disciplinary Tuchtcommissie had issued no rulings a year after its introduction, why 43 of 57 complaints were rejected by the Stichting Tuchtrecht Banken, and how franchisees denied access to their credit files and loan information could be protected. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the first year was a transitional period without retroactive effect, that rejected complaints were civil disputes for Kifid or the courts, that six complaints are pending with first rulings expected late 2016, and that DNB and AFM are investigating how banks implement the oath.
An adequate procedure at the Stichting Tuchtrecht Banken appears to be assured.
Een adequate procesgang bij de stichting Tuchtrecht Banken lijkt geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Oud-bankier Dirk Scheringa maakt comeback via lege beurshuls’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the reverse listing of CS Factoring via the listed shell company Lavide, and its possible exemption from the prospectus requirement, is desirable and adequately informs investors. The Minister answered that the AFM assesses case by case whether the conversion exemption applies and whether investors are adequately informed, and that the AFM will ensure this.
It is up to the AFM to assess case by case whether the exception applies.
Het is aan de AFM om van geval tot geval te beoordelen of de uitzondering van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht “Van slachtoffer naar schuldige”

An MP (Nijboer, PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about reports that victims of bank card fraud are often left uncompensated, questioning whether banks refuse payment too readily on grounds of gross negligence and whether the Kifid complaints body applies the law correctly. The minister answered that banks almost always compensate victims, that the burden of proof of gross negligence lies with the bank, and that new PSD2 rules will reduce the customer's liability and set a one-business-day refund period.
I do not have figures showing what share of the fraud losses from debit and credit card fraud banks have compensated to victims.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers die inzichtelijk maken welk deel van de opgetreden fraudeschade als gevolg van betaalpas- en creditcardfraude de banken aan de gedupeerden hebben vergoed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over ontwikkelingen aangaande kredietunies in Nederland

MPs Nijboer asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the role of credit unions in SME lending, subsidy targeting, unregulated bodies calling themselves credit unions, banks acting as intermediaries, and regional or sectoral focus. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that credit unions are small, that subsidies are not split by model, that AFM oversees crowdfunding intermediaries using the name, and that banks' conditions are case-specific without committing to new action.
There is no reason to prohibit these initiatives from calling themselves a credit union.
Er is geen reden om deze initiatieven te verbieden om zich kredietunie te noemen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de berichten “France airs fears over London Stock Exchange merger with Deutsche Börse” en “French concerned about risks of Deutsche Börse, LSE Merger”

An MP asked the Finance Minister how he views the proposed merger of the London Stock Exchange and Deutsche Börse, including effects on Dutch finance, Euronext, and comments from French officials. The minister answered that the European Commission will assess competition effects, that Dutch supervisors lack competence over the non-Dutch merging firms, and that no timeline can yet be given.
The European Commission will investigate whether, and to what extent, there will be reduced competition as a result of the announced merger
De Europese Commissie zal gaan onderzoeken of, en in welke mate, sprake zal zijn van verminderde concurrentie als gevolg van de aangekondigde fusie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over de berichten 'European Commission Authorized Italian Government to Support Banks' en 'Duitsland hekelt bankenplan Italië'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports on an EU-approved Italian plan to support banks and German criticism of it, asking about the rules, the state aid basis, budget consequences, and German objections. The minister answered that the plan is a precautionary liquidity guarantee facility (up to 150 billion euro) for solvent banks under Commission conditions, that it is for the Commission to judge state aid, that no budget consequence arises unless the facility is used, and that EU bail-in rules will not be set aside.
On this measure too, I have no independent judgement.
Ook over deze maatregel heb ik geen zelfstandig oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over het bericht dat de alternatieve arbeidsinkomensquote momenteel relatief laag is

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the government about DNB's finding that the alternative labour income share is currently low, its historical position, the role of self-employment, and whether wages lag productivity. Minister Asscher answered that the measures differ mainly due to bank mortgage profits and self-employed income treatment, that a longer series and a common method are needed, and that wage-setting is for social partners, while the government will keep urging them to use available wage room.

I therefore follow with interest the hearing on wage developments and the labour income share to be held after the recess at the initiative of MP Voortman, and I invite the parties involved to agree on a uniform method for presenting the labour income share.

Ik volg dan ook met interesse de hoorzitting over de ontwikkeling van de lonen en het AIQ die op initiatief van het lid Voortman zal plaatsvinden na het reces, en nodig de betrokken partijen uit om met een uniforme methode te komen om de AIQ te presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Nieuwe tegenvaller Staat bij verkoop Vivat’

The MP asks the Finance Minister about reports of a new setback for the State in the sale of Vivat, including a pension agreement and the repayment of subordinated loans. The Minister confirms the pension indexation settlement (EUR 117.5 million in total, of which SRH owes EUR 81.7 million to Vivat), describes the loan repayment and the liability cap of EUR 150 million, but gives no clear answer on the supervisory role.
What role has the supervisor played in this?
Wat is de rol van de toezichthouder geweest in deze?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Schikking over derivaten stuit op onwil banken’

An MP from the PvdA asks the Finance Minister about reports that banks resist a commission's proposal to settle interest-rate derivative mis-selling claims collectively, including the reported settlement amounts, whether banks will cooperate, and the role of the AFM. The minister replies that independent experts are drawing up a uniform redress framework, that concrete figures were not shared with him, that banks are still in talks and have committed to the process, and that the AFM lacks legal power to enforce redress.
Concrete proposals have not been shared with me.
Concrete voorstellen zijn niet met mij gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Krol en Van Klaveren over "het behandelvoorbehoud op het EU-voorstel inzake bedrijfspensioenfondsen"

MPs Omtzigt, Krol and Van Klaveren asked whether the government would present the negotiated text on the EU occupational pensions (IORP) directive in time for Parliament to instruct its voting position, and by when. The State Secretary replied that the consolidated negotiation text was sent to Parliament on 24 June and made available via the Council extranet, that COREPER would discuss it on 30 June, and that Parliament could still state its view before the Council decision.
The consolidated text of the negotiation result will be submitted to COREPER
De geconsolideerde tekst van het onderhandelingsresultaat zal worden voorgelegd aan COREPER
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de nieuwe Europese richtlijn pensioenen, IORP-2

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the status of the IORP-2 pension directive, whether a deal was reached in the trilogue, whether publication was delayed until after the Brexit referendum, and whether the government kept its 2014 commitments to inform parliament quarterly and send draft Council positions in time. The State Secretary answered that the trilogue reached a provisional compromise, that the stilte procedure passed without objection, that Coreper vote is planned for 30 June, that the text will be shared with parliament, and that prior briefings were sent, while publication timing is a normal procedure.
No minutes were drawn up of these trilogue meetings.
Van deze triloogbijeenkomsten zijn geen notulen opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over opvallende vastgoeddeals van ING

MPs asked the ministers whether they were involved in, or aware of, questionable real estate deals by ING and how housing corporation Rochdale could lose 35 million euro on the sale of the Frankemaheerd office building to ING. The minister answered that the deals are private transactions outside state pre-approval, that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties found Rochdale acted within the rules, and that the sale price reflected a long, difficult process, while stating ING and Rochdale did not know of an 18 million option.
I note that these are agreements between private parties.
Ik stel vast dat het hier om overeenkomsten gaat tussen private partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het bericht 'Fransen kapen KLM’ en ‘Stakingsdreiging Air France: wat zijn de consequenties voor KLM'

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked about reports that Air France might shift KLM flights from Amsterdam to Paris amid strike threats, and about the strain on the KLM-Air France relationship. The State Secretary replied that Air France KLM denies such a plan, that cost-cutting is needed at both airlines, that the government opposes shifting capacity at KLM's expense, and that it will keep defending the public interests tied to KLM and Schiphol, promising a letter to the House.
We continue to commit to safeguarding the public interests involved with KLM and the main-port function of Schiphol.
We blijven ons inzetten voor de borging van de publieke belangen die met KLM en de mainportfunctie van Schiphol zijn gemoeid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht "DNB zet deur op kier voor eigen koers bankenbuffer"

An MP asks the Finance Minister about reports that DNB may ease bank capital buffer requirements if mortgage risk weights rise under Basel reforms. The minister replies that the Basel trajectories are still pending, that he sees no automatic link between systemic buffers and those reforms, and that capital requirements will remain firm.
I therefore see no direct or automatic link between the level of the systemic buffers and the reforms being worked on in the Basel Committee.
Ik zie daarom geen directe of automatische relatie tussen de (hoogte van de) systeembuffers en de hervormingen waar in het Bazelse Comité aan wordt gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het bericht ’EU liet 113 miljard begrotingsboetes voorbij gaan'

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the European Commission's reluctance to impose fines under the Stability and Growth Pact undermines fiscal discipline and the euro, citing reports on France, Spain, Portugal and Italy. The Minister replies that fines are only one step, that Commission application of the rules involves discretion and flexibility which has increased, that he rejects claims of favouritism towards France, and that he supports greater transparency and simplicity of the Pact.
It is essential for the credibility of the rules that the Commission does not shy away from taking steps when the budgetary situation in member states gives cause for them.
Het is essentieel voor de geloofwaardigheid van de regels dat de Commissie er niet voor terugdeinst stappen te zetten, indien de begrotingssituatie in lidstaten daar aanleiding toe geeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Chinese muur’ vertoont gat'
