An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch rules separating audit and advisory work for listed companies are circumvented when foreign affiliates of Dutch audit firms advise audit clients' foreign subsidiaries, and whether the rules should be reconsidered. The minister answered that Dutch law covers only Dutch-linked advice, that foreign affiliates' advice to foreign subsidiaries is not covered and not circumvention, and that EU Regulation 537/2014 from 17 June 2016 will ban such services for EU-based affiliates, so auditor independence is sufficiently safeguarded.
With the entry into force of the aforementioned regulation on 17 June 2016, additional rules will apply to foreign network members of audit firms that provide advisory services.

Met de inwerkingtreding van voornoemde verordening met ingang van 17 juni 2016 zullen aanvullende regels van toepassing worden voor buitenlandse netwerkonderdelen van accountantsorganisaties die adviesdiensten verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht ‘Marjo maakt foutje, dag €17.000 spaargeld’

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether banks should check payee names against account numbers to prevent misdirected transfers, and whether reissuing closed account numbers should be avoided. The minister answers that the current procedure recovers over 80% of misdirected payments, that name-number checks are complex, costly and error-prone, and that the Betaalvereniging is mapping the problem, while leaving banks responsible for implementing any risk measures.

I trust that once the results of the research into the nature and numbers of misdirected transfers are known, the Consumer Association and the Dutch Payments Association will consider how customers can be better assisted in preventing and recovering such transfers.

Ik vertrouw erop dat als de resultaten van het onderzoek naar de aard en aantallen van verkeerde overboekingen bekend zijn, de Consumentenbond en de Betaalvereniging zullen bezien hoe klanten beter kunnen worden bijgestaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Voortman en Karabulut over de arbeidsomstandigheden van de beveiliging op Schiphol

Three MPs asked whether working conditions for airport security staff at Schiphol had improved despite earlier promises, whether TNO's dwell-time recommendations were implemented, and whether Schiphol as client should be held to account, including whether security should return to a public body. Minister Asscher answered that employers and CAO parties are responsible, that the Inspectorate has received no complaints, that a new TNO report recommends a 120-minute dwell limit under review by June, and that no public body is needed.

Schiphol and the security companies have indicated that, until the new TNO report's recommendations are translated into practical and feasible dwell-time agreements, the current CAO norm of a maximum dwell time of 150 minutes is strictly observed.

Schiphol en de beveiligingsbedrijven hebben aangegeven dat, totdat de aanbevelingen uit het nieuwe TNO-rapport zijn vertaald in praktische en haalbare afspraken over statijden, de norm die in de huidige CAO staat – een maximale statijd van 150 minuten – strikt wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Jasper van Dijk over de productie van euromunten door een Zuid-Koreaans bedrijf dat ook betrokken is bij de productie van clustermunitie

MPs Merkies and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the state-owned Royal Dutch Mint (KNM) bought euro coin blanks from Poongsan, a Korean firm also linked to cluster munitions, and what the state as shareholder did about it. The Staatssecretaris answered that KNM ordered blanks in 2013 and 2015, that the state now asks KNM to stop ordering from Poongsan and will check this, and that the state will use the case as a general warning to other state holdings.
The state as shareholder will use this specific case as a general warning to the other state holdings that it is important to assess client and supplier relationships also on CSR aspects.

De staat als aandeelhouder zal deze specifieke casus gebruiken als algemene waarschuwing richting de andere staatsdeelnemingen dat het van belang is om klant- en leveranciersrelaties ook op MVO-aspecten te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de renteopslagen die banken in rekening brengen aan huiseigenaren bij het toepassen van rentemiddeling van 29 maart 2016

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether early-repayment penalty interest on mortgages, including rate-averaging charges, may include opaque surcharges and whether components and calculation must be transparent. The minister answered that penalties must reflect the lender's actual financial loss, that transparency is required, and that the AFM will oversee compliance under the Mortgage Credit Directive and may issue further rules if needed.
The customer's interest must be central when calculating the penalty interest.
Het belang van de klant moet bij de berekening van de boeterente centraal staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de investeringen van verzekeraars in bedrijven die bont en exotisch leer verkopen

An MP asked whether insurers' indirect investments in fur and exotic leather firms are regulated, whether the government will create rules, ensure transparency and talk to insurers to phase these investments out. The government answered there is no current regulation, relies on self-regulation via a planned multistakeholder CSR convenant with the insurance sector that may cover animal welfare and transparency, and noted two insurers are willing to engage on animal welfare.
Within the framework of (international) corporate social responsibility, the government relies on self-regulation.
In het kader van (internationaal) maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen (iMVO) zet de overheid in op zelfregulering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Tanamal over de Klachtenregen over zzp-verzekeringen arbeidsongeschiktheid

MPs Mei Li Vos and Tanamal asked the ministers about complaints over disability insurance for self-employed workers, including whether premiums should be refunded when insurers refuse benefits over non-disclosed medical history and why premium restitution under the old Commercial Code was dropped. The government answered that insurers may refuse claims only where the non-disclosed information was material, that premium restitution is limited under article 7:938 BW, and that it will review the rule with stakeholders and report after the summer.
In view of the above, I see sufficient reason to review, in consultation with the relevant stakeholders, article 7:938 of the Civil Code and the scope of the right to premium restitution.
In het voorgaande zie ik voldoende aanleiding om in overleg met de relevante stakeholders artikel 7: 938 BW en de reikwijdte van het recht op premierestitutie tegen het licht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “TenneT vraagt kabinet geld voor windparken”

MP Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about TenneT's request for extra state capital for offshore grid investments, including how much is needed, the funding source, the timing and parliamentary involvement, and why TenneT cannot raise financing privately. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the state is considering a request for EUR 1 billion in extra equity, to be decided on the basis of an external second opinion and reflected in the 2017 budget, with the Chamber informed separately if a decision is made.
In advance of this, I will also inform the Chamber by separate letter if the cabinet intends to proceed with the injection of additional capital.
Vooruitlopend hierop zal ik uw Kamer ook via een separate brief informeren indien het kabinet voornemens is om tot storting van additioneel kapitaal over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Sparen buiten eigen land blijft risicovol’

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about savings held at foreign banks through Dutch intermediaries, including the risks, deposit guarantee coverage, and possible malicious intermediaries. The minister answered that intermediaries must be licensed and disclose risks under AFM rules, that DNB and AFM supervise compliance, and that the revised EU deposit guarantee directive reduces the chance the state must step in.
There are no reports identifying how much savings, in volume and number, reaches foreign banks via intermediaries active in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen rapportages die identificeren hoeveel spaargeld, zowel qua omvang als aantal, via bemiddelaars actief in Nederland bij buitenlandse banken terecht komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers en Aukje de Vries over het op te richten Italiaanse noodfonds

MPs Harbers and Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about a proposed Italian private rescue fund for weak banks, its governance, state aid and bail-in implications, and whether it circumvents the BRRD. The minister answered that information is limited to public reports, that state aid compatibility is for the European Commission to judge, and that a private fund on market terms would fall outside the bail-in rules.
My information about such a fund is limited to public reporting.
Mijn informatie over een dergelijk fonds is beperkt tot openbare berichtgeving
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over het bericht “Schrap het verpandingsverbod”

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the proposal to lift the ban on pledging claims (verpandingsverbod) to ease SME credit. The minister answered that the problem lies in contractual clauses rather than statute, that a statutory change would be a restriction on freedom of contract, that talks with the banks and factoring association are ongoing, and that a decision will follow after stakeholder consultation.
On this basis, the final decision on the proposal made will take place.
Op basis hiervan zal de definitieve besluitvorming over het gedane voorstel plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over ‘de aantasting van de pensioenen’

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether ECB policy threatens pensions, whether rate windfalls on state debt could fund AOW or pension compensation, and whether the mandatory supplementary pension should be replaced by an opt-out. The government said it is in talks with social partners, DNB and others and will send a DNB report in May, declined to make theoretical windfall calculations, would consider pensioners in the purchasing-power decisions, and kept mandatory pension participation while planning a differentiated approach to be sent to parliament before summer.
In May the cabinet will send the DNB report with an assessment of the figures to your House.
In mei stuurt het kabinet de rapportage van DNB met een appreciatie van het cijferbeeld naar uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over uitspraken over helikoptergeld van de hoofdeconoom van de Europese Centrale Bank (ECB)

MP Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about ECB chief economist Peter Praet's remarks on 'helicopter money', including whether it is legal under Article 123 TFEU and what risks it poses for the Dutch state. The minister replied that helicopter money is a theoretical concept, that the Eurosystem is independent within its mandate, that legality could be tested before the Court of Justice, and that no legal advice would be sought, while agreeing to answer before the plenary debate.
Whether the ECB acts within its mandate can be brought before the European Court of Justice by interested parties.
Of de ECB handelt binnen haar mandaat kan door belanghebbenden worden voorgelegd aan het Europese Hof van Justitie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht ‘Rood staan blijft duur, ondanks lage rente’

An MP from the CDA asks the Finance Minister why overdraft interest rates remain high despite low market rates, whether the legal 15% cap is fair, and whether banks should be pressed to change overdraft pricing. The minister explains the cap is tied to the statutory interest rate plus 12 points (now 14%), attributes stickiness to fixed risk and admin costs, notes the ACM found intervention could backfire, and declines new talks with banks while promising to keep urging clearer information and cheaper alternatives.
I will again bring this to the attention of banks in my discussions with them.
Dit zal ik in mijn gesprekken met banken nogmaals onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Nijboer en Groot over het bericht dat de heer Meerstadt per direct opstapt als commissaris bij ABN AMRO

MPs Nijboer and Groot asked the Finance Minister about the sudden resignation of ABN AMRO supervisory board member Meerstadt after Panama Papers reports, and whether undisclosed offshore interests should be disclosed and checked in suitability tests. The minister answered that the resignation was unplanned, Meerstadt denies involvement, disclosure rules apply, and tax authorities will use the Panama Papers information, but declined to assess whether further information can be provided.
The Tax Authority will use the information from the Panama Papers to detect possible tax fraud.
De Belastingdienst zal de informatie uit de Panama Papers gebruiken om eventuele belastingfraude op te sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Toorenburg over binaire opties

MPs Ronnes and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked whether binary options should be treated as games of chance rather than financial products, given their prize-like payout, the broker's opposite interest, and possible refusal of successful traders. The Minister of Finance replied that binary options are classed as financial instruments under MiFID and the AFM supervises them, that a court case on the gambling question is pending, and that no new measures are planned for now.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over verzekeringen tegen internetfraude

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about insurance products offering a safety net against internet fraud, whether consumers should bear losses, and whether banks and online sellers are shifting losses onto consumers. The minister answered that such insurance is a private market choice, that banks must prove gross negligence to pass losses to consumers under Dutch civil law, and that he sees no shift of losses onto consumers.
I do not observe such a development.
Ik neem een dergelijke ontwikkeling niet waar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat DNB zich verzet tegen hogere kapitaalbuffers voor banken

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether he agrees that bank capital buffers should be raised further, whether DNB's opposition to this in international fora is inappropriate, and about DNB's views on internal models and Basel Committee proposals. The minister answers that buffers have already been raised and further steps are needed, defends the internal-model reforms and the Basel process, and declines to confront DNB on its lobbying while setting out the Basel agenda in a separate letter.
Yes. Have you taken note of the report 'DNB does not give up fight against buffers'?
Vraag 1 Hebt u kennisgenomen van het bericht «DNB geeft strijd tegen buffers niet op»?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over de aankondiging van ING om te stoppen met het aanbieden van hypotheken voor woonboten

MPs asked the Finance Minister whether ING's decision to stop offering mortgages for houseboats, leaving only Rabobank, would harm buyers and owners and what would be done about it. The minister confirmed the decision, said existing customers are unaffected, and said the market is complex and new entrants may appear, with consultation of the Dutch banking association planned.
Consultation will be held with the Dutch Banking Association and they will be asked whether they have ideas on how more providers of houseboat mortgages can enter the market.

Er zal overleg worden gevoerd met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken en worden gevraagd of zij ideeën hebben over hoe ervoor kan worden gezorgd dat er meer aanbieders van woonboothypotheken op de markt kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht «ING stopt met watervilla hypotheken»

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about ING ending houseboat mortgages, the market consequences, and how to attract new providers. The minister confirmed ING is the largest player, that Rabobank will remain the only provider, and that the government will consult the Dutch banking association on new entrants.
Consultation will be held with the Dutch Banking Association and it will be asked what ideas they have to ensure more providers of houseboat mortgages can enter the market.

Er zal overleg worden gevoerd met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken en gevraagd worden welke ideeën zij hebben om ervoor te zorgen dat er meer aanbieders van woonboothypotheken op de markt kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de mogelijke veiligheidsrisico's van pinpassen waarmee contactloos betaald kan worden

An MP asked the Finance Minister about security risks of contactless payment cards, including whether amounts above €50 can be charged unnoticed and whether banks should be pressed to supply protective sleeves. The minister answered that the €50 cumulative limit applies (customers may raise it to €250 at some banks), that fraud is hard and unlikely, and that banks themselves must implement any risk measures, while he will discuss risk reduction with them.
Ultimately it is up to the banks themselves to respond to this and implement any risk measures.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de banken zelf om hier gehoor aan te geven en eventuele risicomaatregelen te implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Albert de Vries over banken die niet meewerken aan het oversluiten van een hypotheek waardoor klanten niet van de lage rente kunnen profiteren

MPs Nijboer and Albert de Vries asked the Finance Minister about banks that refuse to help mortgage holders refinance to benefit from low rates, including those with pension or benefit income, and whether banks should be obliged to accept such clients. The minister answered that refinancing can be in the client's interest but depends on individual factors, rejected a duty to accept all refinancing requests as harmful to competition, and described voluntary measures such as rate smoothing and a banking trust monitor, while the AFM had no concrete signals of advisers misinforming clients.
I would therefore not want to advocate that credit providers be obliged to accept a client who wants to refinance their mortgage.
Ik zou er dan ook niet voor willen pleiten dat kredietverstrekkers verplicht een klant moeten accepteren die zijn hypotheek wil oversluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Financiën over de schikking met NS-fraudeurs

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked why NS settled employment contracts with executives involved in the Limburg concession tender irregularities despite the minister's earlier promise of no severance payments, and about the amounts, timeline and whether the state approved them. The minister answered that the NS board handled the settlements under employment law, that the state as shareholder has no role in ordinary employee dismissals, that he does not know the individual amounts, and that the settlements avoided costly litigation.
It is not for the shareholder to make this information public. That is for the company itself.
Het is niet aan de aandeelhouder om deze informatie publiek te maken. Dat is aan de onderneming zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over duurzame investeringen in de bankensector naar aanleiding van het rapport ‘Undermining our future’

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about Dutch banks' greater investment in fossil fuels than in renewables, a coal-reduction recommendation, transparency, and ING's selection as state house bank. The minister acknowledged the report, pointed to a bank climate statement and planned transparency talks, and said commitments on coal were a matter for the energy phase-out and sector, giving only partial substantive answers.
Perhaps the researchers themselves can explain this.
Wellicht kunnen de onderzoekers zelf hier duiding aan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Mei Li Vos en Tanamal over het bericht ‘Klachtenregen over zzp-verzekeringen arbeidsongeschiktheid’

MPs Mei Li Vos and Tanamal asked the ministers of Finance and Social Affairs about reports that self-employed contractors in construction struggle to get disability insurance from private insurers, and about insurers invoking medical non-disclosure to restrict or reclaim benefits. Minister Asscher answered that self-employed workers are responsible for arranging their own coverage, pointed to fallback options such as the private safety-net policy and voluntary UWV insurance, announced an awareness campaign, and said the insurers' association is modernising the health declaration form.
I consider it important that all self-employed workers, including those in construction, are aware that they are themselves responsible for arranging coverage against the risk of incapacity.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat alle zzp’ers – dus ook in de bouw – zich er bewust van zijn dat zij er zelf verantwoordelijk voor zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Bashir over een mogelijke btw-deal bij de schadeafwikkeling van aardbevingsschade in Groningen

MPs Smaling and Bashir asked whether a VAT integration-supply or other VAT arrangement applies to earthquake damage settlements in Groningen, why NAM routes payments via notaries, and how VAT treatment works for the Groninger Forum. The minister declined to comment on any specific VAT ruling, citing the tax inspector's exclusive competence and secrecy, described the general VAT deduction rules, and said NAM follows a standard settlement and deposit procedure without commenting on individual cases.
The tax inspector has the exclusive, statutorily established competence to rule on this arrangement.
Het is de exclusieve, wettelijk vastgelegde bevoegdheid van de belastinginspecteur om een uitspraak te doen over deze constructie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over de rapporten van de Auditdienst Rijk

Two MPs (Ronnes and Omtzigt, CDA) asked the Finance, Justice and Security, and Defence ministers about the Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) audit reports, including a list of 2015 reports, when each was sent to parliament, and the status of six announced audits. The government answered that it sent most reports promptly, gave dates for each, said some audits are unfinished or were commissioned by other ministers, and committed to publishing the reports on the ministries' websites.
The study referred to under b is being carried out on the instructions of the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and has not yet been completed.
Het onderzoek bedoeld onder b wordt uitgevoerd in opdracht van de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Te hoge hypotheken verstrekt door verwarring over regels’

MPs Van der Linde and Aukje de Vries asked whether lenders wrongly granted NHG mortgages up to 106% LTV based on minimal energy-saving measures, whether homeowners are harmed, and how rules and oversight should respond. The minister confirmed some lenders breached the rules, attributed partial confusion to WEW guidance, said homeowners face no tax loss, and that WEW clarified its norms and the AFM will inventory the problem.
It is correct that a number of institutions granted mortgages with an LTV of 106% without the full additional financing room being spent on energy-saving measures.
Het klopt dat een aantal instellingen hypotheken hebben verstrekt met een LTV van 106% zonder dat de volledige extra financieringsruimte is besteed aan energiebesparende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over de Radar-uitzending over arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen

MPs Aukje de Vries and Ziengs asked the Finance Minister about a Radar broadcast alleging that disability insurers refuse payouts over unreported, unconscious omissions made at application, and whether applicants should be screened in advance. The minister replied that the duty to disclose and the Protocol Verzekeringskeuringen apply, insurers may refuse only where non-disclosed facts matter, an industry form revision is underway, and the AFM has examined advice quality and is considering fines.
The AFM has in the past investigated how disability insurance works in practice, including the aspects raised in the Radar broadcast of 18 January.
De AFM heeft in het verleden onderzoek gedaan naar de werking van arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen, ook naar de aspecten die in de Radar-uitzending op 18 januari jl aan de orde kwamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat Italië banken van slechte leningen af mag helpen

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Italy's state guarantees for non-performing loans constitute state aid and why Dutch bank interventions were treated differently, and asked how Italian banks passed the ECB stress test and what measures protect the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Commission found the Italian scheme not to be state aid if the fee is market-based, explained the 2014 stress test outcomes, and pointed to the banking union safeguards, while refusing to answer a question on leaving the euro.
Moreover, the European Commission has not yet published the full decision for this case.
Overigens heeft de Europese Commissie het volledige besluit voor deze casus nog niet gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers en Aukje de Vries over de reddingsactie van de Portugese overheid bij de Banco Novo

MPs Harbers and Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about Portugal's rescue of Banco Novo, whether it followed EU state aid and BRRD rules, whether it was timed to avoid the new BRRD, and about a similar Italian bad bank deal. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the state aid approval, BRRD and state aid rules were followed, that the ECB had no role in the Portuguese resolution decision, and that he cannot judge investor claims.
I have no indication that the measures at Novo Banco violate the European state aid rules or the applicable BRRD rules.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de maatregelen bij Novo Banco in strijd zijn met de Europese staatssteunregels of de geldende regels uit de BRRD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over FinTech betaaldiensten

An MP asked the Finance Minister about divergent Dutch and EU interpretations of rules on payment institutions holding client funds, whether bitcoin-related firms can obtain bank accounts, and other obstacles for FinTech payment services. The minister answered that the core rule (Article 16(2) PSD) applies uniformly, that banks individually assess high-risk clients such as bitcoin exchanges, and that the revised PSD will improve indirect access for payment institutions.
Finally, I note that I am not aware of any signals of a trend in which Dutch payment institutions move to other member states where payment regulation is much more favourable.
Tot slot merk ik nog op dat mij geen signalen bekend zijn van een tendens waarbij Nederlandse betaalinstellingen uitwijken naar andere lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over een reclame-event voor accountants dat meetelt als PE-activiteit

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether a paid sales event for accountants that carried 5 PE (continuing education) points should be allowed, and whether the NBA should be held to account and the PE system tightened. The minister said the NBA is responsible for PE accreditation, has already reviewed and concluded no PE points could be awarded to this event, and pointed to a planned PE system reform with knowledge tests and a 2016 pilot.
The NBA has the possibility to nevertheless reject individual PE activities.
De NBA heeft de mogelijkheid om individuele PE-activiteiten desalniettemin af te keuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht: Hagel Verzekering Maatschappij bezwijkt onder druk DNB

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether DNB's supervision made it impossible for a small mutual hail insurer to survive, and how the rules and the fit-and-proper tests burden small insurers. The minister answered that DNB applies the proportionate Solvency II Basic regime to small insurers, that individual cases are not his to judge, and that proportionality has been reviewed with DNB, with an evaluation planned for 2018.
As Minister of Finance I have no insight into individual background circumstances.
Als Minister van Financien heb ik geen inzicht in individuele achtergronden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de omvang en de in transparantie van het ANFA-programma waarmee Nationale Centrale Banken voor honderden miljarden staatsobligaties opgekocht hebben en over de totale hoeveelhe

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the opaque ANFA agreement limiting national central banks' net financial assets, the composition of national central bank bond holdings, and whether ECB bond purchases amount to monetary financing of sovereign debt. The minister largely deflected, citing the ECB's and national central banks' responsibility and confidentiality of ANFA, while providing aggregate PSPP purchase figures per country and committing only to discuss publishing ANFA with DNB.
It is therefore up to the NCBs themselves whether they use the room that ANFA offers them.
Het is dus aan de NCB's zelf of zij de ruimte die hun geboden wordt op basis van ANFA benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over de ANFA en het opkoopbeleid van nationale centrale banken

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the ANFA agreement and national central banks' purchases of government bonds, including whether they bought bonds to support their own governments and what DNB holds. The minister answered that NCBs may hold sovereign bonds within ECB limits, that ANFA caps their net financial assets, that he supports the ban on monetary financing, and that he will discuss publishing ANFA with DNB.
Ultimately, however, this is up to the ECB and the national central banks.
Dit is uiteindelijk echter aan de ECB en de nationale centrale banken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over een Spaans onderzoek naar fraude bij een dochteronderneming van Propertize

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a Spanish investigation into fraud at Propertize's Spanish subsidiary PDU, whether Propertize's control of PDU was reported late, and what this means for the planned sale. The minister said the OM was unaware of any Spanish investigation or request, explained the historical consolidation and disclosure of PDU, and said the matter does not affect the sale because it contains no new facts.
The OM has informed me that it is not aware of a Spanish investigation into Propertize or of a request for legal assistance from Spain to the Netherlands in this matter.
Het OM heeft mij te kennen gegeven niet bekend te zijn met een Spaans onderzoek naar Propertize dan wel met een rechtshulpverzoek van Spanje aan Nederland in deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de rol van private equity in de ondergang van V&D

An MP asks ministers about the role of private equity firm Sun Capital in the bankruptcy and possible restart of V&D, and whether bankruptcy law protects against abuse. The government answers that the curator leads any restart under judicial supervision, that existing rules guard against abuse, and that the private equity role will be examined in a separate study.
Because of competitive sensitivity, the curators do not disclose the identity of the selected parties.
De curatoren maken vanwege de concurrentiegevoeligheid de identiteit van de geselecteerde partijen niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij, Kerstens en Nijboer over de oud -eigenaar Sun Capital die mogelijk betrokken is bij een doorstart van V&D

MPs Vermeij, Kerstens and Nijboer asked about former owner Sun Capital's possible role in a V&D going-concern restart after bankruptcy, and whether bankruptcy was misused against staff and creditors. Minister Asscher answered that the court and curators are responsible, that the curators' report will show Sun Capital's role, and that research into works council positions in takeovers will be completed before summer.
It is not for me to make statements about the background to this bankruptcy and the financial situation of the company.
Het is niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen over de achtergronden bij dit faillissement en de financiële situatie van de onderneming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht: ‘Geen voordeel verzekeraar meer bij NHG-lening’

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Solvency II rules that deny insurers the risk-reducing effect of the NHG mortgage guarantee, and the late communication of this, will raise NHG mortgage rates and distort competition. The minister confirmed the problem, said DNB rightly sees no legal room to recognise NHG under the current standard formula, pledged to work with DNB to fix it in the 2018 review, and argued the effect on rates and competition would be small.

Once the European Commission starts the evaluation of the delegated acts, expected to be completed in 2018, the Ministry of Finance will work together with DNB to resolve this omission in the Solvency II framework recently identified by DNB.

Zodra de Europese Commissie de evaluatie van de gedelegeerde handelingen opstart, waarvan de afronding is voorzien in 2018, zal het Ministerie van Financiën zich gezamenlijk met DNB inzetten om deze onlangs door DNB geconstateerde omissie in het Solvabiliteit II kader op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over het bericht ‘100% veilige bank’ sneuvelt op depositogarantiestelsel

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a proposed 'fully safe' bank (Depositobank) and whether DNB can exempt banks from the deposit guarantee scheme and set near-zero contributions for low-risk banks. The minister answered that no bank is fully safe, that participation is mandatory under EU law with no DNB discretion to exclude, and that risk-based contributions are proportionate, while agreeing to examine the scheme as an entry barrier.
No. As indicated in answer 2, even with a very low credit risk, risks remain for depositors.
Nee. Zoals aangegeven bij vraag 2 blijven er, ook indien sprake is van een zeer laag kredietrisico, voor depositohouders risico’s bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het bericht "Provincie belegt weer 50 miljoen"

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a province investing 50 million in a hybrid tier 1 instrument issued by BNG Bank, whether this circumvents mandatory treasury banking and which other authorities did similar investments. The minister answered that the investment is permitted as fulfilling a public task under the financing law, listing the other participating authorities, and denied circumvention.
If the province of Friesland therefore regards BNG Bank and NWB Bank as institutions performing a public task, these funds may be provided to those banks.
Wanneer de provincie Friesland BNG Bank en NWB Bank dus aanmerkt als instellingen die een publieke taak verrichten, mogen deze middelen verschaft worden aan deze banken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over een nieuwe, tweede corruptiezaak bij Propertize

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a second corruption case at Propertize (ex-SNS Property Finance), the scope of prior DNB instructions, integrity measures taken, and whether integrity problems caused SNS's failure. The minister confirmed the criminal case and its suspects but declined to give the year or other details, citing prosecution interests, said no information is given on other investigations, described the DNB instruction and Propertize's integrity measures, and refused to comment on the integrity question while the case is before the court.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that, given investigation and prosecution interests, it cannot provide any information on this.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij medegedeeld dat het, gelet op de opsporings- en vervolgingsbelangen, hierover geen mededelingen kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Oskam over binaire opties

MPs Ronnes and Oskam (CDA) asked the Finance and Justice ministers about binary options, whether they should fall under gambling law rather than securities supervision, and the status of the AFM court case and warnings. The government answered that binary options are financial instruments under MiFID and the Wft, that the AFM's appeal is pending before the CBb, that the AFM has warned investors but imposed no sanctions, and that it will push for harmonised cross-border supervision.
Due to supervisory confidentiality, the AFM cannot address whether investigations into specific parties are ongoing or whether it intends to impose measures on such a party.

Vanwege toezichtvertrouwelijkheid kan de AFM niet ingaan op de vraag of er nog onderzoeken naar specifieke partijen lopen of dat er een voornemen is tot het opleggen van maatregelen aan een dergelijke partij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat een betaalopdracht voor een reis richting Cuba wordt geweigerd door ING

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether ING's refusal of a payment for a Cuba holiday trip was reasonable and whether banks may refuse payments to countries without an embargo. The government answered that US sanctions and the bank's own risk assessment determine such decisions, that banks are responsible for their own choices, and that it does not intervene in them.
It is up to the banks themselves to weigh, within this context of various legal frameworks, how a particular transaction relates to these rules.
Het is aan de desbetreffende banken zelf om in deze context van verschillende wettelijke kaders een afweging te maken hoe een bepaalde transactie zich verhoudt tot deze regels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Tellegen over het bericht "Financiële sector let te weinig op terrorisme, zegt DNB"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Tellegen asked the Finance and Justice Ministers about DNB's finding that the financial sector pays too little attention to terrorism financing, and about the effectiveness of the Wwft, its gaps and EU/international plans. The Minister said the effectiveness of the measures cannot be quantified, acknowledged DNB's concerns, pointed to ongoing supervision, the FEC project and EU/FATF discussions, but gave no firm new legislative commitments.
Because it concerns sensitive information, this information will probably not be made publicly available.
Omdat het gevoelige informatie betreft, zal deze informatie waarschijnlijk niet publiek ter beschikking worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Monasch over de ondoorzichtige kostenstructuur die banken hanteren bij valutatransacties voor het MKB

MPs Nijboer and Monasch asked the Finance Minister whether banks' cost structures for foreign currency transactions for SMEs are opaque and whether margins reach hundreds of percent. The minister answered that banks say they are transparent and charge fair prices, that the minister has no view of their margins, and that SME clients should compare offers across providers.
I have no insight into the profit margins of banks on foreign currency transactions for SMEs.
Ik heb geen zicht op de winstmarges van banken op valutatransacties voor het MKB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat banken niets willen doen om verkeerde overboekingen te voorkomen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that banks refuse to act on wrong transfers caused by incorrect IBAN entry and do no name-number checks. The minister answered that customers bear primary responsibility for checking IBANs, banks must help recover misdirected funds (about 80% recovered), and an industry study is planned with the Consumentenbond continuing talks.
If a transfer nevertheless goes to a different number than the customer intended, I am of the view that banks must assist their customers in recovering the amount concerned.
Indien het toch een overboeking plaatsvindt naar een ander nummer dan de klant beoogde, dan ben ik van mening dat banken hun klanten moeten bijstaan bij het terughalen van het betrokken bedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Drama’s na IBAN-fout onopgelost”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about erroneous IBAN transfers, agreements with the Betaalvereniging and Consumentenbond, possible remedies, the number of misdirected transfers and the recovery problems, the charity-number waiver and remaining SEPA/IBAN issues. The minister said talks with the Consumentenbond have not yet produced satisfactory results, that the Betaalvereniging will inventory the problem from 1 January, and that the recovery procedure returns over 80% of misdirected payments, while committing only to monitoring and to support DNB's approach on the charity waiver.
The Betaalvereniging has committed to inventorying this from 1 January.
De Betaalvereniging heeft toegezegd om vanaf 1 januari a.s. dit te inventariseren.

Vragen van de leden Nijboer (PvdA) en Koolmees (D66) aan de Minister van Financiën over rentemiddeling waardoor hypotheekbezitters kunnen profiteren van een lagere hypotheekrente (ingezonden 15 juni 2015).

MPs Nijboer and Koolmees asked the Finance Minister about interest averaging for mortgage holders, whether most banks offer it, and whether he would discuss it with the banking sector and explain how early-repayment penalties are calculated. The minister's follow-up answer says the fiscal obstacles have been removed and he has sent letters to the Dutch Banking Association and the insurers' association asking them to offer interest averaging.
Meanwhile the fiscal-technical obstacles to offering interest averaging have been removed, and I have sent a letter to the Dutch Banking Association and the Association of Insurers.
Inmiddels zijn de fiscaaltechnische belemmeringen bij het aanbieden van rentemiddeling weggenomen en heb ik de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken en het Verbond van Verzekeraars een brief gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht ‘Nederland blokkeerde belastingherzieningen’

Senator-level MP Merkies (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Netherlands systematically blocked EU tax reforms on business tax benefits such as the innovation box, and why. The State Secretary denied chairing or steering the Code of Conduct group, explained the modified nexus approach compromise and the Dutch aim of keeping the box open to SMEs, and said the 2010 tax-ruling exchange was only a temporary study reservation later withdrawn.
The Code of Conduct group discussed patent and innovation boxes within the EU on several occasions.
Er is in de Gedragscodegroep een aantal keren gesproken over patent- en innovatieboxen binnen de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over zijn uitspraak dat hij voortaan wel alle documenten aan de Kamer zal sturen, als daarom gevraagd wordt

Omtzigt asks Finance Minister Dijsselbloem whether he will send Parliament all documents requested by MPs, citing Article 68 of the Constitution, and asks which documents were withheld, including Eurowob, NS remuneration and Commission coco correspondence. The minister affirms the Article 68 framework, says all necessary information is provided unless state interests oppose it, declines to compile a list or reconsider past decisions, and points to earlier answers and the NS annual report.
For that reason I provide all information necessary to enable you to perform that function, unless the interest of the State opposes it.
Om die reden verstrek ik alle inlichtingen die nodig zijn om u die functie te kunnen laten vervullen, tenzij het belang van de Staat zich daartegen verzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over witwasdossiers die blijven liggen bij de Financial Intelligence Unit

Two PvdA MPs asked why suspicious-transaction reports from the Financial Intelligence Unit seem to go unused in money-laundering cases, and whether the number of prosecutor requests has fallen. The minister answered that such reports are useful intelligence but are not separately tracked in criminal files, that cooperation and new registration agreements are being improved, and that money laundering is prosecuted alongside confiscation.
The Public Prosecution Service does not record on the basis of what type of information a criminal case was started.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) registreert niet op grond van welke soort informatie een strafzaak is gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees, Omtzigt en Bashir over de informatie over de bonus van de voorzitter van de Raad van Bestuur van NS

MPs Koolmees, Omtzigt and Bashir asked the Finance Minister whether NS had emailed the ministry in April 2015 that its board received a 17.5% bonus, and why the ministry only checked the status of the bonuses on 17 June. Minister Dijsselbloem confirmed the April email, said agreement on the CEO bonus existed but payment could not occur until the CFO salary compensation was agreed on 30 May, and pointed to previously public documents for the communication request.
It is correct that NS sent an email on 14 April about a possible communication line on the variable pay awarded to NS's statutory board.
Het klopt dat NS op 14 april een e-mail heeft gestuurd over een eventuele communicatielijn over de toegekende variabele beloning van de statutaire directie van NS.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert en Geurts over de decharge die de aandeelhouder van de NS verleende op 4 maart 2015 tijdens de ALV, ondanks het feit dat toen al duidelijk was dat NS in 2014 de Spoorw

MPs Omtzigt, Van Helvert and Geurts asked why the shareholder granted discharge to NS management on 4 March 2015 although an ACM finding of a Railway Act breach was already foreseeable, and about the handling of the Veolia tender case, remuneration reports and bonuses. The minister answers that ministries were informed step by step, that NS did not yet know the ACM decision date on 4 March, that discharge covers only facts known at that time, and that remuneration information is publicly available in the annual reports.

Moreover, the shareholder grants discharge to the directors only for what the shareholder knew at that moment, and it does not amount to approval of the conduct for which the legal entity remains responsible.

Overigens geeft de aandeelhouder alleen decharge aan de bestuurders voor wat de aandeelhouder op dat moment (moment decharge) bekend is en betreft het hier geen goedkeuring van de gedragingen waarvoor de rechtspersoon verantwoordelijk is en blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies naar aanleiding van het bericht “Bank had geen zicht op klant met ‘verhoogd risicoprofiel’”

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that ABN AMRO Dubai lacked insight into client wealth, allegedly systematic failures, PEP clients, and whether the DNB fine decision would be published. The minister acknowledged rule breaches and blank signed forms for three clients but found no concrete signs of systematic misconduct, and said DNB cannot publish the fine decision due to confidentiality, with publication to be addressed through the EU fourth anti-money-laundering directive by June 2017.
Due to a confidentiality obligation regarding supervisory information, DNB cannot make the fine decision known to anyone other than, in this case, ABN AMRO.
Vanwege een geheimhoudingsplicht ten aanzien van toezichthoudersinformatie kan DNB het boetebesluit niet kenbaar maken aan anderen dan, in dit geval, ABN AMRO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Merkies naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Vivat verzekeringen krijgt mogelijk junkstatus’

MPs Ronnes and Merkies asked the Finance Minister about credit rating agency S&P suspending Vivat's rating after its takeover by Anbang, including effects on solvency, DNB's access to information, the Dutch management's influence, and continuity. The minister answered that the rating suspension does not directly affect solvency, that DNB granted the takeover approval with full information, that governance is a matter for the company and shareholder, and that the EUR 1.35 billion capital injection secures stability.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Aukje de Vries over het artikel “Eumedion vreest uitbuiting kleine aandeelhouders”

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Aukje de Vries asked whether the government sees risks in the concentration of control by majority shareholders at Dutch listed companies and whether minority shareholders should be better protected, following an Eumedion position paper. The minister disputes the doubling figure, finds it impossible to judge whether control has concentrated, sees existing Dutch company and securities law as adequate, and is cautious about new procedural rules while committing to consider the position paper and to evaluate the Wet bestuur en toezicht in 2016.

Dutch company law aims both to give entrepreneurs a legal infrastructure enabling them to fully pursue their activities and to give those involved in the company, including shareholders and creditors, sufficient protection against abuse of power.

Het Nederlandse vennootschapsrecht strekt er enerzijds toe om ondernemers een juridische infrastructuur te bieden die hen in staat stelt hun activiteiten ten volle te ontplooien en anderzijds om de bij de vennootschap betrokkenen, waaronder aandeelhouders en crediteuren, voldoende bescherming te bieden tegen (machts)misbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht “Nieuwe druk op KLM”

An MP from the CDA asks ministers whether Air France-KLM plans to absorb Transavia and whether this breaches earlier commitments on KLM's position. The government answers that talks are ongoing, that earlier agreements were reaffirmed and are expected to be honoured, and that a transfer of Transavia France is not harmful to Schiphol network quality.
No conclusion can yet be given on changes to the governance structure of Transavia Netherlands, because these talks are still ongoing.
Over wijzigingen in de governancestructuur van Transavia Nederland is nog geen uitsluitsel te geven, omdat deze gesprekken nog lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries inzake Franse verhuizing Transavia

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked whether Transavia Nederland would sell its 40% stake in Transavia France and whether governance changes would weaken KLM's independence and Schiphol's hub role. The government answered that talks between the companies are ongoing, that no formal Dutch or French government role exists, and that it stressed KLM's independent position and Schiphol's network quality.
No definitive answer can yet be given on changes to Transavia Nederland's governance structure, because these talks are still ongoing.
Over wijzigingen in de governancestructuur van Transavia Nederland is nog geen uitsluitsel te geven, omdat deze gesprekken nog lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Mei Li Vos over de artikelen ‘Ce que veut faire Air France-KLM avec ses deux Transavia (La Tribune, 4 november 2015) en ‘Strijd om Transavia’

Two MPs asked the government about reported plans to merge or restructure the governance of Transavia Holland and Transavia France within Air France-KLM, and whether this threatens KLM and Schiphol's network. The government confirmed talks are ongoing, said Transavia France does not fly from Schiphol, stressed the importance of KLM and Schiphol's network, and said it raised concerns with Air France-KLM, without committing to a concrete binding step.
As for possible changes in the governance structure of Transavia Netherlands, no definitive answer can yet be given, because for this airline the talks are still ongoing.
Wat betreft mogelijke wijzigingen in de governancestructuur van Transavia Nederland is nog geen uitsluitsel te geven, omdat wat deze luchtvaartmaatschappij betreft de gesprekken nog lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes c.s. over de inhoud van de prospectus voor beursgang ABN AMRO

MPs from several parties asked the Finance Minister whether the ABN AMRO prospectus for its stock market listing shows share-linked bonuses that conflict with earlier assurances and the Merkies/Nijboer amendment, and about conflicts of interest of two board members. The minister answered that identified staff may receive variable pay in non-cash form, that the top 7 board members and 25 senior managers are barred from variable pay while the state holds a stake, that the amendment is complied with, and that the bonus decisions rest with ABN AMRO itself.
ABN AMRO as a company itself bears responsibility for drawing up a variable pay scheme within the legal framework.
ABN AMRO heeft als vennootschap zelf de verantwoordelijkheid om binnen het wettelijke kader een variabele beloningsregeling op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de toegenomen volatiliteit op financiële markten en de risico’s voor de financiële stabiliteit

An MP asked the Finance Minister about rising market volatility, financial stability risks from China, US monetary tightening, shadow banks and investment funds, interbank exposures and Dutch problem loans. The minister answered that Dutch bank problem loans are low (2.9%), that DNB is studying shadow banks with a publication due by early next year, and that supervisors have existing tools for interbank exposures and problem-loan resolution.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het artikel “AFM en DNB beletten innovatie in de financiële sector”

Opposition MP Aukje de Vries (VVD) asks whether the AFM and DNB impose extra conditions on Dutch financial firms beyond EU and Dutch rules, creating an uneven playing field for crowdfunding, investment firms and payment providers. Minister Dijsselbloem answers that supervisors may attach conditions to licences where justified and proportionate, notes ongoing crowdfunding rule changes and a planned relaxation of investment limits, and states he sees no unjustified distortion of the level playing field.
I have no indications that the AFM and DNB go further in these areas than strictly necessary and I therefore see no distortion of the level playing field.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de AFM en DNB op deze terreinen verder gaan dan strikt noodzakelijk en zie dan ook geen verstoring van het gelijke speelveld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grashoff en Voortman inzake het bieden van premiekorting in ruil voor privédata door verzekeraar Achmea

MPs Grashoff and Voortman asked ministers whether insurer Achmea may offer premium discounts in exchange for personal behavioural data, and how data use, consent, sanctions and societal effects would be policed. The government answered that such data use is permitted only within the Wbp framework and purpose limitation, that the Cbp supervises compliance, and that insurers must inform customers of privacy risks, while acknowledging possible societal effects.
It is up to the Cbp to assess whether the Wbp is being complied with.
Het is aan het Cbp om te beoordelen of de Wbp wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht «Commissarissen zijn grote bemoeienis Dijsselbloem zat»

An MP asks the Finance Minister about reports that supervisory board members of state holdings resent the state's active shareholder role, and about related conflicts, the board's role, appointments and aviation expertise at Schiphol. The minister denies any real conflict, says the state's active shareholding is intended and that boards must weigh public interest, and gives general answers on appointments without giving detailed case figures.
We remain in discussion about how the cooperation with the supervisory boards is shaped.
Over de vormgeving van de samenwerking met de RvC's blijven we in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van 't Wout en Aukje de Vries over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over aanhoudende problemen bij EU-aanbesteden

MPs Van 't Wout and Aukje de Vries asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Finance about the European Court of Auditors' report on persistent EU public procurement problems, including errors in about 40% of audited projects and possible suspension of payments. The minister answered that the government shares the recommendations, pushes for stricter Commission enforcement, notes new EU procurement directives and REFIT simplification efforts, and is still exploring whether regional and local procurement rules can be excluded for EFRO and ESF projects.

The cabinet shares the recommendations of the European Court of Auditors and believes the European Commission should strictly and uniformly supervise compliance by member state authorities when spending EU funds.

Het kabinet deelt genoemde aanbevelingen van de Europese Rekenkamer en is van mening dat de Europese Commissie bij besteding van EU fondsen op strikte en uniforme wijze moet toezien op naleving door autoriteiten in lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Mei Li Vos over het artikel “Air France-KLM topman komt Franse staat tegemoet”

MPs Monasch and Mei Li Vos asked whether Air France-KLM's leadership was backing away from reorganisation plans, whether this shifts losses onto KLM, and whether the Dutch state should take a larger shareholding. The government denies reversing the plans, says it is seeking alternative cost reductions, and declines to take up a larger stake for now while maintaining contact with French counterparts.
Should the Dutch state also acquire a stake at least equal to the French stake in Air France-KLM to strengthen the position of Dutch interests within the holding?
Vraag 7 Zou de Nederlandse staat ook een aandeel gelijk aan tenminste het Franse aandeel moeten krijgen in Air France-KLM om de positie van de Nederlandse belangen binnen de holding te versterken?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Merkies over de besteding van een IMF-lening aan Oekraïne

MPs Van Bommel and Merkies asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers whether IMF loan money to Ukraine was diverted to offshore accounts linked to oligarch Kolomoisky, and sought investigation of beneficial owners and auditor selection. The ministers answered that Dutch funds are pooled and untraceable, that the IMF found no irregularities in the central bank's use of funds, and that since the IMF already supervises its funds no further investigation is needed.
Since it is standard policy that the IMF monitors the use of its public funds and this has recently occurred in the case of Ukraine, we see no need to advocate further investigation.

Aangezien het standaard beleid is dat het IMF de besteding van haar publieke middelen controleert en dit recent is gebeurd in het geval van Oekraïne, zien wij geen noodzaak om voor nader onderzoek te pleiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het bericht «Voormalig NS-topman Huges spant kort geding aan om vergoeding»

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports that former NS chief Huges sued for a large severance payment, whether his 2014 variable pay was reclaimed, and how NS governance and disclosure of the settlement work. The minister answered that the matter was settled out of court, the variable pay was repaid as part of the settlement, the shareholder discharge was granted, and the settlement will appear in the 2015 annual report, with the settlement document made available for confidential inspection.
I have made the settlement agreement itself available for confidential inspection.
De vaststellingsovereenkomst zelf heb ik ter vertrouwelijke inzage gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Jan Vos over fossiele reserves die mogelijk zullen worden afgeschreven

MPs Nijboer and Jan Vos asked the Finance and Infrastructure and Environment ministers about 'stranded assets' from fossil fuel reserves, the Citigroup valuation, DNB and FSB work on climate risk, annual reporting of climate risk and Chevron dividends. The government answered that a Paris agreement's effects are premature to judge, that the carbon bubble concept is still debated, and promised to inform parliament on FSB results and to ask DNB for a broad climate-risk analysis by early next year.

During the AFB of 1 October it was also promised that DNB will be asked to look broadly at the risks of climate change for the financial sector in light of a recent speech by Mark Carney and the FSB's plans.

is tevens toegezegd dat DNB verzocht zal worden om in het licht van een recente speech van Mark Carney 5 en de plannen van de FSB, in brede zin te kijken naar de risico’s van klimaatverandering voor de financiële sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de beslissing van Deloitte om niet van account te wisselen

The MP Nijboer asked the Minister of Finance why Deloitte chose not to rotate its external auditor after more than ten years, and whether the selection committee, including the CFO and head of Finance, was independent enough. The Minister called the reported decision a poor fit with sector integrity goals, noted that Deloitte reversed it and will start a new selection, and pointed to forthcoming statutory safeguards such as a mandatory internal supervisory body, rotation rules and transparency on partner remuneration.
The AFM will report on compliance and enforce the statutory requirements.
De AFM zal over de naleving rapporteren en op de wettelijke eisen handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over de rol van banken bij faillissementen

MPs Nijboer and Recourt asked the Ministers of Finance and Justice about banks' role in the Imtech bankruptcy, including criticised information provision, pre-pack procedures, account blocking and protection of stakeholders. The Minister of Justice answered in general terms, declining to assess the specific case, and pointed to the Wet continuïteit ondernemingen I and related faillissementsrecht reforms as remedies.
To avoid misunderstanding, I note that in answering these questions I make no findings about the factual course of events surrounding the Imtech bankruptcy.

Ter voorkoming van misverstanden merk ik op dat ik bij de beantwoording van de hier aan de orde zijnde vragen geen vaststellingen doe over de feitelijke gang van zaken rond het faillissement van Imtech.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Albert de Vries over het AFM-onderzoek naar de dienstverlening van hypotheekaanbieders bij betalingsproblemen met hypotheken

MPs Nijboer and Albert de Vries asked about an AFM study finding that mortgage lenders must improve their service to borrowers with payment problems, including which lenders must improve, the safeguarding of borrower interests and fees, and the timing of a follow-up study. The minister answered that most lenders still need improvements, the AFM will monitor progress and decide on follow-up research, and the EU mortgage directive will limit charges to actual damages.
Which lender falls into which category is not disclosed because this is supervisory-confidential information.
Welke aanbieder in welke categorie valt wordt niet bekend gemaakt omdat dit toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de mogelijke betrokkenheid van Nederlandse banken bij valutafraude

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch banks are implicated in currency fraud, whether regulators are investigating, whether staff were dismissed or prosecuted, and what the capital risks and progress on reforms are. The minister answered that he lacks further information on settlements, that AFM and DNB are investigating and will report this year, that dismissals are a matter for firms, that benchmark manipulation is now prohibited and prosecutable, and that he sees no capital risk.
The AFM and DNB are currently investigating the involvement of Dutch financial institutions in currency trading and benchmarks; this investigation is expected to be completed this year.
De AFM en DNB doen op dit moment onderzoek naar betrokkenheid van Nederlandse financiële instellingen bij valutahandel en -benchmarks; dit onderzoek zal naar verwachting dit jaar worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht “Bankieren duurder voor kwetsbaren”

Karabulut (SP) asked the ministers of Finance and Social Affairs about ABN AMRO raising bank tariffs for professional debt administrators (bewindvoerders) managing accounts of vulnerable people, and whether the government would intervene. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that tariffs are a matter for banks themselves, that the government sees no reason for measures despite state shareholding, and that dialogue between banks and administrators is advisable.
That said, setting tariffs is a matter for which banks themselves are responsible.
Vooropgesteld moet echter worden dat de tariefstelling bij banken een aangelegenheid is waarvoor de banken zelf verantwoordelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over woekerpolissen

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about the 2011 'best of class' commitment on follow-up policy for woekerpolissen, Kifid ombudsman appointment, loss estimates, TER cost disclosure, a 2014 bonus at Nationale Nederlanden, and insurers' out-of-court settlements. The minister answered that the AFM monitors activation of policyholders, that Parliament will be consulted on the ombudsman appointment, that total damages cannot be determined, that TER rules apply, and that the AFM will report on settlements at end October.
I will consult the House of Representatives beforehand.
Ik zal hieraan voorafgaand de Tweede Kamer raadplegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht “EU Squeezed $7.8 Billion Greek Bridge Loan Via ESM Loophole”

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether a Bloomberg-reported EFSM bridge loan to Greece was in substance an ESM loan routed around ESM unanimity and information rules. The minister replied that the ESM lent to the European Commission as part of its investment policy, that Greece was not a party, that no loophole exists and the information protocol was followed.
The ESM provided a loan to the European Commission, thus had a claim on the Commission, and is otherwise not a party to the purpose the Commission chooses for the borrowed money.
Het ESM heeft een lening verstrekt aan de Europese Commissie, had dus een vordering op de Commissie en is verder geen partij bij de bestemming die de Europese Commissie kiest voor het geleende geld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat de bestuursvoorzitter van Vivat anderhalve maand na de overname door Anbang vertrekt

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about the departure of Vivat's CEO shortly after the takeover by Anbang, including effects on governance, policyholders, DNB approval and the capital injection. The minister answered that Vivat's governance is now a matter for the company, its supervisory board and the shareholder, that DNB approved the takeover under confidentiality rules, and that the EUR 1.35 billion capital injection is due by 26 October 2015 with DNB enforcement tools available if conditions are not met.
DNB is bound by a statutory duty of confidentiality under article 1:89 of the Financial Supervision Act.
DNB heeft op grond van artikel 1:89 van de Wet op het financieel toezicht een geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over het plotselinge vertrek van de CEO van Vivat na de overname door Anbang

Christian Democrat MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about the sudden departure of VIVAT's CEO after the Anbang takeover, including DNB's conditions, debt repayment, capital injection, and shareholder obligations. The minister gave a largely evasive reply, citing supervisory confidentiality, while confirming Anbang's tax payment and committing only to continued contact and a new chair vetted by DNB.
Information about the content of a declaration of no objection is confidential supervisory information and therefore not public.
Informatie over de inhoud van een verklaring van geen bezwaar is toezichtvertrouwelijk en daarmee niet publiek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Aukje de Vries over de verplichte roulatie van accountants en een mogelijke tegenstrijdigheid tussen de Europese Verordening EU/537/2014 en het wetsvoorstel Wijzigingswet financ

Omtzigt and Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister whether the Dutch Wijzigingswet financiële markten 2016 lacks transitional rules for audit firm rotation that the EU Regulation 537/2014 provides, and whether this creates a conflict with EU law and what consequences follow. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the EU Regulation applies directly, the Dutch rotation provision will not enter into force by royal decree, the AFM has a limited extension power in exceptional cases, and a separate letter will be sent to the House.

By royal decree it will be determined that article 23, part c, of the Wta, as well as the amendment to it in the Wijzigingswet Financiële Markten 2016, will not enter into force, so that for office rotation only the EU Regulation provisions apply.
Door middel van een koninklijk besluit zal worden bepaald dat artikel 23, onderdeel c, van de Wta, evenals de wijziging daarop in de Wijzigingswet Financiële Markten 2016, niet in werking zal treden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Merkies over de toename van de kloof tussen arm en rijk in Amsterdam

MPs Karabulut and Merkies asked the ministers about a report showing rising rich-poor segregation in Amsterdam, the role of the state, housing liberalisation and possible action with the municipality. Minister Asscher answered that Amsterdam ranks relatively low on segregation among the 13 cities studied, that government focuses on equal opportunities in education and the labour market, and that the municipality shares responsibility for affordable housing.

Moreover, a further study into the spatial distribution and mixing of different groups in the Netherlands is currently being carried out on behalf of the Minister for Housing and Central Government Reform.
Overigens wordt momenteel, in opdracht van de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst, een nader onderzoek uitgevoerd naar de ruimtelijke spreiding en menging van verschillende groepen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht "Toezichthouder houdt zich niet aan salarisnorm"

The MP Ronnes (CDA) asked the Minister of Finance why a newly appointed AFM supervisor was given a salary above the WNT (Balkenende) norm, whether this was justified, and whether such deviations will be avoided in future. The minister answered that the WNT allows individual exceptions and that the unique combination of knowledge, experience and labour market conditions justified one here, referring to the Staatscourant publication, while stating that the aim is to stay within the norms.
In this specific case, the unique combination of knowledge, experience and the labour market situation was reason to make an exception.
In dit specifieke geval, vormde de unieke combinatie van kennis, ervaring en de arbeidmarktsituatie reden om een uitzondering te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over uitzondering WNT bij salaris AFM-bestuurslid de Vries

An MP asked why the minister used the WNT individual exception to set a higher salary for the new AFM board member Femke de Vries, and how the decision was made and communicated. The minister answered that the unique combination of knowledge, experience and labour-market conditions justified the exception, that the decision was published in the Staatscourant, and that the salary would be reduced to a non-excessive level, while declining to disclose the content of candidate negotiations.
The content of the discussions with a candidate is not public.
De inhoud van de gesprekken met een kandidaat zijn niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het nieuws dat de NS bezwaar maakt tegen Overijsselse lijnen

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary whether NS's formal objection to a Syntus regional rail concession could delay the 2017 start, why NS would object to lines it also bid for, and how high-frequency service on Enschede-Almelo would be achieved. The State Secretary answered that the province is responsible for the regional concession, that all parties should seek a swift solution, that the high-frequency programme does not cover Enschede-Almelo, and that she would intervene if no agreement is reached.
If no agreement is reached, they can turn to me. If necessary I will ensure that a decision is made.
Indien geen overeenstemming wordt bereikt, dan kunnen zij zich tot mij wenden. Als het nodig is zal ik ervoor zorgen dat er een besluit komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over beweerdelijk belemmeren van financiële start-ups door de Autoriteit Financiële Markten

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the AFM caps start-up financial firms at six staff, on what legal basis and rationale, and whether it will reconsider such limits to allow faster growth and competition. The minister denied any formal cap, explained that a relaxed suitability test applies to firms of up to six persons, and said growth is not blocked and the AFM will keep the balance with competition in view.
No, the Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM) of course does not set a minimum or maximum requirement on the size of a start-up firm.
Nee, de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) stelt uiteraard geen minimum- of maximumeis aan de omvang van een startende onderneming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Vermeij over het artikel «Pension Funds Can Only Guess at Private Equity’s Cost»

MPs Nijboer and Vermeij asked the Finance Minister and the Social Affairs State Secretary about pension fund private equity costs, including whether fees and profit-sharing are lawful and whether pension funds can see their costs. The government answered that fee levels are negotiated contractually, that it cannot assess whether the costs are lawful, that existing reporting rules are sufficient for now, and that it will push for more cost transparency internationally through the AIFMD evaluation.

It is not clear to the cabinet what the pension funds named in the article agreed with the private equity funds concerning the allocation, level and reporting of the various costs, and how this relates to the costs actually charged.

Het is voor het kabinet niet inzichtelijk wat de onderzochte pensioenfondsen die in het artikel worden genoemd met de betreffende private equityfondsen hebben afgesproken over de allocatie, hoogte en rapportage van de verschillende kosten en hoe dit zich verhoudt tot de daadwerkelijk in rekening gebrachte kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat deurwaarders ziedend zijn over het daltarief van het CJIB

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of Finance about bailiffs' anger over falling CJIB fee rates, the price-setting of the CJIB tender, and possible concurrence distortion and fee cuts affecting bailiffs' finances. The government answered that fee structures changed little since 2012, defended the tender as normal market-based price setting within legal frameworks, and declined to answer many questions because the tender is subject to pending court proceedings.
Since these questions are directly related to matters that are before the court, I cannot answer these questions substantively at this time.
Aangezien dit direct verband houdt met de vraagstukken die onder de rechter zijn, kan ik deze vraag op dit moment niet inhoudelijk beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht “Huizenbezitters betalen te veel rente voor hun spaarhypotheek"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked whether banks charging a risk surcharge on savings mortgages despite substantial savings balances overcharge homeowners, whether banks are transparent about this, and whether the AFM has investigated. The minister replied that the effect depends on savings balance and tax rate, that consumer information rules apply, and that the AFM has not studied risk surcharges structurally but has challenged a few providers on signals and will continue to hold providers to account where needed.
The AFM will also hold mortgage providers to account on this in the future, where necessary.
De AFM zal hypotheekverstrekkers hier – waar nodig – ook in de toekomst op aanspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht "NS wil corrupt Qbuzz aan Fransen verkopen"

MP Hoogland asked whether NS is secretly selling its bus subsidiary Qbuzz to the French railways in exchange for shares in Thalys, whether other units like Abellio are for sale, how this serves Dutch travellers, and whether it is linked to the Limburg tender irregularities. The Minister of Finance answered that NS is still in a strategic reorientation of its regional activities, that talks with parties are exploratory, that the government will not anticipate the outcome, and that the analysis and government view on NS's positioning will be sent to Parliament this autumn.
Until then, I do not consider it opportune or in the interest of NS and the state as shareholder of NS to anticipate the outcomes of the strategic reorientation
Tot die tijd acht ik het niet opportuun en niet in het belang van NS en de staat als aandeelhouder van NS om vooruit te lopen op de uitkomsten van de strategische heroriëntatie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het artikel “Laat kleine onderlinge verzekeraar niet verdwijnen”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a newspaper report that small mutual insurers face unsustainable regulation under Solvency II and Basic, and about the consequences for their survival and new entry. The minister acknowledged cost burdens, described the simplifications for small insurers, and explained why full reinsurance does not qualify for exemption while promising to inform parliament about the exemption regulation.
In my view, applying all requirements of Solvency II to all insurers can indeed be considered disproportionate and burdensome.
Naar mijn oordeel kan toepassing van alle eisen uit de richtlijn solvabiliteit II op alle verzekeraars inderdaad als niet proportioneel en knellend worden beschouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Merkies over de mogelijke verkoop van QBuzz door de Nederlandse Spoorwegen

MPs Smaling and Merkies asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about the NS plan to sell bus company Qbuzz, its reasons, effects on staff and the HTM joint venture, and whether a Dutch bus firm should go to a foreign state company.
