Minister Dijsselbloem replied that NS's strategic reorientation must finish first, so no comment on the sale is possible yet, while information is exchanged and the government will send an analysis this autumn.
I consider it important that this reorientation is first completed before decisions are taken.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat deze heroriëntatie eerst wordt afgerond alvorens er besluiten worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht «NS haalt huisadvocaat De Brauw van ontslagzaken»

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether NS shareholders were consulted when NS removed law firm De Brauw from the disciplinary (ontslag) cases and whether De Brauw should continue its investigation into misconduct at NS. The minister said consultation with the shareholder took place, defended De Brauw's use as normal, and pointed to a second opinion by Brenninkmeijer and an Orde van Advocaten review as safeguards.
Although I see no reason to question the integrity and critical attitude of De Brauw, I have announced that a second opinion on De Brauw's investigation will be carried out by Mr Alex Brenninkmeijer.

Hoewel ik geen aanleiding zie om de integriteit en de kritische houding van De Brauw in twijfel te trekken, heb ik aangekondigd een second opinion op het onderzoek van De Brauw uit te laten voeren door de heer Alex Brenninkmeijer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt naar aanleiding van het bericht “Verdere selectie van zakenbanken voor de voorgenomen beursintroductie van ABN AMRO”

MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about the selection of underwriting banks for the planned ABN AMRO IPO, including fees, other remuneration, share allocation and whether banks can earn money from the deal. The minister answered that NLFI runs the selection, that a base fee is zero with capped expenses and a discretionary fee up to 4.5 million euro, and that share allocation follows set criteria with safeguards against improper practices.
The contract terms I will make available for confidential inspection.
De contractvoorwaarden zal ik vertrouwelijk ter inzage beschikbaar stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haersma Buma en Omtzigt over het aftreden van de Griekse premier

Two CDA MPs asked whether the cabinet knew in advance of the Greek prime minister's planned resignation and snap elections, what this means for implementing the Greek bailout, and whether an Eurogroup meeting would be convened. The government answered that it was not informed beforehand, that calling elections is a sovereign Greek decision not in conflict with the agreement, that an interim government cannot take binding decisions, and that the next Eurogroup meeting is on 12 September.
A decision to hold early elections is a sovereign decision of Greece.
Een besluit tot vervroegde verkiezingen is een soeverein besluit van Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de rol van Nederland in het faciliteren van belastingontwijking vanuit Griekenland

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Netherlands facilitates tax avoidance from Greece through letterbox companies, and about Greek tax collection, the Lagarde list, and the troika's negotiating conduct. The minister denied that Dutch letterbox firms facilitate avoidance, refused to give company-specific or nationality-based information citing tax confidentiality, and gave general answers on Greek reforms and the bailout process.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot provide information on individual taxpayers.
Ik kan op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen geen informatie geven over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over de verkoop van Vivat (Reaal) aan Anbang

MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister why DNB blocked Anbang's takeover of Nationale Nederlanden, whether approvals elsewhere were delayed, how DNB views Anbang's European acquisitions, and how pension and customer data are protected after the Vivat sale. The minister declined to disclose DNB's assessment citing supervisory confidentiality, said Vivat Verzekeringen's sale was completed with DNB's no-objection statements, and pointed to existing supervision by DNB, AFM and CBP.
Information about the assessment of an application for a no-objection statement, if one had been submitted in that case, is supervisory-confidential.
Informatie over de beoordeling van een aanvraag van een verklaring van geen bezwaar, zo die in het genoemde geval zou zijn ingediend, is toezichtvertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het rapport 'Dutch Banks: Commitments and Progress' van de Eerlijke Bankwijzer

An MP asked the Finance Minister how the government responds to a report on Dutch banks' sustainability commitments, transparency gaps, and compliance with OECD guidelines. The minister answered that banks are largely meeting commitments, that transparency is being addressed through industry dialogue and IMVO covenants, and that the government mainly encourages rather than enforces.
Insofar as possible and necessary, I catalyse and facilitate these initiatives.
Voor zover mogelijk en nodig katalyseer en faciliteer ik deze initiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes naar aanleiding van publicatie over vermeende overtreding van regels rondom de beursgang van ABN Amro

MP Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about reports that a NLFI employee involved in the ABN Amro listing dined with a JP Morgan executive, whether rules were broken, what action was taken, and whether Dutch banks were passed over as global coordinators. The minister confirmed NLFI's chair accepted a dinner invitation during the selection process, saw no breach of law or listing rules, reviewed the matter with an explanation from the chair, and defended a non-discriminatory, quality-based bank selection that does not require restarting.
Following the publication, Mr Enthoven was asked to provide an explanation of the matters described in the publication.
Naar aanleiding van de publicatie is de heer Enthoven gevraagd om een toelichting te geven op de in de publicatie omschreven zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bashir over de extra aandeelhoudersvergadering van de NS

Two MPs (Omtzigt and Bashir) asked the Finance Minister about extra shareholder meetings of NS and whether the invitation and minutes would be shared, and whether any settlement agreement with CEO Huges would be made public. The minister confirmed the meetings, declined to share the minutes because of ongoing legal proceedings and possible harm to the state's legal position, and referred the settlement question to a prior answer.
Publication of the minutes could harm the legal position of the state.
Openbaarmaking van het verslag kan de juridische positie van de staat schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over toestemming voor een bonus aan de oud-topman van de NS

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister whether the former NS chief was authorised to receive a EUR 75,000 bonus, why the minister earlier said the bonus was taken without NS or supervisory board knowledge, whether further surprises can be expected in the dismissal procedure, and asks for all dismissal documents. The minister says a 17.5% variable pay was agreed in principle but only finalised as part of a package on 2 June, admits earlier information was not always correct, declines to release documents because of a pending kort geding, and promises only to inform the Chamber confidentially after the procedure.
To avoid harming NS's legal position, I cannot comply with your request.
Om de juridische positie van NS niet te schaden kan ik niet aan uw verzoek voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de uitbetaalde bonus van de voormalig topman van de NS en de uitspraken van de minister van Financien over deze zaak

CDA MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked the Finance Minister how NS top executive Huges's bonus was paid out before the supervisory board and shareholder had approved it, and about the minister's earlier statements on the matter. The minister confirmed the earlier statements, said the board and shareholder had not authorised the payment, and explained the timeline of the bonus and the executive's departure.
The supervisory board has informed me that the supervisory board did not authorise the payment.
De raad van commissarissen heeft mij gemeld dat de raad van commissarissen de uitbetaling niet heeft geautoriseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees en Van Veldhoven over het bericht "NS-topman had steun voor uitbetalen bonus"

MPs Koolmees and Van Veldhoven asked the Finance Minister about reports that the NS chief executive had support for paying his bonus, and about the timing of the 2014 bonus payment and communication. The Minister explains that the supervisory board and shareholder reached in-principle agreement on 17.5% variable pay for the CEO and CFO, that the payment in March was premature because the overall package and communication were not yet settled, and that he only learned of the payment in June, while criticising the CEO's instruction to HR as contrary to good corporate governance.
Furthermore, I find it remarkable that an NS official gave his HR director the instruction himself to pay out a reward due to him.
Daarnaast vind ik het opmerkelijk dat een functionaris van NS aan zijn personeelsdirecteur zelf de instructie geeft een aan hem toekomende beloning uit te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'OM hoeft Rabobank niet te vervolgen om Libor-fraude'

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether prosecutors could not pursue Rabobank staff in the LIBOR case because evidence gathering did not meet criminal procedure rules, and whether a new benchmark-manipulation offence would have enabled prosecution. The minister said the court's ruling in an individual case cannot be second-guessed, that prosecution of current staff was rightly dropped, that benchmark manipulation became punishable on 1 January 2015, and that the earlier lack of such an offence did not affect the outcome.
The cabinet cannot intervene in a judge's assessment in an individual case.
Het kabinet kan niet treden in het oordeel van een rechter in een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam over het niet vervolgen van Rabobankiers bij de Libor/Euribor-fraude

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked which Rabobank settlement transactions were agreed, whether the Dutch settlement shields staff from prosecution, and why the Libor/Euribor case led to no prosecution of current employees. The government answered that the non-prosecution decision was an independent OM decision confirmed in the settlement, refused to publish the Dutch settlement, and defended the approach as proportionate while acknowledging slow DNB action and FIOD evidence handling issues.
In the Dutch system a settlement agreement is not made public.
In het Nederlandse stelsel wordt een vaststellingsovereenkomst niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Koolmees over rentemiddeling waardoor hypotheekbezitters kunnen profiteren van een lagere hypotheekrente

MPs Nijboer and Koolmees asked whether banks should offer 'rentemiddeling' (averaging a fixed mortgage rate with market rates to spread the early-repayment penalty) so homeowners can benefit from lower rates, and whether the penalty calculation can be made transparent. The minister said six banks offer it, that it depends on individual circumstances, that he will ask the sector by letter to offer it, and that the penalty calculation will be further regulated under the Mortgage Credit Directive in 2016.
I will ask the sector, by letter, to offer rentemiddeling as an option, whereby in individual situations it must be considered whether rentemiddeling is in the customer's interest.
Ik zal de sector, middels een brief, verzoeken om rentemiddeling als optie aan te bieden, waarbij in individuele situaties moet worden bezien of rentemiddeling in het belang is van de klant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over beleggingen van verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen in de wapenhandel

MPs asked whether insurers and pension funds should stop investing in arms makers supplying controversial states, and about reported billions in such holdings, including APG's. The government answered that only cluster munitions are legally barred, that it promotes IMVO covenants, and that the banking and insurance sectors are pursuing sector-specific covenants.
For investments in cluster munitions there is a statutory ban; beyond that, there are no other binding legal restrictions on insurers and pension funds investing in companies.

Voor investeringen in clustermunitie geldt er een wettelijk verbod, verder zijn er geen andere dwingende wettelijke belemmeringen voor het investeren in bedrijven door verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Schut-Welkzijn en Ziengs over het bericht “Negen manieren om je als zzp-er goedkoper te verzekeren”

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the disability insurance market for self-employed workers offers enough cheaper 'adapted' policies, whether rules or advice obligations block them, and whether the 13-week registration deadline for voluntary insurance should be extended. Minister Asscher replied that many options exist, that no legal barriers are known, that the AFM sees room for better advice, and that extending the deadline is not favoured because of adverse selection, promising to return to the issue after the IBO zzp.
In the context of the IBO zzp and the Weyenberg motion, I will return to the insurability of the disability risk.
In het kader van het IBO zzp en de motie Weyenberg 3 , zal ik terugkomen op de verzekerbaarheid van het arbeidsongeschiktheidsrisico.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over banken die dienstverlening weigeren aan coffeeshops

MP Koolmees asked the Finance Minister whether banks still refuse payment services to coffeeshops without clear reasons, whether banks have adjusted their acceptance policies, and whether the minister will again negotiate with the Dutch Banking Association (NVB). The minister answered that banks assess each application individually, that the 2010 agreement with the NVB was reconfirmed, and that the NVB will publish information on the complaints procedure.
The NVB has reconfirmed the agreements made in 2010.
De NVB heeft de afspraken zoals gemaakt in 2010 zijn nogmaals herbevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Cegerek over dubieuze transacties van investeringsfonds Waterland

MPs Nijboer and Cegerek asked whether private equity fund Waterland extracted more cash from Attero than it invested, whether this weakened the firm's landfill aftercare provisions and ability to pay future remediation costs, and what it means for staff. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that excess distributions are not per se improper, pointed to existing private equity asset-stripping rules and corporate law, said aftercare reserves and financial guarantees remain legally required, and said Waterland describes Attero as financially healthy while the staff impact cannot be assessed.
Dutch company law provides that the profit of a private or public limited company belongs to the shareholders, and sets limits on distributability.
Het Nederlandse vennootschapsrecht bepaalt dat de winst van een besloten of naamloze vennootschap toekomt aan de aandeelhouders, en stelt grenzen aan uitkeerbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het kaalplukken van een afvalverwerker voor private equity

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister how the government views private equity firm Waterland extracting EUR 183 million in dividends from waste processor Attero, partly intended for landfill remediation, and what it will do to prevent asset stripping. The minister replied that the company's finances are not unhealthy, that dividend rules and the AIFM directive's anti-asset-stripping measures already apply, and that interest deduction limits were judged unwarranted for now.
I am aware of the reporting surrounding the takeover of Attero by Waterland.
Ik ken de berichtgeving rond de overname van Attero door Waterland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de naheffing

An MP asks the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers why correspondence with the European Commission about the EU budget levy (naheffing) is withheld, and demands the emails and a breakdown of payments per country. The government refuses to send the correspondence, claims diplomatic confidentiality and parliamentary information rules, provides a country-by-country payment table, and dodges the question about when the Prime Minister was first informed.
Are you willing to finally send the parliament the correspondence about the levy relating to the sixth supplementary budget 2014, as has been requested several times?
Bent u bereid alsnog de correspondentie over de naheffing, die betrekking heeft op de zesde aanvullende begroting 2014 aan de Kamer te doen toekomen, zoals meerdere keren gevraagd?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Afvalgigant kaalgeplukt’

MPs Van Veldhoven and Koolmees asked whether Attero's sale to Waterland drained 183 million euro, including 87 million earmarked for pre-aftercare, and whether closed landfills stay safely financed and provinces accept the cut. The Staatssecretaris confirms the 183 million figure from Waterland's statement, says prior provincial consent was not needed and was not sought, and says legal aftercare and capping guarantees are unchanged while Attero must report to the competent authority.
No prior consultation took place with the provinces of Drenthe, Limburg and Noord-Brabant on this matter.
Met de provincies Drenthe, Limburg en Noord-Brabant heeft hierover vooraf geen overleg plaats gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het beperkte inzicht van afschriften van betaalrekeningen

MP Nijboer asks the Finance Minister whether banks should guarantee free access to account statements for several years, given that some banks restrict online viewing of statements to 15 months and cause problems for tax and benefit claims. The minister answers that no rules require a minimum period, that the big banks offer 5 to 10 years of digital history, and that the Overstapservice evaluation will examine problems when switching banks.
For this reason I see no urgent need to engage in further discussion on this at the present time.
Ik zie om deze reden geen dringende noodzaak om hierover op dit moment nader in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over het onderzoek naar het reilen en zeilen van de NS

VVD MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries asked whether law firm De Brauw, which investigated irregularities in the NS Limburg tender while also advising NS on challenging the ACM's findings, has a conflict of interest, and whether an independent body should take over the investigation. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that he sees no reason to doubt De Brauw's integrity, but agreed with the supervisory board that a second opinion on the Limburg investigation will be commissioned and that another firm will investigate the other tenders NS or its subsidiaries bid for.

To avoid any appearance of partiality and to rule out any doubt about the soundness of the investigations, I have agreed with the NS supervisory board that a researcher will be asked to give a second opinion

Om elke schijn van partijdigheid te vermijden en iedere twijfel over de gedegenheid van de onderzoeken uit te sluiten, heb ik met de raad van commissarissen van de NS afgesproken dat een onderzoeker wordt gevraagd een second opinion te geven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Van der Linde en Anne Mulder over bericht “proef flexwerkershypotheek uitgebreid”

VVD MPs asked whether the perspective-statement pilot for flexworkers and self-employed mortgage applicants should be broadened and made permanent, and whether mortgage rules should change. The Minister replied that the pilot falls within existing rules (Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet), that current rules already allow tailored assessments, and that no regulatory change is planned.
The approach taken with the perspective statement falls within the current possibilities of the Temporary Regulation on Mortgage Credit.
De gevolgde werkwijze met de perspectiefverklaring valt binnen de huidige mogelijkheden van de Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Vliet over de raming versus realisatie van de maatregel “integrale vennootschapsbelastingplicht voor woningcorporaties”

An MP asks the Minister of Finance why the realised revenue of the integrated corporate tax liability for housing associations fell well below the 500 million euro projected in 2008, and what administrative and implementation costs and future prospects apply. The State Secretary explains that revenues were low due to the unforeseen use of a reinvestment reserve and property write-downs, implementation costs were broadly in line, and expected revenue will rise on recovery of the housing market.
When the integrated corporate tax liability for housing associations was introduced, the revenue from the integrated corporate tax liability for 2008 was projected at 500 million euros.
Bij de invoering van de integrale Vpb-plicht voor woningcorporaties is de opbrengst van de integrale vennootschapsbelastingplicht voor 2008 geraamd op 500 miljoen euro.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over diverse berichten over bedreigingen voor crowdfunding

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports of a proposed EU VAT burden on crowdfunding and a DNB ban on Kredietbank Nederland raising funds via crowdfunding. The minister said no such Commission proposal is known, only a VAT committee paper with no binding guidance, and that the ban applies under the Wft as Kredietbank lacks a bank licence, with a review of a possible exemption promised for Q4.
As previously promised, I will inform your House in the fourth quarter in more detail on this point, among others.
Zoals eerder toegezegd, zal ik uw Kamer in het vierde kwartaal nader informeren over onder meer dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Mei Li Vos, Visser en Aukje de Vries over de situatie bij Air France-KLM

MPs from the PvdA and VVD asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about the French state's increase of its stake in Air France-KLM, its double voting rights, possible break-up or sale of KLM, governance changes and Qatar landing rights. The minister replied that the French stake increase is not a fundamental shift, no agreement exists on joint share purchases, no break-up is on the agenda, and the reports of a 'plan B' sale are unsubstantiated speculation.
I have no indication whatsoever that such a plan B is on the agenda.
Ik heb geen enkele indicatie dat een dergelijk plan B aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht "Kleine verzekeraars vechten om voortbestaan"

An MP asked the Finance Minister about small insurers struggling to survive, including their cost burden, exits from the market, and whether supervision favours consolidation. The minister answered that Solvency II includes proportionate easing for small insurers, that exits are partly due to consolidation and portfolio transfers, and that small insurers remain valuable in a competitive market.
To limit supervisory costs as much as possible, easings have been introduced in the supervisory regime for small insurers, without endangering the enforcement of good supervision.

Teneinde de toezichtkosten zo veel mogelijk te beperken, zijn versoepelingen aangebracht in het toezichtregime voor kleine verzekeraars, overigens zonder de handhaving van goed toezicht in gevaar te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dijkgraaf over verminderde douanecontrole, beveiliging en patrouilles op de Waddenzee en op de Westerschelde

Two SGP MPs asked whether reduced customs, marechaussee and police patrols on the Wadden Sea and Western Scheldt weaken interdiction of drugs and smuggling, and whether RHIB boats and port checks are adequate. The government replied that patrols are not being halted but shifted to intelligence-led, faster-response boats, that port controls continue 24/7, and that it sees no need for continuous patrols; it did not register controls or tips in a way that allows measuring their results.
This is not correct. Checks continue unchanged in the Zeeland ports of Terneuzen and Vlissingen.
Dit is niet juist. In de Zeeuwse havens Terneuzen en Vlissingen vinden onverminderd controles plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Aukje de Vries aover het artikel “Verzekeraar kansloos in concurrentie met het UWV”

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Aukje de Vries asked whether the unequal playing field between the UWV and private insurers under the WGA hybrid system, and the UWV's reassessment and independence practices, were acceptable. Minister Asscher answered that the government monitors the system, is analysing premium adjustments, and will inform parliament before the summer recess, but declined to answer nine questions in time for the scheduled debate.
At present I am examining whether and how the premium setting at the UWV can be adjusted to improve the balance in the hybrid market.
Op dit moment onderzoek ik of en op welke manier de premiestelling bij het UWV aangepast kan worden om zo het evenwicht op de hybride markt te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over coco's (contingent convertibles)

An MP asks the Finance Minister about contingent convertibles (coco bonds): their rapid growth, whether they increase interdependence among banks, whether limits or stricter rules are needed, the risks of triggering, suitability for retail investors, and tax deductibility. The minister answers that existing CRR/CRD-IV rules already limit bank exposures, that stricter rules could be considered later (e.g., higher trigger level, leverage-ratio limits) pending EBA and Commission work, that tax deductibility was needed for competitiveness and leverage ratio reasons, and that the AFM considers cocos suitable only for professional investors.
Nevertheless, some prudential requirements regarding cocos could be further tightened in the future.
Niettemin zouden enkele prudentiele eisen rondom coco's in de toekomst verder kunnen worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Brussel ligt dwars bij nieuw instituut voor hypotheken’

MPs Verhoeven and Koolmees asked the Ministers of Housing and of Finance about reports that Brussels opposes the planned Dutch mortgage institute (NHI), including the state-aid and debt-classification issues, the difference from the existing NHG guarantee, and the added value of the NHI in current market conditions. The minister answered that talks with the European Commission and Eurostat are not concluded, that state-aid and classification outcomes are still open, that the NHI's added value lies mainly in stress periods and transparency, and that no signals of waning investor interest were received.

Naturally, I aim to have sufficient clarity and assurance as soon as possible on whether the preconditions can be met so that the NHI does not lead to state aid and is not classified in the government sector.
Vanzelfsprekend streef ik ernaar zo spoedig mogelijk voldoende duidelijkheid en comfort te hebben of aan de randvoorwaarden kan worden voldaan dat de NHI niet leidt tot staatssteun
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het weigeren van verzekeringen aan mensen met een strafblad

An SP MP asked whether refusing car insurance, or charging higher premiums, to people with a criminal record is legitimate and whether the government will discuss a solution with insurers' association Verbond van Verzekeraars. The minister defended the insurer's right to assess risk and asserted that few ex-offenders face problems, so no talks are planned.
The Verbond van Verzekeraars indicates that there are few or no complaints or reports on this issue.
Het Verbond van Verzekeraars geeft aan dat er op het gebied van deze kwestie weinig tot geen klachten of meldingen binnenkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “AFM wil vaker namen kunnen noemen”

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether he supports the AFM's wish to name firms more often and to publish office-specific audit findings, and what powers the AFM wants. The minister agreed in principle to more transparency, noted the AFM already can publish findings, described planned legal changes (performance disclosure for pre-2013 investment insurance, sharing findings with audit clients, a 2017 amendment), and flagged confidentiality limits.
It is up to the supervisor to weigh, case by case, whether a confidentiality obligation or one of the aforementioned interests opposes the interest served by disclosure.

Het is aan de toezichthouder om van geval tot geval de afweging te maken of een geheimhoudingsverplichting of een van voornoemde belangen zich verzet tegen het belang dat met openbaarmaking is gediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Karabulut over het bericht dat de vermogensongelijkheid in Nederland recordhoogtes bereikt

MPs Merkies and Karabulut asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about reports that wealth inequality in the Netherlands had reached record levels, and whether the government would act to reduce it. The minister replied that the CBS figures show rising wealth concentration mainly due to falling house prices, that the government sees no need for action since social security cushions risks, and that it will keep monitoring wealth distribution.
The cabinet therefore attaches no consequences to the current development in wealth distribution, but will continue to follow wealth distribution in the coming years.
Het kabinet verbindt daarom geen consequenties aan de huidige ontwikkeling in de vermogensverdeling, maar blijft de vermogensverdeling de komende jaren wel volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Merkies over bewindvoerders die door een lidmaatschapseis geen bankrekening kunnen openen

MPs Van Nispen and Merkies asked whether banks such as ABN AMRO may require court-appointed trustees (bewindvoerders) to belong to a trade association before opening a bank account, and what the earlier talks with associations and banks produced. The minister replied that the Wwft does not require membership, that banks may choose additional measures case by case, that the Wft and payment-account convention give access to basic accounts, and that talks with associations were constructive but did not resolve the problem.
The Wwft does not require banks to demand that trustees be members of a trade association.
De Wwft schrijft niet voor dat banken van bewindvoerders eisen dat zij lid zijn van een branchevereniging.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het verzoek van de Nederlandse regering aan de Europese Commissie om alle documenten en briefwisselingen tussen Nederland en de Europese Commissie over de naheffing van 642 mil

An MP asks why the government asked the European Commission to keep correspondence about the 642 million euro levy secret, and demands the letter and emails be released. The government refuses to provide the Commission correspondence, citing diplomatic confidentiality and Wob exceptions, and says Article 68 of the Constitution rather than the Wob governs its duty to parliament.
Providing the correspondence with the European Commission itself is, in line with the cited cabinet position, considered undesirable.
Verstrekking van correspondentie met de Europese Commissie zelf achten wij, in lijn met genoemd kabinetsstandpunt, onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “Pensioenfonds moet uit olie en gas”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister about press reports that APG/ABP's exposure to fossil fuels differs from DNB's earlier estimate, and whether DNB would reassess its conclusions and monitor carbon bubble and climate-policy risks. The minister answered that the figures differ because APG/ABP used a broader definition of energy investments, that DNB sees no reason to revise its conclusion, and that DNB addresses ESG risks through supervision and dialogue.
The full APG report is not publicly available because it serves internal risk purposes and contains confidential information.
Het volledige rapport van APG is niet publiek beschikbaar, omdat het voor interne risicodoeleinden dient en vertrouwelijke informatie bevat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Leenders over vertraging bij de aanleg van een centraal beveiligingssysteem op Schiphol

MPs Mei Li Vos and Leenders asked about delays in building a central security system at Schiphol, whether the 3 June deadline will be met, whether costs and complexity were underestimated, whether the Algemene Rekenkamer should audit Schiphol's tendering, and how the state's shareholder powers over state holdings could be strengthened. The minister answers that the 3 June switchover is still planned, Schiphol faces no financial problems if it slips, the state exercises shareholder oversight through informal contact and statutes, declines to ask the Rekenkamer for an audit, and says the Rekenkamer's access to subsidiaries requires a legal change for which the Council of State previously saw no need.
These concern operational matters for which Schiphol's management board and supervisory board are responsible and accountable.
Het betreft operationele aangelegenheden, waarvoor de directie en raad van commissarissen van Schiphol verantwoordelijk en aanspreekbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Merkies over “de megabonus voor de topman van Schiphol”

MPs Bashir and Merkies asked why the Schiphol CEO receives a bonus nearly equal to his base salary, whether this is consistent with the 20% cap, and whether the government has acted to get him to waive it. The minister explains the 2008 contract followed then-applicable policy, states that the new 2014 policy caps variable pay at 20%, says the shareholder sets directors' pay policy, and notes he has told Schiphol the CEO's variable pay should be brought into line with current policy.
In addition, I have informed Schiphol that I am of the view that the variable pay of Schiphol's CEO should be brought into line with the current remuneration policy.
Daarnaast heb ik aan Schiphol laten weten dat ik van mening ben dat de variabele beloning van de CEO van Schiphol in lijn moet worden gebracht met het vigerende beloningsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht ‘Bank weigert rekening aan sekswerkersclub’

MP Rebel asked the Finance and Justice ministers whether a bank refusing a business account to a sex workers' advocacy club was justified and how government will improve sex workers' access to financial services and tax deductions. The minister answered that banks set their own acceptance policies, that individual cases are not reviewed, and that the NVB will issue an information leaflet while casework is referred to it.
I do not intervene in a bank's assessment of individual cases.
Ik treed niet in de beoordeling door een bank van individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de hoge en sterk uiteenlopende kosten van vermogensbeheer

An MP asked the Finance Minister about high and widely varying asset management fees and what should be done about them. The minister answered that fees are set freely by managers, that a cap is too drastic, and that a comparative cost measure has been in place since 1 January 2015, with further EU rules (MiFID II, PRIIPs) planned.
Setting a maximum on market prices is generally too drastic a measure.
Het stellen van een maximum aan marktprijzen is over het algemeen een te ingrijpende maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht "Geschiktheidstoets accountantscommissaris pas in 2016"

Ms de Vries asked why suitability tests for supervisory board members of accountancy firms cannot take place before 2016, and whether this hinders the sector's voluntary quality improvements. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the AFM can only test trustworthiness now, that suitability criteria will be consulted before summer, and that establishing a supervisory body does not depend on the suitability test.
It is correct that members of already established supervisory boards have not been tested for suitability.
Het klopt dat leden van reeds ingestelde Raden van Commissarissen niet zijn getoetst op geschiktheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over uitspraken van DNB over het lage btw-tarief

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether DNB overstepped its remit by suggesting VAT increases to fund lower labour taxes, and cited a NYFER study on job losses in hospitality. The state secretary answered that DNB gives independent advice and must account for its own statements, and that the cabinet is still consulting on and developing the tax reform, with effects to be assessed before the 2016 budget.
For that reason DNB will account for its own statements.
De DNB zal om die reden haar eigen uitspraken verantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Leenders over de verkoop van B.V. Schiphol Airport Retail

MPs Mei Li Vos and Leenders asked whether the sale of 60% of Schiphol Airport Retail B.V. was a privatisation requiring parliamentary approval, and why it was done. The government answered that Schiphol Group, not the state, sold the stake, that the sale needed no shareholder consent under the articles, and that Schiphol keeps control through the shareholder agreement and concession role.
There is no partial privatisation here because the state itself does not dispose of any shares.
Er is hier geen sprake van een deelprivatisering omdat de staat zelf geen aandelen vervreemdt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over regeldrift

MPs asked whether the government finds it acceptable that insurers demand extensive documents from employers before advising on pension schemes, given the aim to cut administrative burden. The minister says the Wft uses open norms, the AFM guidelines are not a checklist, the burden is hard to estimate and is not tracked, and the Actal study on financial-sector regulation will examine similar cases.
Because there are various ways to gather information from the client, the administrative burden arising from this cannot be reliably estimated.
Vanwege de verschillende mogelijkheden om informatie bij de klant in te winnen zijn de administratieve lasten die hieruit voortkomen niet goed in te schatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het bericht dat de Griekse overheid onderzoek doet naar een statisticus

Harbers (VVD) asked the Finance Minister about reports that Greek authorities are investigating the statistics chief Georgiou over the 2009 deficit figure, and about independence of statistics and Greek fiscal oversight. The minister said the investigating judge will decide on prosecution, that statistical independence is important and required under EU rules and the Greek loan programme, and that he awaits talks with the Greek authorities.
It is not for me to speculate now on the outcome of a Greek judicial investigation.
Het is niet aan mij om nu te gaan speculeren over de uitkomst van een Grieks gerechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over het winnen van de aanbesteding in Limburg door Abellio

MPs De Vries and De Boer asked whether NS's subsidiary Abellio could bid in the Limburg public transport tender without being cross-subsidised and on a level playing field with commercial rivals, and how its return and finances fit NS's required return. The minister answers that the bid was discussed with the shareholder, meets NS's investment criteria, is market-conform in financing, and that NS does not report subsidiary-level returns publicly.
Providing insight into the return per business unit, subsidiary and participation could lead to a deterioration of NS's competitive and negotiating position.
Inzicht geven in het rendement per bedrijfsonderdeel, dochteronderneming en deelnemingen kan leiden tot een verslechtering van de concurrentie- en onderhandelingspositie van de NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de kwaliteit van het hersteladvies door verzekeraar voor houders van woekerpolissen

Opposition MP Merkies asked the Finance Minister about the poor quality of repair advice given by insurers to holders of 'woekerpolissen' (investment-linked insurance policies), and about the share of clients who keep unchanged policies, whether advice is independent, and how the AFM supervises. The minister acknowledged concerns, said the AFM can enforce against deficient advice, announced further AFM research into clients who choose not to change, and said advice rules apply in full to insurer advice.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over het arrest van de Hoge Raad dat de Staatsloterij kopers van staatsloten in de periode 2000-2008 zou hebben misleid

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the government about a Supreme Court ruling that the State Lottery misled ticket buyers in 2000-2008, including revenue figures, possible misleading draw practices, the Kansspelautoriteit investigation, and liability. The government answered that the KSA found no reason to suspend draws, recommended measures the lottery will implement by Q2 2015, and that no assessment of damages can yet be made.
The KSA expects that the State Lottery will have implemented the final measures to carry out the recommendations by the end of the second quarter of 2015 at the latest.
De KSA verwacht dat de Staatsloterij uiterlijk aan het einde van het tweede kwartaal 2015 de laatste maatregelen ter uitvoering van de aanbevelingen heeft ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het artikel ‘‘Onafhankelijke’ voorzitter beleidsonderzoek zzp krijgt topfunctie bij Financiën”

An MP asked whether appointing the chair of the IBO Zzp study to a directorate-general post at Finance undermines the study's independence and the support for its policy options. The minister replied that the IBO is technical and the chair qualifies for both roles, and that the chair agreed to finish the study as planned, with the report to parliament before summer.
The report will be submitted to the House of Representatives before summer, as previously announced.
Antwoord 6, 7 Het rapport zal – zoals eerder gemeld 2 – voor de zomer aan de Tweede Kamer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over de regels met betrekking tot de meldplicht van accountants

Two MPs asked whether an Accountantskamer ruling narrows accountants' confidentiality duty when they suspect large tax fraud, and whether it conflicts with earlier rulings and with the Wwft reporting duty. The minister answered that the ruling reflects existing rules, that no conflict exists, and that no new legislation is needed.
No. The existing laws and regulations offer sufficient starting points for the accountants' duty to report fraud.
Nee. De bestaande wet- en regelgeving biedt voldoende aanknopingspunten voor de meldplicht van accountants bij fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het gedogen van illegale gokbedrijven en de risico’s voor het betalingsverkeer

An MP asked the State Secretary about the Kansspelautoriteit's alleged issuing of 'comfort letters' to illegal online gambling operators, and about the reliability of payment service providers after a Buckaroo director was suspected in a gambling case. The State Secretary denied that comfort letters or tolerance policy exist, described warning letters sent under prioritisation criteria, and pointed to planned licensing rules and DNB supervision of payment institutions while declining to comment on individual cases.
I do not have these individual letters.
Ik beschik niet over deze individuele brieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht "ABN AMRO CFO: Nieuwe kapitaalbodems kunnen buffer hard raken"

Two MPs from the VVD asked the Finance Minister about a report that international supervisors plan capital floors per loan type that could hit Dutch banks' capital buffers, and about effects on mortgages, SME lending and securitisation. The minister answered that the Basel Committee is consulting on a new floor based on the standardised approach and a revised standardised approach, that effects depend on final design and are likely to raise risk-weighted assets for large Dutch banks, that the government will watch for disproportionate impacts, and that existing EU securitisation rules remain in force.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over fraude bij ABN Dubai

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about alleged fraud at ABN Amro's Dubai operation, including its nature, duration, supervisory role, DNB's knowledge, and the implications for the planned IPO. The government answered by referring to a separate letter to parliament on the same matter, without answering the questions directly.
The written questions from MP Merkies (SP), question number 2015Z04403, have been answered by means of the letter
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Merkies (SP), vraagnummer 2015Z04403 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over het bericht 'NS wil af van winkelvastgoed'

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about a report that NS (the state railway) wants to divest property and non-core retail, and about its consequences for the state's role as shareholder and concession grantor. The ministers answered that the divestments are gradual and market-driven, that they favour keeping station management in public hands with a regulatory role, and that the concession is unaffected, leaving much of the shareholder assessment to the shareholder itself.
It is mainly up to the shareholder to assess whether the strategy of the entire NS group is in line with the public interests of the railway.
Het is met name aan de aandeelhouder om te beoordelen of de strategie van het gehele NS-concern in lijn is met de publieke belangen van het spoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel “Schimmigheid krijgt trekjes van patroon”

Omtzigt asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands objected to disclosure of its correspondence with the European Commission about a surcharge, and what it had told the Commission. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the Netherlands invoked privacy and internal policy-opinion exceptions under the Wob and EU access rules, that the Commission accepted these grounds, and declined to commit to writing a letter urging disclosure.
The Netherlands informed the European Commission which information it would make public in the context of the Wob request.
Nederland heeft de Europese Commissie gemeld welke informatie Nederland in het kader van het Wob-verzoek openbaar zou maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht «Dure bootpolis verrast ex-klanten Friesland Bank»

An MP asked the Finance Minister about consumers who were moved from Friesland Bank boat policies to more expensive Interpolis policies after the takeover, and whether they could switch immediately. The minister said about 80% of transferred policies became more expensive, that customers could terminate within 30 days or cancel at any time with one month's notice, and that stepping up premiums should not surprise clients.
In situations like this, customers must be clearly and timely informed in writing about increases in policy costs and about their options to switch.
Klanten moeten in dit soort situaties helder en tijdig schriftelijk worden geïnformeerd over stijgingen van de kosten van een polis en over hun mogelijkheden om over te stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het AFM-rapport Productonderzoek Contracts for Difference

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the AFM's product study of Contracts for Difference (CfDs), including investor protection against residual debt, aggressive marketing, and why foreign-passported providers escape AFM supervision. The minister answered that providers should offer stop-loss protection and that MiFID II will allow tighter product rules, but that home-country supervision applies to EU providers and that ESMA cooperation has not yet produced concrete steps.

The AFM has raised this within ESMA and will continue to work towards further harmonising supervision of the European rules so that differences in supervisory practice between national supervisors are reduced.

De AFM heeft dit in ESMA verband aangekaart en zal zich verder inzetten voor het verder harmoniseren van het toezicht op de Europese regels zodat verschillen in de toezichtpraktijk tussen de nationale toezichthouders worden verkleind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht “Geëiste premiedaling komt niet van de grond”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs and Employment and the Minister of Finance about reports that a promised fall in pension premiums was not materialising, and about the premium forecasts underlying the coalition agreement and the expected revenue from cutting pension accrual. The government answered that premiums fell between 2014 and 2015, that current CPB forecasts are below earlier projections, and that the expected revenue of 2.1 billion euro in 2017 is not at risk.

The CEP 2015 forecast shows that the realised premium development in 2014 and the expected development for 2015 and 2016 are so far more favourable than expected at the time of the pension agreements.
Uit de CEP-raming 2015 blijkt dat de gerealiseerde premieontwikkeling in 2014 en de verwachte ontwikkeling voor 2015 en 2016 vooralsnog gunstiger is dan verwacht ten tijde van de pensioenafspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de Aukje de Vries en Lodders over bankfinanciering in relatie tot muizenschade in Fryslân

MPs asked whether Deutsche Bank takes a stricter line than Rabobank toward farmers suffering vole damage in Fryslân, and whether the minister would raise this with Deutsche Bank and survey other banks' financing problems. The government answered that Deutsche Bank's affected client base is too small to show a specific policy, that complaints unrelated to its strategic reorientation must be filed by clients themselves, and that the State Secretary is consulting banks and regions and examining a guarantee scheme for residual hardship cases.

As I indicated in my letter of 29 January and as agreed with your House, I will continue to bring complaints that are the direct result of Deutsche Bank Nederland's strategic reorientation directly to the attention of its Management Board.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 29 januari jl. heb aangegeven en ook met uw Kamer heb afgesproken, zal ik klachten die het directe gevolg zijn van de strategische heroriëntatie van Deutsche Bank Nederland rechtstreeks onder de aandacht blijven brengen van de Raad van Bestuur van Deutsche Bank Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over renteopslagen rentederivaten

MP Merkies asks the Finance Minister whether banks may unilaterally raise risk and liquidity surcharges on business loans, whether MSMEs are adequately informed, and whether Kifid complaint routes are wide enough. The minister replies that banks say derivative valuations do not affect risk surcharges, that the AFM has found insufficient transparency and will review arbitrariness, that no public-law limits exist beyond contract and reasonableness, and that Kifid's derivatives desk is designed for narrow cases.

As I promised in response to questions from MP Nijboer (PvdA) at the General Consultation on lending of 5 February, I will consult with the AFM to see whether it recognises the picture of arbitrariness in banks' application or increase of interest surcharges.

Zoals ik heb toegezegd op vragen van het lid Nijboer (PvdA) in het Algemeen Overleg over kredietverlening van 5 februari jl. zal ik met de AFM in overleg treden om te kijken of zij het beeld dat sprake is van willekeur bij het toepassen of verhogen van renteopslagen door banken herkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de handel in ‘contracts for difference’

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about contracts for difference (CfDs), including their risks, whether investors are adequately informed, which providers operate and under what supervision, possible protective measures, expected returns, and whether CfD trading resembles gambling. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that CfDs are suited mainly to professional investors, that the AFM found providers gave insufficient information and that some foreign providers breach EU rules, and that MiFID revision from 2017 and AFM enforcement powers will strengthen protection.
The AFM finds that a number of providers insufficiently comply with the applicable European rules. The AFM considers this situation worrying and will raise it at European level.
De AFM constateert dat een aantal aanbieders de geldende Europese regels onvoldoende naleeft. De AFM vindt deze situatie zorgwekkend en zal dit in Europees verband aankaarten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het reglement van het klachtenloket bij het Klachteninstituut Financiële Dienstverlening (KiFiD), dat zo is opgesteld dat veel gedupeerde ondernemers er nooit gebruik van zulle

Mr Omtzigt asks the Finance Minister whether the KiFiD interest-rate derivatives complaints rules, including exclusion of loan-margin complaints, the Dec 2016 deadline, the restrictive SME definition, and the appeal clause, unduly keep many injured entrepreneurs from the complaints desk. The Minister defends the rules as a low-threshold procedural arrangement, says the desk need not cover all loan-condition complaints, will press banks if the deadline proves too short, and describes the committee members' independence checks.
If that proves necessary, I will hold the banks to account on it.
Als dat nodig mocht blijken, zal ik de banken daarop aanspreken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de uitspraken van de president van de Europese Investeringsbank (EIB), die twijfelt aan het realiteitsgehalte van projecten die zijn ingediend voor het Europese investerin

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers whether the EIB president's doubts about projects submitted to the EFSI fund are justified, whether EFSI mainly targets unprofitable investments, and whether the government will help regional provinces' investment funds access EFSI. The minister denied that EFSI mainly targets unprofitable investments, stressed projects are economically sound and assessed on merit, and said regional parties can apply and the government will play a facilitating role.
From my responsibility for the EIB, I fulfil a facilitating role in this, together with the Minister of Economic Affairs.
Vanuit mijn verantwoordelijkheid voor de EIB vervul ik hierin een faciliterende rol, samen met de Minister van Economische Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de lage scores van Nederland in de ‘Index of Economic Freedom’

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Finance Minister why the Netherlands scores poorly on labour freedom, government spending and fiscal freedom in the Heritage Foundation's Index of Economic Freedom, and whether a flat tax, uniform VAT and smaller state would boost growth. The state secretary replied that the Dutch scores reflect its social security system, that the Netherlands remains among the most competitive countries, and that tax options will be considered in the ongoing tax reform.
Possible adjustments to wage and income tax, such as a flat tax, and VAT rates will be considered within the planned revision of the tax system.
Mogelijke aanpassingen in de loon- en inkomstenbelasting – zoals een vlaktaks – en de btw-tarieven worden bezien in het kader van de voorgenomen herziening van het belastingstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Gesthuizen over de opkomst van Apple en Google in het betalingsverkeer

MPs Merkies and Gesthuizen (SP) asked whether the uneven playing field between banks and tech firms like Apple and Google in payments, data-use rules and payment data protection should be closed. The government answered that all parties must comply with the same privacy law, that the voluntary banking code is only a further interpretation of it, and that the new EU directives and privacy regulation will add registration and risk-based duties.
All the parties mentioned, both financial institutions and other companies, must comply with the same privacy legislation.
Alle genoemde partijen, dus zowel financiële instellingen als andere bedrijven, moeten voldoen aan dezelfde privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de ‘behoedzame’ beleggingsportefeuille van Alex Vermogensbank

MP Merkies asked the Finance Minister whether an automated investment model at Alex Vermogensbank that swaps shares for bonds on market declines reduces losses, whether a 100% equity portfolio can be called cautious, how the AFM checks risk profiles, and whether banks may freely name risk profiles and owe a duty of care. The minister answered that firms choose their own models and profile names, that the AFM supervises whether processes are correctly set up and whether names are misleading, and that the duty of care under the Wft requires client information gathering.
What the AFM supervises is whether the legally required investment processes are set up correctly and carefully by the investment firm.
Waar de AFM toezicht op houdt is of de wettelijk vereiste processen voor het beleggen correct en zorgvuldig door de beleggingsonderneming zijn ingericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het besluit van de ECB om op grote schaal staatsobligaties op te gaan kopen

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the ECB's large-scale government bond purchases amount to a transfer union and reward indebted southern states, and what measures will prevent northern countries from bearing their costs. The minister declined to characterise the ECB programme, pointed to existing eurozone budgetary reforms and ESM conditionality, and rejected a parallel currency option.
For a response to the ECB's announced Expanded Asset Purchase Programme, I refer you to parliamentary document 21 501-07, no. 1235.
Voor een reactie op het door de ECB aangekondigde Expanded Asset Purchase Programme verwijs ik u naar kamerstuk 21 501-07, nr. 1235.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Oosenbrug over het artikel ‘Beveiligingslek banken maakte phishing mogelijk’

MPs Nijboer and Oosenbrug asked whether a web security flaw in major Dutch banks enabling phishing was known, whether victims would be fully compensated, and whether banks invest enough and share vulnerabilities. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that banks follow a responsible disclosure policy, that DNB has tightened IT-risk requirements, that banks say they know of no attacks exploiting the flaw, and that liability for victims applies unless gross negligence is involved.
Given the development of cyber threats, DNB has tightened the requirements it imposes on supervised institutions regarding the analysis and control of IT risks from this year onward.
Gezien de ontwikkeling van cyberdreigingen heeft DNB de eisen die zij stelt aan onder toezicht staande instellingen wat betreft de analyse en beheersing van IT-risico's vanaf dit jaar verzwaard.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de kaspositie van KLM

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether KLM's roughly 1 billion euro cash position will stay under KLM's own management, whether KLM keeps control of its financial management, and whether the SAK foundations and MoU remain in force. State Secretary Mansveld answered that Air France KLM reported no plans to transfer KLM's surplus cash to the holding, that KLM will retain autonomy over its cash, banking and hedging, and that the foundations and MoU are maintained, though no final decision on financial management had yet been taken.

This means that KLM as an independent airline can continue to invest (such as in fleet financing) and remains responsible for its own cash flows, bank relations, management of its financial cash position and execution of its own hedging.

Dit betekent namelijk dat KLM als zelfstandige luchtvaartmaatschappij kan blijven investeren (zoals ten aanzien van vlootfinanciering) en verantwoordelijk blijft voor haar eigen kasstromen, bankrelaties, beheer van de financiële kaspositie en uitvoering van haar eigen «hedging».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over een mogelijke uittreding van Griekenland uit de Eurozone

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether a Greek exit from the eurozone would be manageable, as suggested by the German government, and whether the cabinet has a contingency scenario for such an exit. The minister answered that the priority is keeping Greece in the eurozone, that speculation about an exit is not appropriate, and that no 'Greece out of the eurozone' scenario is available.
A scenario 'Greece out of the eurozone' is not available.
Een scenario «Griekenland uit de eurozone» is niet beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de plannen om het financiële beheer van KLM van Nederland naar Frankrijk over te hevelen en daarmee KLM een groot deel van haar resterende autonomie te laten ve

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether Air France KLM plans to move KLM's financial management to Paris, whether the Memorandum of Understanding and other agreements are respected, and related questions on the state's shareholding and KLM's profits. The State Secretary answered that concrete plans are not yet known, that the state's influence as shareholder is limited, that the 2010 MoU safeguards KLM's Dutch base and hub network, and offered confidential inspection of the MoU.
I am willing to make this Memorandum of Understanding and the agreements with the State available for confidential inspection.
Ik ben bereid om dit Memorandum of Understanding en de afspraken met de Staat vertrouwelijk ter inzage te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de gestegen inkomens van accountants

MP Nijboer asks the Finance Minister whether rising partner incomes at Big 4 audit firms are acceptable given the sector's quality problems, its own pledges to invest in quality, and the reduced partner involvement in audits. The minister replies that audit firms are private bodies setting their own pay, points to NBA measures (claw-back, capped variable pay, partner-hours reporting) and says the AFM will supervise implementation, while noting the reported pay covers the prior financial year before the measures took effect.
The Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM) will closely monitor both the progress of implementing the measures and the quality of the statutory audit.
De Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) zal nauwgezet toezien op zowel de voortgang van de implementatie van de maatregelen als de kwaliteit van de wettelijke controle.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de vestiging van een moskee/islamitisch centrum in Gouda

MPs Oskam, Omtzigt and Knops asked ministers about a planned mega-mosque and Islamic centre in former Gouda barracks, including sale arrangements, financing from abroad, links of preachers to jihadism and counter-radicalisation measures. The government answered most questions, declining to comment on individual cases and noting that the municipality is responsible for land use and the financing investigation is ongoing.
I do not make public statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik in het openbaar geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over renteverhogingen door banken

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether banks should limit variable-rate increases, tie them to objective criteria and benchmarks, and whether such rules should be legally anchored, including for business credit. The minister said banks are not obliged to link rates one-to-one to benchmarks, pledged to work for clearer communication of rate components to consumers and businesses, and would consider legal anchoring only if needed.
I will work to ensure that credit providers clearly inform both consumers and entrepreneurs about the components of the variable interest rate.
Ik zal mij ervoor inzetten dat kredietaanbieders zowel consumenten als ondernemers duidelijk informeren over de componenten waaruit de variabele rente is opgebouwd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de werkwijze van online broker DeGiro

MP Merkies asks the Finance Minister about DeGiro's practices: holding client cash in money market funds, deposit and investor compensation schemes, and securities lending. The minister answers that DeGiro lacks a banking licence, that client assets are legally segregated, and that lending requires explicit client consent with collateral and supervisory rules.
Investment firms such as DeGiro are not permitted to attract repayable funds from consumers outside a closed circle, unless De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) has granted an exemption.

Het is aan beleggingsondernemingen zoals DeGiro niet toegestaan opvorderbare gelden van consumenten buiten besloten kring aan te trekken, tenzij De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) hiervoor een ontheffing heeft verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Europese naheffing die op 30 december 2014 betaald gaat worden

An MP asked the Finance Minister why the Netherlands was surprised by the EU levy, why internal emails and the 17 October 2014 negotiation note (stuk 75) were withheld under the Wob, and when the Parliament was told about the 30 December payment date. The minister answered that the surprise concerned the size of the levy, that stuk 75 was withheld to protect confidentiality of negotiations and Dutch relations with other states, and that Parliament was informed of the payment date via the Najaarsnota and a supplementary budget.

I previously set out to your House, by letter of 13 November 2014, the reasons underlying the decision not to make public the report of the Permanent Representation in Brussels of 17 October 2014, document 75.

Ik heb eerder, per brief van 13 november 2014, aan uw Kamer de redenen uiteengezet die ten grondslag liggen aan het besluit het verslag van de Permanente Vertegenwoordiging in Brussel van 17 oktober 2014, stuk75, niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Segers, Dijkgraaf en Thieme over het wachtgeld voor de voorzitter van de Europese Raad

Five MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the EU transitional allowance (wachtgeld) for the outgoing President of the European Council, who had already reached pensionable age and could draw his Belgian pension alongside it, and about pension accrual rates and job-seeking obligations. The minister confirmed the facts, said the EU rules (Regulation 422/67/EEG) cap the allowance at three years with no job-seeking duty, and said the Netherlands is willing to examine modernising and reducing the scheme, though any change requires Council action.
The Netherlands is willing to examine whether modernising and reducing the current scheme for political office holders in the EU is possible
Nederland is bereid te bekijken of modernisering en versobering van de huidige regeling voor politieke ambtsdragers in de EU mogelijk is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over het bericht "Gebrek aan MKB-krediet remt groei Nederland"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Ziengs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about OECD and ECB findings that limited SME credit is slowing Dutch growth and about the effects of bank capital rules. The ministers answered that weakened SME finances and lower domestic demand explain falling credit, that DNB finds banks can meet the new rules under the baseline scenario, and that further measures will be reported.
The cabinet will inform the House shortly about the effects of the accumulation of regulation on the banking sector and credit provision.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer op korte termijn informeren over de effecten van de stapeling van regelgeving op de bancaire sector en de kredietverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over inzage rulingpraktijken

Klaver (GroenLinks) asked whether the government had requested all Luxembourg tax rulings concerning Dutch companies and wealthy individuals, and why Germany was given access to the Dutch ruling practice. Wiebes answered that Dutch tax interest in Luxembourg rulings is still being examined and that rulings will be requested if warranted, while defending bilateral exchange of rulings and the fiscal secrecy duty against calls for public disclosure.
At present it is being examined whether, and if so in which cases, there is Dutch tax interest in relation to Luxembourg rulings.
Op dit moment wordt uitgezocht of, en zo ja in welke gevallen, er Nederlands heffingsbelang is in relatie tot Luxemburgse rulings.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over “de goudclaim van Nederland op Zwitserland en het bericht dat DNB Nederlands goud uit het buitenland naar Nederland heeft gehaald”

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Swiss gold referendum and expert advice (Kalshoven) change the government's position on the Dutch wartime gold claim against Switzerland. The minister answered that the claim lacks legal grounds, that the Van Kemenade commission conclusions are adopted, and that no new legal opinion will be sought unless new stolen gold surfaces.
I see no reason to reconsider my position on the gold claim.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om mijn standpunt over de goudclaim te heroverwegen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aangifte tegen het ministerie van Financiën en antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over getuigenissen van belastingambtenaren in rechtbanken

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about a criminal complaint against the Ministry of Finance over alleged witness influencing in a tax case, the instructions given to tax witnesses, the payments to an anonymous tipster, and why the court's order to disclose the tipster was not followed. The State Secretary confirmed the complaint, explained that the 'other interests' remark referred to the policy of keeping tipster identities secret, declined to disclose the exact tipster payment terms citing tax secrecy, and argued the court's sanction did not require disclosure.

The exact agreement (including the percentages) made with this tipster about his payment falls under the fiscal confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act and I cannot make it public.

De exacte afspraak (waaronder de percentages) die met deze tipgever over zijn vergoeding zijn gemaakt valt onder de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen en kan ik niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de kosten van beleggingsfondsen

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether fund management fees, the stacking of funds and high investment costs undermine investors' interests and whether costs are transparent enough. The Minister replied that the advisor commission ban protects investors, that fund management fees are standard practice, and that clearer cost disclosure will come via Dutch bank commitments and EU rules (MiFID II, PRIIPS) with Europe-level advocacy.
In my view, information on investment costs can be more complete and transparent.
Informatie over kosten van beleggen kunnen mijns inziens vollediger en inzichtelijker.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Omtzigt en De Rouwe over het bericht ‘Overheid sluit deal voor behoud pinautomaten’

CDA MPs asked whether the government's intention agreement with SNS RegioBank on cash-machine provision in rural areas, and its relation to a Finance Ministry pilot on avoiding ATM 'white spots', was lawful and coordinated. The minister answered that the agreement concerns local liveability rather than ATM retention, that the ACM saw no reason for a competition assessment, and that the pilot's competition-law compatibility is still under discussion with the ACM.
For an assessment under the Competition Act by the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) there is therefore no reason.
Voor een beoordeling op grond van de Mededingingswet door de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) bestaat dan ook geen aanleiding.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt die mij gesteld zijn inzake het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer “Op weg naar correcte gegevens over het bruto nationaal inkomen (BNI): een meer gestructureerde en gerichte aanpak

An MP asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about European Court of Auditors criticism of EU GNI statistics that underpinned a 642 million euro extra payment by the Netherlands. The Finance Minister answered that the recommendations target the Commission and Eurostat, that the GNI committee found the data suitable for own resources, and that Eurostat's verification cycle is still pending, so the Netherlands must pay while other countries' revisions are being reviewed.
Based on the publicly released figures and Eurostat regulations, the Netherlands is obliged to pay the supplementary levy.
Op basis van de openbaar gemaakte cijfers en Eurostat regelgeving is Nederland gehouden de naheffing te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over de naheffing door de EU

An MP asked the Finance Minister how the UK can claim a 50% reduction on the EU levy, how the UK rebate works, and whether the Netherlands' 642 million euro payment should be dropped. The minister answered that the UK rebate has not been halved, explained the rebate mechanism and the 25% reduced contribution by four member states, and referred to earlier letters on the macroeconomic revisions.
The British have not received a 50% discount on their surcharge.
De Britten hebben geen 50% korting op hun naheffing gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Eis Haagse politiek ontmoedigt vervroegd aflossen hypotheek’

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the planned 4% leverage ratio for systemically important banks would discourage early mortgage repayment by narrowing risk-based rate differences and raising mortgage rates. The minister rejected that premise, arguing the leverage ratio is designed alongside risk-weighted requirements, and said he does not expect banks to make early repayment less attractive or to cause substantial unwanted behaviour effects.
The cabinet's vision for the Dutch banking sector explicitly states that it pursues a higher leverage ratio of at least 4% in conjunction with the increase in risk-weighted capital requirements.

In de Kabinetsvisie Nederlandse bankensector is echter expliciet aangegeven dat het kabinet een hogere leverage ratio van minimaal 4% nastreeft in samenhang met de stijging van de risicogewogen kapitaaleisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over fouten van banken bij het omzetten van adresboeken van klanten

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether banks made errors converting customers' address-book account numbers to IBAN and who is liable when money goes to a wrong account. The minister answered that the IBAN check digit prevents most errors, that account holders share responsibility, that banks are jointly liable for incorrectly executed transfers, and that wrong transfers should fall markedly after the August 2014 switch to IBAN.
If payments are however executed incorrectly through the bank's doing, the bank is jointly liable towards its customers and responsible for refunding the amount of the incorrectly executed payment.

Als betalingen echter door toedoen van de bank foutief worden uitgevoerd, is deze mede aansprakelijk richting haar klanten en verantwoordelijk voor terugboeking van het bedrag van de foutief uitgevoerde betaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de naheffing

An MP asked the Finance Minister and Prime Minister about the 2014 EU budget surcharge (naheffing), including when Eurostat reservations were known, who in government knew and when, and the correspondence with the European Commission. The minister answered almost every question by referring to earlier letters and debates, while answering question 9 and 10 only in general terms and pointing to Ecofin reports.
I informed you about this on 3 November in answering the parliamentary questions on the consequences of the macroeconomic revisions for the EU contributions.
Ik heb u hierover op 3 november geïnformeerd bij de beantwoording van de Kamervragen over de gevolgen van de macro-economische revisies voor de EU-afdrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over indirecte investeringen van ambtenaren via pensioenfondsen in legbatterijen en megastallen in het buitenland

An MP asked whether civil servants' pension fund ABP indirectly invests in megastables and battery cages abroad, and whether the government would engage ABP or switch funds. The minister declined to monitor individual investments, stating pension funds and their boards decide investment policy under legal frameworks, and refused to engage ABP or change funds.
It is not the government's task to monitor and assess specific investments of individual funds, so I cannot comment on this.
Het is niet de taak van het kabinet om specifieke beleggingen van individuele fondsen te monitoren en te beoordelen, dus ik kan hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat de NS in Schotland gaat rijden

Two PVV MPs asked whether NS's Scottish rail subsidiary Abellio carries financial risks for the State as shareholder, and whether NS should stop international concessions to focus on domestic rail after the Fyra debacle. The Secretary of State replied that the UK concession model leaves most asset and personnel risk with the authority, that NS needs no capital or guarantees from the shareholder, that the €3.2 billion is a fixed operating payment rather than a price paid by NS, and that NS decides its own foreign concessions within agreed financial frameworks.
I do not share that view. NS has not paid €3.2 billion for the Scottish concession, but receives a fixed amount to cover operating costs.
Ik deel die mening niet. NS heeft geen € 3,2 miljard betaald voor de Schotse concessie, maar ontvangt een vast bedrag ter dekking van de exploitatiekosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Verheijen over het bericht “Controles op EU-subsidies moeten slimmer”

MPs Aukje de Vries and Verheijen asked the Finance Minister about the European Court of Auditors' call for mandatory Member State declarations and related calls for smarter EU subsidy controls. The Minister replied that Nederland supports a national declaration and will keep pushing for transparent accountability, noting an EU working group's final document, but gave no new binding commitments.
The Netherlands continues to work unremittingly towards good accountability for the European budget and supports a National Declaration.
