Nederland blijft zich onverminderd inzetten om te komen tot een goede verantwoording over de Europese begroting en is voorstander van een Nationale Verklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over de besteding van de opbrengsten van de veilingen van grenscapaciteit op het elektriciteitsnet

MPs Van Hijum and Agnes Mulder asked how the €664 million from cross-border capacity auctions on the electricity grid would be spent, and whether it could improve supply security in vulnerable 'uitloper' areas. The minister answered that EU rules require the proceeds to fund interconnector investments or lower network tariffs, not grid reinforcement in uitloper areas, and described the existing TenneT reinforcement programme and timelines.
Under European regulations, TenneT is obliged to use the auction proceeds for investments related to interconnector capacity or for lowering network tariffs.
Op basis van Europese regelgeving is TenneT verplicht om de veilinggelden aan te wenden voor investeringen die samenhangen met de interconnectiecapaciteit of voor verlaging van de nettarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de gevolgen voor klanten van hogere kapitaaleisen voor banken

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch banks pass higher capital costs on to customers more than banks elsewhere, citing a Vallstein report, and whether banks should instead raise buffers through cost cuts, dividend retention and new capital. The minister disputes the report's methodology and its benchmark of 10% return on equity, notes Dutch banks are already well capitalised, says supervisors can restrict payouts, and points to measures on banking competition and regulatory barriers.
I do not share this premise, because shareholders in better capitalised banks can accept lower returns as the risks also decrease accordingly.
Ik deel dit uitgangspunt niet, omdat aandeelhouders in beter gekapitaliseerde banken genoegen kunnen nemen met lagere rendementen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het krantenbericht “G20 komt met eigen reddingsfonds banken”

Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about press reports of a G20 bank rescue fund and the planned GLAC/TLAC bail-in capacity for global systemically important banks, including its relation to EU rules and which Dutch and European banks are covered. Dijsselbloem answered that the G20 is not creating a rescue fund but negotiating minimum total loss-absorbing capacity via the FSB, that TLAC is complementary to the EU MREL, that only ING among Dutch banks qualifies, and that the Netherlands supports an ambitious standard to be decided at the Brisbane summit.
I will inform the House in due course about the outcomes of this.
Ik zal de Kamer te zijner tijd verder over de uitkomsten hiervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het bericht ‘Kritiek op Icesave-deal minister’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about criticism that the sale of the Icesave claim against Landsbanki would worsen the bargaining position of local governments and the 100,000+ depositors, and whether he had consulted them beforehand. The minister denied skipping consultation, argued that the position of creditors is not harmed, and offered advice and monitoring while not committing to active mediation.
Moreover, the Dutch government will closely monitor the settlement of Icesave.
Bovendien zal de Nederlandse overheid de afwikkeling van Icesave nauwlettend blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de kredietverlening aan het midden- en kleinbedrijf

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about ECB lending support for SMEs, the causes of weak SME credit, and whether family loans could be encouraged through a revived Tante Agaathregeling tax scheme. The ministers say the ECB's TLTRO effects are hard to estimate, attribute low SME lending mainly to falling demand and weaker borrower positions, and point to SME financing measures while staying cautious about new tax measures.
The cabinet has therefore decided to support market parties in setting up a subordinated loan fund (AGL) fund
Het kabinet heeft daarom besloten marktpartijen te gaan ondersteunen bij het oprichten van een achtergestelde leningenfonds (AGL)-fonds
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Tony Van Dijck en Bosma over het bericht ‘Terrorisme wordt vanuit Nederland gesteund met geld’

PVV MPs asked whether terror groups in Pakistan and Afghanistan received money from the Netherlands over 100 times, why money transfers flagged by exchange offices were not stopped sooner, and what action would be taken against those involved. The government answered that the press report misrepresented the figures: 108 dossiers in 2013 were reported to the authorities after analysis, none yet shown to involve terrorist financing, and prosecution decisions rest with the Public Prosecution Service.
Under the statutory duty of confidentiality, no further details can be given about the amounts involved.
Uit hoofde van de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht kunnen geen nadere gegevens vermeld worden omtrent de in het geding zijnde bedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het aankomende rouleren van stemrechten binnen de ECB

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the ECB's planned move to six-weekly monetary meetings, the publication of minutes, and the rotation of voting rights when Lithuania joins the euro in 2015, including effects on Dutch influence. The minister answers that rotation starts on 1 January 2015 under the Treaty, that meeting frequency does not change the rotation, that no date for the Dutch president's voting gap is yet published, and that a treaty change is not necessary.
No. The ECB has not yet published a decision on this.
Nee. De ECB heeft hier nog geen besluit over gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Parex-bank

Parliamentarian Omtzigt asks whether the Parex bank put option with the EBRD, and related Latvian transactions, were correctly recorded under ESA95 and whether Eurostat and the EBRD should be asked to revise or disclose them. The Minister answers that the transactions were correctly recorded, refuses further Eurostat or EBRD requests, and describes existing Commission verification powers.
The EBRD has indicated that it cannot disclose further specific information.
De EBRD heeft aangegeven geen verdere specifieke informatie openbaar te kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘Eneco laat particulieren beleggen in zijn windpark’

MPs Klever and Tony van Dijck asked the ministers about a report that Eneco lets private individuals invest in its wind park, including how the AFM checks and warns about risks, whether subsidised returns of 8 to 12% are possible, what happens to investors if subsidies or electricity prices fall. The minister answered that the AFM reviews prospectuses for completeness, consistency and comprehensibility, that the 8 to 12% figures were wrongly reported, that subsidy changes affect only new parks, and that the AFM oversees advertising but no advance warning was committed.
The AFM checks whether the prospectus is complete, consistent and comprehensible.
De AFM controleert of het prospectus volledig, consistent en begrijpelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het bericht ‘Frankrijk laat begrotingsdoel los’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that France was relaxing its deficit target, its growth and deficit forecasts versus April, and whether the Netherlands would push France on structural reform. The minister said the EU fiscal rules already allow flexibility, France must still show sufficient measures, and structural reform is discussed in Eurogroup and Ecofin without committing to a specific intervention.
The Dutch government is of the view that the European budget rules provide sufficient flexibility to take economic circumstances into account.
De Nederlandse regering is van mening dat de Europese begrotingsregels voldoende flexibiliteit bieden om rekening te houden met economische omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat Barclays wordt beticht van misleiding van institutionele beleggers

MP Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch institutional investors such as pension funds were harmed by reports that Barclays misled institutional investors through its dark pool, and whether dark pools exist in the Netherlands and how they are supervised. The minister replied that no signals of harm to Dutch investors had reached him, that no dark pools currently operate in the Netherlands, that AFM would supervise such venues if they existed, and described the new EU MiFID/MiFIR rules tightening dark pool trading.
At present, no dark pools are operated in the Netherlands.
Op dit moment worden er geen dark pools in Nederland geëxploiteerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de gevolgen van het Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP) en Trade in Services Agreement (TISA) voor financiële regulering

SP MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked about a leaked EU proposal on regulatory cooperation in financial services under TTIP and about the effects of TISA on financial regulation. Minister Ploumen answered that the EU aims only at institutional cooperation and consultation, not at weakening financial rules, and that TISA's financial provisions largely reaffirm existing GATS and standstill commitments.
Once enough parties have joined the TISA negotiations, I will also work to bring TISA under the WTO framework to safeguard the continuity of the global trading system.

Wanneer zich voldoende partijen bij de TISA-onderhandelingen hebben aangesloten, zal ik mij bovendien inzetten om TISA onder het raamwerk van de WTO te brengen om zo de continuïteit van het mondiale handelssysteem te waarborgen.

Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de Minister van Financiën over het bericht dat de Portugese overheid de Banco Espírito Santo (BES) redt met 4,9 miljard euro dat afkomstig is uit een Europees fonds (ingezonden 4 au

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the Portuguese rescue of Banco Espírito Santo with 4.9 billion euro from a European-linked fund, its causes, funding and whether the Netherlands had to consent. The minister answered that the rescue followed a capital breach, that private bail-in was applied to shareholders and subordinated creditors, that the funding came from the Portuguese resolution fund and a loan from the Portuguese state, and that the Netherlands did not need to consent since the facility is a Portuguese fund.
No, as indicated in the answers above, the Bank Solvency Support Facility is a Portuguese fund.
Nee, zoals in bovenstaande antwoorden is aangegeven is de Bank Solvency Support Facility een Portugees fonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat de Portugese overheid de Banco Espírito Santo (BES) redt

The MP asks the Finance Minister about the Portuguese state rescue of Banco Espírito Santo, including the supervisor's past actions, fraud, burden-sharing with private parties, debt effects, contagion risk and Dutch exposure. The minister answers mostly by cross-reference, describes the Portuguese central bank's supervisory steps, and says the operation does not change Portugal's debt and that Dutch risk runs only indirectly via EFSF, EFSM and IMF.
The Portuguese Central Bank found irregularities in the accounts of the parent company of Espírito Santo International (ESI) in an audit in 2013.
Meer specifiek heeft de Portugese Centrale Bank in een audit in 2013 onregelmatigheden in de rekeningen van het moederbedrijf van Espírito Santo International (ESI) geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het bericht dat de Portugese overheid de Banco Espírito Santo (BES) redt

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that Portugal is rescuing Banco Espírito Santo, including whether state aid was tested under EU rules, why junior creditors were not fully bailed in, and whether the bail-in principle agreed in Eurogroup/ECOFIN was respected. The Minister answered that the Commission found the BES resolution compliant with current state aid rules, and that losses fall on shareholders and subordinated bondholders.
Because losses on the bad assets fall on shareholders and subordinated bondholders, bail-in of private creditors takes place in line with the state aid rules.
Doordat verliezen op de slechte activa neerslaan bij de aandeelhouders en achtergestelde obligatiehouders vindt er bail-in plaats van private crediteuren confom de staatssteunregels.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Omtzigt en van Hijum over het Parex-schandaal in Letland

MPs Omtzigt and Van Hijum asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the rescue of Latvian bank Parex, alleged Russian dirty money, EBRD stakes in its successor Citadele, and lessons for Lithuania's euro entry. The government answered most questions by pointing to Latvian authorities, the Commission and the EBRD, stated that no Dutch loans or guarantees were used beyond a roughly 5% share of EU balance-of-payments aid, and declined to disclose EBRD due diligence and transaction details.
Beyond the information under questions 13 and 14, the EBRD has indicated that it cannot make further specific information public.
Buiten de informatie bij vraag 13 en14 heeft de EBRD aangegeven dat het verdere specifieke informatie niet openbaar kan maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het artikel ‘Banken vrezen ECB-toezicht’

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the ECB taking over bank supervision will raise risk weights on Dutch mortgages, forcing banks to hold billions more capital, and whether the ECB will properly weigh NHG and mortgage interest deduction. The minister replies that there are no signs the ECB intends to change risk weights, that DNB will stay closely involved, and that he sees no reason to take action.
There are currently no indications that the ECB would want to change the risk weighting of Dutch mortgages.
Er zijn op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat de ECB de risicoweging van Nederlandse hypotheken zou willen aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de beloningen bij vermogensbeheerders

MP Nijboer asks the Finance Minister whether he agrees with the AFM that asset managers should charge hourly rather than a percentage of assets, and whether such a fee is fairer and more transparent. The minister answers that fees must serve the client's interest, that the AFM does not require hourly pay but questions flat percentage fees, and that it is too early to draw conclusions on fee models.
In my view it is still too early to draw conclusions regarding the different forms of remuneration.
Het is mijn inziens nog te vroeg om conclusies te trekken ten aanzien van de verschillende vormen van beloning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat ING overweegt delen van haar hoofdkantoor te verhuizen naar Londen of Frankfurt

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether ING was considering moving parts of its head office abroad and whether DNB knew of such plans, and whether a state-aided bank should be leaving the Netherlands. The minister denied that ING was considering any relocation, stating the bank had said so directly.
No, I cannot confirm that. Following the press report in the FD, I was in contact with ING and the bank informed me that it is by no means considering moving its head office or parts thereof abroad.

Nee, dat kan ik niet bevestigen. Ik heb naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving in het FD contact gehad met ING en de bank heeft mij laten weten geenszins te overwegen het hoofdkantoor of delen daarvan naar het buitenland te verplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over de verhoging van het vaste salaris van de ABN AMRO top

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked whether ABN AMRO's 20% fixed-salary increase for its senior management, and its cost-to-income ratio, are acceptable given the minister's call for bank pay moderation. The minister replied that the salary rise is the bank's own responsibility, that the executive board decided without prior notice to him or NLFI, that pay can be lowered but wage setting belongs to employers and employees, and that Dutch personnel costs and cost-to-income ratios are high relative to the EU average.
As a shareholder, I am concerned with the remuneration policy of the executive board, not with the remuneration policy of senior management.
Als aandeelhouder ga ik over het beloningsbeleid van de RvB en niet over het beloningsbeleid van het senior management.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over de fors gestegen lonen van bankiers

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the Finance Minister why bank staff pay rose sharply, whether bonus caps are circumvented by higher fixed salaries, and whether talent-retention arguments justify this. The minister said pay setting is for employers and employees, that the bill targets variable pay rather than fixed pay, and that the talent argument is overstated, while giving limited data on how banks compensated staff.
Wage formation, however, is reserved for employers and employees. The government in principle plays no role in this.
De loonvorming is echter voorbehouden aan werkgevers en werknemers. De overheid speelt daar in beginsel geen rol bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over uitzondering provisieverbod

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the proposed exception to the commission ban for mortgage clients in payment difficulties risks abuse, how terms like 'payment arrears' are defined, what conditions apply, whether double payment and AFM enforcement are addressed, and when the ban will be evaluated. The minister defends the open norm, states safeguards (inducement norm, transparency, AFM enforcement), and commits to evaluating the ban around 2017.
The commission ban was introduced to bring about a shift from product-driven sales to client-oriented advice.
Het provisieverbod is ingevoerd om een beweging te bewerkstelligen van productgedreven verkoop naar klantgerichte advisering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het bericht dat IJsland Nederlandse spaarders niet wil uitbetalen

An MP asked the Dutch government whether it would push Iceland to release Icesave deposit funds to Dutch savers, including the 100,000+ savers, and what steps it was taking. The government answered that it urges Iceland to grant exemptions for future estate payouts, that Iceland's central bank has not yet decided on a fifth payout request, and that efforts benefit all preferred creditors equally, with about €617 million of principal still outstanding.
The cabinet considers it of the utmost importance that the Icelandic authorities grant exemption without delay for future estate payouts
Het kabinet vindt het inderdaad van het grootste belang dat de IJslandse autoriteiten zonder vertraging vrijstelling verlenen voor toekomstige boedeluitkeringen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Groot over het alarmerende bericht dat de integriteit van trustkantoren in het geding is

MPs Nijboer and Groot asked the Finance Minister about DNB findings that trust offices take unacceptable risks with Dutch limited partnerships (cv-structures), lack separation of functions and source-of-funds checks. The minister agrees the findings are worrying, points to new integrity rules (RibWtt 2014) effective 2015, and says tax avoidance via these structures falls outside last year's measures and is being addressed internationally.
Soon I will publish the new Regulation on Integrity of Business Operations under the Trust Offices Supervision Act (RibWtt 2014).
Binnenkort zal ik de nieuwe Regeling Integere Bedrijfsvoering Wet toezicht trustkantoren (RibWtt 2014) publiceren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de voorlichting van banken aan het midden- en kleinbedrijf (MKB) over de risico’s van derivaten zoals renteswaps naar aanleiding van de uitspraak van de rechtbank in Den Bosch

An MP asks the Finance Minister how banks inform SMEs about the risks of interest rate swaps, following a court ruling on a bank's duty of care, and whether execution-only sales should be allowed. The minister says banks must inform clients under existing MiFID/Wft rules, that the AFM found shortcomings and banks have committed to improvements, and that the AFM will review past sales and report.
The AFM will continue to closely monitor these developments.
De AFM blijft deze ontwikkelingen nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Harbers over een leningsverzoek van Curaçao ter grootte van 60 miljoen Antilliaanse Guldens

MPs Bosman and Harbers asked the Finance Minister about Curaçao's 60 million ANG loan request, the CFT's advice, whether the Rijkswet's conditions were met, why the Netherlands subscribes despite CFT concerns about financial management, and transparency of state-owned enterprises. The Minister answered that the CFT found the requirements met and advised positively, that Dutch subscription is mandatory under the Rijkswet, and that Aruba's protocol is not currently active.
On the basis of this assessment, the CFT gave positive advice on Curaçao's loan request.
Het Cft heeft op basis van deze toets positief geadviseerd over het leningverzoek van Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de overname van BEB door Gasunie

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers whether the Finance Ministry knew of the regulatory risks behind a 1.5 billion euro write-down on the BEB/Gasunie acquisition and whether the 2005 Gasunie share purchase overpaid. The minister answered that Finance was aware regulatory risk was important but judged its materialisation very unlikely, that the earlier denial was incorrect, and that the 2005 price was a negotiated outcome not an overpayment.
The Ministry of Finance was aware at the time of the acquisition that regulatory risk was an important risk.
Het Ministerie van Financiën was ten tijde van de overname op de hoogte van het feit dat het reguleringsrisico een belangrijk risico was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Madlener en Wilders over het bericht 'Mogelijk 300 miljoen extra naar Brussel'

PVV MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the cabinet budgets for EU payments beyond the 8 billion euro for next year, why the money goes to Brussels rather than domestic tax relief or elderly care, and whether he will leave the EU. The minister replied that the 2015 EU payments are estimated at 7.2 billion in the 2014 budget, that CBS revisions may affect them but cannot yet be quantified, that details will follow in the Spring Memorandum, referred to the Prinsjesdag budget documents for the rationale, and rejected leaving the EU.
In the Miljoenennota 2015 I will address the changes that occur in budget year 2015.
In de Miljoenennota 2015 zal ik ingaan op de mutaties die zich voordoen in het begrotingsjaar 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht "Grieken belazeren de boel opnieuw...."

Two PVV MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Greece's primary surplus is an illusion, whether Eurostat and member states knew of statistical manipulation, whether the pension fund holds 4.7 billion euro, and whether he will travel to Greece to reclaim loans. The minister denied the manipulation claims, citing Eurostat-confirmed deficit and debt figures and programme definitions, explained the social fund surplus as neutral state transfers, and declined to travel.
No, Eurostat has confirmed that for 2013 the Greek government deficit comes to 12.7% of GDP (incl. bank recapitalisation) and debt to 175.1% of GDP.
Nee, Eurostat heeft bevestigd dat voor 2013 het Griekse overheidstekort uitkomt op 12,7% BBP (incl. bankenherkapitalisatie) en de schuld op 175,1% BBP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Klaver over het voorkomen van witwassen van Russische vermogens

MPs Servaes and Klaver asked how the government implemented a motion calling for heightened vigilance against money laundering of Russian officials' and oligarchs' assets, and about Navalny's claims that Western police obstructed investigations and that 90% of Russian corruption money is laundered in the West. The minister replied that the Wwft's risk-based regime already requires heightened vigilance, that supervisors issued guidance and circulars, that FIUs cooperated on Ukraine and Russia, and that the government could not verify Navalny's claims, with the OM reporting no contact from Navalny's foundation.
Ultimately it is up to the institutions themselves to determine the degree of risk and which measures to take.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de instellingen zelf om de mate van het risico te bepalen en welke maatregelen men neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over KPMG en de mogelijke fraude bij de nieuwbouw van het hoofdkantoor

Two PvdA MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about alleged tax-return fraud by a KPMG-linked joint venture building KPMG's headquarters, and whether accountancy fraud is structural and calls for stricter rules. The minister declined to give details while the criminal investigation is ongoing, pointed to AFM supervision and recent reforms, and said the sector must change its culture.
Given that the criminal investigation is still ongoing, no further information can be provided on this matter.
Gelet op het feit dat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog gaande is, kunnen daarover geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over de werkwijze van afdelingen bijzonder beheer van banken

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the conduct of Dutch bank special-management departments toward SMEs, including transparency, AFM complaints, and whether oversight and the duty of care should be extended to small businesses. The minister answered that the UK Tomlinson findings are not representative for the Netherlands, that complaints are being monitored by the AFM, and that he does not intend to extend the general duty of care to small business clients for now.
I am therefore not currently intending to extend the general duty of care to (small) business clients.
Ik ben op dit moment dan ook niet voornemens om de algemene zorgplicht uit te breiden naar (klein)zakelijke klanten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat BinckBank Amerikanen uitsluit van een beleggingsrekening

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether BinckBank excluding US persons from investment accounts is justified under FATCA and the IGA, and whether this constitutes nationality discrimination. The minister answered that FATCA and the IGA do not justify excluding Americans on nationality alone, that the exclusion is based on tax liability, that the CRM opinion is non-binding, and that other banks are expected to comply without terminating services.
The College does not, however, issue a binding ruling but gives an opinion on whether the equal treatment act has been violated.
Het College doet overigens geen bindende uitspraak maar geeft een oordeel of de wet gelijke behandeling is overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over het bericht “scheepswerf Peters in Kampen vraagt faillissement aan”

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about the bankruptcy of shipyard Peters in Kampen, including whether a guarantee application under the shipbuilding finance guarantee scheme was rejected and how many guarantees had been granted. The minister confirmed the bank withdrew its offer after no sound post-delivery financing was arranged, that EZ/RVO did not grant a guarantee, that €44 million in guarantees were approved in 2013, and that the curator will assess options while UWV handles job placement for affected workers.
Early 2014 RVO received a request from the bank to agree to a changed financing structure.
Begin 2014 ontving RVO een verzoek van de bank om in te stemmen met een gewijzigde financieringsopzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de aanpak van flitshandel

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether high-frequency traders gain unfair advantages, distort prices, and whether research or regulation is needed. The minister answers that MiFID II and AFM supervision ensure a level playing field, that flash trading is not possible in Europe, and that ESMA is the appropriate body to study HFT further.
It is important that everyone has access to trading in financial instruments on regulated trading platforms under equal conditions.
Het is belangrijk dat iedereen onder gelijke voorwaarden toegang heeft tot de handel in financiële instrumenten op gereguleerde handelsplatformen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de verwerkingstermijn van betaaltransacties op weekenden en feestdagen

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Target2 closure on weekends and holidays, which delays card payment crediting, could be shortened, and whether banks could compensate merchants and assess damages and systemic risks. The Minister answered that Target2 cannot be extended to 365 days in the short term, that the matter is being studied with DNB via the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer with a report due in May, and that damages are unknown while banks do not compensate overdraft costs.
The consequences of the longer processing times for interest received and paid are not known.
De gevolgen van de langere verwerkingstijden voor te ontvangen en betalen rente zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas en Aukje de Vries over crowdfunding

MPs Lucas and Aukje de Vries asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about crowdfunding: the platforms licensed or exempted by the AFM, the difference between licences and exemptions, legal certainty, barriers, EU rules, investor caps and the scope for equity crowdfunding. The minister answered at length, describing the AFM regime, the planned review of the supervisory framework, and monitoring, while stating that current caps and rules stay in place for now.
I intend, together with the AFM, DNB and EZ, to re-examine the current supervisory framework for crowdfunding and to investigate whether the current regulation can be better tailored to crowdfunding.

Ik ben daarnaast voornemens om, in samenwerking met de AFM, DNB en EZ, het huidige toezichtkader voor crowdfunding opnieuw onder de loep te nemen en te onderzoeken of de huidige regelgeving nog beter op crowdfunding kan worden toegesneden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het akkoord over de Europese bankenunie

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the European banking union agreement: whether it accelerates pooling of national resolution funds, the fund's size and borrowing capacity, the Dutch contribution, bail-in rules, and the speed of resolution. The minister answers that the fund builds up over eight years to 1% of covered deposits (about 55 billion euro), with borrowing capacity and bail-in rules set out in the BRRD and SRM regulation, and the Dutch resolution authority remains involved in resolution decisions.
How much the fund can borrow cannot be stated with precision.
Hoeveel het fonds kan lenen is niet met precisie te zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat verzekeraars het provisieverbod schenden

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister how to respond to reports that insurers still pay commissions in breach of the commission ban, such as welcome bonuses, and whether the AFM is acting. The minister agrees such constructions are undesirable, notes the AFM has informed the market and engaged insurers who then stopped or will stop, and says the AFM cannot give an overview of individual institutions due to supervisory confidentiality.
The AFM cannot give an overview of individual institutions because it concerns supervisory-confidential information.
De AFM kan geen overzicht geven van individuele instellingen omdat het om toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mei Li Vos over de loonverdubbeling bij het overheidsbedrijf Enexis

MPs Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked the government about a reported salary doubling for the Enexis board, whether Enexis faces competition, whether it is a fully public company, and whether the WNT pay cap applies. The minister answered that Enexis falls under the 130% WNT cap, that the board letter was a consultation response on lowering the cap that some read as a pay-doubling proposal (which Enexis denies), that the grid operator is a regulated monopoly with tariffs set by the ACM, and that the company is a regular private-law NV owned by provinces and municipalities.
In any case, under the WNT it is not possible to set a salary increase that exceeds the maximum remuneration norm.
Het is op basis van de WNT in ieder geval niet mogelijk om een loonsverhoging vast te stellen waarmee de maximale bezoldigingsnorm wordt overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Koolmees over de conclusie van de Europese Rekenkamer dat de door de lidstaten verrichte verificaties van de EU-landbouwuitgaven niet betrouwbaar zijn

MPs Schouw and Koolmees asked the Finance Minister about the European Court of Auditors' finding that member states' verification of EU agricultural spending is unreliable, and whether the Commission's error rates given to Parliament are flawed. The minister acknowledged the criticism, said the verification gap has been legally remedied from 2015, and stated the Netherlands relies mainly on the Court's own figures rather than Commission statistics.
I am therefore pleased that the European Court of Auditors has devoted a specific audit to this subject regarding the Common Agricultural Policy.
Ik ben daarom verheugd dat de Europese Rekenkamer voor wat betreft het Gemeenschappelijke Landbouwbeleid een specifiek onderzoek heeft gewijd aan dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van Hijum en Keijzer over stijging van de zorgpremie

MPs Bruins Slot, Van Hijum and Keijzer asked why the CPB projects the nominal health insurance premium rising by EUR 144 to 2015 when the minister had claimed an increase of at most EUR 20 from the transfer of AWBZ care, and asked about funding, compensation and the own-risk increase. The minister answered that the EUR 20 figure covers only the transfer effect, that the remainder stems from the 50/50 rebalancing, reserves and autonomous cost growth, that the temporary state contribution is covered within the revenue framework, and that low-income households are fully compensated via the healthcare allowance, including for the own-risk rise.

The premium increase of at most EUR 20 mentioned in the letter of 4 March 2014 relates only to the expected rise in the nominal premium under the Health Insurance Act (Zvw) in 2015 due to the transfers.

De premiestijging van maximaal € 20 die wordt genoemd in de brief van 4 maart 2014 heeft enkel betrekking op de verwachte stijging van de nominale premie in de Zorgverzekeringswet (Zvw) in 2015 door de overhevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over de hypotheek van de president van de Nederlandsche Bank

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a favourable mortgage with an interest discount that the DNB president received, its size and compliance with rules, and whether such perks should be abolished or taxed. The minister confirmed a EUR 1.2 million mortgage meeting lending norms, defended the staff scheme as a permitted benefit, declined to discuss an individual taxpayer's tax position, and said the fiscal treatment would be reviewed in the Belastingplan 2015.
Questions from MP Tony van Dijck (PVV) to the Minister of Finance about the mortgage of the president of the Nederlandsche Bank
Vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck (PVV) aan de Minister van Financiën over de hypotheek van de president van de Nederlandsche Bank
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Nijboer over het bevriezen van Oekraïense tegoeden en het voorkomen van belastingontwijking via Nederland door de Oekraïense elite

MPs Servaes and Nijboer asked about the amount of Ukrainian assets frozen in the Netherlands and how the FIU reported only one suspicious transaction linked to Ukraine, and whether the government would investigate how the assets came to the Netherlands and improve supervision. The minister declined to give amounts or breakdowns citing secrecy rules, explained the separate legal procedures for freezing and reporting, and committed to examine the cases and feed the results into an anti-money-laundering policy monitor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat de Raad van Commissarissen van de Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) zich zorgen maakt over het toekomstige salaris van de directie van DNB

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that DNB's supervisory board is worried that the WNT pay cap will make it hard to attract and keep directors, and whether the board's concern is justified given the shift of supervision to the ECB. The minister rejects the concern, says the WNT leaves room for a sound pay structure with a case-by-case exemption, will not cut current directors' pay during their terms, and says the board will submit any new appointment pay decision to him for assessment.
At a new appointment or reappointment of a director, that will be the case. I will then assess that.
Bij een nieuwe benoeming of bij een herbenoeming van een directielid zal daarvan sprake zijn. Dat zal ik vervolgens beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over het bericht “ING geeft adverteerder inzicht in klantgedrag”

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven (D66) asked the government about reports that ING wanted to commercialise customers' payment data, and whether this is lawful under the Dutch data protection act and the sector code. The State Secretary answered that such use for third-party marketing is not explicitly covered by the code, that consent must be free, specific and informed, and that the Cbp and supervisors are critical, while leaving the question of ING's plans to ING and the supervisors.
A careless approach and poor communication could damage consumer trust in the banking sector.
Een onzorgvuldige aanpak en slechte communicatie kan het vertrouwen van de consument in de bancaire sector schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van Oosten over het bericht "ING geeft adverteerder inzicht in klantgedrag

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about ING's plan to give advertisers insight into customers' payment behaviour and whether it fits privacy rules and the Dutch banks' data code. The minister answered that consent and purpose-limitation rules apply, that the plan's scope is unclear and banks must demonstrate compliance, and that the privacy regulator may investigate but no ruling was given.
It is not for me, nor for the State Secretary of Security and Justice, to rule on compatibility with the Code of Conduct or the Wbp.
Het is niet aan mij noch aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie om een uitspraak te doen over de verenigbaarheid met de Gedragscode of de Wbp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat ING adverteerders inzicht wil bieden in klantgedrag

SP MPs Merkies and Gesthuizen asked the Finance Minister how he reacts to ING's plan to give advertisers insight into customer behaviour, and whether the pilot breaches privacy law, the sector code, consent rules and customer data ownership. The minister says he and the AFM and DNB are critical, that consent under the Wbp would be required for commercial use, that the Cbp is responsible for enforcement and may investigate, and that no further legal change seems necessary for now.
It is not for me nor for the State Secretary of Security and Justice to pronounce on compatibility with the Code of Conduct or the Wbp.
Het is niet aan mij noch aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie om een uitspraak te doen over de verenigbaarheid met de Gedragscode of de Wbp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over problemen met foute overschrijvingen met IBAN

An MP asked the Finance Minister about wrongly directed bank transfers under IBAN, including the lack of name checks and how to recover misdirected payments. The minister answered that IBAN's built-in check digit prevents most typing errors, that the misdirected-payment problem mainly arises during the dual period with converted old Postbank accounts, and that no bank duty of care exists for transfers, so the government sees no need to put the issue on the agenda of the next MOB meeting.
The use of IBAN is not the cause of incorrect transfers, but precisely a solution to them.
Het gebruik van het IBAN is niet de oorzaak van onjuiste overboekingen, maar juist een oplossing hiervoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de voortgang van het internationale onderzoek naar de prijsmanipulatie op de internationale valutamarkten

MP Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about the progress of international investigations into manipulation of currency benchmarks, Dutch banks' involvement, the Fideres report, enforcement under the new EU market abuse rules, and benchmark design. The Minister answered that DNB and AFM are investigating Dutch banks' benchmark risks, that the Fideres report is not public, that new sanctions and national legislation are coming, and that benchmark design principles are being pursued.
On the possible involvement of Dutch banks I cannot make any statements at this time because the investigation by DNB and AFM is still ongoing.
Over de eventuele betrokkenheid van Nederlandse banken kan ik op dit moment geen uitspraken doen omdat het onderzoek door DNB en AFM nog loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over “de goudclaim van Nederland op Zwitserland”

Parliamentarian Van Hijum (CDA) asked the Finance Minister whether the Dutch government had silently abandoned its gold claim against Switzerland, whether the Van Kemenade commission's conclusions on the claim were adopted, what efforts were made to recover the gold, and whether the government would take further steps or raise the matter with Switzerland. The minister answered that the Van Kemenade conclusions were fully adopted and no further legal steps will be taken, that past efforts are described in the commission report, and that the government sees no reason to reopen the matter now, while it will reassess if other countries act or new looted gold surfaces.
To the extent there may still be any uncertainty about this: the conclusions have been fully adopted by the Dutch government.
Voor zover daar nog onduidelijkheid over mocht bestaan: de conclusies zijn door de Nederlandse regering integraal overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over extra eisen Nederlandse banken

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Netherlands can set a national leverage ratio above the EU baseline for Dutch banks, how this fits with the planned Single Rulebook and ECB supervision, and over what timeframe such a rise should occur. The minister answered that member states may set stricter leverage ratios until an EU-wide rule applies from 2018, that the government aims for at least 4% for systemically relevant banks by 2018, and that DNB will assess the banks' multi-year capital plans.
The starting point is that the Dutch systemic banks must have brought the leverage ratio to at least 4% by 2018 at the latest.
Het uitgangspunt is dat de Nederlandse systeembanken uiterlijk in 2018 de leverage ratio naar minimaal 4% hebben gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het gebruik van levende dieren bij militaire oefeningen

Two MPs asked the government whether it condones live-animal military training such as shooting pigs and goat trauma drills, and whether Dutch soldiers take part in such training. The minister answered that the armed forces limit animal use as far as possible, that survival and trauma-surgery training uses pigs and rabbits or chickens under supervision, and that she cannot commit to ending such training for Dutch soldiers.
No, this information is not available.
Nee, deze informatie is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over Chinese schaduwbanken

An MP asked the Finance Minister about Chinese shadow banking and its risks to the world economy, its growth in China, the Netherlands and the EU, and whether regulation is being circumvented. The minister acknowledged the risks, gave growth figures and said he sees no current signs of regulatory evasion, while promising a separate letter on shadow banking regulation once international proposals are clearer.
As soon as there is more clarity on this, I will inform the House in a separate letter on this theme.
Zodra hier meer duidelijkheid over is, zal ik de Kamer middels een aparte brief nader informeren over dit thema.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Aukje de Vries en Mei Li Vos over premieverhogingen van arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen voor ZZP’ers

MPs Ziengs, Aukje de Vries and Mei Li Vos asked about insurers raising disability insurance premiums for self-employed workers via en-bloc clauses, including questions on legal limits, complaint routes, switching options and AFM oversight. The minister answered that insurers must apply such clauses reasonably and sparingly, that the AFM and DNB oversee communication and solvency, and that the AFM will explore the product's cost-efficiency and en-bloc use.
The AFM will, from its product oversight and product development process supervision, start an exploration into the use of the en bloc clause in disability insurance.

In het licht hiervan zal de AFM vanuit het toezicht op producten – en productontwikkelingsproces (PPP) een verkenning starten naar het gebruik van de en bloc clausule bij arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de kwaliteit van dienstverlening door banken en beleggingsondernemingen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the AFM study finding that investment services for wealthy clients often failed to match portfolios to client profiles, and about enforcement, remediation and whether clients can rely on advice. The minister said the AFM recommendations are enforceable under the Wft, that some firms have started remediation, that AFM will monitor compliance, and that it cannot name the firms due to confidentiality.
The AFM will closely monitor the extent to which banks and investment firms actually implement the promised remedial measures.
De AFM zal nauwkeurig monitoren in hoeverre banken en beleggingsondernemingen de toegezegde verbetermaatregelen ook daadwerkelijk implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de Leden Van Ojik en Klaver en Omtzigt over Oekraïense vermogens die in Nederland gestald worden en de rol die de Nederlandse ambassade hierin speelt

MPs Van Ojik, Klaver and Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch embassy in Kiev actively invited companies to a November 2013 seminar on investing in the Netherlands, whether attendees were linked to EU-sanctioned persons, and how trust offices and FIU reports relate to Ukrainian assets. The minister answered that the embassy did not actively approach companies, that the attendee list is not shared for privacy reasons, that no sanctioned person attended, and that embassy promotion events and trust office presentations are not centrally registered.
These reports of unusual transactions are then assessed by FIU, and based on the information available to FIU, FIU may decide to report the unusual transactions as suspicious to law enforcement.

Deze meldingen van ongebruikelijke transacties worden vervolgens door FIU beoordeeld en op basis van de bij FIU beschikbare informatie kan FIU besluiten de ongebruikelijke transacties als verdacht door te melden aan de opsporing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Albert de Vries over de aansturing van het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam

MPs Mei Li Vos and Albert de Vries asked the Finance Minister about the governance of the Port of Rotterdam Authority, including whether public interests are safeguarded, whether statutes should be amended, comparisons with neighbouring countries, land control and dividend levels. The minister replied that the state as shareholder already protects public interests through the statutes and the Nota Deelnemingenbeleid, rejected changes such as restricting shareholders to governments, and explained that dividend payments follow fixed agreements, giving a payout ratio of around 36-46% rather than 20%.
Where that is still insufficiently the case, I will adjust the statutory purpose in consultation with the co-shareholder Municipality of Rotterdam and the company.
Waar dat nog onvoldoende het geval is, zal ik de doelomschrijving in overleg met de medeaandeelhouder Gemeente Rotterdam en de onderneming aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver en Omtzigt over Oekraïense vermogens die in Nederland gestald worden en de rol die de Nederlandse ambassade hierin speelt

MPs Van Ojik, Klaver and Omtzigt asked about trust offices and the Dutch embassy in Kiev hosting a November seminar on the Dutch fiscal climate, including whether the presentations fit OECD substance rules, whether they would be shared, the guest list, and the number of anti-money-laundering reports on Ukrainian funds. The minister answered that the seminar was a public event within embassy tasks, that none of the 18 EU-sanctioned persons attended, that FIU-Nederland received 1475 linked transactions and two unusual trust-office reports, and that gatekeepers self-police under DNB supervision, while leaving several questions (presentations, guest list) unanswered.
The Cabinet is of the view that facilitating this meeting falls within the standing mandate of the embassies.
Het Kabinet is van mening dat het faciliteren van deze bijeenkomst past binnen de staande taakopdracht van de ambassades.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het artikel ‘Gemeente verhult grondverliezen met dubieuze boekhoudtrucs’

Van Hijum (CDA) asked the ministers of Finance and Interior whether municipalities hide land-development losses through accounting tricks, including reclassifying investments, low interest charges, stretched sale horizons, off-balance PPS risks and the size of write-downs. Minister Plasterk answered that municipalities appear to act within the BBV rules as far as provincial supervisors can judge, referred to Deloitte figures, and saw no reason for further action.
As far as I can judge, based on information we receive from the provincial supervisors, municipalities act within the framework of the regulations.
Voor zover ik kan beoordelen – op basis van de informatie die wij verkrijgen van de provinciale toezichthouders – handelen gemeenten binnen de kaders van de regelgeving.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Hijum over de berichten dat online met aanschaf van bitcoins een semi-automatisch wapen is aangeschaft en een tiener zichzelf gedood heeft met een omgebouwd pistool

MPs Oskam and Van Hijum asked about reports that an illegal semi-automatic weapon was bought online with bitcoins and a teenager died from a converted pistol, including what has been done to tighten firearms law, border controls, international cooperation and online arms trade. The minister answered that prior measures concerned legal gun ownership, that border scanning is overwhelmed by volume but being strengthened, that existing enforcement is adequate, and that existing laws and an upcoming bill address online weapon trade, while declining to ban bitcoin.

Yes, the Computer Crime III bill, which I expect to be able to send to the Council of State within a reasonable time, provides among other things for creating an explicit statutory power for the police to enter a computer remotely.

Ja, het wetsvoorstel Computercriminaliteit III, dat ik binnen afzienbare termijn naar de Raad van State verwacht te kunnen sturen, voorziet onder andere in het creëren van een expliciete wettelijke bevoegdheid voor de politie om op afstand een computer te betreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over het EenVandaag onderzoek naar zogenaamde babbeltrucs

MP Baay-Timmerman asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Finance about the EenVandaag findings on babbeltrucs targeting the elderly, including low reporting rates, the lack of a national approach, and whether banks should share one easy card-blocking number. The minister replied that no own figures on prevalence exist, pointed to reporting-improvement measures and prevention, rejected a national coordinated approach as unnecessary, and said the Finance minister saw no reason to negotiate a single blocking number with banks.
As I answered in earlier parliamentary questions on this subject, I do not have my own figures on the scale of this phenomenon.
Zoals ik heb geantwoord op eerdere Kamervragen over dit onderwerp beschik ik niet over eigen cijfers over de omvang van dit fenomeen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het Europese bankenresolutiefonds

Green Left MP Klaver asks whether the intergovernmental treaty underpinning the European banking resolution fund breaches EU law principles such as loyal cooperation, institutional balance, democracy, standstill and equal treatment, and whether the Court of Justice's short-selling ruling undermines the Meroni objection to Article 114 TFEU. The government answers that the intergovernmental route is lawful because the matter falls within shared competence not yet exercised by the Union, that the Court of Justice and European Parliament retain oversight roles, and that it sees no need to seek separate advice from the Council of State.
According to the cabinet, the intergovernmental approach does not conflict with the principles mentioned.
Volgens het kabinet is de intergouvernementele aanpak niet in strijd met de genoemde beginselen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over een mogelijk nieuw steunpakket voor Griekenland

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether a new Greek support package was discussed at the Eurogroup and Ecofin, whether the Troika found a 15 billion euro financing gap, and whether a 10-20 billion package is being prepared, and why debt restructuring is excluded. The minister answered that no new package was discussed on 27 January, the Troika has not concluded on a financing gap, a possible new package can only be assessed later in 2014, and no third package has been discussed yet.
No, that is not correct. At the Eurogroup of 27 January we discussed progress in implementing the current Greek loan programme.
Nee dat klopt niet. Tijdens de Eurogroep van 27 januari jl. hebben we gesproken over de voortgang van de implementatie van het huidige Griekse leningenprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries (over het bericht tienduizenden huizen nog altijd onverkoopbaar door erfpacht

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked about reports that tens of thousands of homes on leasehold land remain unsaleable because banks refuse financing. The minister defends the banking guideline agreed between the notaries and the banks as self-regulation, says he will consult stakeholders shortly, and rules out bringing leasehold contracts under financial supervision or declaring the guideline generally binding.
I will shortly consult with the parties involved about the outcomes of this evaluation.
Ik zal op korte termijn in overleg treden met betrokken partijen over de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Bouwmeester over de transparantie van de lobbypraktijken van Nederlandse banken

MPs Nijboer and Bouwmeester asked whether the government would adopt SOMO's recommendations on transparency of Dutch banks' lobbying, including a 'lobby paragraph' in each bill, and whether similar transparency should apply to business generally. The minister replied that banks should implement recommendations themselves, that the government supports transparent accountability of stakeholder influence, and that consultation reports already function as such a lobby paragraph.
The cabinet therefore endorses the importance of transparent accountability for the influence of stakeholders on the policy process.
Het kabinet onderschrijft derhalve het belang van transparante verantwoording over die invloed van belanghebbenden op het beleidsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘De Nederlandsche Bank verliest € 6,2 miljard op goudbelegging’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that De Nederlandsche Bank lost €6.2 billion on its gold holdings, the current gold value, whether dividends or the 2014 budget are affected, the timing of physical gold checks, the storage locations, and whether the gold should be repatriated. The minister confirmed the €7.6 billion market value drop, said it is absorbed by the revaluation reserve without affecting dividends, reported annual physical checks with no discrepancies, listed the storage split, and declined to ask DNB to repatriate the gold.
I see no reason to ask DNB to bring its gold back to the Netherlands.
Ik zie geen reden om DNB te verzoeken haar goud terug te halen naar Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over KPMG en de steekpenningenaffaire van Ballast Nedam

MPs Nijboer and Recourt asked the Ministers of Finance and Justice about KPMG's role in the Ballast Nedam bribery affair, the AFM's handling of it, and accountant oversight. The minister answered that the AFM helped arrange a gradual handover of the 2012 audit, that the criminal investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed in detail, and that existing rules already cover integrity and fraud signalling, with a response to a pending motion promised.
To avoid harming this ongoing investigation, I cannot answer the specific questions you ask at this time.
Om dit nog lopende onderzoek niet te schaden kan ik de specifieke vragen die u stelt nu niet beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Merkies (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over de introductie van een overlijdensrisicoverzekering op basis van postcode (ingezonden 12 december 2012).

MP Merkies (SP) asked the Finance Minister whether premiums for a death-risk insurance based on postcode are acceptable and whether such postcode-based selection amounts to discrimination, and asked what measures would follow. Minister Dijsselbloem answered by sending the College voor de Rechten van de Mens advice, which found an indirect distinction by origin with an objective justification, so it is not prohibited, and said he will keep following developments critically.
It is important that they have ruled on this situation. I will of course continue to critically follow future developments in premium differentiation.
Het is belangrijk dat zij over deze situatie een uitspraak heeft gedaan. Ik zal toekomstige ontwikkelingen op het gebied van premiedifferentiatie uiteraard kritisch blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het verwijderen van geldautomaten en het sluiten van bankkantoren, met name in de kleinere gemeenten

MP Merkies asked the Finance Minister about the disappearance of over 1,000 bank branches and ATMs and the accessibility of cash services, especially in small municipalities, and whether minimum banking provision should be agreed. The minister answered that nearly all Dutch residents remain within five kilometres of a bank facility, that digital banking and retail cash options have grown, and that no agreement on minimum provision is currently warranted, though the situation will be monitored via the MOB.
I do not have an overview of the decline in the number of ATMs at municipal level.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van de afname van het aantal geldautomaten op gemeenteniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over storingen en fraude bij online bankieren

An MP asked the Finance Minister about online banking outages, fraud losses, bank compensation practices, the ECB security recommendations and the burden of proof on consumers under civil code rules. The Minister answered that no fixed availability norm exists, that DNB monitors resilience, that banks are working toward ECB recommendations, and that liability for gross negligence is for courts to decide.
I do not have the percentage of fraud cases in which the bank compensated the damage, nor the percentage of cases still ongoing.
Ik beschik niet over het percentage van fraudegevallen waarbij de bank de schade heeft gecompenseerd en een percentage van welke zaken nog lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vries over het bericht bedrijven krijgen meer tijd voor overgang naar SEPA en goede doelen vrezen daling giften door langere IBAN-nummers

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that the SEPA migration deadline might be extended to 1 August 2014 and that charities fear fewer donations due to longer IBAN numbers. The minister answered that charities and banks are addressing the issue through the NFS working group, that the government will not use the member-state option to delay consumer migration, and that conversion services are only permitted until the deadline.
In my view, it is therefore not a given that the number of donations to charities will fall due to the longer 555 account number.
Mijns inziens is het daarom geen gegeven dat het aantal giften voor goededoelenorganisaties zal dalen door het langere 555 rekeningnummer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat Rabobank-topman Sipko Schat vertrekt met bijna negen ton

The PVV MP Tony van Dijck asked whether it is acceptable that Rabobank executive Sipko Schat, not prosecuted in the LIBOR affair, receives a severance of nearly nine million euros, and why the US can charge former Rabobank traders while the Netherlands does not. The Minister of Finance answers that the Public Prosecution Service found no criminal conduct by Schat, that the severance is a bank matter subject to DNB supervision of remuneration rules, and that the Dutch criminal investigation into former staff is ongoing and coordinated with US authorities.
The criminal investigation in the Netherlands has not yet been concluded.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in Nederland is nog niet afgerond.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde, Bosman en Aukje De Vries over het bericht dat de aanleg van glasvezel in Caribisch Nederland twee keer duurder is dan begroot en volledig door de Nederlandse belastingbetaler wo

MPs from the VVD asked why the Caribbean Netherlands submarine fibre cable cost roughly double its budget, why the state took on extra costs, and why it became a shareholding in SSCS B.V. without prior parliamentary approval. The minister replied that costs exceeded the original estimate by about EUR 8.9 million (not a doubling), that the extra funds covered redundancy and protection, that the shareholding was a transitional choice under the Comptabiliteitswet, and that the company is non-profit with cost-based tariffs.
With my letter of 9 December I aimed to align as closely as possible, albeit retrospectively, with the normal procedure of Article 34.
Met mijn brief van 9 december jl. heb ik beoogd zoveel mogelijk, zij het achteraf, aan te sluiten bij de normale procedure van artikel 34.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘Rijken sluizen 54 miljard weg’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that wealthy Greeks moved 54 billion euro abroad to avoid tax, and about the slow handling of the Lagarde list of Greek tax evaders. The minister said the government shares concern about the pace of the investigation, pressed the Greek authorities, and promised to address the issue in the next progress report.
Greece is itself responsible for criminal prosecution of possible tax evasion.
Griekenland is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de strafrechtelijke vervolging van mogelijke belastingontduiking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over beleggingen in tabaksaandelen door pensioenfondsen en banken

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Health and the Finance Minister whether Dutch pension funds (notably ABP) and state-owned banks (SNS, ABN AMRO) investing in tobacco shares conflicts with FCTC article 5.3 and related recommendations, and whether the government would intervene. The government answered that pension funds and banks are responsible for their own investment policy, that the FCTC recommendations are not binding, that tobacco investment is legal and not excluded by law, and that it sees no reason to instruct ABP, while pointing to existing CSR transparency policy for state holdings.
It is not the government's task to monitor and assess the specific investments of individual funds.
Het is niet de taak van het kabinet specifieke beleggingen van individuele fondsen te monitoren en te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht "Europese accountantsregels wijken af van de Nederlandse wet"

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Finance how the Dutch audit rules on mandatory firm rotation and separation of audit and advisory differ from the EU accountancy agreement reached in December 2013. The minister explained the EU deal, noted the Dutch rules largely fit within it except the cooling-off period, and committed to report to parliament before the 2016 rotation deadline.
Once the European rules are definitively established, we will have to adopt national legislation to implement them.
Zodra de Europese regels definitief vaststaan, zullen we nationale regelgeving moeten vaststellen om deze te implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de financiële fragmentatie van het bankenlandschap in Europa

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that German supervisors restrict Dutch banks from funding Dutch loans with German deposits, and about the effects on interest rates and the banking union. The Minister said no general ban exists under CRD-IV, that national supervisors can restrict intragroup liquidity transfers, and that the banking union should reduce fragmentation.
I am not aware of a general ban imposed by the German supervisor on Dutch banks using German deposits to fund loans in the Netherlands.
Ik ben niet bekend met een algeheel verbod voor Nederlandse banken van de Duitse toezichthouder om Duitse deposito’s te gebruiken voor het uitzetten van leningen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de uniforme veiligheidsregels voor online bankieren

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the uniform security rules for online banking agreed between the Dutch Banking Association and the Consumentenbond, including their legal status, whether they shift liability onto customers, and phishing losses. The minister replied that the rules are voluntary agreements that do not alter the statutory burden of proof on banks, that courts decide on gross negligence, and that banks decide on any voluntary compensation.
From articles 7:524 and 7:529 of the Civil Code it follows that the burden of proof for intentional conduct or gross negligence of the consumer rests with the bank.
Uit de artikelen 7:524 en 7:529 BW volgt dat de bewijslast voor opzettelijk handelen of grove nalatigheid van de consument op de bank rust.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bosman over het advies van de SER van Sint Maarten om de Antilliaanse Gulden in te ruilen voor de US Dollar

Two MPs asked the Dutch ministers about the Sint Maarten SER advice to dollarize the Antillean guilder, including the Curaçao-Sint Maarten current account deficit, devaluation risks, and effects on BES islands. The government replied that dollarization is not currently planned, that the matter is for the countries themselves, and that it will share Dutch experience with Sint Maarten.
The peg between the Antillean guilder and the US dollar is a matter for the countries themselves.
De koppeling tussen de Antilliaanse gulden en de US Dollar is een aangelegenheid van de landen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over het provisieverbod en kosten voor preventief advies bij dreigende betalingsachterstanden

Koolmees (D66) asked the Finance Minister whether banks and intermediaries may charge advisory fees for preventive advice to clients facing payment arrears on their mortgages, and whether a legal basis exists for such fees. The minister answered that under the advice-fee rules fees generally need not be charged for servicing talks with existing clients about foreseeable arrears, since these aim at a payment arrangement rather than a new contract, and that the AFM has published guidance on this.
Banks do not need to charge advisory costs to the client for such servicing talks because the talks are not aimed at concluding a (new) agreement.
Banken hoeven voor dergelijke beheergesprekken geen advieskosten in rekening te brengen bij de klant omdat de gesprekken niet gericht zijn op het tot stand brengen van een (nieuwe) overeenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer inzake het gebruik van en toezicht op nieuwe digitale betaalmiddelen zoals de Bitcoin

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether financial supervision of digital currencies such as Bitcoin is adequate, whether e-money definitions should change, and how money laundering risks are limited. The minister replies that Bitcoin falls outside financial supervision, sees no need for legislative change now, warns consumers of the risks, and says regulators will monitor developments and act if needed.
For now there does not appear to be a need to amend the law on this.
Vooralsnog lijkt er geen noodzaak te bestaan de wet hierop aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het investeringsfonds BlackRock

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether BlackRock was hired to advise on the sale of ING's Alt-A mortgages and to revalue Dutch bank property portfolios, and whether its investments and advisory role create conflicts of interest. The minister confirmed the advisory roles, stated that BlackRock's stakes are held for clients largely in passive funds, and explained that Chinese Walls separate its advisory and investment arms.
Between these branches of a company such as BlackRock there are so-called Chinese Walls to prevent conflicts of interest or misuse of confidential business information.
Tussen deze takken van een onderneming als BlackRock staan zogenaamde Chinese Walls om te voorkomen dat belangenverstrengeling kan plaatsvinden of bedrijfsgevoelige informatie misbruikt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het gebrekkige monitoren van transacties door trustkantoren

The SP MP Merkies asked the Finance Minister about weak transaction monitoring and unreported unusual transactions by trust offices, citing DNB findings and a possible money-laundering probe. The minister acknowledged DNB's findings that monitoring does not always fit client risk profiles, listed formal measures and FIU report counts, and said an ongoing investigation could not be discussed.
No statements can be made about possibly ongoing criminal investigations.
Over mogelijk lopende opsporingsonderzoeken kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over uiteindelijke-belanghebbendenregisters in relatie tot de herziening van de derde anti-witwasrichtlijn

An MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about beneficial-ownership registers in the EU anti-money-laundering directive, including whether such a register should be public. The minister answered that the Netherlands prefers a central shareholder register accessible only to authorised public bodies and notaries, not the public, and that the UBO content is still under discussion in the Council.
The Netherlands sees more in a central shareholder register.
Nederland ziet meer in een centraal aandeelhoudersregister.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over de 3VO kaart

MPs Mulder and Van Hijum asked the ministers whether a prepaid 3V card topped up via beltegoed.nl and billed later to the phone bill, and whether AFM and DNB pass responsibility to each other. The minister answered that DNB and AFM share supervision, that AFM is examining whether such top-ups amount to credit, that ABN AMRO and 3V have blocked the method and launched an internal inquiry, and that the minister will raise the issue in the EU e-money directive evaluation.
DNB and the AFM cannot make statements about investigations into individual companies and products.
DNB en AFM kunnen geen mededelingen doen over onderzoeken naar individuele ondernemingen en producten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de stevige kritiek van de ESMA op kredietbeoordelaars

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about ESMA's criticism of credit rating agencies on independence, conflicts of interest, leaked sovereign ratings, delayed publication and resourcing, and its implications for ratings' quality, bank capital rules, competition and enforcement. The minister acknowledged the findings as serious, said ESMA will keep monitoring and that EU rules may be tightened later, while deferring to ESMA on compliance and noting limited direct reliance of Dutch banks on external ratings.
It is therefore important that ESMA continues to monitor progress to ensure that credit rating agencies address the identified points.
Het is daarom van belang dat ESMA de voortgang blijft volgen om er zeker van te zijn dat kredietbeoordelaars de gesignaleerde punten oppakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Ulenbelt over investeringen in de kernwapenindustrie

MPs from the SP asked whether the government would discourage or ban investment by Dutch banks and pension funds in nuclear weapons producers, following an IKV Pax Christi report. The minister replied that financial institutions are responsible for their own investment policies, that the government will not amend the legal framework, and that no ban is being considered.
Pension funds and banks are primarily themselves responsible for their investment policy.
Pensioenfondsen en banken zijn primair zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over Nederlandse financiële instellingen die investeren in kernwapens

An MP asks whether the government will restrict Dutch financial institutions, including the ABP pension fund and ABN AMRO, from investing in nuclear weapons producers, and whether it will pressure them to stop. The government answers that the NPT does not ban such investment, that institutions bear their own responsibility under national law, that no ban is being considered, and that it sees no added value in raising the issue again with ABP.
With reference to the answer to question 1, no ban on investing in companies that manufacture nuclear weapon components is being considered.
Onder verwijzing naar het antwoord bij vraag 1 wordt er geen verbod inzake het investeren in bedrijven die onderdelen voor kernwapens maken overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over banken die geen producten verkopen na onafhankelijk advies

An MP asked whether banks that only sell their products to clients who also take an advice meeting with them, and whether consumers with independent advice can buy at any bank without extra advice costs, and what options exist for market improvement. The Minister answered that consumers are free to choose where to get advice, that banks must charge advice costs directly, that double payment can be disproportionate, and that the AFM will talk with market parties while the government monitors the market after the commission ban.
Consumers are free to decide where they want to obtain advice, just as providers are free to organise the distribution of a financial product within the applicable legal framework.

Het staat de consument vrij om te besluiten waar hij een advies wil afnemen, net als het aanbieders vrij staat om – binnen de daarvoor geldende wettelijke kaders – de distributie van een financieel product in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Klein over de schenkingsvrijstelling en boeterente

MPs Omtzigt and Klein asked the government whether banks would waive early-repayment penalties when mortgages are repaid with gifts under the temporarily expanded gift-tax exemption, and whether ABN AMRO's conditions contradict earlier letters to parliament. The Minister replied that banks have implemented the call differently (ABN AMRO and ING for underwater mortgages, Rabobank and SNS for gifts up to 100,000 euro), that penalty waiver is a bank decision, and that he would answer the remaining questions before the vote on the Tax Plan.
Providers have therefore given different interpretations to the cabinet's call.
Aanbieders hebben derhalve op een verschillende manier invulling gegeven aan de oproep van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het feit dat Blackrock vastgoed gaat keuren waar het zelf belang in heeft

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether DNB's hiring of BlackRock Solutions to audit Dutch bank real-estate portfolios, while BlackRock holds stakes in ING, creates conflict of interest. The minister replied that BlackRock's advisory arm is walled off from its investment arm, the contract contains strict safeguards, and DNB sets the valuation methodology, so no conflict is found.

Because of the sensitive nature of the examination BlackRock Solutions will carry out, the contract between DNB and BlackRock Solutions contains strict conditions to prevent misuse of information and to contain any risks of conflicts of interest.

Vanwege de gevoelige aard van het onderzoek dat BlackRock Solutions zal uitvoeren, zijn in het contract tussen DNB en BlackRock Solutions zware condities opgenomen om misbruik van informatie te voorkomen en eventuele risico's van belangenverstrengeling in te dammen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Groot over het bericht dat de Rabobank heeft aangekondigd de Liborboete in mindering te brengen op de nettowinst van de bank

MPs Nijboer and Groot asked whether Rabobank may deduct a Libor fine from its taxable profit, and how that squares with the rule that fines are non-deductible. The State Secretary declined to discuss an individual taxpayer, explained that foreign fines are in principle deductible unlike Dutch fines, and said he is considering proposing that foreign fines also be non-deductible in a letter to parliament.
I am therefore considering proposing that foreign fines also no longer be allowed as a deduction.
Ik overweeg daarom voor te stellen ook buitenlandse boetes niet langer in aftrek toe te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Albert de Vries over de kosten van een hypotheek in krimpgebieden

Two MPs asked whether mortgages are more expensive in shrinking regions, whether this lowers housing demand, and whether lenders may impose such costs given mortgage rules and the tax deduction. The minister answered that the NVM and lenders do not recognise higher rates in specific regions, that rates reflect demonstrable risk, and that lenders' code bars refusing applications solely on location.

Lenders have, through the Mortgage Lending Code of Conduct, committed to the rule that the mere fact that the mortgaged home is located in a particular district or postcode area may not be grounds to reject the application in its entirety.
