Financiers hebben zich middels de Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financieringen wel gebonden aan de bepaling dat het enkele feit dat de hypothecair te verbinden woning is gelegen in een bepaalde wijk of postcodegebied geen grond mag zijn om de aanvraag in zijn geheel af te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘Rabobank schikt in Libor-affaire voor €774 miljoen’

An MP asked the Finance Minister why most of Rabobank's 774 million euro Libor settlement goes to US and UK regulators and only 10% to the Dutch Public Prosecution Service, and how the money is spent. The minister answered that each authority settled separately under its own framework, that the Dutch prosecution received 70 million euro booked under Justice and Security, and that Dutch authorities have not settled with other banks for Libor/Euribor manipulation due to jurisdictional limits.
For the Dutch Public Prosecution Service, a transaction was concluded with Rabobank under which Rabobank pays 70 million euro.
Voor het Nederlandse Openbaar Ministerie (OM) geldt dat zij met de Rabobank een transactie is aangegaan waarbij de Rabobank een betaling doet van € 70 mln.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘Rabo ongekend hard veroordeeld voor fraude’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the Rabobank Libor manipulation case, including the resignation of only the chair, the limited clawback of bonuses, disciplinary measures against traders, and tax consequences of the settlement. The minister answered that bonuses were partly held back and clawback was judged unlikely to succeed, announced a bonus-policy bill, and declined to give tax information about individual taxpayers.
Based on the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, I cannot provide information about individual taxpayers.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik geen informatie geven over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over het niet afbouwen van staatssteun aan ING

MP Koolmees asks the Finance Minister about the Alt-A mortgage portfolio guaranteed for ING, whether it is above break-even, whether it will be sold, and the costs and proceeds to the state. The minister states the portfolio's market value exceeds the remaining obligation to ING, refers to a separate letter for the sale question, and gives a cost overview with expected net gain of about EUR 800 million.
For the answer to these questions I refer you to the letter to the House on winding down state support for ING that I sent on 1 November.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u naar de kamerbrief «afbouw staatssteun ING» die ik op 1 november aan de Tweede Kamer heb verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum inzake de Facebook-actie "Banken weigeren betalingsverkeer te beveiligen"

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a Facebook campaign claiming banks refuse to secure payment transfers and how often citizens send money to wrong account numbers. The minister said exact figures are unknown but errors are limited due to check digits, and that banks should decide on name-number checks, noting the move to IBAN; disputes are left to bank-customer agreement or KiFiD.
Exact figures on how often citizens unintentionally transfer money to an incorrect account number are not known to me.
Exacte cijfers over het aantal keer dat burgers onbedoeld geld overmaken naar een foutief rekeningnummer zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Maij inzake de uitspraken van de president van de Europese Centrale Bank over het ontzien van junior obligatiehouders

Two PvdA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the ECB president's letter urging that junior bondholders be spared losses in bank rescues conflicts with Dutch aims to push risks onto banks and markets, and whether the bail-in agreement, stress test and state aid exception would be weakened. The minister answered that he supports the Commission's state aid rules, that the BRRD bail-in agreement is unaffected, and that the exception would apply only in very exceptional circumstances.
I attach great importance to sparing taxpayers from the costs of problems at banks.
Ik hecht grote waarde aan het ontzien van de belastingbetaler van de kosten van problemen bij banken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over belastingheffing op de Amsterdamse beurs door Frankrijk en Italië

An SP MP asked the Finance Ministry whether French and Italian transaction taxes on shares listed in Amsterdam are legitimate, whether the revenue can flow to the Dutch treasury, and whether the tax can be credited against Dutch box 3 tax. The State Secretary confirmed the taxes apply, said they are legally permissible without a basis for sharing revenue, and said they cannot be credited against box 3.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over de dienstverlening van banken aan het midden- en kleinbedrijf (MKB) bij het afsluiten van rentederivaten

Parliamentary questions from MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about the AFM finding that banks serving SME clients insufficiently inform them on interest rate derivatives, whether banks circumvent the duty of care, compensation for harmed firms, bank liability, and access to the Kifid complaints body. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the AFM will conduct follow-up research and monitor bank improvements, declined to commission damage assessment for now, deferred liability to civil courts, and saw no current need to widen Kifid access.
The AFM will follow up on this exploration.
De AFM zal aan deze verkenning een vervolg geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over de creatieve wijze van kapitaalversterking door Spaanse en Italiaanse banken

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about Spanish and Italian banks seeking accounting relief, such as converting deferred tax assets into tax credits and revaluing Bank of Italy shares, and how buffer manipulation and state aid rules would be policed. The minister answered that supervisors have enforcement powers, that tax credits can count as core capital under CRD-IV while profit-dependent deferred tax assets cannot, that the ECB and EBA will oversee the matter, and that the Commission would assess any state aid or fiscal impact.
I do not have sufficient information to assess whether a possible revaluation of this share would be in line with the CRD-IV agreements, partly because there is no concrete proposal.

Ik beschik niet over voldoende informatie om in te schatten of een eventuele herwaardering van dit aandeel in lijn zou zijn met de afspraken van CRD-IV, mede vanwege het ontbreken van een concreet voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over pensioenen

An MP asked how many Dutch residents are entitled to and receive Greek state pensions, how many have sought SVB help, and whether the government has contacted other countries or Greece. The State Secretary answered that the government lacks data on entitlements and payments, has received only a few signals, and sees no need for further action, while noting that collecting the pension is the pensioner's own responsibility.
I do not know how many people residing in the Netherlands are entitled to a pension from the Greek state.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel personen die woonachtig zijn in Nederland recht hebben op een pensioen van de Griekse staat.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Koolmees over het bericht dat de servers van de Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) mogelijk zijn afgetapt door de NSA

MPs Schouw and Koolmees asked ministers whether the NSA tapped SWIFT servers, including any server in the Netherlands, and what the government would do about it, including the EU-US TFTP programme. The government said it cannot confirm the report, SWIFT found no evidence of unauthorised access, the Commission has asked US authorities for clarification, and it sees no reason to suspend the TFTP agreement for now.
However, I cannot confirm the accuracy of that report.
Ik kan de juistheid van dat bericht echter niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over toezicht en regels verzekeraars

MP Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister whether insurers' complaint that DNB supervision is too strict is valid, whether Dutch rules are the strictest in Europe, whether the Netherlands is ahead of Solvency II, whether DNB is stricter on the discount rate, and what the effects on investment and competitiveness are. The minister denied that Dutch rules are the strictest or that the Netherlands is alone in anticipating Solvency II, explained the planned tightening (a theoretical solvency criterion limiting dividends of life insurers) as giving DNB more tools, and said insurers will not invest less due to buffers.
With the theoretical solvency criterion, DNB will namely receive more tools to block dividend payments by life insurers if this should prove necessary.
Met het theoretische solvabiliteitscriterium krijgt DNB namelijk meer handvatten om dividenduitkeringen van levensverzekeraars tegen te houden indien dit nodig mocht zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Krol en Klein over het ontbreken van bereidheid bij banken om boeterente  bij vervroegde aflossing van hypotheken te laten vervallen

MPs Krol and Klein asked the Finance Minister whether banks should drop early-repayment penalty interest on mortgages, given negative equity and the expanded gift-tax exemption. The minister answered that the penalty is a legitimate compensation for lost interest, that some banks (SNS, ABN AMRO) are considering waiving it when the exemption is used, and that he has asked banks to do so.
As is known, I have asked the banks to waive the penalty interest when use is made of the expanded gift exemption.
Zoals bekend heb ik de banken gevraagd de boeterentes te laten vervallen indien gebruik wordt gemaakt van de verruimde schenkingsvrijstelling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Merkies over de vergoedingen die de Trojka in rekening brengt bij steunprogramma’s

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether the troika had received 224 million euro in fees from Ireland's support programme and asked about the fee structure, its basis, refunds and the interest rates. The minister denied that the troika itself receives the fees, explained the EFSF, EFSM and IMF fee components and total fees paid by programme countries, and set out the interest rate calculation.
No. The Troika consists of representatives of the European Commission, the ECB and the IMF.
Nee. De Trojka bestaat uit vertegenwoordigers van de Europese Commissie, de ECB en het IMF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de verbetering van het toezicht op belangrijke financiële benchmarks

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reforming the setting of financial benchmarks such as LIBOR, EURIBOR and ISDAfix after manipulation reports, including whether IOSCO principles, EU regulation, Dutch participation, ESMA supervision and mandatory panel participation are supported. The minister supports the international principles and proportionate EU regulation, notes that the AFM's powers over benchmark manipulation will expand under the new market abuse regulation, and gives estimates of contract values while declining to quantify the impact of a one basis point deviation.
With the new Market Abuse Regulation, manipulation of benchmarks will be brought within the scope of the market abuse rules.
Met de nieuwe Verordening marktmisbruik zal manipulatie van benchmarks wel onder de reikwijdte van de regels ter voorkoming van marktmisbruik worden gebracht.

Vragen van het lid Nijboer (PvdA) aan de Minister van Financiën over de verstrekking van kredieten aan financieel adviseurs door verzekeraars en het ontwijken van het provisieverbod (ingezonden 5 augustus 2013).

An MP asks the Finance Minister about insurers granting discount credit to financial advisers, whether this undermines the provisieverbod (commission ban), and about possible circumvention such as service subscriptions and double charging. The minister says the ban safeguards impartiality, that he lacks data on how many advisers hold such credits, will restrict premium collection in a draft amendment, and that the AFM is investigating misconduct.
I have no information on how many financial advisers have a discount credit outstanding with an insurer.
Over hoeveel financieel adviseurs een kortingskrediet hebben lopen bij een verzekeraar heb ik geen informatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Tony van Dijck over de mogelijke transfer van speler Gareth Bale van Tottenham Hotspur naar Real Madrid

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Dijck asked the Finance Minister about the reported 100 million euro transfer of Gareth Bale to Real Madrid, alleged Real Madrid tax debts, and whether Spanish bank Bankia, which received ESM-linked support, is a Real Madrid lender. The minister declined to comment on Spanish tax matters or Bankia's ties to Real Madrid, explained the ESM framework, and answered the closing question about the MP's own football ability with a flat no.
I make no statements about the individual tax matters in Spain, nor about the relationship between Bankia and Real Madrid.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over de individuele belastingzaken in Spanje en ook niet over de relatie tussen Bankia en Real Madrid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het artikel ‘De macht van de tabakslobby, hoe de industrie de winkelier voor haar karretje spant’

An SP MP asked the government for its reaction to a press article on tobacco industry lobbying, including the moral judgement on covertly funded anti-tobacco-prevention campaigns and the FSIT fund linked to the NSO retailers' association, and whether other similar fundraising organisations exist and what will be done to prevent them. The state secretary answered that retailer organisations may freely represent their sector's interests, that other similar bodies may exist, and that they must comply with existing rules such as the tobacco advertising ban, without committing to new action.
It is not for the cabinet to prevent such organisations, which seek to represent the interests of a sector, from being established.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te voorkomen dat dergelijke organisaties, die de belangen van een sector willen vertegenwoordigen, worden opgericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van Laar over de boekhouding van het Rijk

MPs Nijboer and Van Laar asked the Finance Minister about press reports that ministries spent 472 million euros unlawfully and about the accountability of central government spending. The minister answered that 0.20% of 2012 spending (about 470 million euros, of which roughly 60% was uncertain rather than wrong) was unlawful, within the 1% tolerance, and pointed to Court of Audit reports, the 2013 accountability debate and ministers' commitments.
The unlawfulness rate of central government spending in 2012 (0.20%: about 470 million euros) remained well within the 1% tolerance limit.
Het onrechtmatigheidspercentage van de rijksuitgaven in 2012 (0,20%: circa € 470 miljoen) bleef daarmee ruim binnen de tolerantiegrens van 1%.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat ondernemers in de problemen komen door rentederivaten

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that SMEs face problems from interest rate derivatives, including the scale of the problem, litigation, the AFM investigation, comparison with housing corporations, mis-selling and the duty of care. The minister answered that no data on numbers or amounts is available yet, that the AFM investigation results come in September, and that further steps will wait for those results.
At this moment I have no additional information on how many entrepreneurs are struggling with problematic (interest rate) derivatives or what total amount is involved.
Op dit moment heb ik geen aanvullende informatie over hoeveel ondernemers kampen met problematische (rente)derivaten of om welk totaalbedrag het zou gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de mogelijke verkoop van NUON door Vattenfall

The MP asks whether the government sees NUON as strategically important for energy supply and the Energy Agreement, and whether it will examine a state stake in or full takeover of NUON. The minister answers that NUON is an important supplier, that the government will not take a stake because the market is liberalised and supervised by the ACM, and that Vattenfall's search for an investment partner is a normal market matter.
State participation in Nuon is not an issue.
Deelname van het Rijk in Nuon is niet aan de orde.
Vragen van het lid Nijboer(PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over mogelijke prijsmanipulatie op de internationale valutamarkten (ingezonden 17 juni 2013).

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about possible price manipulation on international currency markets, the 'wild west' characterisation, dark pools, MiFID II treatment, and benchmark manipulation such as WM/Reuters and LIBOR. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that spot FX is outside MiFID but FX derivatives are covered, that the government supports EU and IOSCO benchmark principles and will regulate benchmarks proportionately, and that the forthcoming market abuse regulation will bring benchmark manipulation within enforcement reach.
Given the widespread use of benchmarks in financial instruments and contracts, it is important that benchmarks are set in an honest and transparent manner.
Gezien het wijdverbreide gebruik van benchmarks in financiële instrumenten en contracten is het belangrijk dat benchmarks op een integere en transparante wijze tot stand komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de problemen waar de Bond van Belastingbetalers tegenaan is gelopen

MPs Mulder and Van Hijum asked why the Bond van Belastingbetalers could not learn which firms received subsidies under the Veiligheid Kleine Bedrijven scheme, and whether recipients and uses would be published. The minister agreed in principle to publish recipients and amounts for 2011 (excluding sole traders), but refused to disclose the specific security measures funded, citing the risk to firms and staff.
I am certainly willing to make public which companies received subsidy in 2011 under Veiligheid Kleine Bedrijven and which amounts these companies received.
Ik ben zeker bereid bekend te maken welke bedrijven in 2011 subsidie hebben ontvangen in het kader van Veiligheid Kleine Bedrijven en welke bedragen deze bedrijven hebben ontvangen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het rentebesluit van de ECB

MP Monasch asked whether the minister knows the ECB will keep rates low for a long time, how this affects mortgage interest deduction in the Netherlands, and whether he will consult banks about lowering mortgage rates. The minister confirmed the ECB position, explained that banks decide themselves how much of lower funding costs to pass on, and pointed to recent measures and an ACM study on competition in the mortgage market.
It is up to providers themselves to decide whether and to what extent they pass on the possible benefit of low financing costs through a lower mortgage interest rate.
Het is aan aanbieders zelf om te bepalen of en zo ja in welke mate zij het eventuele voordeel van lage financieringskosten doorberekenen middels een lagere hypotheekrente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het bericht dat huiseigenaren door de bank als melkkoe worden gebruikt

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether banks' mortgage margins are historically high, whether the price-leadership ban on Dutch banks should be ended, and what measures will lower mortgage rates. The minister replied that the ING price-leadership restriction has ended and the ABN Amro ban is being weighed in ongoing Commission talks, and referred to earlier answers on mortgage rates without announcing new measures.
See the answers to questions 2 and 3 from MP Monasch (PvdA) to the ministers of Finance and for Housing and Government Organisation on the ECB interest rate decision.
Zie beantwoording van de vragen 2 en 3 van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën en voor Wonen en Rijksdienst over het rentebesluit van de ECB.
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over de verklaring van geen bezwaar (vvgb) (Ingezonden d.d. 1 juli 2013).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether an asset manager acquiring over 10% of another asset manager must obtain a new declaration of no objection (vvgb) even when the target already holds one, and whether a shortened procedure is possible. The minister confirmed a new vvgb is required because the financial soliditeit of the other firm must be assessed anew, and that the rules are EU-harmonised so no deviation is possible.
Because it concerns a different enterprise (asset manager), a new assessment, and therefore a new vvgb, is required.
Omdat het gaat om een andere onderneming (vermogensbeheerder) is dus een nieuwe toets, en derhalve vvgb, vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het bericht ‘Investitionsprogramm für Griechenland’

An MP from the VVD asked the Finance Minister about a planned 500 million euro investment fund for Greece, whether other eurozone states were being asked to contribute, and whether Dutch funds should go in outside the EFSF/ESM framework. The minister confirmed the fund for Greek SMEs, listed contributions from Germany (via KfW), the EIB and EU structural funds, and said the Netherlands had received no official request, leaving contributions to member states' own choice.
The Netherlands has so far received no official request.
Nederland heeft tot op heden geen officieel verzoek ontvangen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over aanpassing van stemrechten binnen de ECB-Raadsvergaderingen

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether he supports the rotation system for voting rights in the ECB Governing Council once a further country joins the euro, and whether it endangers balanced monetary policy. The minister answered that the system respects equal treatment and transparency, that Netherlands stays in the first group for the foreseeable future, and that the rotation start is not yet determined.
This random start has not yet been assigned, so an overview of the rotation cannot yet be drawn up.
Deze willekeurige start is nog niet toegewezen, een overzicht van de roulatie kan zodoende nog niet worden opgesteld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over bonussen bij Robeco

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a Robeco transaction bonus approved by DNB despite apparently conflicting with the remuneration rules, and whether it could be blocked or clawed back. The minister said DNB granted a one-time exemption with added conditions, that the payment had not yet occurred and clawback is possible, and that he will consult on a bill capping financial sector bonuses after the summer recess.
I have asked DNB for an explanation regarding the considerations behind approving the transaction bonuses.
Ik heb DNB om uitleg gevraagd met betrekking tot de overwegingen bij het goedkeuren van de transactiebonussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Koolmees over de ongewogen kapitaalratio

MPs Nijboer and Koolmees asked the Finance Minister about risk-weighted capital ratios, the non-risk-weighted leverage ratio, and related Basel III and CRD IV timing and accounting issues. The minister answered that internal models allow useful flexibility but create variation and risks, that the EU and Basel are studying the variation, that the leverage ratio should complement risk-weighted requirements, and that a binding minimum will come later (2018).

For this reason, both the European Banking Authority (EBA) and the Basel Committee have for some time been researching the causes of differences in RWA and policy options to limit undesirable differences.

Daarom doen zowel de Europese Bankenautoriteit (EBA) als het Bazels Comité op dit moment al enige tijd onderzoek naar de oorzaken van verschillen in RWA en beleidsopties om ongewenste verschillen te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Tony van Dijck over 25% meer betalingsachterstanden op de hypotheken

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Housing and Finance about the 25% rise in mortgage payment arrears, whether the government's policy is causing harm, and whether the PVV's proposal to keep mortgage interest deduction should be pursued. Minister Blok answered that arrears are hard to forecast but not expected to fall soon, that the government's measures give clarity and that he will not change current mortgage rules.
I can agree with the view that stability in the housing market is necessary.
Ik kan mij vinden in het standpunt dat rust op de woningmarkt noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Aukje de Vries over het artikel «Politiek verslikt zich in bezuinigingsoperatie auditfuncties»

MPs Van der Linde and Aukje de Vries asked the government whether a newspaper article about cuts to internal audit functions, including centralisation into the Auditdienst Rijk and reliance on external hiring, was accurate and how it fits the goal of efficiency. The minister rejected the claims of a duplication and monopoly, said the Auditdienst Rijk remains each department's internal audit function, and explained that framework contracts reduce external hiring costs while no new action is planned.
The Auditdienst Rijk is and remains the internal audit function of the individual departments.
De Auditdienst Rijk is en blijft de interne auditfunctie van de afzonderlijke departementen.
Antwoord vragen Merkies over beloningen in de financiële sector

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about reported large salary increases in 2012 at state-supported financial firms such as Achmea and Leaseplan, and whether these are excessive and what concrete steps will be taken to lower pay. The minister confirmed the increases, explained they used a one-off permitted 20% fixed-pay compensation under the bonus ban, said moderation of pay is reasonable, and committed to asking bank boards to address pay and to sending the EBA pay report to parliament.
I have also reported this to the chair of the ING board. The House will be informed about the progress of the CAO agreements.
Ik heb dit tevens gemeld aan de bestuursvoorzitter van ING. De Kamer zal over de voortgang van de CAO-afspraken worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over witwaspraktijken op Cyprus

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether reports by Deloitte and Moneyval on money laundering in Cyprus were available, public, and linked to conditions for European aid tranches, and whether they gave a misleadingly incomplete picture. The minister answered that the reports were received and published on the Cypriot finance ministry website, that the problem lies in implementation rather than legislation, and that completing an action plan is a condition for the next aid tranche.

As also stated in the Eurogroup and Ecofin Council report of 13 and 14 May 2013, the research shows that the shortcomings lie not so much in the laws and regulations as in their implementation and compliance.

Zoals ook vermeld in het verslag van de Eurogroep en Ecofin Raad van 13 en 14 mei 2013 (met kenmerk BFB 2013-5174M) blijkt uit het onderzoek dat niet zozeer in de wet- en regelgeving tekortkomingen zijn, maar in de implementatie en naleving hiervan.
Antwoord vragen Aukje de Vries en Van der Steur over het bericht ‘Plan voor verkoop pingegevens winkels in ijskast na golf van kritiek’

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister and Justice State Secretary about Equens' plan to sell ping (debit card) payment data to shops, which was shelved after public criticism. The minister confirmed banks adhere to the data-processing code, that Equens acts as a processor bound by it, that the CBP supervises compliance, and that Equens has halted activities pending broad societal support.
Equens has indicated that the way it makes analyses and planned reports from the data it uses as processor amounts to processing data that are not, or no longer, personal data.

Equens heeft aangegeven dat de wijze waarop zij analyses en voorgenomen rapportages maakt van de door haar als bewerker gebruikte gegevens neerkomt op het verwerken van gegevens die niet of niet langer zijn aan te merken als persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Harbers over het bericht ‘Dijsselbloem wil af van rol IMF bij reddingsoperaties’

MP Harbers asked whether the minister wants to review the IMF's role in future eurozone rescue operations and why the government's long-standing demand for IMF participation seems to be changing. The minister replied that the Netherlands' position is unchanged, that the IMF should stay involved in the Troika for its financial capacity and expertise, and that any review of the IMF's role would only be considered after the eurozone crisis ends.
The Dutch position on IMF involvement in the current crisis in Europe is therefore unchanged.
Het Nederlandse standpunt over IMF-betrokkenheid in de huidige crisis in Europa is derhalve ongewijzigd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het vertrek van de president-directeur van de NS

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister why NS chief executive Meerstadt left, whether it relates to the failed Fyra, how his successor Huges was selected, and why the Balkenende norm does not apply to his pay. The minister answered that Meerstadt left voluntarily without severance, the supervisory board ran a standard search with an external firm, and the successor's pay is about 35% lower than his predecessor's under a new pay policy, with the Balkenende norm not applying to such holdings.
As is well known, holdings do not fall under the Public Sector Top Incomes Act because they are not publicly funded and are generally subject to competition.
Zoals bekend vallen deelnemingen niet onder de Wet Normering Topinkomens omdat zij niet publiek bekostigd worden en omdat zij over het algemeen aan concurrentie onderhevig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de aanpak van de woekerpolisaffaire

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the handling of the 'woekerpolis' affair: whether insurers are restoring trust, how many policies have negative value, what compensation is offered, and how the Oosting commission for hardship cases works. The minister answered that insurers must actively reach out to affected customers, the AFM will monitor aftercare with results in early 2014, and the hardship commission is expected to see little use.
I will inform the House of these results.
Ik zal uw Kamer over deze resultaten informeren.
Antwoord vragen Nijboer over misstanden met uitvaartverzekeringen

MP Nijboer asks the finance minister about misconduct in funeral insurance, including possible double payment for advice, opaque cost structures, AFM warnings since 2008, and over-insurance. The minister says the AFM has been alerted and will decide on enforcement, a standardised service document will improve cost comparison from 1 July, the AFM is investigating intermediaries and has considered formal measures, and it monitors consumer information without further targeted investigation.
I have alerted the AFM to the possibility that consumers are paying twice for advice.
Ik heb de AFM erop geattendeerd dat er mogelijk sprake is van dubbel betalen voor advies.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Wilders en Madlener over het bericht “Eurozone scheldt mogelijk Griekse schuld kwijt”

MPs Van Dijck, Wilders and Madlener asked the Finance Minister why he suggested in a Greek newspaper that eurozone countries might forgive Greek debt and demanded a public retraction. The minister answered that the Eurogroup will only revisit possible further debt-sustainability measures for Greece at a later date, and that the Netherlands opposes debt forgiveness.
The Netherlands is not in favour of debt forgiveness.
Nederland is geen voorstander van schuldkwijtschelding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over de opkomst van de Bitcoin als digitale betaaleenheid

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about the rise of Bitcoin as a digital currency, its risks, its use for money laundering, and its tax treatment. The minister answered that Bitcoin falls outside financial supervision and poses no current systemic risk, that the FIOD monitors possible criminal use, and that Bitcoin gains are taxable income.
Its use is not subject to any form of government financial supervision, and the deposit guarantee scheme does not apply to Bitcoin.
Het gebruik ervan is niet onderworpen aan enige vorm van financieel toezicht van overheidswege en ook het depositogarantiestelsel is niet van toepassing op Bitcoin.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over verplichte roulatie voor accountants

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the Netherlands' domestic rules on mandatory audit-firm rotation and separation of audit and advisory services are consistent with the European Parliament legal committee's vote, and whether the evaluation should be brought forward. The minister answers that EU negotiations are ongoing, the Dutch measures already reflect the Commission proposal, and the Dutch rules will be adjusted if they conflict with EU rules, with a progress letter promised before summer recess.
I have indicated that if a conflict arose between Dutch and European regulation, we would of course have to adjust the relevant legislation.
Daarbij heb ik aangegeven, dat wanneer er strijdigheid zou ontstaan tussen de Nederlandse en de Europese regelgeving we de betreffende wetgeving uiteraard zullen moeten aanpassen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over beperking flitshandel

MP Nijboer asks the Finance Minister about high-frequency trading, EBS dropping first-come-first-served order handling, and fake Twitter news moving markets, and whether the government will consult exchanges to curb flash trading. The minister answers that EBS's plans are unclear, that MiFID II will address algorithmic trading risks, that misleading information is covered by market manipulation rules, and that consulting exchanges is not opportune because EBS is an unregulated FX platform.
The precise plans of EBS are not known.
De precieze plannen van EBS zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over de vergunningplicht op grond van de Wet op het financieel toezicht op het gebied van onder andere curatele en bewindvoering

An MP asked whether banks demanding AFM licences from court-appointed administrators (bewindvoerders) to open accounts can be stopped, given the minister's promised exemption. The minister confirmed the promise, said he asked the banks' association to inform members, and aims to publish the exemption by 1 July 2013, retroactive to 26 February.
I have therefore asked the NVB to point its members to my commitment and my intention with it.
Ik heb de NVB daarom gevraagd haar leden te wijzen op mijn toezegging en mijn bedoeling daarmee.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “ING-top: salarissen moeten omhoog”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that ING's board wanted higher pay for its top executives and that fixed salaries for staff rose 9% after bonuses were abolished under the state-aid bonus ban. The minister answered that Dutch executive pay is below the European median but that pay should not rise given sector challenges, that ING's board proposed no raise for current executives, and that a fixed-pay increase is legally allowed under the bonus ban.
This does not mean, however, that pay in the Netherlands should go up.
Dit betekent echter niet dat de beloningen in Nederland omhoog zouden moeten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over schoon schip maken bij SNS

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the status of SNS Reaal's internal integrity investigation, including FIOD suspicions of conflicts of interest at SNS Property Finance and reports that suspects remained supervisory board members. The minister answered that the investigation is ongoing with external help, 17 persons are no longer active, a former director was reported, and the two suspects' supervisory mandates have been ended, while stating he has asked management to keep him informed.
Since the investigation is not yet concluded, no specific statements can be made about it at this time.
Aangezien het onderzoek nog niet is afgerond kunnen hier nu nog geen specifieke mededelingen over worden gedaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Oskam over een gewelddadige roofoverval op een gelddepot van waardetransporteur Brinks

MPs Van Hijum and Oskam asked the ministers of Justice and Finance about a violent robbery of a Brinks cash depot and the rising number of ram and explosive raids, including what is being done to protect cash transport and staff, whether drones could be used in pursuits, and whether banks reducing ATMs is acceptable. The minister answered that ram and explosive raids on ATMs have risen while other robbery types have not, listed existing preventive and repressive measures, declined to give full operational detail for confidentiality reasons, judged drones largely impractical, and pointed to ongoing consultation in the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer.
In the interest of the operational strategy, I cannot in this letter address all the measures taken to counter these serious robberies.
In het belang van de operationele strategie kan ik in deze brief niet ingaan op álle maatregelen die genomen worden om deze zware overvallen tegen te gaan.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Nijboer en Mei Li Vos over de mogelijkheid voor financieel dienstverleners om adviezen van het Klachteninstituut financiële dienstverlening (Kifid) als niet-bindend te aanvaarden

MPs Nijboer and Mei Li Vos asked the Finance Minister about reports that financial firms can opt out of binding Kifid complaint rulings, and whether the list of non-binding firms and the scope of Kifid access should change. The minister answered that binding force cannot be enshrined in law under the Constitution, announced that Kifid will limit withdrawal of binding acceptance to new contracts, and said he is willing to examine extending access to small businesses.
Kifid plans to amend its rules so that withdrawal of acceptance of the binding force of its rulings applies only to contractual relationships entered into after that date.

Het Kifid is van plan haar reglementen zo aan te passen dat een intrekking van de aanvaarding van de bindendheid van haar uitspraken alleen geldt voor contractuele verhoudingen die na deze datum zijn aangegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Vermeij over het nieuwe voorstel van de Europese Commissie voor een financiële transactiebelasting

MPs Nijboer and Vermeij asked the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the Commission's new financial transaction tax proposal, including its effect on Dutch pension funds, extraterritorial reach, a de minimis exemption, next steps, and compensation for non-participating states. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the Netherlands will not join the enhanced cooperation yet because pension funds are still taxed, that the impact cannot yet be reliably calculated, and that compensation is not provided but will be raised in negotiations.
Therefore the Netherlands will for now not join the enhanced cooperation.
Nederland zal daarom op dit moment niet toetreden tot de nauwere samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het artikel «Europese Commissie houdt Nederland buiten transactietax»

MP Klaver asks the Finance Minister about a news report that the European Commission had excluded the Netherlands from the financial transaction tax and disputed the pension sector's cost estimates. The minister answers that the Netherlands will not join the enhanced cooperation on the current proposal because pension funds are not exempted, cites DNB estimates of at least €500 million in FTT payments by Dutch financial institutions, and disagrees with the NSFM paper on pension funds.
The Netherlands will continue to actively press Dutch wishes on the Commission and the other member states.
Nederland zal zich er actief voor blijven inzetten om de Nederlandse wensen onder de aandacht te brengen bij de Commissie en de overige lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over witwassen via prepaid- en cadeaukaarten

An MP asked the Finance Minister about money laundering through prepaid and gift cards, including the FATF estimate for the Netherlands, reporting obligations, card limits and customs controls on cross-border movement. The minister answered that prepaid cards fall under the anti-money-laundering law with reporting duties supervised by DNB, that no statutory limits exist but gift cards in practice carry small balances, and that customs lacks powers over prepaid cards, which will be examined.
Thus the EGI is exempt that issues electronic money usable only within its own premises, within a limited network of service providers or for a limited range of goods and services.

Zo is de EGI uitgezonderd die elektronisch geld uitgeeft waarmee alleen kan worden betaald binnen de eigen bedrijfsgebouwen, binnen een beperkt netwerk van dienstverleners of voor een beperkte reeks van goederen en diensten.
Antwoord vragen Dijkhoff en Aukje de Vries over het bericht banken te laks met de aanpak van cybercrime

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Finance about a report that banks were too lax in tackling cybercrime, questioning the banks' cooperation and the value of a working group. The ministers replied that cooperation is good, fraud fell 60% in late 2012, banks will place a liaison at the NCSC, and a mandatory breach-notification law is being prepared.
Given the seriousness of the cybercrime threat, a still greater effort than is already being made must be delivered across the board, including by the banking sector.
Gezien de ernst van de dreiging van cybercrime moet evenwel over de hele linie een nog grotere inspanning dan nu al het geval is worden geleverd, ook door de bancaire sector.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Nijboer over grote winstmarges voor banken op hypotheken

MPs Monasch and Nijboer asked about reports that Dutch banks' mortgage profit margins rose between January 2012 and January 2013 despite small rate cuts, and about the size of the extra margin and its effect on borrowers and the housing market. The minister confirmed margins have risen since 2011 per an ACM study, but said the absolute size is uncertain and gave an estimated increase of 0.24 to 0.74 percentage points, with ACM promising further research into competition in the mortgage market.
The ACM has indicated it will conduct further research this year into possibilities for improving market competition in the banking sector, including the mortgage market.
De ACM heeft aangegeven nog dit jaar nader onderzoek te zullen verrichten naar mogelijkheden voor verbeteringen van de marktwerking in de bancaire sector, waaronder de hypotheekmarkt.
Antwoord vragen Dijkgraaf over de column op www.boerenbusiness.nl dat Deutsche Bank in strijd handelt met de zorgplicht

MP Dijkgraaf asked whether Deutsche Bank breaches its duty of care by terminating credit agreements with about 18,000 clients and enforcing high break fees, and whether DNB and the AFM should intervene. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the courts, not he or the supervisors, must judge civil-law duties, that the bank's strategy change is its own business decision, and that the bank has promised to find individual solutions.
On your questions concerning alleged violation of civil-law norms, I cannot give an answer.
Op uw vragen die betrekking hebben op vermeende schending van civielrechtelijke normen, kan ik geen antwoord geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over het ontduiken van wetgeving door accountants

An MP asked the Finance Minister about roughly fifty dubious contracts accountants concluded at the end of 2012 that the AFM said circumvent the new separation of audit and advisory work, and what the government would do. The minister answered that the transition period was not meant for new long-term advisory contracts, that the AFM has asked the Big 4 firms to reassess them and most have withdrawn or limited them, and that the sector must change its behaviour.
The AFM urgently called on the firms to reassess all contracts concluded just before 1 January 2013 and to end or limit those not in line with the legislator's intention.

De AFM heeft een dringend beroep gedaan op de kantoren om alle vlak voor 1 januari 2013 afgesloten contracten te (her)beoordelen en die contracten die niet in overeenstemming zijn met de bedoeling van de wetgever te beëindigen of te beperken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over ernstige tekortkomingen bij externe accountantscontroles en de weigering van de grote vier accountantskantoren om de wet over scheiding van advies- en controlepraktijk na te le

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the finance minister about the AFM's findings that Big 4 audit firms signed new advisory contracts with audit clients just before the transitional period of the audit-advisory separation law, and that most audits at nine firms showed serious deficiencies. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the firms acted against the spirit of the law, that the AFM has enforcement tools it is using, and that the existing enforcement framework is adequate.
The existing enforcement instruments seem to me sufficiently adequate.
Het bestaande handhavingsinstrumentarium lijkt mij voldoende adequaat.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat Cyprus haar crisisonderzoek heeft gestaakt

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether he shares concern that Cyprus halted its inquiry into capital flight before the banking freeze, that the central bank withheld information, and that evidence was destroyed, and how an independent investigation will be ensured. The minister replies that responsibility lies primarily with the Cypriot authorities and the Troika, that he will not speculate on wrongdoing, and that he awaits the commission's results.
I do not want to speculate on whether there were irregularities or improper outflow of deposits, and I await the results of this commission's investigation.
Ik wil niet speculeren over of er sprake is geweest van onrechtmatigheden of een oneigenlijke uitstroom van deposito’s en wacht de resultaten van het onderzoek van deze commissie af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat een huishouden in Cyprus gemiddeld vier keer meer vermogen heeft dan een Nederlands huishouden

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Dijck asked why Cypriot households hold about four times the average wealth of Dutch households and why the Netherlands should contribute to Cypriot bailout aid, asking whether this aid should be reversed. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the ECB itself notes Cyprus data are not comparable across the eurozone, pointed to earlier letters on the bailout, and did not reverse or commit to changing the aid.
The ECB states in its study that the figures for Cyprus are not well comparable with the rest of the eurozone for several reasons.
De ECB stelt in haar studie dat de cijfers voor Cyprus niet goed vergelijkbaar zijn met de rest van de eurozone om meerdere redenen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de gevolgen van de overname van Deutsche Bank voor diverse klantengroepen

An MP asks the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about Deutsche Bank Nederland dropping 18,000 clients, whether boetevrij exit should be allowed, what tools the government and DNB have, and whether the 2007 ABN Amro/HBU sale was flawed. The minister answers that the bank's strategic and contractual decisions are its own, that case-by-case solutions are expected, and that he will press the bank in a meeting.
It is not for me to directly intervene in the strategic decision of an individual bank or in the contractual relationship between a bank and its customers.
Het is niet aan mij om rechtstreeks in te grijpen in de strategische beslissing van een individuele bank of in de contractuele relatie tussen een bank en haar klanten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Schouw, Segers, Leijten, Klaver, Tony van Dijck, Dijkgraaf, Ouwehand en Klein over het bericht “VNG wil overleg kabinet over bezuinigingen”

MPs asked whether the government would commission research, with the VNG, into whether the decentralisations and cumulative efficiency cuts are feasible for municipalities, and how risks and cumulative effects on vulnerable groups are monitored. The minister declined a separate CPB study for now, pointed to monitoring commitments and a motion-based independent study to be scoped with the VNG, and said the minister of Social Affairs would map cumulative effects.
Your House has since, in a motion by MP Schouw, asked the government to have an independent party investigate the financial and implementation risks of the decentralisations.

Uw Kamer heeft inmiddels in een motie van het lid Schouw aan de regering verzocht door een onafhankelijke partij een onderzoek te laten doen naar de financiële risico's en uitvoeringsrisico's van de decentralisaties
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt betreffende derivaten

Deputy Omtzigt asked the Interior and Finance ministers about derivative positions of the central government, local authorities and their participations, including whether regional and municipal participations hold derivatives and what rules apply, and asked about specific cases such as Slibverwerkingsbedrijf Noord-Brabant and PWN. Minister Plasterk answered that participations are privately organised and fall outside the Fido and Ruddo regimes, that accountability for them lies with the local councils and shareholder governance, and promised a separate letter on Groningen Seaports and a later inventory of central government derivative positions.
I am not responsible for supervising these private-law organisations.
Ik ben niet belast met het toezicht op deze privaatrechtelijke organisaties.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat de schoonzoon van de Cypriotische president 21 miljoen weggesluisd heeft

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether he knew of a list of 132 account holders who moved nearly 700 million euro out of Cyprus before the bailout, including the president's son-in-law's firm, and whether suspicious transactions would be investigated independently. The minister said he would not speculate, that responsibility lies primarily with Cypriot authorities and the Troika, that a Cypriot commission has been appointed and he will await its results, and that the government considers adequate anti-money-laundering safeguards very important.
I do not wish to speculate on whether there has been an improper outflow of deposits.
Ik wil niet speculeren over of er sprake is geweest van een oneigenlijke uitstroom van deposito’s.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over het bericht dat de EU 11,2 miljard euro wil om Brusselse gaten te dichten

PVV MPs Madlener and Wilders asked the Finance Minister and Prime Minister whether the government would refuse to pay a proposed 11.2 billion euro EU budget increase and demand the money back. The minister answered only that Question 1 was yes and that Questions 2 to 4 were covered in a separate letter to the House.
For an answer to questions 2 to 4, I refer you to the letter I sent to the House of Representatives simultaneously with the answers to these parliamentary questions.
Voor een antwoord op de vragen 2 t/m 4 verwijs ik u naar de brief die ik hierover gelijktijdig met de beantwoording van deze Kamervragen naar de Tweede Kamer heb gezonden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de kwaliteit van de cijfers van de Spaanse overheidsfinanciën

MPs Van Hijum and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about the reliability of Spanish deficit figures, the accounting of bank capital injections, and retroactive ESM bank recapitalisation. The minister answered that Spanish and Commission deficit figures are broadly consistent once financial-sector interventions are included, that Eurostat applies rules consistently case by case, and that the Netherlands is very reluctant about retroactive ESM recapitalisation.
There is no reason to assume that the rules are being bargained over.
Er is geen reden aan te nemen dat er gemarchandeerd wordt met de regels.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over een dividenduitkering door ABN AMRO

An MP asked the Finance Minister about ABN AMRO's 2013 dividend despite profit gains from one-off items, its loan pricing to SMEs, and whether systemic banks should hold higher capital buffers. The minister answered that dividend and pricing are the bank's decisions, that ABN AMRO meets current capital rules, and that a systemic-relevance buffer for ING and other systemic banks will be introduced via a bill to come.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Merkies en Van Hijum over een mogelijke gang naar de Ondernemingskamer in het kader van mogelijk mismanagement bij SNS

MPs Merkies and Van Hijum asked why the government would not initiate an enquiry by the Enterprise Chamber into alleged mismanagement at SNS REAAL, and whether this creates uncertainty. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that an enquiry would add no value beyond the nationalisation, the evaluation commission and the supervisory board's investigation, and would burden the company, while the Council of State ruling confirmed the nationalisation was lawful.
I am of the view that an enquiry procedure regarding SNS REAAL adds no value compared with the measures already initiated and moreover has disadvantages.
Ik ben van oordeel dat een enquêteprocedure ten aanzien van SNS REAAL geen meerwaarde heeft ten opzichte van de reeds in gang gezette maatregelen en bovendien nadelen kent.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over de gevolgen van de extra taken van Geld Service Nederland

An MP asked the finance minister about the consequences of Geld Service Nederland (GSN), a joint venture of the three big banks, taking over cash counting, storage and transport, including effects on logistics, safety, costs for shopkeepers, competition and ATM availability. The minister answered that GSN concentrates counting onto fewer sites with efficiency gains, that DNB supervises and positively views GSN, that the competition authority is investigating a complaint, and that ATM availability is monitored.
I will inform your House of the outcomes of this research.
Ik zal uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek informeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders, Tony van Dijck en Van Vliet over de sombere CBS-cijfers over de werkloosheid, de huizenprijzen en het consumentenvertrouwen

Opposition PVV MPs asked whether the minister would relax the 3% deficit ceiling and reconsider labour, housing and pension reforms in light of gloomy CBS figures on unemployment, house prices and consumer confidence. The minister replied that the 2013 deficit will exceed 3%, citing a housing package and business stimulus, that the government keeps its spending rules and will not add cuts in 2013, and that it will push ahead with reforms and targeted support for unemployed workers and youth.
The cabinet will further maintain the budget rules for 2013; any overruns will be resolved within the budget, and the spending ceiling will be respected.
Het kabinet zal verder voor 2013 de begrotingsregels handhaven; eventuele overschrijdingen zullen binnen de begroting worden opgelost, het uitgavenplafond wordt gerespecteerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over het criminele gebruik van het 500 eurobiljet

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about criminal use of the 500-euro note, the reasons for differing 500-note shares across euro countries, reporting thresholds for cash transactions, foreign high-denomination note policies, and whether DNB or the ECB should be asked to investigate further. The minister answered that the ECB holds exclusive competence over banknotes, outlined the ECB's findings and sanctions under the Wwft, and agreed to ask DNB and the ECB to give special attention to the 500-euro note in future research without prejudging outcomes.
I am willing to ask DNB and the ECB to give special attention to the role of the €500 note in future research on euro banknote use.
Ik ben bereid DNB en ECB te verzoeken speciale aandacht te geven aan de rol van specifiek het € 500-biljet in toekomstige onderzoeken naar het gebruik van eurobiljetten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over de invoering van het provisieverbod

An MP from the CDA asked the Finance Minister about confusion and bottlenecks after the introduction of the commission ban on financial advice, including free advice, Rabobank's delayed model change and the level playing field. The minister answered that the transition is a deliberate culture shift, that cost separation is adequately regulated with AFM enforcement powers limited to excessive fees, and that information channels for consumers and firms are sufficient.
The aim of the commission ban is to bring about a culture change.
Het doel van het provisieverbod is een cultuuromslag te laten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over de digitale poliskluis

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the industry's proposed digital insurance 'policy vault' and its privacy implications, including the use of the citizen service number. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that a digital overview can help curb over- and under-insurance, pointed to the BSN-based pension register as precedent, and described ongoing feasibility work and new adviser competence rules.
The Association of Insurers regards the use of the BSN, DigiD and/or access to the GBA as an important success factor for the policy vault.
Het Verbond van Verzekeraars geeft aan het gebruik van BSN, DigiD en/of toegang tot GBA als een belangrijke succesfactor voor de poliskluis te zien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Klant nog geen koning met het provisieverbod'

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the 2013 commission ban has really benefited consumers, given reports of costly service subscriptions and unclear charges on annuities, and whether the ban is being implemented in line with its purpose. The minister rejected the conclusion that consumers have gained little, pointed to greater cost transparency, promised a standardised service document from July 2013, and said the AFM monitors implementation closely.
That is why I am closely monitoring developments, and the AFM is intensively monitoring the implementation of the commission ban.
Daarom houd ik de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet in de gaten en monitort de AFM de uitvoering van het provisieverbod intensief.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Geurts over de gevolgen van de overname van Deutsche Bank voor diverse klantengroepen

MPs Van Hijum and Geurts asked the finance minister whether clients harmed by Deutsche Bank's takeover of an ABN Amro unit, required by the European Commission, should be protected, whether unilateral changes to financing terms are allowed, and what government role exists. The minister replied that material terms stayed the same, that Deutsche Bank says it will seek solutions per client, that strategy changes are a private business decision not for government to override, and that courts remain available.
I therefore see no role for the government in this.
Ik zie nu dan ook geen rol voor de overheid hierbij.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het artikel “DNB: blijf af van bankschuld. Korten obligaties treft financierbaarheid sector”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a DNB official's warnings on bail-in of bank bondholders and the differences between the Dutch Interventiewet and the European recovery and resolution directive. The minister explained the two bail-in approaches, the Dutch preferred combination, and existing powers to impose losses on creditors.
The Dutch government, with DNB's support, is working in the RRD negotiations for a combination of both approaches.
De Nederlandse regering zet zich, met steun van DNB, in de RRD-onderhandelingen in voor een combinatie van de beide benaderingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Fritsma over het bericht dat «consumenten 1,3 procent teveel hypotheekrente betalen»

MPs Van Klaveren and Fritsma asked whether banks' mortgage margins are excessive, whether the Brussels price-leadership ban causes lack of competition, and what measures the government will take to lower mortgage rates. The minister says CPB and DNB find no systematic higher funding costs, that the ABN AMRO price-leadership ban remains and will be discussed with the Commission, and points to a forthcoming NMa margin study and new consumer-protection rules from 1 January 2013.
The Central Planning Bureau (CPB) states that there are no indications that financing costs in the Netherlands are systematically higher than in the surrounding countries.
Het Centraal Planbureau (CPB) stelt dat er geen aanwijzingen zijn dat de financieringskosten in Nederland systematisch hoger zijn dan in de ons omringende landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Visser over het bericht «Huiseigenaren richten hun woede op bankdirecteuren»

MPs De Vries and Visser asked whether banks are earning excess profits on mortgages, why Dutch mortgage rates exceed those in neighbouring countries, and whether more competition or transparency is needed. The minister says he awaits the NMa's update on mortgage margins, notes structural differences that make cross-country comparison difficult, and points to transparency measures and lifting ING's price-leadership ban as steps toward more competition.
I do not have this insight, so I cannot give you this explanation.
Dit inzicht heb ik niet, waardoor ik u deze toelichting niet kan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Van Klaveren over het CPB rapport «De Nederlandse woningmarkt – hypotheekrente, huizenprijzen en consumptie»

MPs Tony van Dijck and Van Klaveren asked the government to respond to a CPB report finding Dutch mortgage rates about 1 percentage point above neighbouring countries, and asked how to end excessive margins, quantify lost consumption, housing wealth and tax revenue, and recover losses from the financial sector. The minister acknowledged the rate gap, attributed house price changes to several factors, and said a quantification of 'excessive' interest and lost revenue was not feasible because no objective benchmark exists.

A calculation of the loss of purchasing power due to possibly 'excessively paid' interest is not feasible in my view, because there is no unambiguous and objective measure for the possibly 'excessively paid' part of the interest.

Een berekening van het verlies aan koopkracht als gevolg van eventueel «te veel betaalde rente» acht ik niet goed mogelijk omdat er geen eenduidige en objectieve maatstaf is voor het eventueel «te veel betaalde» deel van de rente.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over de beloningen bij de genationaliseerde SNS

An MP asked the Finance Minister about pay at nationalised SNS REAAL and ABN AMRO, including whether staff exceed the public-sector pay norm, executive and supervisory board pay, adviser fees, and whether bonuses can be clawed back. The minister said the WNT norm does not apply to these commercial banks, gave board and supervisory pay figures and fees, and committed to an independent clawback investigation and informing the House of its outcome.
I share the view that an independent investigation must be carried out into the possibilities of recovering the variable remuneration awarded and paid out.
Ik deel de mening dat er een onafhankelijk onderzoek moet komen naar de mogelijkheden de toegekende en uitgekeerde variabele beloningen terug te vorderen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “SNS lost risicodragende schuld af ondanks kapitaalnood”

An MP asked the finance minister why SNS REAAL repaid subordinated participation certificates while still owing state aid and negotiating new aid, and whether DNB would explain its decision. The minister answered that DNB, as an independent supervisor, could not explain individual decisions due to confidentiality, that the certificates were repaid after DNB withdrew their Tier 1 status to avoid mass damage claims, and that contractual repayment conditions on state aid would have undesirable side effects.
In principle DNB is bound by supervisory law to keep data on individual institutions confidential, and for that reason DNB is not permitted to send an explanation of its decision.

In beginsel is DNB op grond van de toezichtwetgeving gehouden tot geheimhouding van gegevens over individuele instellingen en is het DNB om die reden niet toegestaan om een toelichting te sturen op haar besluit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over de vergunningplicht Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) op het gebied van onder andere curatele en bewindvoering

An MP asked whether court-appointed administrators (bewindvoerders) need an AFM licence to open bank accounts for clients, and whether that conflicts with the Civil Code duty to open such accounts. The minister answered that opening accounts is brokering requiring a licence in principle, but because the administrator is already legally obliged and supervised by the court, a licence exemption will be created with the AFM, also for curators, and that other categories will be discussed with the AFM.
I will therefore create an exemption in consultation with the AFM.
Ik zal dan ook in samenspraak met de AFM een vrijstelling vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Geurts over de gevolgen van stopzetten (agrarische) financiering door Deutsche Bank

MPs Van Hijum and Geurts (CDA) asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the consequences of Deutsche Bank ending agricultural lending, including possible unfair terms for clients moved from ABN AMRO, complaints received, and support for farmers' financing. The government answered that the decision is a private business choice, that the EC remedy set no lending-terms commitments, that AFM cannot disclose investigations, and that existing agricultural support measures are in place.
However, the AFM cannot make any statements about possible investigations into individual institutions.
Over mogelijke onderzoeken naar individuele instellingen kan de AFM echter geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de berichten dat Deutsche Bank geen leningen meer verstrekt aan bedrijven met een omzet van minder dan 1 miljoen euro

Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether Deutsche Bank's withdrawal from lending to small businesses (turnover under 1 million euro), including agricultural firms, forces clients into costly refinancing, collateral lock-in and break fees, and what DNB or the AFM could do. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the bank's strategy is a private choice, that DNB supervises strategy only for sustainability, that the AFM has no lending oversight, and that the bank will talk with affected clients, without committing to new action.
I am not aware of the precise content of the private contracts between entrepreneurs and Deutsche Bank.
Van de precieze inhoud van de private contracten tussen ondernemers en Deutsche Bank ben ik niet op de hoogte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de juistheid van de berichten dat Deutsche Bank een toezegging doet aan boeren die met hun hele financiering naar een andere bank gaan

An MP asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs whether Deutsche Bank's reported pledge to let farmers leave without penalty is accurate, how break-fee clauses apply to split loans and swaps, and whether the bank's changed lending policy will be put in writing. The minister says Deutsche Bank will work with clients to find solutions, may revisit break fees, and will inform clients about its strategy in April 2013, but he declines to intervene in the bank's commercial strategy and defends break-fee clauses in general.
It is not for me to directly intervene in the strategic decision of an individual bank.
Het is niet aan mij om rechtstreeks in te grijpen in de strategische beslissing van een individuele bank.
Antwoord vragen Madlener en Tony Van Dijck over het EU-trendrapport 2013 van de Algemene Rekenkamer

Two MPs (Madlener and Tony van Dijck, PVV) asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the Court of Audit's 2013 EU trend report, including the 3.9% error rate, unverified Greek loans and EFSF funds, member states' resistance to a national declaration, and whether governments should be forced to provide one. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the government opposes the error rate, that EFSF/Greek loans are controlled via conditionality and national budget channels with an audit committee being explored, that no member state refuses accountability, and that he will not link ESM aid to a national declaration.
The cabinet is exploring whether EFSF funds can be placed under the supervision of the ESM audit committee.
Het kabinet verkent of de middelen van het EFSF onder toezicht van het ESM-auditcomité gebracht kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over het onderzoek van de FIOD naar mogelijke belangenverstrengeling in de top van SNS Property Finance

PvdA MP Nijboer asked the ministers of Finance about a FIOD investigation into possible conflicts of interest at SNS Property Finance, including the basis for suspicion, links to its losses and nationalisation, contact with SNS Reaal's new board, and liability and bonus claw-back for staff. The minister declined to discuss the ongoing criminal investigation, said the board was monitoring integrity signals, and noted employers can hold staff financially liable for fraud.
I make no statements regarding ongoing criminal investigations.
Ik doe geen mededelingen met betrekking tot lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken.
Antwoord vragen Koolmees en Bergkamp over een tax shelter voor de filmindustrie

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about introducing a tax shelter for the Dutch film industry, its prevalence in the EU, its design, and its effects on competitiveness and Dutch post-production firms. The government answered that it does not intend to introduce a tax shelter because it conflicts with its simplification agenda, and gave limited figures on foreign spending and bankruptcies while saying the effects on public finances are unknown.
The cabinet therefore does not intend to introduce a tax shelter for the Dutch film industry.
Het kabinet is daarom niet voornemens een tax shelter voor de Nederlandse filmindustrie te introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Van Hijum over de Nationale Hypotheekgarantie

CDA MPs Knops, Omtzigt and Van Hijum asked the ministers about the Nationale Hypotheekgarantie (NHG): claim numbers, debt write-offs, sale methods, approval of forced sales, controls on lenders and the maximum state risk. Minister Blok answered with WEW data, noting forced-sale approval rules were tightened from 1 January 2013 and that the maximum exposure is well below the guaranteed EUR 149 billion.
The WEW states it has no data on this.
Het WEW geeft aan hierover geen gegevens te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Vermeij over de uitspraken van eurocommissaris Semeta over een financiële sectorbelasting en de positie van pensioenfondsen

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Commissioner Semeta's statements that a new financial transaction tax would not exempt pension funds conflict with the Dutch coalition conditions for joining enhanced cooperation on the tax. The minister replied that the Commission proposal does not meet the coalition conditions, so the Netherlands will not join for now, and that it will keep lobbying in the Ecofin Council and inform parliament via a BNC fiche.
This proposal does not meet the conditions of the coalition agreement.
Dit voorstel voldoet niet aan de voorwaarden van het regeerakkoord.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over de rol van het €500 biljet in de geldsmokkel, witwascircuit, drugs- en overige criminaliteit

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the role of the 500-euro note in money smuggling, money laundering and crime, and whether it should be withdrawn. The minister replied that the ECB decides denominations, that Dutch use of the note is limited, and that existing reporting duties and EU cash controls are adequate, so he will not push for withdrawal.
All things considered, I do not intend to advocate at DNB and the ECB for withdrawing the 500-euro note from circulation.
Alles overwegende ben ik niet voornemens om bij DNB en de ECB het uit het betalingsverkeer halen van het biljet van 500 euro te bepleiten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Nijboer en Mei Li Vos over de kosten verbonden aan creditcardbetalingen

MPs Nijboer and Mei Li Vos asked about the high cost of credit card payments for retailers, whether card companies may charge above cost, whether the EU consumer rights directive will curb fees, whether Dutch action should not await EU payment services rules, and whether the regulators should investigate. The minister answered that retailers negotiate with their payment provider, that no action is warranted now, that the directive limits surcharges to actual costs, and that the competition authority NMa is independent and may start its own investigation.
I currently see no reason to take action in this area.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om actie op dit vlak te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Nijboer en Mei Li Vos over de hoge betalingskosten voor verkopende partijen bij PayPal

Two MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about high PayPal fees charged to sellers, whether a legal cap applies, and whether the EU consumer rights directive or a regulator investigation would change this. The minister answered that no legal maximum exists, that consumers are protected from excessive surcharges by the directive, and that the competition authority NMa is independent and has been informed of the concerns.
The NMa is an independent regulator, so it is not for me to ask it to investigate certain markets.
De NMa is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder, het is dan ook niet aan mij om haar te verzoeken onderzoek te doen naar bepaalde markten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het bericht ‘Komt de JSF er en gaat de koningin’?

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the cabinet would abandon the EU 3% deficit limit, whether pre-agreed spending cuts and a reserve list existed from the coalition formation, and whether any side-letter agreements exist. The minister denied any deviation from the Stability and Growth Pact, denied that such agreements were made during the formation, and stated no additional agreements were made.
No additional agreements have been made.
Er zijn geen aanvullende afspraken gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Bashir over het bericht dat Nederlandse banken tientallen vennootschappen hebben in belastingparadijzen

SP MPs Merkies and Bashir asked whether Dutch banks, especially state-supported ones, should avoid tax via tax-haven subsidiaries, whether such structures are tax avoidance, and whether banks should disclose and justify foreign subsidiaries, plus the status of a proposed reporting duty for tax advisers. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that he has no reason to doubt banks' stated reasons, that tax avoidance is legal but sometimes undesirable, that foreign subsidiaries are already partly disclosed and tax authorities have sufficient powers, and that a reporting point for tax advisers is unnecessary given existing covenants.
Moreover, Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act does not allow me to go into individual cases.
Overigens staat artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelasting mij niet toe in te gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Merkies over de introductie van een overlijdensrisicoverzekering op basis van postcode

Member Merkies (SP) asked the Finance Minister whether it is acceptable that a life insurance premium be based on the policyholder's postcode, and whether this amounts to discrimination. The minister said such differentiation is not legally prohibited, that he finds it undesirable, and asked the Human Rights College to investigate the discrimination question.
I have asked the Human Rights College to conduct an investigation into the composition of the affected groups and the objective justification for any indirect distinction.
Ik heb het College voor de Rechten van de Mens verzocht een onderzoek in te stellen naar de samenstelling van de geraakte groepen en de objectieve rechtvaardiging voor eventueel indirect onderscheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het niet uitkeren van het premieoverschot door enkele overlijdensrisico-verzekeraars bij het voortijdig stopzetten van de verzekering

MP Nijboer asked whether life-risk insurers must pay out the premium surplus or offer a paid-up policy when a policy is cancelled early, and asked for AFM attention and an inventory of such products. The minister answered that the Civil Code obliges surrender or paid-up continuation only in some cases, that the AFM was alerted and can enforce the client-interest norm, and that an inventory was not opportune, while consultation with the insurers' association had already taken place.
I drew the AFM's attention to the legal framework it was already aware of and asked it to pay attention to possible non-compliance with the rules by insurers.
Ik heb de AFM geattendeerd op het wettelijk kader waarmee zij bekend was en daarbij aandacht gevraagd voor de eventuele niet-naleving van de regels door verzekeraars.
Antwoord vragen Klaver over het bericht ‘Hoge salarissen bankiers drukken kredietverlening’

Klaver (GroenLinks) asked the Finance Minister whether high bankers' salaries restrict lending, whether the government will press banks on wage moderation, and whether regulation will be softened while banks lack wage restraint. Minister Dijsselbloem replied that he has raised wage moderation with the Dutch Banking Association, that CAO wages are for unions and employers, and that lending will be monitored with a possible review if credit contracts for several quarters.
If lending is negative for several consecutive quarters or there is an acute sharp contraction in lending, it will be studied whether there are instruments that burden lending less.

Wanneer de kredietverlening enkele opeenvolgende kwartalen negatief zal zijn of er een acuut forse krimp in de kredietverlening optreedt, dan zal bestudeerd worden of er instrumenten zijn die kredietverlening minder belasten.
Antwoord vragen Tony van Dijck en Graus over het rapport van de Stichting SOMO “Het financiële overgewicht van Nederland”

Two PVV MPs asked the finance minister to respond to a SOMO report arguing that Dutch bank salaries are about 15% too high, costing around two billion euros in lending, and to state what the government will do about its recommendations. The minister said the lending effect cannot be isolated, that the government lacks direct influence over private wage setting, and listed existing and planned measures on shareholders, bank structure and mortgage tax incentives.
