this amendment therefore provides that 0.8 million euro of the reserved implementation funds is transferred to policy article 1 'strengthening the rule of law'
derhalve regelt dit amendement dat € 0,8 miljoen van de gereserveerde middelen voor de uitvoering worden overgeheveld naar beleidsartikel 1 «versterking rechtstaat»
Motie van de leden Kisteman en Vermeer over bij de verkenning naar een nieuwe financieringssystematiek voor de Kamer van Koophandel de financiële gevolgen ervan voor ondernemers meewegen
Motion asks the government to explicitly weigh the financial burden on entrepreneurs when exploring a new funding system (annual contribution) for the Chamber of Commerce.
requests the government, in exploring a new funding system for the Chamber of Commerce, to explicitly weigh the financial consequences for entrepreneurs

verzoekt de regering bij de verkenning naar een nieuwe financieringssystematiek voor de Kamer van Koophandel de financiële gevolgen van een nieuwe systematiek voor ondernemers uitdrukkelijk mee te wegen
Motie van het lid Vermeer over een onderzoek naar de sociale, economische en financiële gevolgen van zero-emissiezones voor ondernemers, ambulante handel en regio's
Asks the government to study the social and economic effects of zero-emission zones on businesses and regions, inform parliament, and explore options to postpone the policy if evaluation shows harm.
requests the government to start a thorough study of the social, economic and financial effects of introducing zero-emission zones
verzoekt de regering om een grondig onderzoek te starten naar de sociale, economische en financiële gevolgen van de invoering van zero-emissiezones
Motie van het lid Flach c.s. over het Adviescollege toetsing regeldruk vragen zijn signaleringsfunctie te verbreden naar nationale koppen die afkomstig zijn van landelijke toezichthouders
Asks the government to tell supervisors not to add requirements beyond legislation and to ask the ATR to broaden its signalling role to national reports from national supervisors.
requests the government to ask the ATR to broaden its signalling function to national signals from national supervisors
verzoekt de regering het ATR te vragen zijn signaleringsfunctie te verbreden naar nationale koppen afkomstig van landelijke toezichthouders
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over in de bedrijfseffectentoets opnemen dat "nee, tenzij" in nieuwe wetsvoorstellen het uitgangspunt voor rapportageverplichtingen is
Asks the government to make the nee-tenzij principle the starting point for reporting obligations in new bills, reflected in the business impact assessment.
requests the government to ensure that in new bills the starting point for reporting obligations is 'no, unless'
verzoekt de regering te bewerkstelligen dat in nieuwe wetsvoorstellen het uitgangspunt voor rapportageverplichtingen «nee, tenzij» is
Motie van het lid Kisteman c.s. over de tussenevaluatie en de eindevaluatie van de Impulsaanpak winkelgebieden naar voren halen
Asks the government to bring forward the interim and final evaluations of the Impulsaanpak winkelgebieden so the House can act on the results sooner.
requests the government to bring forward the interim evaluation planned for 2027 and the final evaluation planned for 2032
verzoekt de regering de tussenevaluatie die op dit moment gepland staat voor 2027 en de eindevaluatie die op dit moment gepland staat voor 2032 naar voren te halen
Motie van de leden Flach en Vermeer over de tussenevaluatie van de Impulsaanak winkelgebieden tijdig opleveren, zodat deze betrokken kan worden bij de besluitvorming over de Voorjaarsnota 2025
Motion asks the government to deliver the interim evaluation of the Impulsaanpak shopping areas in time for the Voorjaarsnota 2025 decision.
requests the government to deliver the interim evaluation on time so it can be included in budget decision-making
verzoekt de regering de tussenevaluatie zodanig op tijd op te leveren dat deze betrokken kan worden bij de besluitvorming
Motie van het lid Martens-America c.s. over de lessen van de Beethovenaanpak gebruiken voor vernieuwing van het innovatie- en industriebeleid en de regionale economische ontwikkeling
Asks the government to apply lessons from the Beethoven approach to renewing innovation, industrial and regional economic policy.
requests the government to take the lessons of the targeted Beethoven approach and use them to renew innovation and industrial policy
verzoekt de regering de lessen van de gerichte Beethovenaanpak mee te nemen en te gebruiken voor de vernieuwing van ons innovatie- en industriebeleid
Motie van het lid Van Oostenbruggen c.s. over een onderzoek door de Algemene Rekenkamer naar de oorzaken van de grote verschillen tussen de ramingen van het begrotingstekort en de uitkomsten
Asks the Algemene Rekenkamer to investigate why budget deficit forecasts diverged so far from outcomes.
requests the Algemene Rekenkamer, under article 7.23 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016, to investigate the causes of the large differences between the budget deficit forecasts and the outcomes

verzoekt de Algemene Rekenkamer op grond van artikel 7.23 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016 een onderzoek in te stellen naar de oorzaken van de grote verschillen tussen de ramingen van het begrotingstekort en de uitkomsten
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Vermeer ter vervanging van nr. 16 over een aanvulling op het bedrag ineens als na invaren het pensioenrecht bij de waardeoverdracht wordt verhoogd
Adjusts pension transfer rules so that buy-out amounts of retirees who took a lump sum before a collective transfer are raised in line with the buffer distribution.
This amendment ensures that for the group of persons who take a lump sum before entry, the buffer is also taken into account.
Dit amendement zorgt ervoor dat ook voor de groep personen die vóór invaren gebruik maken van bedrag ineens rekening wordt gehouden met de buffer.
Amendement van het lid Vermeer over een aanvulling op het bedrag ineens als na invaren het pensioenrecht bij de waardeoverdracht wordt verhoogd
Requires that the buy-out amount be increased at transfer when a retiree took a lump sum before pension invaren, so the buffer is distributed as if no buy-out occurred.
This amendment ensures that the group of persons who take a lump sum before invaren is also taken into account for the buffer.
Dit amendement zorgt ervoor dat ook voor de groep personen die vóór invaren gebruik maken van bedrag ineens rekening wordt gehouden met de buffer.
Amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. over het verbod op contante betaling doen gelden vanaf €10.000
Raises the threshold of the ban on cash payments by goods traders from 3,000 to 10,000 euro, aligning it with the EU AML regulation.
In the proposed article 1f in article I, part C, '€ 3,000' is replaced by '€ 10,000'.
In het in artikel I, onderdeel C, voorgestelde artikel 1f wordt «€ 3.000» vervangen door «€ 10.000».
Motie van het lid Erkens c.s. over inzichtelijk maken hoe meer rekening gehouden wordt met ruimte voor verschillende soorten visserij in balans met andere spelers op de Noordzee
Asks the government to begin making visible how fishing space is weighed against other North Sea users while keeping wind-at-sea ambitions.
requests the government to start making visible, in preparation for the coalition agreement, how more account is taken of space for different types of fishing.
verzoekt de regering om in voorbereiding op het regeerprogramma alvast te beginnen met het inzichtelijk maken van hoe meer rekening gehouden wordt met de ruimte voor verschillende soorten visserij
Motie van het lid Erkens c.s. over na het afbouwen van de salderingsregeling direct stoppen met het in rekening brengen van terugleverkosten en andere heffingen voor zonnepanelen
Asks the government to stop charging feed-in costs and other levies on solar panels immediately once net metering is phased out.
ensure that immediately it stops charging feed-in costs
ervoor te zorgen dat er dan ook per direct wordt gestopt met het in rekening brengen van de terugleverkosten
Motie van de leden Vermeer en Erkens over een algemene maatregel van bestuur om de uitbreiding van de bevoegdheden van publieke infrastructuurbedrijven te beperken tot invoer, uitvoer en doorvoer van
Asks the government, by general administrative order, to restrict public infrastructure companies' expanded powers in the energy law to import, export and transit of hydrogen only.
requests the government, via a general administrative order under the Energy Act, to attach rules to the participation of public infrastructure companies
verzoekt de regering via een algemene maatregel van bestuur, conform artikel 3.21, lid 5, van de Energiewet, voorschriften te verbinden aan de deelname van publieke infrastructuurbedrijven
Amendement van het lid Postma c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 45 over dat de redelijke vergoeding bij teruglevering niet negatief mag zijn
Amendment stating that the reasonable compensation for renewable electricity fed back by small-connection end users cannot be set at a negative amount.
The reasonable compensation for renewable electricity cannot be set at a negative amount.
De redelijke vergoeding voor hernieuwbare elektriciteit kan niet worden vastgesteld op een negatief bedrag.
Motie van het lid Vermeer over de voorziene inhoud van de Wet collectieve warmte opnemen in de Energiewet
Asks the government to move the intended content of the Wet collectieve warmte into the Energiewet so consumer protection is harmonised in one law.
requests the government to include the planned content of the Collective Heat Act in the Energy Act
verzoekt de regering om de voorziene inhoud van de Wet collectieve warmte op te nemen in de Energiewet
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de veiligheidsrisico’s van windturbines op land

An MP asked whether the Dutch Safety Board has investigated fire and safety risks of onshore wind turbines, how safety, firefighting and disaster response are assured for turbines of 130 metres and higher, how residents are informed, how cleanup and compensation after an incident are handled, and whether a national risk analysis will be made. The government answered that the Safety Board has not investigated such risks, that safety is ensured through existing environmental-law rules and local competent authorities, that the firefighting approach is limited for turbine fires, that information and cleanup are the responsibility of the initiator, operator and regional authorities, and that it sees no reason for a national risk analysis at present.
At this moment I therefore see no reason to draw up a national risk analysis for wind turbines of 130 metres and higher.
Op dit moment zie ik daarom geen aanleiding een landelijke risicoanalyse op te stellen voor windturbines van 130 meter en hoger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het artikel 'Drie dagen in dienst, 19.000 euro na ontslag wegens geloof

An MP asked three ministers about a court ruling that an employer unlawfully dismissed a worker during probation over religious grounds, and about its consequences for employers and the labour market. The Minister of Social Affairs answered that courts' rulings cannot be commented on, that existing law gives employers enough room, and that no legislative change is currently considered necessary.
In view of the answers given, we currently see no reason to amend laws and regulations.
Met inachtneming van de geformuleerde antwoorden, zien wij op dit moment geen reden om wet- en regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het artikel 'Kabinet trekt toch 700 miljoen euro extra uit voor Oekraïne'

MP Vermeer asked whether using 700 million euros of underspending to fund extra Ukraine aid breaches budget rules, how this fits the cabinet's earlier position, and for overviews of Dutch and EU aid, refugee costs and oversight of aid spending. The government answered that underspending may be redirected, that it is a first step on the Chamber's motion, and provided aid tables, EU instrument details and an account of the procurement and audit controls in place.
The cabinet will then consider at the beginning of the new year how further follow-up to the motion can be given.
Het kabinet beziet vervolgens in het begin van het nieuwe jaar hoe verdere opvolging aan de motie gegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het sectoraal uitzendverbod en initiatieven van de Centrale Organisatie voor de Vleessector (COV) om de omstandigheden van arbeidsmigranten te verbeteren

An MP asked the minister whether the sectoral temporary-agency ban for the meat sector is justified, whether it would actually end abuses given that contract forms would merely shift, and whether the government would drop it in favour of sector-party initiatives led by the COV. The minister said widespread violations justify preparing a sectoral in- and uitleenverbod as a backstop, that agency use is the main predictor of violations and weak-link risks will be studied, and that talks with VleesNL are ongoing with the Chamber to be informed later.
In large parts of the meat sector there are high percentages of flexible work (around 70%) and especially temporary agency workers.
In grote gedeelten van de vleessector is sprake van hoge percentages flexwerk (rond de 70%) en met name uitzendkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over plannen van de Europese Commissie voor een eigen inlichtingendienst

An MP asked whether the European Commission's reported plan for its own intelligence unit would transfer national security powers to Brussels and undermine member-state control. The minister said no Commission proposal has been shared yet, that intelligence sharing with the EU's SIAC is voluntary, that the Netherlands supports closer EU intelligence cooperation via SIAC, and that a future proposal would be assessed and reported to parliament.
If a proposal from the European Commission is published, your House will, as usual, be informed of it through a cabinet response.
Indien er een voorstel vanuit de Europese Commissie gepubliceerd wordt, zal uw Kamer zoals gebruikelijk hierover geïnformeerd worden door middel van een kabinetsreactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de vermeende ontheffing van het deponeren van een jaarrekening met stikstofwinst

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that an environmental adviser's company was exempted from publishing its annual accounts, and whether ANBI status and a commercial BV can be combined. The minister explained the legal conditions for ANBI status and exemptions from filing accounts, and stated that no exemption was granted to the BV in question, calling the premise of the questions incorrect.
No exception or exemption was granted. The premise of questions 8 to 10 is incorrect.
Er is geen uitzondering of vrijstelling gegeven. De premisse in de vragen 8 t/m 10 is onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het toevoegen van agri-PV aan landbouwgrond

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the agricultural exemption for land value changes should cover land used for agri-PV solar panels, and how the Tax Authority applies the 90% farm-use test. The State Secretary confirmed the 90% test, said land used for energy generation does not qualify, and declined to broaden the exemption, citing purpose, complexity, budget and EU state-aid concerns.
It is not obvious to broaden the scope of the agricultural exemption
Het ligt niet voor de hand om de reikwijdte van de landbouwvrijstelling te verbreden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over zonnevelden op landbouwgrond en risico's voor bodem, water en gezondheid

MP Vermeer asked why solar and wind projects continue despite RES targets and grid congestion, whether solar fields on farmland should be restricted, whether chemical leakage and EMF risks have been studied, and whether projects should pause until these are clear. The minister answered that renewable energy on land remains needed, that the tightened solar priority order discourages solar fields on farmland except for listed exceptions, that some panels contain hazardous substances but pose no serious risk in normal use, that EMF is handled under precautionary policy, and that independent research continues.
Solar fields on these lands are in principle undesirable, unless one of the following exceptions applies
Zonnevelden op deze gronden zijn in principe ongewenst, tenzij het gaat om één van de volgende uitzonderingsmogelijkheden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over ‘drijvende zonnepanelen voor de kust van Egmond aan Zee’

An MP asked the minister about a floating solar park planned among wind turbines off Egmond aan Zee, covering its proven status, financing, risk allocation, durability, safety, ecological impact, cumulative effects, monitoring and evaluation. The minister answered that no direct public subsidies or guarantees are given, the developer bears all risks, ecological effects are largely unknown and will be monitored under a multi-year programme, and the project will be evaluated over its one-year term with the Chamber to be informed.
The cabinet undertakes to inform the Chamber about the follow-up to this.
Het kabinet zegt toe de Kamer over de opvolging hiervan te zullen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de gezamenlijke verklaring inzake de humanitaire situatie in Gaza

An MP asked why the government opposes Israel's new NGO registration requirement, why it does not act through the EU jointly, and what Dutch NGOs are affected and what safeguards Dutch aid funding requires. The minister answered that the law risks arbitrary refusals harming civil society and that the Netherlands raised the issue bilaterally and with EU partners, while also describing risk-management and screening requirements for funded NGOs.
For more information, the House was informed today (24 September 2025) by means of a confidential letter.
Voor meer informatie is uw Kamer vandaag (24 september 2025) middels een vertrouwelijke brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de gezamenlijke verklaring inzake de humanitaire situatie in Gaza

An MP asked why the government opposes Israel's new NGO registration requirement, why Dutch involvement in Israel's internal security policy is justified, and why the Netherlands did not act through an EU-wide statement. The minister answered that the law risks arbitrary refusals harming humanitarian aid, that the Netherlands is pressing the issue bilaterally and multilaterally with other countries, and that Dutch NGOs' essential aid is at risk, with vetting procedures for partners described.
For more information, your House was informed today (24 September 2025) by way of a confidential letter.
Voor meer informatie is uw Kamer vandaag (24 september 2025) middels een vertrouwelijke brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas, Vermeer, Pierik, Van Zanten, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Wijen-Nass, Oostenbrink en Joseph over optredens van de haatprediker Bob Vylan in Nederland

MPs from BBB asked whether a Bob Vylan concert in Paradiso calling for violence against Zionists and whether such performances should be allowed, and asked about criminal liability, entry bans and municipal responsibility. The minister said prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, declined to comment on individual cases, and noted that municipal mayors decide on events and that entry refusal is possible under Schengen rules but depends on available information.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to investigate exactly what was said. The police investigation into this is still ongoing.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te onderzoeken wat er precies is gezegd. Het politieonderzoek hiernaar loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het artikel 'De transformatie van Volksbank naar ASN Bank is niet goedkoop'

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the ASN Bank (former Volksbank) reorganisation is aimed at a sale, how much it costs, and whether it conflicts with the House's wish to halt privatisation. The minister answered that the transformation is an operational decision of the bank in its commercial strategy, that the state and NLFI may not influence it under ACM measures, and that no sale decision has been taken yet.
Neither I nor NLFI have been involved in this operational decision.
Noch ik, noch NLFI zijn betrokken geweest bij dit operationele besluit.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het uitblijven van uitvoering van de aangenomen moties Van Zanten en Vermeer over het opzetten van sectorale regeldrukreductieprogramma’s en over de afschaffing van de CO2-rapp

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why motions adopted in April 2025 (abolishing CO2 reporting for firms under 250 employees and sectoral red-tape reduction programmes targeting 20%) have not yet been implemented. The minister says he is working on an SME exemption for the CO2 reporting duty to be assessed in 2026, that about 25% of the most burdensome obligations are being addressed with a target of 100% reviewed by end-2026, and that a new approach to red tape is being pursued.
With the State Secretary of IenW I recently agreed to work out proposals for an exemption for SMEs.
Met de Staatssecretaris van IenW heb ik onlangs afgesproken om voorstellen uit te werken voor een uitzondering voor het mkb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de waardedalingen van woningen nabij windturbines naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving over geplande windturbines in de gemeente Stichtse Vecht

An MP asked the minister about resident opposition to planned 240-metre wind turbines in Stichtse Vecht, the claimed property value losses and whether planning-damage compensation is adequate. The minister answered that the Omgevingswet's 4% normal social risk and planning-damage compensation are sufficient, declined new independent research, and said the province and RES regions decide on wind siting within the agreed targets.
The cabinet considers that the current planning-damage compensation provides sufficient compensation.
Het kabinet vindt dat de huidige planschadevergoedingen voldoende compensatie bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht ' Belastingdienst verstuurde tienduizenden brieven met verkeerd box- 3 rendement'

MP Vermeer asked the State Secretary of Finance about tens of thousands of Tax Authority letters with incorrect box 3 returns, whether the same error recurred, whether affected people were informed, and how the box 3 restitution operation's system problems will be fixed. Minister Heinen says the 33,000 excuse letters contained the correct return, 4,500 rejection letters were sent of which 200 wrongly, the automated checking process is paused and will be fixed by early October.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over Nederlandse subsidies voor waterstofprojecten waarvan het klimaatvoordeel in het buitenland belandt

An MP asked whether Dutch hydrogen subsidies (OWE) produce CO2 savings abroad, notably the Air Liquide plant whose output largely serves Belgium, and whether subsidies should be halted. The minister answered that CO2 reduction is credited where fossil hydrogen production is displaced (here mainly in the Netherlands), that no export-restricting conditions can legally be imposed, and declined to stop the subsidies.
Imposing a condition that, for example, the fully renewable hydrogen produced may only be used in the Netherlands may qualify as such a measure.
Het stellen van een voorwaarde dat bijvoorbeeld de geproduceerde volledig hernieuwbare waterstof uitsluitend in Nederland mag worden gebruikt, kan kwalificeren als een dergelijke maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de betrokkenheid van Extinction Rebellion bij het Nationaal Burgerberaad Klimaat

An MP asked the Minister whether Extinction Rebellion was involved in preparing the National Citizens' Climate Assembly, whether its input shaped the process, and what safeguards exist against activist influence. The Minister answered that XR contacted the secretariat on its own initiative without leading to changes, that the independent secretariat made the selection choices under the agreed conditions, and that the final report will be presented in November rather than before the elections.
XR's input to the secretariat was on XR's own initiative and did not lead to any adjustments by the secretariat.
De input van XR richting het secretariaat was op eigen initiatief van XR en heeft niet geleid tot aanpassingen door het secretariaat.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over verziltingsrisico’s bij het voorkeurstracé, het negeren van regionale voorstellen en het ontbreken van de tunnelvariant Programma Aansluiting Wind Op Zee (PAWOZ) – Eemshaven

Vermeer (BBB) asks the minister about salinisation risks of the preferred PAWOZ-Eemshaven route, why the regional tunnel variant was left out of the project MER, and related questions on modelling, timing and the lack of an initiating party. The minister defends the Schiermonnikoog Wantij route as the only feasible option for timely grid connection, says the tunnel is being studied for future projects, and argues that directional drilling and the modelling used keep the salinisation risk small.
The Schiermonnikoog Wantij route is the only reliable, feasible route that ensures offshore wind makes landfall on time.
De Schiermonnikoog Wantij route is de enige betrouwbare, haalbare route die zorgt dat wind op zee tijdig aanlandt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over extra windturbines op land

An MP from BBB asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether onshore wind expansion is needed given the 2050 energy demand estimates, offshore alternatives, costs, and the Klimaatakkoord targets. The minister answers that the figures are indicative, a broad mix of sources is planned, onshore wind remains useful for local demand, and no separate cost-benefit analysis is planned because existing programmes cover the comparison.
The cabinet sees no added value in doing this separately.
Het kabinet ziet geen toegevoegde waarde om dit apart te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Vermeer over het bericht ‘Hervorming politieke pensioenen per 2028 in gevaar’

MPs Joseph and Vermeer asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that the reform placing politicians' pensions in the new pension system by 2028 is at risk, including the bill's status, budgetary effects of delay, unresolved legal issues, and timing of consultation. The minister answered that the bill is in preparation, the target date of 1 January 2028 still stands, legal and technical issues will be addressed in the bill, and consultation is aimed for 2025.
The aim is to put the bill into consultation in 2025.
Het streven is het wetsvoorstel in 2025 in consultatie te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht 'Uitbreiding stroomnet trekt door TenneT spoor van vernieling bij boeren: je moet instemmen anders kun je worden onteigend'

MP Vermeer asked the Minister of Finance to specify how often TenneT reaches agreement with landowners, how often easement orders, mediation and expropriation were used, and what can prevent legal proceedings. The minister answered that over 3,000 contracts were concluded, about 40 landowners faced easement orders, mediation was used five times, and expropriation once, and that he will keep urging careful conduct by TenneT as shareholder.
Between 2020 and 2024 an easement obligation was imposed on about 40 landowners (in 12 procedures).
Tussen 2020 en 2024 is een gedoogplicht opgelegd aan circa 40 landeigenaren (in 12 procedures)
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het Nationaal Burgerberaad Klimaat

MP Vermeer asked ministers about a children's climate summit run under the National Citizens' Climate Assembly, questioning the factual accuracy and one-sidedness of its video and materials, the role of government, costs, and whether climate education for children should be regulated. The minister responded that the independent chair commissioned and reviewed the summit, acknowledged that the video needed nuance and a fact-check was added, stated government does not produce school materials given freedom of education, and gave a cost of about 61,000 euro.
The chair acknowledged that as commissioner she should have been sharper about the examples and facts presented.
De voorzitter heeft erkend dat zij als opdrachtgever scherper had moeten zijn op de gepresenteerde voorbeelden en feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht 'Uitbreiding stroomnet trekt door TenneT spoor van vernieling bij boeren: je moet instemmen anders kun je worden onteigend'

An MP from BBB asked the Finance Minister about reports that TenneT's grid expansion damages farmers' land, that contractors breach agreements, and that crop-damage compensation is hard to prove after two years. The minister acknowledged complaints, said TenneT uses supervisors and standard contracts, and promised to keep pressing TenneT on careful conduct and to evaluate the compensation process.
I have asked TenneT to continue to pay attention in the coming years to the careful conduct of (sub)contractors and to honour agreements on how the work is carried out.
Ik heb TenneT verzocht de komende jaren aandacht te blijven houden voor het zorgvuldig handelen van (onder)aannemers en om afspraken over de uitvoering van de werkzaamheden na te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de brandbrief ‘bezorgde (oud-)ambtenaren

An MP from BBB asks the Climate and Interior ministers about an open letter by (former) civil servants urging climate policy such as coal plant closure, questioning whether signatories' public action fits political neutrality, the oath of office, the integrity code and conflict-of-interest rules. The minister replies that civil servants are politically neutral but may express views within the functioning norm, that the integrity code applies only to active staff, that only a very small number of signatories are active at the relevant departments, and that assessment is a personnel matter for each employer.
Whether the 'functioning norm' is exceeded cannot be said in general terms or for whole groups.
Of de «functioneringsnorm» wordt overschreden kan niet in algemene zin, of voor hele groepen worden gezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de uitkoop van boeren en de daaropvolgende migratie van bedrijfsbezit naar privé

An MP from BBB asked the State Secretary of Finance how often farmers who exit via the voluntary buyout scheme face large tax assessments when business assets such as the farmhouse move to private use, whether this deters exits, and whether a conservation assessment or payment deferral could help. The State Secretary said there are no signals that farmers are deterred, pointed to the broadened reinvestment reserve, said further tax measures were judged of limited effect, and described the existing conservation assessment and payment-deferral options.

I am not aware of any signals that farmers, because of the tax consequences of withdrawing business assets for private use upon cessation, are caught in difficulties when participating in a voluntary termination scheme.

Er zijn mij geen signalen bekend dat agrariërs, vanwege de fiscale gevolgen van het onttrekken van bedrijfsmiddelen naar privé in het kader van de staking van de onderneming, in de knel komen bij deelname aan een vrijwillige beëindigingsregeling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het gemeentefonds

An MP asks whether the government made errors in calculating the gemeentefonds accres after the switch to the new normering system, whether restoring the opschalingskorting and youth care cuts were meant to fall outside later accres calculations, and how inflation forecast errors affect municipalities and provinces. The Staatssecretaris answers that the amounts were agreed with the VNG and IPO, that the VNG's claimed extra accres (92 and 108 million structural) was not agreed, and that the forecast gap was mainly caused by volatile crisis years, with commitments to improve reporting on taakmutaties in circulars.

Together with municipalities, provinces, the VNG and the IPO, it will be examined how to report on this in the circulars in such a way that the accres calculation is traceable for municipalities and provinces.

Samen met gemeenten, provincies en de VNG en het IPO wordt bekeken hoe hierover in de circulaires te rapporteren op een dusdanige wijze dat voor gemeenten en provincies de berekening van het accres navolgbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over financiering van ngo’s, belangenorganisaties en goede doelen

MP Vermeer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs which NGOs, interest groups and charities receive subsidies from the ministry, the criteria, thematic focus, budgets for 2025-2030, subsidies above 100,000 euro, and a per-project table. The minister replied that no specific subsidy overview for these organisations is kept, pointed to public open data and general subsidy criteria, gave aggregate budgets, and said the Uniform Subsidy Framework will be revised by 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht 'New shipyard for TenneT's German offshore platforms is being built in Spain'

An MP asked whether TenneT's German offshore platform shipyard being built in Spain, financed partly through Dutch state-owned TenneT, conflicts with the Maritime Manufacturing sector agenda and whether Dutch taxpayer money is involved. The minister answered that the Dutch state holds TenneT Holding indirectly, that the EU tender was awarded on price, quality and delivery time without a Dutch consortium bidding, and that the sector agenda was not a criterion, promising only a Q2 2025 progress letter.
The Siemens Energy and Dragados Offshore consortium awarded the tender for building the shipyard on the basis of various criteria.
Het consortium Siemens Energy en Dragados Offshore heeft de aanbesteding voor de bouw van de werf op basis van verschillende criteria gegund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over mijnbouwherstel in Limburg

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about the timeline, organisation, funding and oversight of the Limburg mining-damage compensation scheme, including whether the scheme can open in 2025. The minister answered that a temporary organisation will be set up, the scheme is planned to open at the end of 2025, a permanent body will be created later, the regional advisory role is not yet guaranteed, and a pilot by the Limburg commission will be reported to the House.
The cabinet will open the scheme at the end of 2025.
Het kabinet zal de regeling eind 2025 openstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over slimme gestuurde warmtebatterijen

An MP (BBB) asked the minister whether heat batteries like NEStore, and energy storage generally, are undervalued in building rules and subsidies, and whether the government would support a Dutch gigafactory. The minister replied that storage is being valued in the upcoming NTA8800 method under the EPBD, that existing subsidies already cover storage, and that the government will inform parliament on innovation instruments in Q3 2025.
In the third quarter of 2025 the Minister of EZ will inform the House of his intentions.
In het derde kwartaal van 2025 informeert de Minister van EZ de Kamer over zijn voornemens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over verzorgingsplaatsen van de toekomst

MP Vermeer asks the minister about the high costs and unequal chances for SME operators at rest-stop fuel and charging concessions, the temporary policy rule shortening charging permits, fossil fuel phase-out, and trust with SME fuel station owners. The minister replies that permits are allocated by lottery or on request, fuel stations are auctioned under the Benzinewet, a draft bill is in consultation with equal access as a key aim, existing concession terms will be respected, and the sector will be involved in a participation track on the route map.
Equal access for all entrepreneurs is very important.
Gelijke toegang voor alle ondernemers is erg belangrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ceder, Van der Burg, Kahraman, Vermeer, Boswijk en Eerdmans over christenvervolging in de Democratische Republiek Congo

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the killing of 70 people in a church in the DR Congo, the role of the Special Envoy for Religion, EU terrorist listing of the ADF, foreign support for the ADF, and UN action. The minister condemned the attack, said the Envoy's involvement is not currently of added value, agreed to explore listing the ADF, and described Dutch and EU support for peace and UN human rights mechanisms.
I am willing to examine the possibilities of placing this group on the European terrorism sanctions list or the European ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctions list.
Ik ben bereid te onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om deze groep op de Europese terrorisme-sanctielijst of de Europese ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctielijst te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer naar aanleiding van de Kamerbrief wijzigingen ontwikkelkader wind op zee

An MP from BBB asked why the offshore wind development framework ignores fisheries impacts, how fisheries are protected and involved, cumulative ecological effects, compensation, nature compensation, cable security, decommissioning and costs. The minister replied that fisheries policy trade-offs are made in the North Sea Programme rather than the framework, listed the technical changes made, and described existing consultation, mitigation, monitoring and funding measures, while committing to further studies on active fishing in wind farms.
The policy trade-off between fisheries and offshore wind is made in the North Sea Programme, not in the Development Framework.
De beleidsmatige afweging tussen visserij en windenergie op zee wordt gemaakt in het Programma Noordzee, niet in het Ontwikkelkader.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie subsidies heeft verstrekt aan milieuorganisaties om specifieke wetgevingsvoorstellen te promoten, zoals de Natuurherstelwet

An MP asked the Dutch ministers whether EU Commission subsidies to environmental NGOs to promote legislation such as the Nature Restoration Law raise transparency concerns, and asked for an overview, conditions, and publication of Dutch subsidies to such groups. The minister denied that Dutch subsidies fund lobbying, declined a full overview and publication of individual subsidy agreements, and stated no changes to subsidy policy are planned.
No. The cabinet does not keep a central overview of all national government subsidies.
Nee. Het kabinet houdt geen centraal overzicht bij van alle rijkssubsidies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Vermeer over het bericht 'Minister wijst verder onderzoek naar eilanden met zonnepanelen in IJsselmeer definitief van de hand'

MPs Eerdmans and Vermeer asked whether the Wieringerhoek floating solar project in the IJsselmeer can still proceed despite the minister halting it, and whether the Rijk should stop further steps by the province and municipality. The minister answered that no procedures are running, the cabinet refused the Meerlicht B.V. project application, insufficient prospects for permits exist, and the cabinet sees no reason to act on the call to halt local efforts.
Given this, and since the cabinet has already rejected the Meerlicht B.V. application for the project procedure, the cabinet sees no reason at this time to act on your call.

Gezien dit gegeven en het kabinet de aanvraag van Meerlicht B.V. tot toepassing van de projectprocedure reeds heeft afgewezen, ziet het kabinet op dit moment geen aanleiding om gevolg te geven aan uw oproep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht dat PostNL brievenbussen eerder gaat legen

An MP asked the minister whether PostNL's plan to empty 75% of letterboxes before 17:00 from February 2025 is compatible with the 95%-within-24-hours delivery norm, and whether the ministry was consulted. The minister says the law sets no collection times so ACM may enforce only if other universal-service rules are breached, that PostNL did not seek ministry approval, and that no irreversible steps will be taken before the ACM postal market study and an appraisal to parliament.
To address the concerns of the House, I indeed committed not to take irreversible steps while the ACM's postal market study is still ongoing.
Om aan de zorgen van de Kamer tegemoet te komen heb ik inderdaad toegezegd om geen onomkeerbare stappen te zetten terwijl het onderzoek naar de postmarkt van de ACM nog gaande is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeer en Van Zanten over het bericht 'Vernietiging Armeens erfgoed in Nagorno-Karabach: 'Doelbewust uitwissen geschiedenis''

Two BBB MPs asked whether the government would summon the Azerbaijani ambassador, urge Azerbaijan to stop destroying Armenian heritage in Nagorno-Karabakh, prosecute perpetrators, protect remaining Armenians and compensate displaced people, and add the conflict to Dutch education. The government answered that it is concerned, urged compliance with Hague conventions and peace talks, but did not commit to summoning the ambassador and deferred prosecution and compensation to the two states.
It is up to Armenia and Azerbaijan to ensure investigation and prosecution of crimes within this framework.
Het is aan Armenië en Azerbeidzjan om binnen dit kader zorg te dragen voor opsporing en vervolging van misdrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de tijdsplanning van het wetsvoorstel overgang pensioenaanspraken politieke ambtsdragers naar het nieuwe pensioenstelsel

An MP asked the Minister of Interior why the bill moving political office holders' pensions (APPA) into the new pension system has not yet been put to consultation and why it is delayed. The minister attributes the delay to the cabinet change and complex legal and technical issues, expects to submit the bill in 2025, and aims for full entry into force on 1 January 2028.
The aim remains to bring the Aanpassingswet Appa fully into effect on 1 January 2028.
Het streven blijft er op gericht om de Aanpassingswet Appa volledig in werking te laten treden per 1 januari 2028.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Vermeer over het bericht “Bijna vijftig strijders en zes jihadisten uit buitenland benoemd tot officieren in Syrië”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Ukraine would send food and aid to Syria, questioning how this fits with Dutch support for Ukraine and Dutch budget constraints. The minister answered that the aid runs through the WFP Grain from Ukraine Initiative funded by donors, not by Ukraine, and that Ukraine's support continues.
Ukraine manages the initiative but does not itself make any financial contribution.
Oekraïne beheert het initiatief maar levert zelf geen financiële bijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over windturbinegeluid

MP Vermeer (BBB) asks the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the wind turbine noise standard, the RIVM factsheet, health effects, sleep disturbance, the proposed 10% severe-annoyance norm, and a moratorium on turbines, with calls to stop turbines at night and withdraw permits. The state secretary defends the L den norm and the plan-MER, rejects the moratorium and permit withdrawal as the competence of local or provincial authorities, and promises no new measures beyond continued research.

No, there is no reason for this. The noise standards are, in line with WHO guideline values and the norms for other noise sources, expressed as the annual average noise measure L den, because it aligns with the annoyance relationships available from scientific research.

Nee, hiertoe is geen aanleiding. De geluidsnormen zijn, in lijn met de WHO-advieswaarden en met de normen voor andere geluidbronnen, uitgedrukt in de jaargemiddelde geluidmaat L den , omdat deze aansluit bij de uit wetenschappelijk onderzoek beschikbare hinderrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over Agri-PV

MP Vermeer (BBB) asked the ministers whether the definition of agri-PV (combined agriculture and solar energy) should leave room for innovation, whether the agricultural land designation stays agricultural, and about tax, fertiliser, GLB subsidy and ANLb nature-payment rules. The government answered yes to most questions, committed to a WEnR study and to possibly amending the GLB regulation, but declined general statements on tax treatment and fertiliser quantities, citing case-by-case assessment.
Within taxation, it must be assessed case by case whether entitlement to the various schemes can be claimed.
Binnen de fiscaliteit moet per geval worden beoordeeld of er aanspraak kan worden gemaakt op de verschillende regelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over hoe het groene beleid van de Europese Unie kwalijke emissies buiten de EU veroorzaakt

An MP asked the government whether EU Green Deal policies such as afforestation, bioenergy and organic farming cause harmful spillover emissions and food production shifts outside the EU, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the study's findings, says the government takes such spillovers into account and will assess the forthcoming EU agriculture vision, but does not commit to specific new measures.
The cabinet will assess this vision in due course and inform the House of Representatives about it.
Het kabinet zal deze visie te zijner tijd beoordelen en uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de 54ste bijeenkomst van het WEF

An MP asked why the Dutch cabinet sends a relatively large delegation to the WEF annual meeting in Davos, what sessions it will attend, and whether any agreements will be made without prior parliamentary approval. The minister answered that three ministers will attend, that no agreements or treaties will be concluded there, and that no decisions requiring parliamentary consent are taken, though the programmes were not yet finalised.
During the WEF annual meeting no political decisions are taken or international agreements made for which approval of the House of Representatives is required.
Tijdens de jaarlijkse vergadering van het WEF worden er geen politieke besluiten genomen of internationale afspraken gemaakt, waarvoor instemming van de Tweede Kamer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Vermeer, Bontenbal, Postma en Beckerman over de misleidende praktijken van energieleverancier Hollandse Energie Maatschappij (HEM)

MPs from several parties asked the minister about misleading and intimidating practices by energy supplier HEM, what consumer protection and enforcement tools exist, and whether firms like HEM can be barred from supplying energy. The minister said the Energy Act will give the ACM stronger powers (integrity screening, supply stops, licence revocation), noted bailiff-threat issues fall under the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, and answered all ten questions in turn.
In the Energy Act, the ACM is given sufficient new tools to act firmly when it deems this necessary.
In de Energiewet krijgt de ACM voldoende nieuwe handvatten om stevig op te treden als zij dat nodig acht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het rapport 'Het Windmolendrama' van Clintel

An MP asked the minister, in 18 numbered questions, about the Clintel report on wind turbines covering health effects, noise norms, ecological impact, costs, participation, EU law and turbine safety. The government answered that it takes health concerns seriously, is developing new noise and environmental norms with a plan-MER, rejects a moratorium, and points to ongoing RIVM research and existing compensation schemes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Erkens, Vermeer en Grinwis over de overstap van de industrie naar groene waterstof en de raffinageroute

Four MPs asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth and the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about the proposed 0.4 correction factor for the refinery route for green hydrogen, which they feared would undermine hydrogen investment and rely on uncertain market assumptions. The minister defended the correction factor as a balance between CO2 reduction, pump prices and hydrogen stimulation, acknowledged investment risks and committed to a study under a parliamentary motion on the refinery route's impact.

After the parliamentary questions were asked, the House adopted the motion by MPs Bontenbal and Vermeer calling for a study into how the refinery route should be designed to contribute maximally to the industry's sustainability goals.

Na het stellen van Kamervragen heeft de Kamer de motie van de leden Bontenbal en Vermeer aangenomen over een onderzoek naar hoe de raffinageroute eruit moet zien om maximaal bij te dragen aan de verduurzamingsdoelstellingen van de industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over wachttijden voor stroomaansluitingen

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Green Growth about waiting times of up to 70 weeks for household electricity connections, the causes, the measures to speed up grid expansion and permitting, and how these fit the coalition agreement. The minister acknowledges several thousand customers face delays of 40 to 70 weeks, attributes them to local grid works and staff shortages, and points to planned measures including a grid checker, legal changes to speed permitting, and a joint action programme with local governments and grid operators.
The cabinet is firmly steering the resolution of grid congestion problems and making the electricity grid future-proof, as agreed in the coalition agreement.
Het kabinet voert stevig regie op het oplossen netcongestieproblemen en het toekomstbestendig maken van het elektriciteitsnet, zoals afgesproken in het hoofdlijnenakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de tegenwerking van verduurzaming door woningbouwvereniging deltaWonen te Zwolle

An MP asks whether housing corporation deltaWonen in Zwolle is blocking tenants' sustainability measures such as quiet air conditioning and solar panels, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister says tenants can go to the Huurcommissie or the courts, that the corporation's objections to some measures are reasonable in individual cases, and that a bill on tenants' initiative rights is expected in 2025.
If discussions with deltaWonen do not lead to the desired result, residents can turn to the Huurcommissie or the court.
Bewoners kunnen zich, als de gesprekken met deltaWonen niet tot het gewenste resultaat leiden, tot de Huurcommissie of de rechter wenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het stopzetten van leningen aan bedrijven die zich alleen richten op het oppompen van olie en gas en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe velden

MP Vermeer asked the government whether ING's halt on new loans to pure-play oil and gas exploration companies is allowed, what its economic and financial effects would be, and whether other banks follow. Minister Heinen answered that ING's decision is its own commercial choice, that effects on the Dutch economy are expected to be very limited, that the bank's counterparties are confidential, and that gas remains needed during the transition.
Which parties financial institutions enter into financing relationships with is commercially confidential information.
Met welke partijen financiële instellingen financieringsrelaties aangaan, is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over PV-panelen en PFAS

An MP asked the minister about PFAS in solar panels, Chinese competition, domestic production, recycling and whether PFAS-free panels or recycling norms should be mandated. The minister answered that SolarNL and EU measures support domestic manufacturing, that PFAS content is uncertain, and that MVI criteria will be reviewed next year.
Various measures are being implemented, prioritising those with the greatest short-term impact.
Verschillende maatregelen worden uitgevoerd waarbij prioritering wordt gegeven aan maatregelen met de meeste slagkracht op korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over bericht ‘Waarschuwingen en veroordelingen na nieuwe Georgische anti-lhbti-wetgeving’

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs how the government responds to Georgia's new anti-LGBTI law and whether it will summon the Georgian ambassador, factor the law into Georgia's EU candidate status, press Georgia on rights protection, and reconsider its candidacy. The minister condemned the law, said it had raised concerns in talks and publicly, outlined EU-level steps including the Equal Rights Coalition, and stated that the EU accession process has de facto stalled, though no summoning of the ambassador was committed.
In the run-up to the legislative process, the Netherlands repeatedly made clear in talks with the Georgian authorities that it finds the adoption of LGBTIQ+ laws very worrying.
Nederland heeft in de aanloop naar het wetgevingsproces in gesprekken meermaals aan de Georgische autoriteiten duidelijk gemaakt dat Nederland de aanname van lhbtiq+-wetten zeer zorgelijk vindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oostenbruggen en Vermeer over de onderzoekscommissie naar de kwaliteit van de ramingen

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister to confirm and explain the expert group on forecast quality, including its independence, membership, mandate, timeline and comparisons with other countries. The minister confirmed the group, said it is led by an independent chair with CPB, DNB and CBS involved, declined foreign members and internal-only staffing, and promised a report by 1 April 2025.
I will inform you about this in the letter sent at the same time as this reply.
Ik informeer u hierover via de gelijktijdig met deze beantwoording verzonden brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de Nederlandse uitbreiding van de scope voor ETS2

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about the Dutch opt-in extending the EU ETS2 carbon pricing scope, including its fit with the coalition agreement, competitiveness, administrative burdens for farmers and growers, and next steps toward the European Commission. The minister answered that the opt-in excluding horticulture is an existing commitment, that a decision on greenhouse horticulture will be taken by spring 2025, and that a formal request to the Commission will follow if horticulture is included.
The cabinet will abide by this agreement.
Het kabinet zal zich aan deze afspraak houden.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Vermeer over de mislukte verkoop van TenneT Duitsland

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the failed sale of TenneT Germany, including how TenneT's short-term financing need should be met, the government obligations behind its investments, deadlines, whether German grid tariffs could cover the gap, and whether booking the sale proceeds was premature. The ministers answered that a bridging loan to TenneT is planned, explained the statutory investment obligations and planning cycles, stated that tariffs are set by regulators, and defended the budgeting as the most realistic estimate at the time.
In the short term we intend to grant TenneT an additional bridging loan to ensure TenneT can continue to invest.
Voor de korte termijn geldt dat wij voornemens zijn TenneT een aanvullende overbruggingslening te verlenen om er zorg voor te dragen dat TenneT kan blijven investeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over btw-teruggave consumenten

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling that found against a non-EU consumer's VAT refund claim and about whether retailers can be required to cooperate with such refunds. The State Secretary answers that refunds must run through the retailer under the VAT Directive conditions, that retailers cannot be compelled to participate, and that the Tax Authority has no direct role.
I note that a retailer cannot be obliged to apply the zero VAT rate or to facilitate the VAT refund to the non-EU traveller.
Daarbij merk ik op dat een winkelier niet kan worden verplicht om het btw-nultarief toe te passen respectievelijk de teruggave van btw aan de niet-EU-reiziger te faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oostenbruggen en Vermeer over het convenant tussen de Belastingdienst en de uitzendbranche betreffende de toepassing van de extraterritoriale kostenregeling

MPs Van Oostenbruggen and Vermeer asked about the 2024 covenant between the Tax Authority and the staffing industry on the extraterritorial cost scheme, including recruitment abroad, enforcement, financial impact and the link to the coalition agreement. The State Secretary answered that the conditions are unchanged from 2010, enforcement is regular, no concrete amendment to the scheme exists yet, and an evaluation addendum is forthcoming.
Following this, we are further examining whether and how the ETK scheme can be made less generous.
Naar aanleiding hiervan onderzoeken wij verder of en zo ja hoe de ETK-regeling kan worden versoberd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeer en Eerdmans over de zonne-atollen op het IJsselmeer

MPs Vermeer and Eerdmans asked the Minister about opposition to the floating solar 'zonne-atollen' plan on the IJsselmeer, including its Natura 2000 status, defence use, water storage and timing. The Minister answers that the plan is only being explored in an integrated study (Wieringerhoek), with a decision on a formal project procedure targeted for Q4 2024, and that participation will follow in any later procedure.
Only with a positive decision will there be a project procedure for which my department is responsible.
Pas bij een positief besluit zal er sprake zijn van een projectprocedure waarvoor mijn departement verantwoordelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over BTW-teruggave aan internationale reizigers

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about VAT refunds for non-EU travellers (tax-free shopping), including spending levels, use of the scheme, the effect on growth, digitalisation and competitiveness. The State Secretary answered that digital export validation is being prepared as mandatory, with a consultation to follow, while noting that refunds depend on retailer participation and other factors and that the State will refund more VAT if tax-free purchases rise.
I intend to make the export validation of goods bought in the Netherlands and exported from the Netherlands to the EU mandatory via digital means.
ben ik voornemens om de uitvoervalidatie van goederen die in Nederland zijn gekocht en vanuit Nederland de EU worden uitgevoerd, verplicht langs digitale weg te laten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het onderzoeken van de grenseffecten van de accijnsverhogingen op tabak

MP Vermeer asks the State Secretary of Finance whether border-effect studies promised for excise increases on tobacco and alcohol are underway, and questions whether the methods are comparable and whether stacked excise increases harm border-region businesses. The State Secretary confirms the commitment, reports the tobacco study is completed and alcohol analysis is pending, defends different methods per product, and rejects the claims of severe harm, citing health goals and budgetary considerations.
The study on border effects of the 2023 tobacco excise increase has been completed and sent to the House of Representatives.
Het onderzoek met betrekking tot grenseffecten van de accijnsverhoging op tabak in 2023 is inmiddels afgerond en naar de Tweede Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Vermeer over Huisarts waarschuwt voor negatieve gezondheidsgevolgen van windturbines

MPs Van der Plas and Vermeer asked the ministers about a GP's warning on health effects of wind turbines, including whether noise limits and distance norms adequately protect residents. Minister Dijkstra answered that RIVM monitors the evidence, that sleep and hinder effects are documented but other health effects lack sufficient evidence, and that new environmental rules are being prepared through a plan-MER with a decision expected after summer 2024.
As long as the process is still ongoing, I cannot anticipate the outcomes.
Zolang het traject nog loopt, kan ik niet op de uitkomsten vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de TEK-terugbetalingen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether sports association volunteers were adequately warned about repayment of the TEK energy subsidy advance, how subsidy schemes can be made more reliable, and what support sports clubs will get given high energy costs. The minister answered that the repayment risk was communicated repeatedly, that an evaluation of the TEK is being considered in response to Court of Audit and committee questions, and that no additional measures are planned for sports clubs, while offering to talk with the sector if needed.
I am now assessing how best to give substance to this, for example in the form of an evaluation of the TEK.
Ik beoordeel nu op welke wijze het beste hieraan invulling kan worden gegeven in de vorm van bijvoorbeeld een evaluatie van de TEK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het artikel waarin vermeld staat dat een Frans bedrijf honderden laadpalen wil aanleggen in Nederland

An MP asks whether the grid can absorb a new French charging-point operator given existing grid congestion, its effect on waiting lists and competition, and the risk of French consolidation and data access. The State Secretary answers that new entrants are desirable, that outcomes are unknown, that municipalities keep control through tenders, and that GDPR applies.
It is not known where Electra wants to place charging points, so no assessment of this threat can be made.
Het is niet bekend waar Electra laadpalen wil plaatsen, dus kan geen inschatting van deze dreiging worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vermeer over de reactie van de minister over de landelijke uitrol van de Streetwise-methodiek

MPs Inge van Dijk and Vermeer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Streetwise method, which has supported startups and filled vacant shop space, should be rolled out nationally and what the ministry will do to support it. The minister answers that the approach is positive and not specific to Limburg, that a pilot in Overijssel could help, but that no firm rollout plan exists yet and the ministry will only stimulate partners to draw one up.
At present my ministry is playing a stimulating role in bringing about a broadly supported step-by-step plan by bringing parties together and convincing them of the need for such a plan.

Op dit moment speelt mijn ministerie een stimulerende rol bij het totstandkomen van een gedragen stappenplan door partijen bij elkaar te brengen en ze te overtuigen van de noodzaak van een dergelijk plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de gang van zaken omtrent toekenningen en reserveringen voor het Nationaal Groeifonds

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how conditional allocations and reservations under the National Growth Fund are structured, how they are tranched, whether they are legally binding, and whether reservations and expectations for a fourth round should be withdrawn. The minister answers that conditional allocations are legally binding but reservations are not, that the government will keep existing reservations, and that only communication, not firm commitments, has been made to prospective applicants for the fourth round.
The conversions of the reservations become legally binding after authorisation of the first supplementary budget (Voorjaarsnota) by both chambers.
De omzettingen van de reserveringen worden juridisch verplicht na autorisatie van de eerste suppletoire begroting (Voorjaarsnota) door beide Kamers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Vermeer over de brief van 6 februari ‘Gelijke aanpassingen met spreiden in de uitkeringsfase’

Two MPs (Joseph and Vermeer) asked 30 detailed questions about the minister's letter on equal adjustments with smoothing in the pension payout phase of solidarity schemes, including methods, transparency and the Palland amendment. The minister answered that the forthcoming Decree will give legal clarity on conditions for equal adjustments with smoothing, while many answers defer detailed design to pension funds and the forthcoming Decree.
The implementation framework from the letter will result in the Decree, which will be submitted for internet consultation in April, and I will inform your House about it.
Het uitvoeringskader uit de Kamerbrief resulteert in het Besluit wat in april ter internetconsultatie zal worden voorgelegd en waar ik uw Kamer over zal infomeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht 'Vermalen door het systeem'

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the rules for deducting homeopathic and other medical costs from income tax, and about how the Tax Authority handles errors and fraud among chronically ill taxpayers. The answer explains the legal conditions for deduction, reports that about 28% of returns claiming specific care costs contain correctable errors, and says the scheme is being evaluated for simplification and better targeting.
In working out solution directions, the cabinet will continue to involve the experiences of people with a disability and/or chronic illness and their representative organisations.

Het kabinet zal bij het in kaart brengen en uitwerken van de oplossingsrichtingen de ervaringen van mensen met een beperking en/of een chronische ziekte en diens vertegenwoordigende organisaties blijven betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de gang van zaken met betrekking tot de Wet herwaardering proceskostenvergoedingen WOZ en bpm

An MP asks why the Wet herwaardering proceskostenvergoedingen WOZ en bpm applies transitional rules to reduced fees but not to direct payment of compensation into accounts in the claimant's name, and whether this is inconsistent and unreliable toward citizens. The Secretary of State defends the design: transitional rules protect pending claims, direct payment strengthens claimants' information position, and no retroactive extension is planned.
Not providing transitional law for direct payment does not infringe claimants' rights but in fact strengthens their information position and increases their involvement.

Het niet voorzien in overgangsrecht op het punt van rechtstreeks uitbetalen maakt geen inbreuk op de rechten van belanghebbenden, maar versterkt juist hun informatiepositie en vergroot hun betrokkenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over Netcongestie

MP Vermeer asked the Minister about Professor Vittal's warnings on grid stability, whether renewable integration should be halted, and whether the National Energy System Plan should be updated. The Minister replied that grid operators already use the relevant science, that no halt or plan revision is planned, and that smart charging rules are being developed with consent of those affected.
At this moment I see no reason to update the NPE.
Op dit moment zie ik geen reden om het NPE bij te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het Nationaal Programma Groningen

An MP from BBB asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the governance, democratic accountability, oversight and participation in the Nationaal Programma Groningen and Nij Begun, including the lack of a governance evaluation and who supervises the programme. The State Secretary answers that accountability runs through local councils, the Staat van Groningen and annual parliamentary reporting, that evaluation will wait until 2025, and that broad participation is being arranged.
The cabinet will annually provide political accountability to the House via the Staat van Groningen on the results of the generation-long approach announced in Nij Begun.
Het kabinet zal jaarlijks via de Staat van Groningen politieke verantwoording afleggen aan de Kamer over de resultaten van de generatielange aanpak die in Nij Begun is aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het artikel 'Verkopen op Vinted of Marktplaats? "De Belastingdienst kijkt mee"'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the DAC7 thresholds (30 transactions or EUR 2,000 per year) for platform reporting on private online sellers, and whether these create burdens for citizens and platforms. The State Secretary defended the thresholds as a balance between tax enforcement and workability, denied a central database of online income, and argued that DAC7 adds no new tax rules, though some questions were answered only in combined form.
There is no separate central database at the Tax Authority that stores online income of private individuals.
Er is bij de Belastingdienst geen aparte centrale database die online inkomsten van particulieren opslaat.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Toch ruimte op stroomnet, flexibele bedrijven sneller aangesloten'

MP Erkens (VVD) asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a news report that TenneT found about 9 GW of spare grid capacity for flexible connections, questioning its origin, allocation, monitoring and whether batteries would crowd out businesses. The minister answered that the capacity is 'restruimte' already known but newly made available via the time-limited transport right (TDTR), allocated first-come-first-served, with flexible contracts, monitoring by TenneT and regional operators, and ongoing improvements in grid data.
This capacity did not newly arise or become available, but concerns so-called 'restruimte' (spare capacity).
Deze ruimte is niet ontstaan of beschikbaar gekomen, maar betreft zogenoemde «restruimte».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Buijsse over de kansen van generatieve AI voor de productiviteit in de publieke sector

MPs Erkens and Buijsse (VVD) asked about generative AI's potential to raise public-sector productivity, cite claimed savings of up to 20 billion euro, and question whether AI can ease staff shortages and reduce the need for a growing civil service. State Secretary Szabó replies that productivity trends are mixed, that the government is exploring AI in service processes via the National Digitalisation Strategy and an upcoming overheidsbrede handreiking, while stating that savings and job effects cannot be quantified yet and that many pilots are not yet evaluated.
That there are currently 425,000 vacancies is not entirely correct.
Dat momenteel sprake zou zijn van 425.0000 vacatures is niet geheel correct.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Grinwis over het bericht 'Zonnestroom is in 2027 geen cent meer waard, dus paneelbezitters zijn de dupe'

MPs Erkens and Grinwis asked the minister about reports that feed-in compensation for solar power will fall sharply from 2027 and whether Greenchoice's terms comply with the legal 50% floor and fairness rules. The minister answered that Greenchoice meets the 50% minimum, that fairness and cost questions are for the ACM regulator to examine, and that the ACM is reviewing feed-in costs and will get extra tools from 2027.
The ACM already supervises this and can enforce where necessary.
De ACM houdt hier nu al toezicht op en kan daar zo nodig op handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het NOS-artikel ‘Regionale industrie krijgt geen stroom, maar betaalt wel voor CO2-uitstoot’

MP Erkens asks why regional industrial firms that cannot get grid connections to decarbonise must still pay the CO2 levy, and whether the levy could be deferred or differentiated. The minister acknowledges the problem, outlines grid congestion and permitting measures, and says additional flexibility options are being studied but differentiation and a lower levy are ruled out.
However, this request in essence corresponds to introducing a hardship clause, which is legally and technically not feasible.
Dit verzoek komt in de kern echter overeen met het introduceren van een hardheidsclausule, wat juridisch en uitvoeringstechnisch niet mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over vertraging bouw kerncentrales

An MP (Erkens, VVD) asked why construction of two new nuclear plants is delayed, why alternative sites such as Eemshaven were only now being examined, and what costs, legal routes and acceleration options exist. The minister answers that the site decision is delayed, the first plant is unlikely to be operational by 2035, legally robust siting requires examining reasonable alternatives, and no legislative change or special project law is considered necessary or useful.
As soon as possible this year the cabinet will announce which location alternatives it will investigate.
Zo snel mogelijk dit jaar maakt het kabinet bekend welke locatiealternatieven het gaat onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Nederlandse gasvoorraden raken razendsnel leeg: Energiecrisis is allerminst voorbij'

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about reports that Dutch gas storage is emptying fast, whether the target fill level should be raised, and how supply and prices are protected. The minister answers that supply is secured for this winter per GTS, cites EBN's filling task and a forthcoming bill, and says a fill target will be set in law and a letter follows.

The cabinet intends to include in the proposed Energy Supply Crisis Combating Act that the Minister for Climate and Green Growth sets an annual filling target, in other words a minimum fill level at the start of winter, for gas storage.

Het kabinet is voornemens om in het voorstel voor de Wet bestrijding energieleveringscrisis op te nemen dat de Minister voor Klimaat en Groene Groei jaarlijks een vuldoelstelling – met andere woorden: een minimale vulgraad bij aanvang van de winter – voor de gasopslagen vaststelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over overbodige functies, adviesorganen en doublures bij de Rijksoverheid in relatie tot voorgenomen besparingen op het overheidsapparaat

MP Erkens asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about growth in central government staff, advisory bodies and external hiring, and how savings and overlap would be managed. The minister acknowledged significant growth, said the savings target has no fixed FTE goal, promised a plan on reducing external hiring and a separate letter on the parliamentary motion, and answered most questions with data or general descriptions.

In the parliamentary debate on the functioning of the civil service of 6 November 2024 I committed in this context to send your House an action plan for reducing external hiring in the first quarter of 2025.

In het commissiedebat Functioneren Rijksdienst van 6 november 2024 heb ik in dit kader toegezegd om in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 een plan van aanpak terugdringen externe inhuur aan uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over de opschaling van groene, blauwe en andere koolstofarme waterstof in Nederland

Two MPs (Erkens, VVD, and Bontenbal, CDA) asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about scaling up blue, green and other low-carbon hydrogen, including infrastructure, the REDIII industry obligation, Norwegian import contracts, nuclear-based hydrogen and cost competitiveness. The minister answered that hydrogen policy is largely technology-neutral, that the government is exploring barriers for low-carbon hydrogen, and that the industry quota and a demand subsidy are still being designed, with several points deferred to a later letter and studies.
The cabinet will also examine whether and how companies can be facilitated in jointly purchasing low-carbon and renewable hydrogen.
Het kabinet zal daarnaast onderzoeken of en hoe bedrijven gefaciliteerd kunnen worden bij het gezamenlijk inkopen van koolstofarme en hernieuwbare waterstof
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Vermeer, Bontenbal, Postma en Beckerman over de misleidende praktijken van energieleverancier Hollandse Energie Maatschappij (HEM)

MPs from several parties asked the minister about misleading and intimidating practices by energy supplier HEM, what consumer protection and enforcement tools exist, and whether firms like HEM can be barred from supplying energy. The minister said the Energy Act will give the ACM stronger powers (integrity screening, supply stops, licence revocation), noted bailiff-threat issues fall under the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, and answered all ten questions in turn.
In the Energy Act, the ACM is given sufficient new tools to act firmly when it deems this necessary.
In de Energiewet krijgt de ACM voldoende nieuwe handvatten om stevig op te treden als zij dat nodig acht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de opschaling van groen gas

An MP asked the minister how biogas expansion is coordinated with municipalities and regional energy strategy regions, how the 2030 targets will be reached, how regional spread is steered, whether a regional target is planned, how price increases will be monitored, what grid maintenance agreements exist, and how Guarantees of Origin could be kept domestic. The minister answered that the government is developing new cooperation agreements with subnational governments and supports provinces, does not steer regional spread, relies on CBS monitoring and sector consultation, relies on grid operators for network adaptation, and considers domestic reservation of guarantees of origin not possible within the EU internal market.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Erkens, Vermeer en Grinwis over de overstap van de industrie naar groene waterstof en de raffinageroute

Four MPs asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth and the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about the proposed 0.4 correction factor for the refinery route for green hydrogen, which they feared would undermine hydrogen investment and rely on uncertain market assumptions. The minister defended the correction factor as a balance between CO2 reduction, pump prices and hydrogen stimulation, acknowledged investment risks and committed to a study under a parliamentary motion on the refinery route's impact.

After the parliamentary questions were asked, the House adopted the motion by MPs Bontenbal and Vermeer calling for a study into how the refinery route should be designed to contribute maximally to the industry's sustainability goals.

Na het stellen van Kamervragen heeft de Kamer de motie van de leden Bontenbal en Vermeer aangenomen over een onderzoek naar hoe de raffinageroute eruit moet zien om maximaal bij te dragen aan de verduurzamingsdoelstellingen van de industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'RWE hoopt op geitenpaadje voor project met waterstof uit afval'

An MP asked whether RWE's FUREC project producing green hydrogen from household waste counts toward the RED-III binding green hydrogen target, how other EU states handle this, and what the government will do to support such projects and resolve grid connection delays. The minister answered that the project does not qualify as RFNBO because it uses partly biogenic waste rather than renewable electricity, that the government remains in contact with RWE and will keep supporting it, and that grid congestion is being addressed through prioritisation rules and the industry decarbonisation programme.
