No. RED-III uses the term 'renewable fuel of non-biological origin' (abbreviated RFNBO in English) for green hydrogen.
Nee. In de RED-III wordt de term «hernieuwbare brandstof van niet-biologische oorsprong» (in het Engels afgekort tot RFNBO) gehanteerd voor groene waterstof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Aukje de vries en Erkens over de financiering van kernenergieprojecten

MPs Aukje de Vries and Erkens asked about international banks' pledge to support nuclear energy, how the government will engage banks and COP29 for financing new Dutch nuclear plants, and how to keep gas extraction in the North Sea financed. Minister Hermans answered that a market consultation is ongoing with results to follow, that the government will engage the financial sector including via the climate commitment, and that the sector must make its own financing decisions while a sector agreement on North Sea investment is being prepared.
Within a few weeks the cabinet will inform the House about the results of the market consultation, a cabinet appraisal of them and the follow-up process.
Binnen een aantal weken zal het kabinet de Kamer informeren over de resultaten van de marktconsultatie, een kabinetsappreciatie daarvan en het vervolgproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Buijsse over het verminderen van regeldruk in circulaire processen

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reducing regulatory burden and advancing the circular economy, including how circularity affects competitiveness, emissions and the definition of waste. The State Secretary answered that Dutch circular policy is being developed at EU level, that the national programme will be updated in September 2025, and that the definition of waste follows EU law.
A new ICER will be published in early 2025. Partly on that basis, I will send an updated NPCE to the House in September of that year.
Begin 2025 komt een nieuwe ICER uit. Mede op basis hiervan zal ik in september van dat jaar een geactualiseerd NPCE aan de Kamer aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over de leveringszekerheid van elektriciteit

MPs Bontenbal and Erkens asked whether the Monitor Leveringszekerheid 2024 shows electricity supply reliability problems by 2033 due to falling dispatchable capacity, and what the government will do before the costs of action rise. The minister confirms the projected 2033 shortfall, calls it an early warning rather than a certainty, and promises a letter by year-end on options including a strategic reserve, without a concrete timetable.
I will inform the House about this at the end of this year.
Hierover zal ik de Kamer eind dit jaar informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over ‘Gaswinning op de Noordzee blijft achter bij verwachtingen’

An MP asks the minister why North Sea gas production lags expectations despite faster permitting, what the impact on energy security and state revenue is, and whether a sector agreement or carbon takeback obligation could help. The minister attributes the shortfall to the late-life phase and operator concerns about investment risk, political support and permit predictability, says a sector agreement is being pursued, and rejects a carbon takeback obligation for now.
I am in discussion with Element-NL and EBN to examine which bottlenecks exist and which measures are needed to stimulate gas extraction in the North Sea.
Ik ben hierover in gesprek met Element-NL en EBN om te bezien welke knelpunten er zijn en welke maatregelen nodig zijn om de gaswinning op de Noordzee te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'TenneT wil regels zien voor apps voor zonnepanelen en waarschuwt voor black-outs'

An MP asked the minister about press reports that TenneT wants rules for solar-panel management apps and warns of black-outs, including IT security rules for manufacturers and whether Dutch hackers breached such software. The minister acknowledged the vulnerabilities, pointed to upcoming EU cybersecurity rules (RED from August 2025, CRA from about 2027), and stated that the risk of a large-scale black-out is very small.
The cabinet recognises a number of the vulnerabilities mentioned and therefore is working to strengthen the resilience of the (vital) energy sector.
Het kabinet herkent een aantal van de genoemde kwetsbaarheden en daarom werkt het kabinet aan de versterking van de weerbaarheid van de (vitale) energiesector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over het bericht ‘Energiereus Engie vreest tekort aan stroom in Nederland: ’Binnen vijf jaar al gebrek’’

MPs Bontenbal and Erkens asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about Engie's warning of a near-term electricity shortage, including capacity changes, a capacity mechanism and possible gas plant guarantees. The Minister answered that the latest monitoring shows no security-of-supply risk until 2030, that no capacity mechanism is needed yet, and that options will be explored and reported to parliament by year-end.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Alliander loopt tegen grenzen bij versnellen netuitbreiding'

An MP asked the minister about grid-expansion delays at Alliander, the number of cable and transformer kilometres built, how to steer grid operators, and whether windfall proceeds from selling Kenter should be invested in grid reinforcement. The minister acknowledges delays caused by labour and material shortages, points to existing reporting, the LAN programme and ACM oversight, and states the Kenter proceeds mostly strengthen Alliander's equity.
The Ministry of KGG checks whether the investment plans of the national grid operators sufficiently account for developments in the energy market.
Het Ministerie van KGG toetst of de investeringsplannen van de landelijke netbeheerders voldoende rekenschap hebben gegeven aan ontwikkelingen in de energiemarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Becker, Erkens, Paternotte en Bamenga over ‘het bericht dat de nieuwe partij NL Plan steunt op organisaties verbonden aan de Chinese Communistische Partij’

MPs from VVD and D66 asked ministers about reports that the new party NL Plan received support from organisations linked to the Chinese Communist Party, and about foreign interference and the effectiveness of the ban on foreign donations under the Dutch party financing law. The minister answered that NL Plan reported no donations above the threshold, that enforcement and oversight of the ban are still being assessed, and that a study on Chinese interference and a new political parties law are in preparation.

I would like to refer to the extensive media coverage of the recently arrested employee of German AfD lead candidate Maximilian Krah, who allegedly spied for China, and to the Belgian politician Filip de Winter, who allegedly worked for years on behalf of the Chinese Communist Party.

Ik verwijs hier graag naar de uitgebreide berichtgeving in de media over de recent gearresteerde medewerker van de Duitse AfD-lijsttrekker Maximilian Krah die gespioneerd zou hebben voor China en over de Belgische politicus Filip de Winter die jarenlang in opdracht van de Chinese Communistische Partij gewerkt zou hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Waakhond ACM zet als enige in Europa de industrie op achterstand'

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about the ACM's abolition of the volume correction scheme for grid tariffs, which benefited about 35 industrial firms, and whether this disadvantages electrification and creates an uneven playing field with Germany and Belgium. The Minister acknowledges the scheme's removal raised costs for those firms, says the ACM's cost-based analysis gave no basis for it, and commits to raising the harmonisation issue with ACER and the European Commission, while stating that tariff structure remains the ACM's exclusive competence.
I do not have information on the discount received per individual company.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de ontvangen korting per individueel bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de voortgang van de Delta Rhine Corridor

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth why the Delta Rhine Corridor delay of about four years emerged only now, what lessons apply, and how industry, Germany, decentralised governments and Gasunie are affected. The minister acknowledges the planning was too ambitious, admits the Rijk's own limited steering instruments, promises further reflection and a return to the house after summer, but gives no firm figures on emissions or costs.
My ministry will therefore also examine which steering instruments the central government can still (additionally) deploy to strengthen steering of this project in future.
Mijn ministerie zal daarom ook onderzoeken welke sturingsinstrumenten het Rijk nog (aanvullend) kan inzetten om de sturing op dit project in de toekomst te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens het artikel 'Ingrijpen in energiemarkt noodzakelijk om stroomtekort te voorkomen'

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister for Climate and Energy how the government will safeguard electricity supply adequacy in the energy transition, including whether capacity mechanisms like those in the UK or Belgium should be introduced. The Minister answers that no supply risks are expected until 2030, that a 2033 shortfall prompts an implementation plan, and that options including a capacity mechanism are being inventoried, with a letter to the Chamber promised at the end of 2024.
In line with my predecessor's commitment, I will inform the Chamber further about this at the end of 2024.
Conform de toezegging van mijn ambtsvoorganger zal ik de Kamer hierover eind 2024 nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht 'Poland's capital Warsaw earmarks $30 million for bomb shelters and other security'

An MP asked the ministers whether the government is prepared for worst-case scenarios, how many bomb shelters exist in the Netherlands and whether they are distributed evenly, and whether new shelters are planned. The government answered that it prepares for various threats through crisis plans and coordinates resilience work, but that public shelters have had no role since 1990, the current state of existing shelters is unknown, and no plans for new shelters are known.
The Minister of Defence, on behalf also of the Minister of Justice and Security, has promised a letter to the House on societal resilience in relation to military threats.
De Minister van Defensie heeft, mede namens de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, een Kamerbrief toegezegd over de maatschappelijke weerbaarheid in relatie tot militaire dreiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het rapport 'Optimising Dutch Air and Space Power Policy Recommendations' van het Royal United Services Institute (RUSI)

MP Erkens (VVD) asked the Minister and State Secretary of Defence how the government views the RUSI report's recommendations on Dutch air and space power, including F-35 readiness, noise norms for military airbases, SEAD/DEAD capability, training, and financial implications. The government broadly endorses the need for sustained readiness, stronger SEAD/DEAD capability and growth to at least 2% of GDP, lists measures already taken, and leaves funding decisions to a future cabinet.
The financial implementation of this is a matter for a next cabinet.
Financiële invulling hiervan is aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Energieleveranciers misleiden klanten met CO2 gecompenseerd gas'

An MP asked the minister about reports that energy suppliers sold CO2-compensated gas whose offset projects underperformed or delivered no compensation, and how consumers can be protected and the offsets verified. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to upcoming EU rules banning compensation claims from 2026, ACM guidance and voluntary market recommendations, and referred to earlier answers for validation.
That it does not deliver the promised CO2 reduction or removal does not mean that supporting climate projects has no positive effects at all.
Dat het niet de beloofde CO 2 -reductie of verwijdering oplevert betekent niet dat het steunen van klimaatprojecten helemaal geen positieve effecten heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Erkens over het vinden van een balans tussen drinkwater en geothermie in Limburg

MPs Grinwis and Erkens asked how their amendment protecting drinking water reserves in Limburg would be applied to geothermal drilling, including interpretation, EBN's plans, permitting speed, and double casing standards. The State Secretary answered that the amendment's scope depends on whether 'designated or reserved' covers only water-catchment areas or also supplementary protection zones, that a legal opinion is pending, and that double casing is already legally required for geothermal wells.
The advice is expected this summer and I will share it with your House.
Het advies wordt deze zomer verwacht en zal ik met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht ‘Utrecht wil niet meer samenwerken met Eneco en eigen warmtebedrijf oprichten’

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the City of Utrecht abandoning its heat network partnership with Eneco and setting up its own heat company, including effects on support, investment and household energy bills. The minister acknowledged the collapse, attributed it to rising costs and limited transparency in the business case, and pointed to forthcoming legislation (Wcw), a possible national shareholding and a guarantee fund, while noting the Utrecht case has stalled so the bill question is moot.
It is my intention to send the Wcw to your House in the short term, which will also provide clarity to municipalities and heat companies.
Het is mijn voornemen om op korte termijn de Wcw naar uw Kamer te zenden, waarmee ook duidelijkheid gegeven wordt aan gemeenten en warmtebedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Erkens over de levering van Patriot-systemen en raketten aan Oekraïne

Two VVD MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about supplying Patriot systems and missiles to Ukraine, including use of Dutch stocks, production acceleration, interoperability and NASAMS. The minister answered that the government is actively examining options, committed funds for air defence, and is pursuing joint procurement and production efforts, though it gave no firm decisions on several points.
In weighing this, the impact on operational readiness, international obligations and the ability to keep training Dutch military personnel is critically examined.
Hierbij wordt in de afweging kritisch gekeken naar de gevolgen voor de operationele gereedheid, internationale verplichtingen en de mogelijkheid om Nederlandse militairen te blijven trainen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Hermans en Erkens over de vergunningverlening bij DOW naar aanleiding van het artikel 'Hoe een groen megaproject muurvast zit door ruzie Dow en overheid’

MPs Erkens, Hermans and Thijssen asked ministers about stalled permitting for Dow Chemical's planned hydrogen-based decarbonisation investment, reportedly blocked by nitrogen emission limits and conflict with government. The minister answered that talks continue, that initial plans exceeded the 80 mg/Nm3 nitrogen limit, that Dow is preparing revised plans, and that a permitting solution will be sought before further updates to parliament.
I will inform your House further about progress via the progress report on the tailor-made approach.
Ik zal uw Kamer nader informeren over de voortgang via de voortgangsrapportage maatwerkaanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van Campen over de productie van groengas via monomestvergisting

Two VVD MPs asked the minister why small monomanure digestion projects already granted SDE++ subsidies at the old lower rate cannot switch to a new higher-rate category, and whether this undermines viable business cases. The minister confirmed that switching is not possible once a subsidy decision is granted, that the rate increase was communicated in advance, and that projects which did not proceed can reapply in 2024.
It is undesirable, and therefore not possible, to submit a new SDE application in a subsequent year after receiving an SDE++ decision merely because tariffs have risen in that year.

Het is niet wenselijk, en daarom niet mogelijk, om nadat men een SDE++ beschikking heeft gekregen opnieuw in een daaropvolgend jaar een SDE-aanvraag in te dienen, enkel omdat in dat jaar de tarieven gestegen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de voorbereidingen voor opschaling van het dienjaar

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Defence eleven questions on preparing the scale-up of the Dutch military service year, covering facilities, instructors, IT, social partners, intake moments, deployment and the specialist pilot. The government answers that preparations are underway within the armed forces' absorptive capacity, with conditions for 1000 participants in 2025 and 4000 later, though it does not commit to specific timelines or new institutional rules.
For the planned scale-up in 2025 to 1000 service year military personnel, the preconditions are in place.
Voor de geplande opschaling in 2025 naar 1000 dienjaarmilitairen zijn de randvoorwaarden op orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Geen plaats op transportnet voor nieuwe kerncentrales’

An MP asked why two new nuclear plants are absent from TenneT's grid investment plans and how grid connection delays will be avoided. The minister said a further study will inform an integrated decision in Q2 2025, with no delay to plant realisation expected.
I am currently having a follow-up study carried out so that I can take an integrated decision on the integration of two new nuclear power plants in the second quarter of 2025.
Ik laat momenteel een vervolgonderzoek uitvoeren, zodat ik in het tweede kwartaal van 2025 een integraal besluit kan nemen over de inpassing van twee nieuwe kerncentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Veltman over het bericht 'Een derde van Gronings dorpje bezoekt dokter vanwege klachten windturbines'

MPs Erkens and Veltman asked about wind turbine distance and noise norms after a report that a third of a Groningen village visited a doctor over turbine complaints, including the status of the draft decree, the motion on a four-times-tip-height distance norm, and whether projects should be paused. The ministers answered that national norms are in draft with planned entry into force on 1 July 2025, that municipalities may set local norms via environmental assessment, and that no pause is warranted as the Nivel study shows no clear health risks.
To prevent delay, I aim to submit the draft decree to your House as soon as possible, expectedly after the summer.
Om vertraging te voorkomen probeer ik zo spoedig mogelijk, naar verwachting na de zomer, het ontwerpbesluit bij uw Kamer voor te hangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over de voortgang van de Delta Rhine Corridor

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked about the progress, investment timing, realisation deadline, the absence of an LPG/propylene pipeline initiator, and next steps with Germany on the Delta Rhine Corridor. The minister answered that the government supports and coordinates spatial planning and permits while investment decisions rest with private initiators, that no LPG/propylene initiator emerged, and that a letter on schedule effects will follow before summer.
I will inform the House before the summer of this year with a letter on the effect of this exercise on the project's planning.
Ik informeer uw Kamer voor de zomer van dit jaar met een brief over het effect van deze exercitie op de planning van het project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot, Brekelmans en Erkens over het artikel ‘Russische schepen die bijtanken bij Vlissingen’

VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a NRC report that Russian-linked shadow fleet ships refuel and anchor at Everingen near Vlissingen, raising sanctions evasion, safety and enforcement concerns. The minister answered that anchorage fees are not charged, ship numbers have not risen sharply, no Russian-flagged ships anchored there, the ILT is still assessing accident risk, and enforcement and EU coordination are being strengthened, while rejecting a ban on anchoring and ruling out a mayoral enforcement role.
It is undesirable that ships can circumvent the European sanctions rules and may also pose a danger to people and the environment.
Het is onwenselijk dat schepen de Europese sanctieregels kunnen omzeilen en daarbij ook mogelijk een gevaar zijn voor mens en milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht “GTS adviseert over gasleveringszekerheid 2024-2025: krapte op de gasmarkt houdt aan”

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how the government will address the projected 2024 gas capacity shortfall flagged by Gasunie Transport Services, including demand-side measures, storage refilling, LNG capacity, innovation, and EU cooperation. The minister replied that the risk is small but serious, pointed to ongoing supply-security measures, storage refilling rules via a forthcoming bill, existing and planned LNG expansions, and EU coordination.

Furthermore, the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate will inform the House in a separate letter about the analysis of which additional measures are necessary and possible to mitigate this remaining risk of a capacity or volume shortage.

Daarnaast wordt uw Kamer per separate brief door de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en Klimaat geïnformeerd over de analyse die is gedaan welke aanvullende maatregelen nodig en mogelijk zijn om dit resterende risico op een capaciteits- of volumetekort te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht “Gerenoveerd zorgcentrum Kerkrade kan niet open vanwege overvol stroomnet: ‘Dit kan nog wel vijf jaar duren’ ”

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a renovated care centre in Kerkrade that cannot open due to grid congestion, and whether a five-year wait is acceptable. The minister confirmed the connection upgrade is queued until 2030 and outlined grid investments, flexible contracts, and the ACM's draft prioritisation framework, while withholding details of queued parties for commercial confidentiality.
Due to (commercial) confidentiality, I have no insight into which parties are in the queue.
Vanwege (bedrijfs)vertrouwelijkheid heb ik geen zicht op welke partijen in de wachtrij staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over “RWE hoopt op geitenpaadje voor project met waterstof uit afval”

An MP asks the ministers how they will press grid operators Enexis and TenneT to keep the FUREC hydrogen-from-waste project on its 2026 connection schedule, and whether delay risks losing EU Innovation Fund money. The ministers say they have no direct role in grid connection priorities, point to the pending ACM prioritisation framework, and say RWE has not yet taken a final investment decision.
However, I have no role in the prioritisation of customer requests with grid operators.
Bij de prioritering van klantaanvragen bij netbeheerders heb ik echter geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Bontenbal en Grinwis over het bericht ‘Zinkfabriek Nyrstar in Budel legt productie stil’

MPs Erkens, Bontenbal and Grinwis asked how the government views the shutdown of the Nyrstar zinc plant in Budel over high energy costs, lack of state aid and the investment climate, and whether this reflects a wider industrial trend, the effect of the tax changes and the ending of the IKC and volume compensation schemes, the link to grid congestion and balancing, and how the government will address negative sentiment around industry. The minister acknowledges the high energy costs and competitive disadvantage relative to neighbours, defends the Dutch climate-led industrial policy ('greener here than grey elsewhere'), explains the reasons for ending the IKC and the ACM's abolition of the VCR, and promises further studies on electricity costs and a report to parliament, but gives limited concrete answers on grid congestion and some questions are answered by reference to policy stance.
I expect that the cabinet will inform the House later this quarter about the findings.
Ik verwacht dat het kabinet de Kamer later dit kwartaal zal inlichten over de bevindingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Gefrustreerde ondernemers stoppen miljoenenproject voor delen van energie: 'Netbeheerder blokkeert voortgang''

An MP asked the minister why an energy-sharing hub project in Flevoland, Gelderland and Utrecht stalled after TenneT said grid capacity was insufficient, despite earlier approvals, and what this means for similar projects and housing. The minister explained that grid congestion outside traditional peaks limits capacity, that TenneT is continuing analyses, and that the government is working with grid operators on pilots and additional measures.
I have asked TenneT for a further analysis of the causes and possible measures, so that as quickly as possible we can see what is still possible and what is needed for that.
Ik heb TenneT verzocht om een nadere analyse van de oorzaken en mogelijke maatregelen, om zo snel mogelijk in beeld te krijgen wat er nog wel kan en wat daarvoor nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de beschikbaarheid van natuurlijk voorkomend waterstof

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether natural hydrogen could exist in the Dutch subsurface, whether research has been done, and whether the Netherlands should explore and partner abroad. The minister answered that the chance is small but not excluded, that no Dutch study has yet been done, and that TNO has started an inventory and is looking at Dutch coal layers and the Caribbean.
TNO has recently started an inventory into the potential presence of hydrogen in the Dutch subsurface.
TNO is recent een inventarisatie gestart naar de potentiële aanwezigheid van waterstof in de Nederlandse ondergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel ‘Extra munitie voor Oekraïne vergt enorme investeringen’

An MP asked the Defence ministers how Europe can jointly procure and expand production of ammunition and defence materiel, including tax incentives, pension and bank financing, export treaties and drones. The government answered in general terms, citing joint procurement initiatives, planned consultations and future letters to parliament, without new binding commitments on the scrutiny of the executive.
We will inform your House as soon as possible, by means of a DMP letter, about how this will be implemented and the associated consequences.
Wij zullen uw Kamer door middel van een DMP-brief zo spoedig mogelijk informeren over de invulling hiervan en de daarbij behorende consequenties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht 'Den Haag pauzeert plannen warmtenetten; ‘niet financierbaar en onacceptabele risico’s’'

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the pausing of district heating plans in The Hague and the financial risks of the planned public-majority requirement for heat companies under the new heat law. The minister defended the public-majority choice as strengthening public steering, outlined transitional arrangements and subsidies, and said public investment costs and possible funding instruments are still being studied.

For this reason, the cabinet is working in the Wcw, and in connection with it the Wgiw, on instruments for municipalities to steer the cost-effective development of collective heat and mitigate risks.

Om die reden werkt het kabinet in de Wcw en, in samenhang daarmee, met de Wgiw aan instrumenten voor gemeenten om de regie te voeren op de kosteneffectieve aanleg van collectieve warmte en om risico’s te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Tuinman en Erkens over het artikel ‘NATO’s Vilnius summit: the consequences for the Allies’

MPs Boswijk, Tuinman and Erkens asked the Dutch government about NATO's New Force Model, its personnel implications for small allies and the Netherlands, and related lessons learned. The Minister answered that the personnel needs will only be clear once NATO details the force model, that Dutch constitutional tasks depend on improved personnel levels, and that the Netherlands contributes to lessons-learned work.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de innovaties van batterijtechnieken

An MP asked the Economic Affairs and Climate and Energy ministers about battery technology, grid congestion, investment incentives, lithium supply and alternative battery chemistries such as sodium-ion. The minister answered that TenneT will propose a tariff change that could make 2 to 5 GW of batteries profitable by 2030, outlined the Growth Fund and innovation programmes, and said lithium remains import-dependent while sodium-ion is being researched.
Grid operator TenneT will submit a code change proposal to the ACM that could lead to a maximum discount of 65% on transport tariffs.
Netbeheer TenneT gaat een codewijzigingsvoorstel indienen bij de ACM die kan leiden tot een maximale korting van 65% op transporttarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de voortgang van het dienjaar

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about the rollout of the one-year military service (dienjaar), including target numbers, selection, funding and lessons from Scandinavia. The government answered that the scale-up is on schedule, that the aim is to raise military staffing levels, and that it is exploring an enquiry for 17-year-olds and reviewing selection and training capacity.
The one-year service must be seen as a meaningful and valuable way to spend, for example, a gap year.
Het dienjaar moet gezien worden als een zinvolle en waardevolle invulling van bijvoorbeeld een tussenjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht 'Zonnepanelen minder gewild bij huiseigenaren: flink minder aanvragen dan voor de zomer'

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a reported sharp drop in applications for rooftop solar panels, the effect on market and climate targets, and the imposition of feed-in (terugleverkosten) charges by energy suppliers, including ACM oversight and the timing of the net-metering phase-out. The minister answered that the drop follows an exceptionally high early-2023 peak, that the government will rely on the pending net-metering bill and ACM oversight of a minimum feed-in compensation, and that suppliers' charges are undesirable but legal under current rules.
I have sent the answers to your House as soon as possible.
Ik heb de beantwoording zo spoedig mogelijk aan uw Kamer verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de voortgang van de raffinageroute en het belang ervan voor de ontwikkeling van groene waterstofproductie

An MP asked the government about the progress, timing and market effects of the planned raffinage route for renewable hydrogen, and about long-term investment certainty and lessons from other member states. The minister answered that the route is well advanced, will open in 2025 with a draft decree to parliament in early 2024, and outlined subsidies and normering as ways to secure supply, while offering no firm mitigation for delay.

The planned timeline of the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management is to send the bill and the amendment to the Energy Transport Decree to the House of Representatives in the first half of 2024.

De voorgenomen tijdslijn van de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat is om in de eerste helft van 2024 het wetsvoorstel en wijziging voor het Besluit energie vervoer aan de Tweede Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Kröger over de Kamerbrief ‘Nieuwe maatregelen netcongestie’

Two MPs (Erkens, VVD and Kröger, GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the unorthodox grid-congestion measures in the letter 'Nieuwe maatregelen netcongestie', covering why these were not chosen earlier, port electrification, grid permits, prioritisation, flexibility subsidies, metering and budget. The Minister answered most questions on substance, explaining the rationale, the ACM prioritisation code due March 2024, and commitments to report back on the laagspanningsnet action agenda and flexibility options, while declining to say more on some budget and metering points yet to be worked out.
It is not expected that changes to the Energy Act will be necessary as a result of the announced measures.
Het is niet de verwachting dat er wijzigingen nodig zijn in de Energiewet als gevolg van de aangekondigde maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'US, UK Lead Pledge to Triple Nuclear Power by 2050 at COP28'

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether the Netherlands will join the US-UK pledge to triple nuclear power by 2050 at COP28, and about its fiscal and knowledge effects. The minister says the pledge is a non-binding global ambition with no short-term investment effect, that the Netherlands supports it as complementary to renewables, and that he opposes strict technology neutrality in the EU context.
The declaration therefore does not oblige individual countries to formulate specific national targets.
De verklaring verplicht individuele landen dus niet tot formuleren van specifieke nationale doelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot, Erkens, Bontenbal en Geurts over het bericht ‘Verduurzaming van koopwoningen komt bij gedeeld huizenbezit slecht van de grond’

MPs from VVD and CDA asked the minister why energy-efficiency upgrades in shared-ownership apartment buildings stall when homeowners' associations (VvE) do not approve them, and what could be done. The minister answered all eleven questions, citing a VvE acceleration agenda with lower decision thresholds, support tools, subsidies, and possible future legislation, while rejecting a rule giving VvEs unconditional competence over sustainability.
I do not intend to prepare legislation to that effect.
Ik ben niet voornemens wetgeving met die strekking te gaan voorbereiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van Campen over het artikel «Rekenfout in groengas-subsidie absurd: honderd Overijsselse boeren missen nu smak geld»

MPs Erkens and Van Campen (VVD) asked the Climate and Energy and Agriculture ministers about a calculation error that lowered SDE++ subsidy base amounts for green gas projects by 20-25%, affecting farmers' planning. Minister Jetten answered that PBL corrected its advice, that the amounts remain higher than in prior years, that no specific project or volume expectations exist, and refused to restore the original amounts or compensate preparation costs, while promising PBL advice on small-scale digesters for SDE++ 2024.
I have asked PBL to provide advice on small-scale digesters so that they can be appropriately stimulated in SDE++ 2024.
Ik heb wel PBL gevraagd om advies uit te brengen voor kleinschalige vergisters, zodat ze in de SDE++ 2024 passend gestimuleerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Aartsen en Erkens over het bericht ‘Drugsmaffia biedt ‘hulp’ aan Limburgse horecaondernemers die sinds de watersnood problemen hebben’

Three VVD MPs asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that drug gangs were offering 'help' to Limburg hospitality businesses struggling after the 2021 floods, covering compensation, prevention, RIEC analysis, information sharing and cross-border criminal approaches. The minister answered that affected hospitality entrepreneurs awaited no pending compensation decision, described existing prevention campaigns and cooperation, and said no specific sector analysis or concrete RIEC signals existed.
Yes, the report is known to me.
Ja, het bericht is mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Bedrijven willen niet aan flexibel stroomgebruik'

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about an article reporting that businesses are reluctant to make their electricity use flexible, including grid capacity data, the costs for grid operators and how businesses are compensated. The minister said data on industrial flexibility potential is insufficient, pointed to a methodology and new contract forms, and noted that a mandatory flexibility obligation is not yet on the table.
Insight into the potential flexible capacity is, however, still insufficiently available both to grid operators and to the industrial parties themselves.
Inzicht in het potentieel aan flexibel vermogen is echter nog onvoldoende aanwezig bij zowel netbeheerders als bij de industriële partijen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over berichten over het stroomnet

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about grid congestion in Zeeland and Nederweert, including whether group capacity-limitation contracts should be mandatory, when a 'right to challenge' will be available, and the effect on nuclear plans and renewable generation. The Minister answers that no single contract type will be mandated since ACM holds that competence, that connection self-service starts early next year, and that new transmission projects and flexibility measures are planned, with progress reports promised at year end.
I will inform the House at the end of this year about the progress of these developments.
Ik zal de Kamer eind dit jaar informeren over de voortgang van deze ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het feit dat verschillende energieleveranciers mensen met zonnepanelen nu extra laten betalen via allerlei omwegen

MP Erkens (VVD) asked whether energy suppliers charging solar-panel owners extra fees via indirect routes is acceptable, and how this affects public support for solar panels, contract lengths and consumer information. The minister said such fees are not prohibited under current law if they reflect actual costs, that ACM can supervise reasonableness, that a bill on the net-metering (salderingsregeling) phase-out is pending, and that he will propose a fixed-tariff model contract in the Energy Act.
I have already had contact with the ACM about the introduction of this new cost item by energy suppliers.
Ik heb reeds over de introductie van deze nieuwe kostenpost door energieleveranciers contact gehad met de ACM.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Erkens over windmolens op land

MP Erkens (VVD) asked how the government will implement the coalition promise of clear distance norms for onshore wind turbines, the status of the motion on a 4x tip-height norm, the revised timeline for national rules, and the effect of delay. The minister answered that a national distance norm will be set in a draft AMvB with consultation planned for autumn 2023 and entry into force likely in 2024, that the 4x tip-height norm cannot be applied temporarily without a plan-m.e.r. due to the EU SEA Directive, and that about 17 municipalities currently apply local distance norms.
The planning must be adjusted because incorporating it into the system under the Environment and Planning Act is more complicated than expected.
De planning moet worden bijgesteld omdat de inbouw in het stelsel onder de Omgevingswet ingewikkelder is dan verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de brief “Vormgeving instrumentarium hernieuwbare waterstof”

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how policy supports hydrogen from fossil and nuclear sources, whether North Sea gas should be used for blue hydrogen, how Norwegian imports and hydrogen storage will be arranged, and whether storage can be ready before 2028. The minister answered that CCS-based hydrogen is supported through SDE++ and infrastructure, that no specific production-method policy exists for gas plants, that Norway import studies are underway, and that salt-cavern storage timelines extend beyond 2028 with additional funding reserved.
The Dutch government will engage with Norway and Germany to see whether such an exploration can be undertaken.
De Nederlandse overheid zal het gesprek aangaan met Noorwegen en Duitsland om te bezien of een dergelijke verkenning kan worden ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de strategische autonomie van Nederland op het gebied van de energietransitie

An MP asked the ministers how strategic autonomy in the energy transition is defined, how large Dutch and EU dependencies on China and other non-EU countries are for key technologies and critical raw materials, and what instruments exist to reduce them. The government answered that dependencies are not inherently problematic but must be mitigated where risky, that quantitative data are insufficient alone, and that it is pursuing a taskforce, further studies and EU instruments, with updates promised to parliament by late 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over het bericht ‘Martin botst met woonstichting om oneerlijke compensatie energiekosten: het is ons geld’

MPs De Groot and Erkens asked the minister why a housing corporation planned to credit the energy compensation for shared connections only in June 2024, and what tools exist to make landlords apply and pass on the subsidy. The minister answered that crediting must follow the existing payment periodicity and cost-allocation key, that landlords must apply and tenants can use the Huurcommissie or courts, and that a Kadaster application will show applications per connection.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de ontwikkelingen in de nettarieven

An MP asked the government about TenneT's announced 2024 transmission tariff increase, its distributional effects, the history and causes of grid tariffs, long-term forecasts, measures to limit increases, and how offshore wind grid costs are allocated. The minister answered substantively, explaining that tariff allocation is the exclusive competence of the ACM and that the government's role is limited to designating which grid operator bears offshore grid costs.
Yes, I am aware of TenneT's tariff forecast for 2024.
Ik ben bekend met de tariefprognose van TenneT voor 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over blauwe waterstof

Two MPs (Bontenbal, Erkens) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the role of blue hydrogen, renewable hydrogen targets, investment certainty for producers, use of North Sea gas, EU RED III implementation and a level playing field, and nuclear-based hydrogen. The minister answered that demand for low-carbon hydrogen will stay large, that the instrument for renewable hydrogen will be clarified this autumn, and that rules will follow the EU and neighbours' approaches.
This autumn I also want to provide clarity on the instruments for renewable hydrogen.
Dit najaar wil ik daarnaast duidelijkheid geven over het instrumentarium voor hernieuwbare waterstof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Erkens over het bericht ‘Gezonde leefomgeving als grondrecht’

MPs Brekelmans and Erkens asked the Foreign Minister about adding a right to a healthy environment to the European Convention on Human Rights, the Reykjavik summit outcome, Dutch positions, and risks of politicised ECtHR rulings and competence conflicts with the EU Court. The minister answered that Dutch positions await the CDDH-ENV feasibility study due in 2024, declined to pre-judge ECtHR rulings, and saw no risk of competence conflict regarding the EU's accession.
Only once the need for and feasibility of a further instrument on human rights and environment, including climate change, have been mapped can the cabinet formulate a well-informed position.

Pas wanneer de noodzaak en haalbaarheid van een nader instrument op het gebied van mensenrechten en milieu, waaronder klimaatverandering, in kaart zijn gebracht, kan het kabinet een goed geïnformeerd standpunt formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Provincie Limburg wil Europese waterstofbank naar Chemelot halen'

An MP asked the ministers whether the government supports Limburg's bid to host the European hydrogen bank, which other regions are in the race, and how the government would help. The ministers replied that the Commission does not plan a new physical entity or a selection process, so no bid decision is needed, and they welcomed the initiative while promising to monitor its institutional design.
There is so far no question of a selection process.
Van een selectieproces is vooralsnog geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van Strien over de Nederlandse zonnepanelenindustrie

MPs Erkens and Van Strien asked about dependence on Chinese solar panels, Dutch/European production support, EU Recovery and Resilience funds and the IPCEI-Solar motion. The minister answered that Europe and the Netherlands depend heavily on China, outlined Dutch production support and funding applications, and said the government prefers aligning with the Net Zero Industry Act rather than the IPCEI-Solar.
Your House will be informed about this before the summer in the broad solar policy letter.
Hierover wordt uw Kamer voor de zomer geïnformeerd in de brede beleidsbrief over zon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de verduurzaming van het zesde industriecluster

An MP asked how the government facilitates decarbonisation of industrial cluster 6 (geographically dispersed firms), including infrastructure, bottlenecks, provincial energy planning, carbon pricing risks and possible maatwerk agreements. The minister answers that regional strategies and the MIEK framework will map needs, a new NPVI unit will address bottlenecks, and a regular update on cluster 6 will be included in future letters.
Yes, I will provide a regular update on the decarbonisation of cluster 6 for companies subject to the CO2 levy in the letters on industrial decarbonisation.
Ja, ik zal in de Kamerbrieven over de verduurzaming van de industrie een reguliere update geven over de verduurzaming van cluster 6 voor de bedrijven die onder de CO 2 -heffing vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over het artikel 'Provincie Limburg zet nieuwe stap in grootschalig onderzoek naar kernenergie'

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked the minister about a provincial Limburg initiative studying small modular reactors (SMRs), their role in industrial decarbonisation, and the government's plans and motion follow-up. The minister answered that the government is following SMR developments, commissioned a market analysis, plans a 65 million euro programme and a stepwise inventory via the industrial clusters, and is in contact with developers.
I am implementing this motion through a stepwise approach.
Ik geef uitvoering aan deze motie middels een stapsgewijze aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het opbouwen van de kennisinfrastructuur op het gebied van kernenergie in Nederland

The MP Erkens (VVD) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how nuclear knowledge infrastructure in the Netherlands will be expanded, how skilled staff will be recruited, how knowledge is secured long term, how regulation, planning, EU cooperation, public information and local support for the planned new nuclear plants in Zeeland will be handled. The Minister answered that education and research initiatives are underway, a interdepartmental working group will report in spring, regulatory evaluation is due end 2023, a communication and participation plan is being drafted, and the 2035 timeline is ambitious but retained.
TU Delft is establishing a chair in Radiation Dosimetry and Biophysics and appointing two PhD candidates there.
Zo wordt er door de TU Delft een leerstoel Stralingsdosimetrie en Biofysica ingesteld en worden daar twee promovendi aangesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht ‘Groene toekomst van Tata Steel allerminst zeker’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports doubting the green future of Tata Steel, covering permits, energy and hydrogen needs, infrastructure, state aid, jobs and the timing of a maatwerkafspraak. The minister answered that the company must first submit complete permit applications and detailed plans, that no firm timeline can be guaranteed, that state aid requires prior European Commission approval, and that the decision on support depends on analysis not yet finished.

Although I cannot go into detail about the commercially confidential information provided, this information and subsequent analyses are essential for the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate to assess the plans.

Alhoewel ik niet in detail kan treden over de aangeleverde bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie, is deze informatie en opvolgende analyses essentieel voor het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat om de plannen te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Erkens en Haverkort over wind op land

MPs Erkens and Haverkort asked whether the planned timetable for new national noise and distance norms for onshore wind turbines (including the Danish 4x tip-height norm) is still feasible and when temporary norms can be applied. The State Secretary answers that the new rules are expected in early 2024 after a plan-MER procedure, that legally no temporary national norm can be imposed before that, and that municipalities must set site-specific conditions in the meantime.
The State Secretary of I&W is committed to ensuring that new regulations for onshore wind turbines can enter into force in early 2024.
De Staatssecretaris van IenW zet zich ervoor in dat begin 2024 nieuwe regelgeving voor windturbines op land in werking kan treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over waterstof uit kernenergie

MPs Bontenbal and Erkens asked the minister whether the Netherlands would pursue hydrogen from nuclear energy, following a Franco-German roadmap, and whether it should count toward EU green hydrogen targets for industry. The minister welcomed Franco-German cooperation, said nuclear-based hydrogen may be imported or produced later, but kept the Dutch position on additionality and a level playing field and committed to no concrete new step beyond ongoing EU negotiations.
I attach importance to maintaining a level playing field for hydrogen producers and users.
Ik hecht er waarde aan dat het gelijke speelveld voor waterstofproducenten en -gebruikers behouden blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Europese Commissie wil met 'noodmaatregel' procedures duurzame energie versnellen'

An MP asked the minister whether the EU emergency measure to speed up renewable energy permitting would cover large projects such as offshore wind, green hydrogen, grid reinforcement and CO2 storage, and what its effect would be on the climate goals and the Porthos ruling. The minister answered that the emergency regulation was extended to larger technologies such as grid reinforcement and standalone large-scale generation, that CCS and Porthos fall outside the definition and are excluded, and that the measure will not bring significant acceleration in the Netherlands.
CO2 transport and storage is not included in the regulation because these projects do not fall under the definition of the European Renewable Energy Directive (RED).
CO 2 -transport en -opslag is niet opgenomen in de verordening, omdat deze projecten niet onder de definitie van de Europese hernieuwbare energierichtlijn (RED) vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over CO2-verwijdering

Two MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the gap between carbon dioxide removal (CDR) in national climate plans and what the Paris goals require, and about policy steps, a long-term target and a roadmap for negative emissions. The minister agrees a policy vision from central government is needed, points to the 2024 Climate Plan and an ongoing study, and says CDR should not replace faster emission reductions.
I will send your House a letter in March on the elaboration of the climate neutrality policy agenda.
Ik zal uw Kamer in maart een brief sturen over de uitwerking van de beleidsagenda op Klimaatneutraliteit
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel “Warmteleveranciers verhogen hun tarieven volgend jaar fors”

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the sharp heat-tariff increases reported by heat suppliers, whether they are reasonable, whether profits are justified, how ACM supervises them, and whether tariff transparency and the gas-price link should change. The minister answered that the increases follow higher gas costs and the gas-linked price cap, that individual cost and profit data are not available to him, and that yield tests and future Warmtewet rules are the relevant safeguards, without committing to new transparency obligations yet.
However, I have no insight into the costs of individual heat suppliers and I cannot assess whether all tariff increases were necessary to absorb cost increases.
Ik heb echter geen inzicht in de kosten van individuele warmteleveranciers en ik kan niet beoordelen of alle tariefverhogingen noodzakelijk waren om kostenstijgingen op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Qatarese gasbellen bezorgen Qatar geopolitieke poleposition'

An MP asked the energy minister about LNG supply security, long-term gas contracts with allies like Norway and the US, and the Qatar article. The minister said contracting is mainly for private parties, outlined expanded LNG import capacity, energy diplomacy, EU joint purchasing and storage measures, without detailing specific country negotiations.
Concluding contracts is in the first instance a matter for market parties.
Het afsluiten van contracten is in eerste instantie aan marktpartijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heerema en Erkens over het artikel ‘Directeur Thialf uit in brief aan Tweede Kamer ’zeer grote zorgen’ over voortbestaan’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about Thialf ice rink's plans to innovate on sustainability and energy costs, and about sustainability support for sports facilities. The minister confirmed awareness, stated support for sports sustainability through the BOSA scheme and other subsidies, and committed to evaluating and continuing the BOSA scheme from 2024 and to exploring financing structures.
I informed your House about this in advance of the committee meeting on sport on 28 November.
Ik heb uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd voorafgaand aan het WGO sport van 28 november jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de laatste ontwikkeling op de energiemarkt,

Member Erkens (VVD) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the risk of winter gas and electricity shortages, EU and neighbouring-country export restrictions, stress tests, and supplier liquidity problems from high margin calls. The minister answered that the government is taking measures to secure gas supply, that EU energy law makes supply security a shared EU matter, that stress scenarios and supplier-monitoring rules are in place, and that a few questions were answered late.
I am aware of the concerns that exist in the energy market and I take them seriously.
Ik ben bekend met de zorgen die leven in de energiemarkt en neem deze serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, Bontenbal, Erkens en Valstar over versnelling geothermie

MPs Grinwis, Bontenbal, Erkens and Valstar asked how to accelerate geothermal heat projects amid the gas crisis, including exceptions to SDE++ deadlines, a correction scheme for glasshouse horticulture, and simpler permitting and risk frameworks. The Staatssecretaris answered that retroactive SDE++ changes are unfair to other bidders, that a temporary correction scheme is being explored with a decision expected soon, and that permitting and risk rules will change in spring 2023 with a taskforce being set up.
An adjustment after the tender has closed, with retroactive effect, affects equal treatment of projects for two reasons and therefore also the government's reliability.
Een aanpassing na afloop van de tender – met terugwerkende kracht – raakt om twee redenen aan de gelijke behandeling van projecten en daarmee ook aan de betrouwbaarheid van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Erkens over het bericht 'Inspectie: burgers onvoldoende beschermd tegen geluidsoverlast windmolens'

MPs Leijten and Erkens asked why a 2009 HUF assessment of wind turbine noise rules was initially reported as absent, why its warnings about the annual-average noise norm were not shared with parliament, and whether the norms and existing permits will be revisited. The state secretary acknowledged the earlier search failure, explained that the assessment's personal policy views were withheld in 2009 and later released, and said the inspectorate's concerns led to tightened measurement rules and a night norm while the new plan-MER will decide any further changes.
In response to the Woo request, it was stated that all requested documents had already been involved in an earlier relatively recent decision (19-08-2021) under the Wob.

Bij het betreffende Woo-verzoek is aangegeven dat alle opgevraagde documenten al betrokken zijn geweest bij een eerder relatief recent besluit (19-08-2021) op grond van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over ‘Voor Chinese apparatuur is geen plaats in het stroomnet’

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about Chinese involvement in the electricity grid, including state influence on Chinese energy firms, national security safeguards at TenneT, oversight of grid operators' tenders, unfair subsidised competition, supply-chain dependencies and future legal adaptation. The government answers that safeguards are being built into the new Energy Act, a defence-and-security procurement regime and a veiling framework, that the Finance Minister will check TenneT investments as shareholder, and that further research on Chinese influence is under way, while stating it has no visibility into sub-suppliers and that regional grid operators fall outside the shareholder check.

The cabinet is therefore investing in greater knowledge of and insight into concentrations of (among other things) control in the wider supply chains, with the aim of limiting as far as possible the supply-chain effects of undesirable influence.

Het kabinet investeert daarom in meer kennis van en zicht op concentraties in (o.a.) zeggenschap in de bredere ketens, met als doel de keteneffecten van ongewenste invloed zo veel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Stoffer over energie uit water

Two MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the role of energy from water (wave, tidal and related technologies) in the Dutch economy, the energy transition, EU targets, funding and innovation, and co-use of offshore wind farms. The minister answered that Dutch geography limits the potential, that wave energy and Dynamic Tidal Power warrant further study, that no commitment to the EU 100 MW target will be made, and pointed to existing EU and national funding and an ongoing EU-SCORES research project.
Therefore I will have follow-up research carried out on this.
Daarom laat ik hier vervolgonderzoek naar uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heerema en Erkens ver het artikel 'Amateurclubs rekenen op taaie winter door hoge gasprijzen: ‘Sommige leden douchen júíst hier'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the impact of high gas and energy prices on sports facilities, especially swimming pools and ice rinks, and what support is available. The minister acknowledged the strong impact, cited a Mulier Institute survey and NOC*NSF estimates (including 200 pools at risk of closure), noted a 378 million euro cost increase for 2022-2023, and pointed to sustainability support and ongoing consultations with operators and municipalities.
That is why I asked operators of sports facilities to calculate the size of the cost increase, from which the figure you cited follows.
Daarom heb ik exploitanten van sportaccommodaties gevraagd om een berekening te maken van de omvang van de lastenstijging, waaruit het door u genoemde getal volgt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar, Erkens, Brekelmans over het bericht 'Norway oil safety regulator warns of threats from unidentified drones'en het bericht 'Duitse media: lek Nord Stream vrijwel zeker sabotage 'do

MPs Valstar, Erkens and Brekelmans asked the government about reports of unidentified drones near Norwegian offshore gas infrastructure and reports that sabotage by a state actor was likely behind the Nord Stream leak, including questions on Russian vessel activity and NATO protection. The Foreign Minister answered that a real threat to vital undersea infrastructure exists but declined to disclose suspicious activity, said the Baltic and Nordic investigations must determine responsibility, and described NATO and Norwegian protective measures and Dutch work on mapping vulnerabilities.
For security reasons, the Netherlands in principle never makes statements about suspicious activities.
Nederland doet vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen in principe nooit mededelingen over verdachte activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Klink over het bericht dat de Europese Unie voornemens is een waterstofbank in het leven te roepen

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that the EU plans a hydrogen bank with three billion euros and whether it could be located in the Netherlands. The minister answered that little is known yet, that the Commission is still developing the concept, that the government will monitor it and may align with Germany's H2Global, and that a full assessment must await more concrete information.
Little is yet known about the planned hydrogen bank.
Er is nog weinig bekend over de voorgenomen waterstofbank.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Grinwis over 'Eneco schroeft vergoeding voor terugleveren zonnestroom flink terug'

Two MPs asked the minister about Eneco sharply cutting the feed-in compensation for solar power and whether this and other suppliers' practices require stronger consumer protection or ACM investigation. The minister confirmed Eneco will reverse the cut for fixed contracts, said ACM supervises reasonable compensation, and announced intent to set a legal minimum of 80 percent of the bare supply tariff from 2025, possibly earlier by decree.

My intention is, from the perspective of consumer protection, to set the statutory minimum of the reasonable compensation for fed-back electricity, from the phase-out of the netting scheme (2025), at 80 percent of the bare supply tariff.

Mijn voornemen is om, uit het oog van consumentenbescherming, het wettelijk minimum van de redelijke vergoeding voor teruggeleverde elektriciteit met ingang van de afbouw van de salderingsregeling (2025) vast te stellen op 80 procent van het kale leveringstarief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het ontbreken van vaste contracten in de Nederlandse energiemarkt

An MP asked the minister why energy suppliers no longer offer fixed-price contracts, whether low exit fees and the lack of a fixed model contract are to blame, and whether the ACM and suppliers can be pressed to restore them. The minister says fixed contracts are undesirable, agreed with suppliers that fixed contracts return in 2023 once the ACM sets exit-fee rules, and is willing to discuss a mandatory fixed model contract with the ACM.
As stated in the letter to parliament on additional energy bill measures (20 September 2022), I have agreed with energy suppliers that fixed contracts will be offered on the market again in 2023

Zoals genoemd in de Kamerbrief over aanvullende maatregelen energierekening (van 20 september 2022) heb ik met energieleveranciers afgesproken dat er weer vaste contracten in de markt zullen worden aangeboden in 2023
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over meerdere ontwikkelingen op het gebied van kernenergie

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked the minister about private small modular reactor initiatives, industrial clusters' interest in nuclear power, the Limburg study, government funding for nuclear innovation, Belgian investment and European SMR cooperation. The minister answered that SMRs are a possible complementary energy source, that existing funds and instruments are open to nuclear innovation, and that research and international cooperation will continue, without committing to new structural changes.
Instead, they should specialise in nationally relevant themes and cooperate in areas where interests are shared.
In plaats daarvan moeten ze specialiseren op nationaal relevante thema's en samenwerken op gebieden waar gedeelde interesses zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de ISDE-regeling

An MP asked whether ISDE subsidy applications are unusually high, how much of the 2022 budget is used, why single insulation measures get a lower subsidy, who applies for single measures, whether linking the Warmtefonds to ISDE helps, and whether the one-year maximum gap between measures will be relaxed. The minister confirmed higher application volumes, expected a budget overrun of 30 to 60 million euros, defended the tiered subsidy design, and said the one-year gap may be extended in the 2023 amendment.
Therefore I will monitor this in the coming period and am considering options to increase the budget.
Daarom zal ik dit de komende periode in de gaten houden en bezie ik de mogelijkheden om het budget te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Erkens, Heinen, Tielen en Grinwis over het artikel 'Al 20 jaar geregeld tekort aan isotopen voor kankerbestraling: waarom het probleem maar niet wordt opgelost'

MPs from VVD and ChristenUnie asked about the status of the PALLAS isotope reactor in Petten after an EenVandaag report on chronic shortages of medical isotopes, and whether government pre-financing or a first-loss facility could fund such projects. The minister described reserved funds of 1.29 billion euro, remaining conditions, expected production around 2030, and said the final decision on the 330 million euro gap is expected in spring 2023, with the Growth Fund also considered.
The cabinet expects to make a definitive decision on the investment in the PALLAS project in spring 2023.
Het kabinet zal naar verwachting in het voorjaar van 2023 een definitief besluit nemen over de investering in het PALLAS-project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over het artikel 'EBN deed bod om gasopslag Bergermeer te nationaliseren'

Two MPs asked the minister why the government blocked EBN's bid to take over TAQA's stake in the Bergermeer gas storage, what analyses underlay that, and whether nationalisation would help supply security and allocation in shortages. The government answered that a larger ownership share would not improve storage filling, that the analyses are confidential, and that it instead subsidises market parties and tasks EBN with filling Bergermeer.

Because these documents contain, among other things, confidentially obtained commercially sensitive information and information that could harm the financial and economic interests of the state, we can only share the information confidentially with your House.

Omdat deze stukken onder meer vertrouwelijk verkregen bedrijfsgevoelige informatie en informatie die de financiële en economische belangen van de staat kan schaden bevat, kunnen wij de informatie alleen vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Bedrijfsleven waarschuwt tegen sleutelrol China in energietransitie'

An MP asked the minister about dependence on China for the energy transition, including Boskalis joint ventures with Chinese firms, sourcing of critical materials, and gas production from small fields. The minister answered that the government screens investments and tenders for strategic dependencies, pursues EU open strategic autonomy, and will publish a geo-economic monitor by end 2022 but not specifically on energy-transition materials.
The aim is to publish the geo-economic monitor at the end of 2022.
Het streven is om de geo-economische monitor eind 2022 te publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Netbeheerder TenneT zet afname en opwek stroom van bedrijven stil'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about grid congestion on the TenneT network in Limburg and Noord-Brabant, including whether an independent investigation, faster permitting and prioritisation are planned. The minister answered that congestion was known, that the Court of Audit has examined it, that a special coordinator and taskforce were appointed, that the Energiewet will be sent to parliament by year end, and that the situation cannot be structurally resolved in the short term.
The Court of Audit recently conducted research into transport scarcity on the electricity grid.
De Algemene Rekenkamer heeft recent onderzoek gedaan naar de transportschaarste op het elektriciteitsnet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de samenwerking tussen Nederland en Noorwegen op het gebied van klimaat en energie

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how the Netherlands can learn from Norway on climate and energy, about hydrogen cooperation, the climate impact of Norwegian gas versus LNG, and possibilities for more gas imports. The minister described long-standing cooperation on CCS, offshore wind, hydrogen and the NordNed cable, but said there is no realistic scope to increase Norwegian gas imports in the coming period.
On balance, I see no possibilities to achieve more natural gas imports from Norway in the coming period.
Per saldo zie ik geen mogelijkheden om de komende periode meer aardgasimport uit Noorwegen te laten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het beleid op het gebied van waterstof

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about hydrogen import diversification, import targets, the role of H2Global and long-term contracts, domestic production, and strategic hydrogen storage. The minister answered that an import strategy is still being developed, that fixed country-share targets are not yet feasible or needed, that options such as H2Global and a strategic storage model are being explored, and that a decision or report will follow later.
A maximum percentage per country (or type of country) for the share in total hydrogen imports is not currently necessary and also not feasible.
Een maximum percentage per land (of soort landen) voor het aandeel in de totale import aan waterstof is nu niet nodig en ook niet goed uitvoerbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Erkens over het artikel 'Hacker ontdekt dat Chinese zonnepanelen een bedreiging zijn voor ons stroomnet'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a report that Chinese solar inverters could threaten the electricity grid, and about dependence on foreign technology in vital infrastructure. The government answered that it shares concerns about state-actor cyber threats, points to existing and planned EU and national rules (NIS, RED, Cyber Resilience Act, Netcode on Cybersecurity, Vifo screening), and promises a scan of foreign-origin equipment in vital infrastructure in response to a motion, with timing still under exploration.
At present the Ministry of Justice and Security, together with the departments concerned, is exploring how to follow up on the motion.
Op dit moment wordt door het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, in samenwerking met de betrokken departementen, verkend op welke manier opvolging kan worden gegeven aan de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het nieuwsbericht ‘Nederland wil nog dit jaar van gas en kolen uit Rusland af’

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the government's plan to end imports of Russian gas, coal and oil, including oil blending, gas storage filling and emergency gas supply plans for winter. The minister answered that oil import bans are being pursued at EU level, gas storage will be filled with low-calorific gas, and further information and advice on winter scenarios will follow.
I will inform your House about this when deciding on gas extraction from the Groningen field for the 2022–2023 gas year.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover informeren bij de besluitvorming over de gaswinning uit het Groningenveld voor het gasjaar 2022–2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Noodlijdend Uniper dringt bij Duitsland aan om snel extra geld'

An MP asked the minister for Climate and Energy about Uniper's request for German state support, the Dutch energy market, the bankruptcies of energy suppliers last winter, supervision by the ACM, and consumer protection. The minister said the Dutch market is unlikely to face a similar situation, that the ACM has tightened supervision with extra financial requirements, and that research on consumer protection in case of supplier bankruptcy is near completion.
The ACM has in the meantime tightened its supervision for this autumn with additional requirements.
De ACM heeft inmiddels het toezicht voor dit najaar met extra eisen aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over groen gas uit niet biogene stromen

MPs Bontenbal and Erkens asked whether current SDE+/SDE++ rules limit subsidised green gas to biogenic feedstock (capping non-biogenic input at 5% and 2.5%), whether gasification could broaden supply, and whether flexibility could be created. Minister Jetten confirmed the rules, said he would have PBL advise and consider opening the category in SDE++ 2023, but rejected retroactive changes to existing decisions.
I have asked PBL to advise on this for the SDE++ round of 2023.
Ik heb PBL gevraagd om hier voor de SDE++ ronde 2023 advies over uit te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over opschaling van de groen gas productie in Nederland

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about scaling up green gas production, including targets, techniques, subsidies, permitting delays and RePowerEU options. The Minister answered that the 2 bcm 2030 ambition is firm, that a higher target will be examined by end-2022, and that permitting and subsidy barriers are being addressed through a range of measures.
Nevertheless, in line with my commitment to MP Erkens during the Climate & Energy committee debate of 24 March 2022, I will examine in the Green Gas Programme whether a higher ambition is feasible.
Desalniettemin zal ik, in lijn met mijn toezegging aan het lid Erkens, tijdens het CD Klimaat & Energie d.d. 24 maart 2022, in het Programma Groen Gas onderzoeken of een hogere ambitie haalbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van der Woude over het artikel 'Interesse in kerncentrales groeit, maar: waar zijn de nucleair specialisten?'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a shortage of nuclear specialists for planned nuclear plants, including staffing estimates, plans to strengthen knowledge infrastructure, and recruitment from abroad. The minister answered that no shortage estimate is possible yet, described an interdepartmental study and working group, and promised letters to parliament later in 2022 on results.
No estimate can be made in advance of a possible shortage of workers for the construction of new nuclear power plants.
Er is op voorhand geen inschatting te maken van een eventueel tekort aan arbeidskrachten voor de bouw van nieuwe kerncentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over mogelijke financiële modellen voor de te bouwen kerncentrales

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Climate and Energy which financing models for new nuclear plants are used in Europe, whether a state holding should be created, and how various schemes (SDE++, CfD, RAB, Mankala, CAPEX) compare. The minister answered that several models are being studied, that a state holding would be a far-reaching step only used when other instruments are insufficient, and that a parliamentary procedure with a 30-day notification would apply, with further findings promised in the autumn.
I expect to give the House more insight in the autumn into which schemes work well abroad and how applicable they are to the Dutch situation.
Ik verwacht de Kamer in het najaar meer inzicht te geven over welke regelingen goed werken in het buitenland en in hoeverre deze toepasbaar zijn op de Nederlandse situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Erkens en Van Strien over het artikel Chinese bedrijven azen op het Europese stroomnet

MPs Erkens and Van Strien asked whether Dutch policy adequately guards the energy grid against undesirable influence from Chinese and other non-European firms, and what tools exist. The minister answered that existing investment screening (Vifo, sectoral tests, public ownership of grid operators) and procurement rules apply, while a new Energy Act will add security-based procurement options and the government will review arrangements with TenneT and monitor the situation.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate will, among other things, review the current arrangements and frameworks with TenneT and make adjustments where necessary.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en klimaat zal onder meer de huidige afspraken en kaders met TenneT tegen het licht houden en zal daar waar nodig aanpassingen doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Brekelmans over de afhankelijkheid van Russisch gas voor Poetins oorlogsdrift

MPs Erkens and Brekelmans asked how dependent the Netherlands is on Russian gas and oil, who owns or operates related infrastructure, and how quickly dependence could be cut. The government answered that Russian gas is an estimated 15% of consumption, that Gazprom holds a usage right and gas cushion gas at Bergermeer storage but no ownership of key infrastructure, that commercial data cannot be shared, and that it will inform the House further on Bergermeer and work with EU partners and the REPowerEU plan.
The share of Russian gas in the purchasing portfolios of European energy companies is private commercially sensitive information and not publicly accessible.
Het aandeel Russisch gas in de inkoopportefeuilles van Europese energiebedrijven is private commercieel gevoelige informatie en niet publiekelijk toegankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over een mogelijk gastekort deze winter en het uitwerken van verschillende scenario’s hiervoor

MP Erkens (VVD) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about preparedness for a possible Russian gas boycott, including scenarios, volumes, load-shedding timing and the Gas Protection and Recovery Plan (BH-G). The government answered at length, describing monitoring with market parties, Entso-G stress-test scenarios, the three crisis levels and the emergency measures ladder, while stating that some quantitative figures cannot be given precisely.
It cannot be said how much gas the protected consumers in total take.
Het is niet te zeggen hoeveel gas specifiek de beschermde afnemers in totaal afnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de samenwerking met het Verenigd Koninkrijk op het gebied van klimaat

An MP asked the climate minister about Dutch-UK climate cooperation after Brexit, including hydrogen, electricity market coupling, CBAM and a shared CO2 market.
