The minister answered that cooperation continues via COP, coalitions and the Trade and Cooperation Agreement, with exploratory work on hydrogen, electricity coupling and a North Sea energy MoU still in progress.
The cabinet is positive that the Commission is seeking alignment with third countries on the CBAM.
Het kabinet is positief over het gegeven dat de Commissie afstemming met derde landen zoekt ten aanzien van de CBAM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over de huidige situatie omtrent de kolencentrales

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked about extra gas use, storage fill levels, compensation costs, CCS feasibility and cost, alternative fuels for coal plants, and whether the Urgenda emission target will be met. The minister answered with estimates (2.5 to 3 bcm extra gas per year, storage fill rise of about 7 percentage points per bcm), declined to give an exact compensation figure pending a letter before summer, and said the Urgenda target is becoming likely for 2022.
As promised, I will send a letter on coal before the summer.
Zoals toegezegd kom ik voor de zomer met een brief over kolen.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Van Strien en Erkens over de publicatie “EU Solar Energy Strategy” van de Europese Commissie

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the European Commission's EU Solar Energy Strategy and its implications for solar-powered vehicles, including Dutch support for the solar mobility cluster. The minister described the EU initiatives and existing fiscal support for solar cars, said further assessment would follow via a BNC procedure, and did not yet commit to new funding.
I am getting to work on this; through a BNC procedure I will go further into the Dutch cabinet's assessment of the EU strategy for solar energy.
Ik ga hiermee aan de slag; middels een BNC-traject zal ik nader ingaan op de beoordeling van het Nederlandse kabinet van de EU-strategie voor zonne-energie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de locatiekeuze voor kerncentrales in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the factors for selecting sites for two new nuclear plants, grid connection suitability, local jobs, public support in Zeeland, and timing of a decision. The minister listed site factors, said a letter before summer would outline steps, and that a site decision would follow after the scenario study.
I expect to inform the House before the summer recess in a separate letter about the steps I am currently taking towards building two new nuclear power plants.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer voor het zomerreces in een aparte Kamerbrief te informeren over de stappen die ik momenteel zet richting de bouw van twee nieuwe kerncentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Gekkenhuis op markt voor zonnepanelen en warmtepompen’

MPs Erkens and Peter de Groot (VVD) asked the Ministers for Climate and Energy and for Housing about a news report on a surge in demand and long waiting times for solar panels and heat pumps, covering possible government actions, installer shortages, suitability of heat pumps and insulation of rented homes. Minister Jetten answered that the demand increase reflects higher energy prices, that supply and installer capacity issues are largely for the market and labour policy, and that the government is pursuing a programmatic insulation approach with housing associations and landlords.
The shortage is a consequence of a global market disruption caused by strong fluctuations in demand and in the transport chain.
Het tekort is een gevolg van een wereldwijde verstoring van de markt, veroorzaakt door sterke schommelingen in de vraag en in de transportketen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Grinwis over de energieleveringszekerheid voor aankomende winter

MPs Erkens and Grinwis asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about gas supply security for the coming winter, covering gas prices, storage filling, North Sea production, long-term LNG contracts, the gas-reduction plan, coal plant limits, insulation and batteries. The minister answered by referring largely to earlier letters to parliament, stating that prices are set by the EU market, that a versnellingsplan for North Sea gas will follow by July 2022, and that there is no room to force large gas users to switch immediately.
I see no room to immediately switch multiple large gas users over to sustainable alternatives.
Ik zie geen ruimte om meerdere grootverbruikers van gas per direct over te laten schakelen op duurzame alternatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de Nederlandse gasopslagen

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how Dutch gas storage fill-levels should be secured for winter, comparing foreign models, strategic oil reserves and financial risk to the state. The government answered that Bergermeer filling measures are being finalised, that the EU Commission proposal will shape structural safeguards, and that a mandatory strategic gas reserve is not favoured due to cost and lead time.
Currently the finishing touches are being put on this, with the focus, as indicated in the aforementioned letter, on the Bergermeer gas storage facility.
Momenteel wordt daaraan de laatste hand gelegd waarbij de focus, zoals aangegeven in voornoemde brief, ligt op de gasopslag Bergermeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over gaswinning op de Noordzee

Erkens (VVD) asked the ministers how North Sea gas production can be kept from declining and reduce dependence on Russian gas, including reserves, emissions and investment climate compared with the UK. The state secretary answered that output will decline regardless, that an acceleration plan with industry will be sent to parliament by July, and that a comparison with the UK's licensing and tax regime is provided with noted differences.
I am working with the sector on an acceleration plan to bring projects forward and stimulate additional gas extraction.
Ik werk samen met de sector aan een versnellingsplan om projecten naar voren te halen en extra gaswinning te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Baanbrekende technologie kan CO2-uitstoot met 99 procent verminderen'

MP Erkens asked the minister of Climate and Energy about a Wetenschap in Beeld article on a hydrogen-based electrochemical technology to extract CO2 from the air, and about the government's policy on carbon removal (CCU, DAC, negative emissions) and its scale-up. The minister called the research interesting but noted it does not permanently fix CO2, pointed to a pending exploratory study and a forthcoming cabinet reaction, and promised to address scale-up in that letter.
In the letter with which I send the research referred to in the answer to question 4 to the House of Representatives, I will also address answering this question.
In de brief waarmee ik het onderzoek, waar in het antwoord op vraag 4 naar verwezen wordt, aan de Tweede Kamer aanbiedt zal ik ook ingaan op het beantwoorden van deze vraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht 'European gas prices shoot to new high as energy crunch worsens'

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary about European gas price spikes, supply security risks, preparedness measures, a prioritisation framework for industrial gas users, gas storage levels, dependence on imports, nuclear phase-out effects, coal plant output limits, and follow-up on a motion for an independent security-of-supply study. The Minister answered at length, describing the Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas preparations, export phase-down plans, storage figures, and TenneT monitoring, while stating that the independent study requires a tender procedure and the storage obligation will be detailed later.

As indicated in the answers to questions 2 and 3, the cabinet has started preparations, in response to the gas market situation, for implementing the Gas Protection and Recovery Plan under current legislation.

Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op de vragen 2 en 3 is het kabinet naar aanleiding van de situatie in de gasmarkt voorbereiding gestart voor het uitvoeren van het Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas onder de huidige wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de RES 1.0 en wind op land-plannen

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about wind-on-land projects in the Regional Energy Strategies (RES 1.0), their phases, turbine heights, distances to housing, the timing of new national noise and distance norms, and grid capacity. The minister answered with phase data, tip-height and housing-distance tables, explained that regions will fix zones in later RES versions and that new national norms are expected around mid-2023 following a plan-MER and AMvB procedure.
In addition, as I indicated in the debate of 17 February with your committee, I will consult with the subnational governments to discuss joint principles for the siting of new wind farms

Daarnaast zal ik zoals ik heb aangegeven in het debat op 17 februari jl. met uw Kamercommissie, in overleg treden met de medeoverheden om te spreken over gezamenlijke uitgangspunten voor de plaatsing van nieuwe windparken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Erkens over het bericht 'Facebook vs. Zeewolde: hoe lokale politici moeten beslissen over een landelijke kwestie'

MPs Rajkowski and Erkens asked about the planned large Meta data centre in Zeewolde, its impact on grid capacity, energy use, heat reuse, national coordination and the conditions attached to the sale of state land. The minister answered that national spatial policy prefers hyperscale centres at the country's edges, set conditions for the land sale, and committed to tighten national steering and admission criteria in a joint letter this spring.
In line with the coalition agreement, this cabinet will tighten national steering and the admission criteria for (hyperscale) data centres.
In lijn met het coalitieakkoord zal dit kabinet de landelijke regie en de toelatingscriteria ten aanzien van (hyperscale) datacenters aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Boucke over het artikel 'Anode Energie vraagt faillissement aan vanwege energieprijzen'

MPs Erkens and Boucke asked about the bankruptcy of Anode Energie and other energy suppliers, consumer losses, supplier protection, licensing by the ACM, and possible stress tests. The minister said about 160,000 customers were affected, outlined a study into stricter financial requirements and consumer protection, and announced Energiewet changes such as VOG screening and Bibob checks.

At this moment I am conducting a study into whether it is desirable and possible to set further requirements for the legal framework and, if so, which requirements best achieve the aim and are workable for both energy suppliers and the ACM.

Op dit moment doe ik een onderzoek naar de vraag of het wenselijk en mogelijk is om nadere eisen te stellen aan het wettelijke kader en zo ja, welke eisen het doel het beste bereiken en goed uitvoerbaar zijn voor zowel energieleveranciers als de ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Boucke over het artikel 'Warmtewet laat nog minstens een jaar op zich wachten’

Two MPs asked the minister for Climate and Energy about press reports that the heat law delay means heat tariffs, tied to gas prices, are rising sharply, and what the government will do about consumer protection and market power. The minister acknowledges that the gas-linked maximum tariff has risen, says a new law moving to cost-based tariffs is being prepared for submission by end 2022, and points to new ACM powers to examine individual suppliers' returns.
To offset the effects of the rise in energy bills, measures were taken at the end of last year that also apply to heat customers.
Om de effecten van de stijging van de energierekening te compenseren zijn eind vorig jaar maatregelen getroffen die ook voor warmte-afnemers gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van Strien over het artikel ‘SABIC overweegt sluiting naftakraker op Chemelot’

MPs Erkens and Van Strien asked whether SABIC is considering closing a naphtha cracker at Chemelot, what it would mean for workers and neighbouring firms, and how the government will secure decarbonisation investment and grid and pipeline infrastructure at the site. The minister answers that no decision has been taken, that the government and the province are monitoring talks with SABIC, that individual maatwerk agreements with large emitters including SABIC and OCI are being prepared, and that infrastructure needs are addressed in the MIEK.
The Ministry of EZK and the province of Limburg are following the outcomes of these talks to monitor the consequences for the entire site.
Het Ministerie van EZK en de provincie Limburg volgen de uitkomsten van deze gesprekken om de gevolgen voor de gehele site te monitoren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Peter de Groot over de uitspraak 201908401/1/R1 van de Raad van State over het verstrekken van omgevingsvergunningen door de gemeente Zutphen aan IJsselwind bv en het waterschap

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the Council of State ruling that annulled the zoning plan and permits for the IJsselwind wind park and the consequences of the related Delfzijl Zuid ruling for general wind turbine rules, municipal and provincial powers, and RES planning. The minister answered that local authorities may set their own environmental norms pending a new plan-MER, that wind projects may be delayed but the 2030 target is expected to be met, and that regional dialogue will address legitimacy and cross-border effects.
The State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management has set in motion the process for carrying out a plan environmental impact assessment for the general environmental rules.
De Staatssecretaris van IenW heeft het proces om een plan-milieueffectrapportage uit te voeren voor de algemene milieuregels in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over de leveringszekerheid van elektriciteit in Nederland

MPs Bontenbal and Erkens asked the Dutch government about the security of electricity supply in the Netherlands, including European coordination, TenneT's monitoring, neighbouring countries' nuclear and coal phase-outs, and the coal CO2 cap. The minister answered that supply adequacy is currently sufficient, that a strategic reserve is the preferred option if needed, that TenneT will supplement its 2021 monitoring within two months, and that a CO2 import/export correction will be considered when the Climate Act is amended.
TenneT has indicated that it will make an additional analysis of the Security of Supply Monitoring 2021 within two months for 2022 regarding the coal plant measures.

TenneT heeft inmiddels aangegeven voor het jaar 2022 binnen twee maanden een aanvullende analyse te zullen maken op de Monitoring Leveringszekerheid 2021 met betrekking tot de maatregelen voor de kolencentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht 'Nog deze maand besluit nodig over waterstofsubsidies'

Rep. Erkens (VVD) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether 25 Dutch hydrogen projects selected for the IPCEI process will be funded in time for the second wave, and whether the government will try to prevent them from falling out. The Minister answered that 35 million euro is earmarked for the first wave, a decision on funding for the second wave depends on EU clarity on subsidiable phases, and the government will keep working to get Dutch projects through the IPCEI process.
The decision to actually make funds available for the second wave depends on which phases of production projects are subsidiable and under which conditions.
Het besluit om nu ook daadwerkelijk middelen voor de tweede golf beschikbaar te stellen hangt af van welke fases van de productie projecten subsidiabel zijn en onder welke voorwaarden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Peter de Groot en Leijten over de invloed van de windlobby op de rapporten van het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) over de gezondheidseffecten van windturbines

MPs Erkens, Peter de Groot and Leijten asked whether RIVM omitted the wind-lobby influence on its reports on health effects of wind turbines, and how independent future research can be ensured. The minister said the RIVM's authority is not in question, that funding source alone should not exclude studies, and that RIVM is exploring additional health research and a study on setback distances.
I do not think it is for me or the cabinet to respond to this discussion, which belongs in the scientific domain.
Ik vind het niet aan mij of het kabinet om te reageren op deze discussie, die in het wetenschappelijk domein thuishoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Erkens over het artikel 'Waar blijft de toegezegde ruimhartige compensatie?'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Erkens (VVD) asked the ministers about news reports that promised generous flood compensation had not yet arrived, and about payout pace, the definition of generosity, affected areas in Brabant, and talks on turnover loss. The minister replies that payouts of 7.26 million euros had reached 296 recipients by 11 January 2022, that a one-off turnover loss scheme and a crop-plan compensation scheme are being prepared, and that the Dutch government's existing flood-relief measures apply.
It indicated, among other things, that the cabinet will publish a one-off turnover loss scheme for affected entrepreneurs in Limburg in early 2022.
Daarin is onder andere aangegeven dat het kabinet begin 2022 een eenmalige omzetdervingsregeling zal publiceren voor getroffen ondernemers in Limburg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over het bericht ‘Zorgen en boosheid na plotseling afblazen contractondertekening voor verbreden A2, Rijkswaterstaat meldt miljoenentekort’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the sudden cancellation of contract signing for widening the A2 near Vonderen-Kerensheide due to a cost shortfall, and about its timing, size, effect on planning and the nitrogen issue. The minister acknowledged the late and poorly handled communication, apologised, but withheld the exact size of the shortfall pending validation and said the planning remains on track with a tender in spring 2022.
The outcome of the validation and the follow-up will be communicated to you through the regular channels under the MIRT.
Over de uitkomst van de validatie en het vervolg wordt u via de reguliere kanalen volgens het MIRT geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Peter de Groot over de haalbaarheidsstudie ‘klimaatneutrale paden TSN IJmuiden’ van Roland Berger

Two VVD MPs asked the cabinet about the Roland Berger feasibility study on climate-neutral routes for Tata Steel IJmuiden, including state financial support, the size of the subsidy need, infrastructure, permit acceleration and inter-government coordination. The minister said the study is an important next step, that financial needs and support options are not yet known and depend on Tata Steel's own business case, that no funds are yet reserved, and that a new cabinet would decide, while permit speed-up and coordination are being explored without an interdepartmental taskforce.
That also cannot be expected at this stage of the process.
Dat kan in deze fase van het proces ook nog niet verwacht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over cumulatie van uitstoot en overlast in Zuid-Limburg

MPs Peter de Groot and Erkens asked about cumulative emissions and nuisance in cross-border South Limburg, including the planned Lixhe biomass plant in Belgium, and whether Dutch municipalities and the province can be stakeholders in the Belgian permit process. The State Secretary answered that Dutch bodies were not yet formally recognised as stakeholders, that the matter is for the bordering authorities to resolve, and that the government will raise concerns diplomatically and with Dutch local authorities.

I believe the province of Limburg and the Dutch municipalities concerned should be able to formally raise these objections in the procedure and that they should be weighed in assessing the application.

Ik vind dat de provincie Limburg en de betrokken Nederlandse gemeenten deze bezwaren formeel moeten kunnen inbrengen in de procedure en dat deze ook meegewogen moeten worden bij de beoordeling van de aanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van het lid Erkens over het bericht ‘Ook energieleverancier Enstroga valt om door hoge gasprijs’

An MP asked the government about energy supplier bankruptcies (Enstroga and others) caused by high gas prices, the protection of affected customers, the fairness of contracts and tariffs, and support for vulnerable households. The State Secretary answered that customers are redistributed under legal supply-security rules, that a generic energy tax cut and municipal support funds are being provided, and that ACM monitors tariff reasonableness, while individual compensation is deemed impractical.
Consumers are protected to ensure that they do not end up without gas or electricity.
Consumenten worden beschermd om ervoor te zorgen dat ze niet zonder gas of elektriciteit komen te zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over het bericht 'Nederlands initiatief in Glasgow: nieuwe vrachtauto's uitstootvrij in 2040'

MPs Peter de Groot and Erkens asked the State Secretary about a news report on the Glasgow zero-emission truck initiative, questioning why a 2040 target was not previously shared, its consistency with the Klimaatakkoord, competitiveness and leakage, and the instruments needed. The State Secretary answered that the MoU is not a new target but supports existing 2050 mobility goals, listed signatories, and described subsidies, charging infrastructure and toll-revenue funding under consideration.
The Global MoU does not involve legally binding agreements that countries must comply with.
Het Global MoU betreft geen juridisch bindende afspraken waaraan landen moeten voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Erkens over het bericht 'Gerberakweker Simon stopt acuut vanwege torenhoge gasprijs: ‘Het is niet meer te betalen’'

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a flower grower stopping production due to high gas prices and what support glasshouse growers could get. The minister said problems are limited to a small number of firms, prices are expected to fall, a tax cut for 2022 is proposed, and no additional compensation is planned for now.
Additional measures are not currently on the table, since high prices are not expected to persist for long.
Aanvullende maatregelen zijn op dit moment niet aan de orde, aangezien het niet de verwachting is dat de huidige hoge prijzen langdurig aanhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over grootschalige energieopslagprojecten in Nederland (Kamerstuk 29023, nr. 270)

An MP asked the state secretary about the role of large-scale energy storage in the Dutch electricity system, existing and planned instruments and budgets, legal obstacles, and projects in the pipeline. The state secretary answered that storage is one flexibility option alongside interconnection and demand response, listed subsidy schemes and a 35 million euro reservation for hydrogen storage, and said TenneT monitors security of supply annually, while declining to appraise individual projects.
I have recently informed the House of Representatives about the expected developments in underground energy storage.
Ik heb de Tweede Kamer recent geïnformeerd over de verwachte ontwikkelingen op het gebied van ondergrondse energieopslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de inzet van de Europese Commissie op het verduurzamen van de industrie door middel van groene waterstof

An MP asked the state secretary whether the European Commission's push for 50% green hydrogen in industry by 2030 makes decarbonisation more expensive than the Dutch CCS and blue hydrogen route, and how it fits with existing climate agreements. The government answered that green hydrogen is likely more expensive in the short term, that exact costs are hard to determine, that a demand-creation instrument and import strategy are being developed, and that research is ongoing with a letter promised at year end.
On the outcomes of this ongoing research I will inform you at the end of this year with the promised letter to parliament on hydrogen.
Over de uitkomsten van dit lopende onderzoek informeer ik u eind dit jaar met de toegezegde Kamerbrief over waterstof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Klink, Amhaouch en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Kabinet maakt reuzendraai: stopt toch met financieren fossiele brandstofprojecten in het buitenland'

MPs from VVD and CDA asked the government about the impact of signing the COP26 pledge to end international public support for unabated fossil energy by end 2022, including effects on firms, jobs, existing export credit insurance, transition support and funding. The minister answered that roughly a quarter of the export credit portfolio is fossil-linked, that 39 countries and institutions have signed, that new policy will be implemented by end 2022, and that existing policies and contracts are unaffected.
In 2022 the cabinet will work on new policy to end international public support for the fossil energy sector, particularly regarding the export credit insurance (ekv).
Het kabinet zal in 2022 werken aan nieuw beleid voor het beëindigen van internationale overheidssteun aan de fossiele energie sector, in het bijzonder voor wat betreft de ekv.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Leijten over de uitvoering van de motie Erkens/Leijten (Kamerstuk 32813-731)

MPs Leijten and Erkens asked the State Secretary for Energy and Climate about the status of research into the effects of distance standards for onshore wind turbines, who is involved, whether court cases and independence of studies are considered, and whether wind-on-land is needed to reach the 35 TWh target given rooftop solar potential. The government answered that research by Arcadis is underway with results expected February 2022, that stakeholders will be involved, that studies on a 45 dB noise norm show reduced potential, and that the 35 TWh target is not assured.
The research has recently been commissioned from the external research bureau Arcadis.
Het onderzoek is recent in opdracht gegeven bij het externe onderzoeksbureau Arcadis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over lokale initiatieven voor kernenergie

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about a Limburg provincial study into nuclear energy, whether the government would support such studies, and the role of small modular reactors and provinces. The state secretary said a national scenario study is due mid-2022, that further nuclear decisions are for a next cabinet, that SMRs carry risks, and that provinces are essential to any further nuclear development.
I find it interesting that Limburg is commissioning research into the possibilities for nuclear energy in Limburg and I will consult with Limburg about this research
Ik vind het interessant dat Limburg aangeeft onderzoek te laten doen naar de mogelijkheden voor kernenergie in Limburg en zal met Limburg in overleg treden over dit onderzoek
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Erkens over het bericht: ‘Klimaatimpact Nederlandse veestapel fors overschat’

MPs Van Campen and Erkens asked the ministers about a report claiming the climate impact of the Dutch livestock herd was overestimated, including whether an IPCC method change reduces cow impact threefold and how methane should be treated versus CO2. The government answered that the IPCC report does not claim cows' impact is three to four times lower, that GWP* only expresses short-lived gases' warming differently over time while GWP100 remains the international standard, and promised to send a cabinet appreciation of the IPCC report, which it had already done.
The IPCC report 'assessment report 6' does not contain such a claim.
In het IPCC rapport «assessment report 6» is een dergelijke stelling niet opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke, Bontenbal, Erkens en Grinwis over de stijgende gasprijzen

MPs from D66, CDA, VVD and ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about rising gas and energy prices, including household exposure, the causes, the Hermans motion funds, and whether France-style price freezes or targeted support should be used. The government answered that most households face higher bills, outlined temporary energy tax reductions for 2022 and a 150 million euro scheme for vulnerable households via municipalities, and rejected price regulation as market-distorting.
This therefore requires an individual assessment of the situation of all households. That information is not available.
Dit vergt dus een individuele beoordeling van de situatie van alle huishoudens. Die informatie is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de problematiek in de metaalsector als gevolg van de hoge elektriciteitsprijzen

An MP asked the ministers about the metal sector's distress from high electricity prices, including the emission factor used for indirect cost compensation, carbon leakage risk for individual firms, and firm failures and job losses. The minister acknowledged the high energy prices, said cost management is primarily the firm's own task, explained that the compensation scheme is generic and cannot be adjusted for individual firms, and said only one firm (about 325 jobs) has signalled acute risk of closure, with steps assessed under the existing state-aid framework.
So far I am aware of one company that itself indicated its continued existence would be in acute danger.
Vooralsnog is mij één bedrijf bekend dat zelf heeft aangegeven dat het voortbestaan in acuut gevaar zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de afwezigheid van kernenergie in de Green Zone op de 26ste Climate Change Conference of the Parties (COP26)

An MP asked the state secretary why nuclear energy is absent from the Green Zone at COP26 and whether the UK, France and others could be engaged to include it. The state secretary said Green Zone and Blue Zone exhibition access is allocated by the UK host under equal, published criteria, that the Netherlands cannot say what role nuclear will play in exhibitor programmes, and that it will raise nuclear's importance in bilateral talks and in events where partners agree.
The application and allocation of exhibition space in the Green and Blue Zones is handled via the COP host country, in this case the United Kingdom.
Het aanvragen en toewijzen van expositieruimte in de Groene en Blauwe Zones gebeurt via het gastland van de COP, in dit geval het Verenigd Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over de stijgende energieprijzen

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked the state secretary about rising gas and electricity prices, their scenarios, impact on sectors and households, flexible contracts, measures in other countries, and the role of nuclear energy. The state secretary answered on substance but deferred a promised letter on household purchasing-power effects and possible measures to the budget debate, and noted a planned tax-reduction measure under motion Hermans.
The cabinet will come back to this before the budget debate and the third round of the General Financial Deliberations.
Het kabinet zal hier voorafgaand aan de begrotingsbehandeling en de derde termijn van de Algemene Financiële Beschouwingen op terugkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Erkens over het artikel 'Nederland blijft achter met gasboringen op zee, bedrijven willen aan de slag'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister why exploration drilling for gas in the Dutch North Sea is lagging, whether domestic gas is preferable to imports, and how the tax investment deduction and supply security affect the outlook. The minister replied that two exploration wells were drilled in 2020, that the shortfall is too early to call structural, that domestic gas is preferable to imports while it is still needed, and that a round table and EU risk assessments will follow.

I am closely monitoring the current developments and am therefore organising a round table discussion with experts from the gas sector in the short term to discuss the developments and their possible consequences.

Ik houd de huidige ontwikkelingen scherp in de gaten en organiseer dan ook op korte termijn een ronde tafel overleg met deskundigen uit de gassector om de ontwikkelingen en de mogelijke gevolgen daarvan te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de hoge aardgasprijzen en leveringszekerheid

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about high gas prices, the decline of domestic production, storage fill levels, strategic gas reserves, long-term contracts and security of supply. The minister answered that prices reflect several market causes, that existing storage agreements and a planned risk evaluation and expert consultation address supply security, and that a strategic gas reserve is not currently deemed necessary.
I will therefore organise consultation with experts from the gas sector, including Gasunie Transport Services (GTS), in the short term to discuss the developments and their possible consequences.
Ik organiseer dan ook op korte termijn overleg met deskundigen uit de gassector, waaronder Gasunie Transport Services (GTS), om de ontwikkelingen en de mogelijke gevolgen daarvan te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Valstar over het ontwerp-weigeringsbesluit omtrent het aardwarmteproject Californië Lipzig Gielen Geothermie (hierna: CLG)

MPs Erkens and Valstar asked the government about the draft refusal decision on the CLG geothermal project, regional geothermal use and seismic risk, future capacity, licensing statistics, the Roer Valley rift, German comparisons and follow-up on SodM contacts. The State Secretary answered each question, explained that the refusal was based on safety uncertainties, and committed to a letter on geothermal risk policy within months.
The Climate Agreement, Built Environment section, sets an ambition of 40 PJ of sustainable heat.
Het Klimaatakkoord, onderdeel Gebouwde Omgeving, is een ambitie van 40 PJ duurzame warmte
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Erkens over het bericht inzake overbelasting van elektriciteitsnetten in wijken

MPs Koerhuis and Erkens asked whether electricity grids in neighbourhoods are becoming overloaded, blocking solar connections, new businesses and new homes, and what the government will do. The state secretary confirms growing transport scarcity, points to existing measures and the planned Energy Act, and says new homes may be allowed gas connections where grid capacity is lacking.
Netbeheer Nederland is still working on a national overview of scarce transport capacity for electricity offtake and expects to have it ready this autumn.
Netbeheer Nederland werkt nog aan een landelijk overzicht van schaarse transportcapaciteit voor de afname van elektriciteit en verwacht dat dit najaar gereed te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Idsinga en Erkens over de fiscale behandeling van thuiswerkdagen in relatie met Duitsland en België

Two VVD MPs asked whether the temporary tax arrangements with Germany and Belgium on home-working days during COVID, currently valid until 30 September 2021, would be extended and whether a permanent arrangement is possible. The State Secretary answered that extension to the end of 2021 is sought but depends on the partner countries, no changes are expected if extended, and a permanent arrangement is being raised in talks without any outcome yet.
I am partly dependent on Belgium and Germany for this.
Ik ben hiervoor mede afhankelijk van België en Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Erkens over een snelle tegemoetkoming voor gedupeerde ondernemers van de waterschade in Limburg

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister about insurers refusing flood damage claims in Valkenburg and how quickly affected entrepreneurs in Limburg could receive compensation, including whether turnover loss and advances could be covered. The minister answered that the Wts compensation scheme and a ministerial regulation are being prepared, damage can already be reported to RVO, turnover loss from disasters is excluded from the Wts but will be discussed with the region, and advances would slow the process because they also require appraisals.
The ministerial regulation includes the damage area.
In de ministeriële regeling is het schadegebied opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul, Erkens en Van Strien over het rapport 'The Role of Critical Minerals in Clean Energy Transitions' van het Internationale Energieagentschap (IEA)

MPs Paul, Erkens and Van Strien asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the IEA report on critical minerals, including dependence on China, strategic stockpiles, nuclear energy and resource efficiency technology. The minister answered that Europe-level policy, circular strategies and industry-led risk management are the preferred response, that stockpiles are only sometimes useful and Europe should first improve risk analysis, and that nuclear could contribute to diversification without being decisive.
That is why the Netherlands is pursuing ambitious raw materials policy at the European level.
Daarom zet Nederland in op ambitieus grondstoffenbeleid op Europees niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Erkens over het bericht 'Van Hoogezand tot Siddeburen: iedereen wil ’s nachts een stil windpark'

MPs Agnes Mulder and Erkens asked whether the government would consider night-time shutdown of wind turbines at park N33 in Midden-Groningen to address noise nuisance, and about current policy, noise standards, RES planning, and the business-case effects of such shutdowns. The state secretary answered that enforcement lies with municipalities, that current noise norms are scientifically based and not to be revised for now, that night shutdown would cut output and a third more capacity would be needed, and that alternatives are being discussed with the sector.
It is therefore up to the municipalities concerned to establish whether the noise standards are exceeded and to decide on possible steps based on their findings.
Het is daarom aan de betreffende gemeenten om vast te stellen of er sprake is van overschrijding van de geluidsnormen en aan de hand van hun bevindingen te besluiten over eventuele stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over het rapport ‘Energy Transition Monitor - Critical Metals' van ABN AMRO

MPs De Groot and Erkens asked about an ABN AMRO report warning that electrifying road transport alone will not solve critical-metal dependence, and about the government's plans on scarcity, circularity, hydrogen and biofuels. The state secretary answered that the government supports a mix of electric, hydrogen and biofuel paths, relies on recycling, the European Critical Raw Materials Action Plan and ERMA, and will use an efficiency-based allocation approach rather than a formal allocation framework.
I am aware that there may be scarcity of sustainable fuels. That is why efforts are directed at using the various fuels as efficiently as possible.
Ik ben mij ervan bewust dat er schaarste kan zijn aan duurzame brandstoffen. Daarom wordt er ingezet op een zo efficiënt mogelijke inzet van de verschillende brandstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Paul over de brief van de regering over de bekostiging van investeringsvoorstellen uit het Nationaal Groeifonds

Two VVD MPs asked how regional balance was ensured in Groeifonds investment allocations, why the advisory commission rejected the Rotterdam–Chemelot pipeline proposal, what the Flemish Antwerp–Chemelot pipeline consultation means for Rotterdam's competitiveness, and whether the government will act on the commission's advice for a pipeline bundle. The government answered that regional spread is not a goal in itself but a consideration, that the commission advised independently, that a Rotterdam-led follow-up study is underway with IenW, and that it endorses making capacity available but it is too early to commit budget.
The fund managers do not interfere in the commission's substantive weighing of proposals, in order to safeguard the commission's independent role.
De fondsbeheerders mengen zich niet in de inhoudelijke weging van voorstellen door de commissie, om zo de onafhankelijke rol van de commissie te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Aukje de Vries over de berichten 'Overvol stroomnet doet pijn in Leeuwarden' en 'Problemen op elektrisiteitsnet: gjin stroom foar nije skoallen yn Ljouwert'

MPs Erkens and Aukje de Vries asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about grid capacity shortages in Leeuwarden that block housing, schools and businesses. The minister confirmed the shortages, explained the timelines for a new substation (2026-2027), and pointed to measures and the Energy Act, without committing to a fast fix.
Expanding the infrastructure takes time, partly due to the scarcity of technical personnel and lengthy planning procedures.
Het uitbreiden van de infrastructuur kost tijd, mede door de schaarste van technisch personeel en door lange planologische procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Aukje de Vries over het verplicht moeten tonen van een negatief testbewijs bij de grens tussen Nederland en Duitsland

Two VVD MPs asked the Dutch government about the German requirement to show a negative test when crossing the border, including for cross-border workers and pupils, and whether the government would raise the problem with Germany. The State Secretary answered that a Dutch test facility is being set up, that Germany has relaxed some rules for cross-border commuters, and that the government has been in ongoing contact with German authorities.
The cabinet shares this view and therefore wants to create a testing facility for these specific groups.
Het kabinet deelt deze mening, en wil voor deze specifieke groepen daarom een testvoorziening creëren.

m: Motie van het lid Van Strien c.s. over een garantiefonds van minimaal 1 miljoen euro opzetten waarmee de Bevrijdingsfestivals zich kunnen verzekeren tegen slecht weer
Asks the government to set up a guarantee fund of at least 1 million euro so the Bevrijdingsfestivals can insure against bad weather, funded from the culture budget.
requests the government to set up a guarantee fund of at least 1 million euro with which the fourteen Liberation Festivals can insure themselves against bad weather.
verzoekt de regering een garantiefonds van minimaal 1 miljoen euro op te zetten waarmee de veertien Bevrijdingsfestivals zich kunnen verzekeren tegen slecht weer
Motie van het lid Van den Berg c.s. over onderzoeken hoe tot een kostendekkende Wlz-premie gekomen zou kunnen worden

The Minister answered in detail on the handling of reports, inspection timing, staffing cuts, lack of registration of PGB initiatives, and victims' legal aid, stating that the earlier reports could not be found and that the IGJ will hold leadership sessions and expand inspection capacity for 2023–2026.
No explanation has been found for the inability to locate the reports that were allegedly made in November 2020 and June 2022.
Er is geen verklaring gevonden voor het niet terug kunnen vinden van de meldingen die in november 2020 en juni 2022 gedaan zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Werner over de uitzending ‘Leven na een amputatie’

MPs Van den Berg and Werner (CDA) asked the Minister of Health about a broadcast on life after amputation, raising gaps in municipal Wmo provision, prosthesis software locks, wheelchair and prosthesis funding, client support, insurer reimbursement and stoma data sharing. The minister answered largely by pointing to municipal discretion, insurers and industry contracting, and promised only general steps such as agreements with the VNG and Movisie on client support.
Municipalities are responsible for implementing the Wmo 2015 and have policy discretion within the legal framework for that implementation.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de Wmo 2015, waarbij zij binnen het wettelijke kader beleidsvrijheid hebben t.a.v. deze uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Werner over het publieksonderzoek van Actiz

Two MPs (Sahla, D66, and Werner, CDA) asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about an Actiz survey showing most Dutch people have not arranged for old age, the delayed IBO elderly-care vision, separating housing and care, nursing-home capacity, and funding cuts to building norms. The Minister acknowledged the challenge, pointed to ongoing WOZO programme work, a Zorginstituut study due March 2024, and NZa tariff adjustments, while deferring the IBO report to the Council of Ministers and promising to share it as soon as possible.
In accordance with the applicable procedure, the IBO elderly care study and the cabinet response will first be discussed in the Council of Ministers.
Conform de geldende procedure zal het IBO-ouderenzorg en de kabinetsreactie eerst besproken worden in de Minsterraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over de uitzending van Undercover in Nederland op 23 april 2023

The MP asks the minister about abuse at a care farm shown on Undercover in Nederland, including IGJ inspection frequency, why small care providers are not licensed, whether licensing should be extended, how founders can be kept from re-entering care, and what relatives can do. The minister says inspection is risk-based with no set frequency, a general licensing duty would be an undue burden and not necessarily prevent such cases, background checks and reporting routes exist, and residents were offered victim support and relocated.
There is no guideline for the frequency of visits to care farms.
Er is geen richtlijn voor de frequentie van het bezoeken van zorgboerderijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘‘Schrikbarende’ conclusies in zeer kritisch advies: Den Haag heeft ‘de regio’ stelselmatig verwaarloosd’

An MP asked the state secretary for Culture about a critical advisory report finding that central government has neglected the regions, including whether regional cultural access gaps will be addressed. The state secretary deferred the broader conclusions to a forthcoming cabinet response, but listed existing and planned regional cultural funding measures and said cultural spreading criteria will be revisited in the BIS 2025-2028 policy letter.
Because this advice touches many policy areas, a cabinet response will follow that addresses the conclusions of the advice.
Omdat dit advies vele beleidsterreinen raakt, volgt er nog een kabinetsreactie waarin zal worden ingegaan op de conclusies van het advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘Ben je vrouw, van kleur of kom je van buiten, dan krijg je het lastig bij NOS Sport'

An MP asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science how a culture of silence and inaction over sexual misconduct at NOS Sport and the broader media sector could be broken, and about the independence of the reporting point Mores.online. The state secretary answered that an independent investigation by the Onderzoekscommissie Gedrag en Cultuur Omroepen is under way, that Mores.online's board has resigned, and that the government commissioner Mariëtte Hamer was asked to advise on its governance, with a follow-up meeting planned.

Because the safety of victims must be guaranteed at all times, on 15 March I asked the government commissioner, Mariëtte Hamer, to investigate what is needed to guarantee that safety for victims and which governance structure fits.

Omdat de veiligheid van slachtoffers te allen tijde gewaarborgd dient te zijn heb ik 15 maart jongstleden de regeringscommissaris, Mariëtte Hamer, verzocht om te onderzoeken wat nodig is om die veiligheid voor slachtoffers te waarborgen en welke governancestructuur daarbij past.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Hijink, Mohandis, Werner en Sylvana Simons over het ratificeren van het facultatief protocol bij het VN-verdrag voor rechten van mensen met een beperking

Five MPs asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport whether she would keep her promise to decide by the end of Q1 2023 on ratifying the optional protocol to the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, and to give clarity within a week. The minister confirmed the commitment, explained that the decision requires broad consultation across the cabinet because the Council of State advised on related protocols, and promised the cabinet decision by mid-May 2023.
My aim is to send you the cabinet decision by mid-May 2023 at the latest.
Mijn inzet is erop gericht om u uiterlijk medio mei 2023 het kabinetsbesluit te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘Gehandicapte in de knel: hulp aan verstandelijk beperkte met gedragsstoornis te duur’

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about reports of waiting lists and rising VG7 care for people with intellectual disabilities and complex psychiatric or addiction problems, including whether tariffs are too low and why the 2021 analysis led to no increase. The Minister gave figures (133 on the waiting list, 5 urgent), attributed the rise to growing complexity, pointed to KPMG and NZa studies with results due in 2023-2025, and announced a development programme for complex care.
I believe people with complex care needs are entitled to appropriate care and support.
Ik vind dat mensen met een complexe zorgvraag recht hebben op passende zorg en ondersteuning.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het door gemeenten in de Duin- en Bollenstreek vervangen van definities in hun Wmo-verordeningen die afwijken van de definities, zoals die door de wetgever in de Wmo 2015 zijn v

An MP asked the State Secretary about four Duin- en Bollenstreek municipalities replacing the statutory Wmo 2015 definitions of 'beschermd wonen' and 'opvang' in their local ordinances, and what this means for residents' protection. The State Secretary answered that the definitions broadly follow the statute but that the element 'begeleiding' is missing from the opvang definition, which is undesirable, and promised to ask VNG to promote clarity and to alert the municipalities to the omission without further specific steps.
It is my intention to ask the Association of Dutch Municipalities (VNG) to promote that no uncertainty arises for residents regarding the mentioned facilities.
Het is mijn voornemen de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) te vragen te bevorderen dat voor de inwoners geen onduidelijkheid ontstaat over de genoemde voorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘33 gemeenten verlagen tarieven voor pgb ondanks inflatie: ‘Als ik weer moet gaan werken, dan moeten mijn kinderen naar een instelling’

MP Werner (CDA) asked the Minister for Long-term Care about 33 municipalities lowering personal budget (pgb) hourly rates, some to the minimum wage, and about budget holders who fear to complain, along with related questions on rate-setting and a national guideline. The minister answered that municipalities are legally bound to set adequate rates, that informal carers are at least owed the minimum wage, that objection and appeal procedures exist, and that a joint handreiking with VNG and Per Saldo on pgb rate-setting is planned before the Christmas recess.
Municipalities are legally obliged to set adequate rates so that budget holders can purchase appropriate care and support.
Gemeenten zijn wettelijk verplicht om toereikende tarieven vast te stellen, zodat budgethouders passende zorg en ondersteuning kunnen inkopen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Werner en Van den Berg over het item in Op1 ‘Administratieve lasten wijkverpleegkundige en huisarts’ d.d. 15 februari 2023

CDA MPs asked the ministers about an Op1 report on administrative burdens for district nurses and GPs caused by insurers now supplying medical aids mainly through national suppliers rather than pharmacies. The minister called the reported situations undesirable, said insurers and V&VN are collecting cases and that the NZa is holding talks, but did not confirm a causal link to the policy change and gave no firm new commitments.
I find the situations mentioned in the broadcast undesirable.
Ik vind de situaties die in de uitzending worden genoemd onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het schrappen van jazz en wereldmuziek bij de NPO

An MP asked the state secretary whether the renaming of Radio 4 to NPO Klassiek, and the removal of jazz and world music from its programming, was known, whether the government accepts that the NPO influences broadcaster programming, and what role ratings played. The state secretary answered that programming decisions belong to the NPO's programmatic autonomy, that jazz and world music remain available on NPO Soul & Jazz, that the renaming was based on audience research, and that the ministry will address the issue with the NPO and jazz sector representatives.
It is for the NPO and the broadcasters to shape the programming in good mutual consultation and cooperation.
Het is aan de NPO en de omroepen om in goed onderling overleg en samenspel invulling te geven aan de programmering.
Antwoord op vragen van Werner over het bericht en het rapport van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens ‘Gecoördineerde aanpak nodig om rechtsbescherming van mensen met een beperking te garanderen’

MP Werner (CDA) asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about a College voor de Rechten van de Mens report calling for a coordinated national action plan to secure legal protection for people with disabilities, and about ratifying the Optional Protocol to the UN disability convention. The minister says the report is welcome and will be discussed with cabinet colleagues, points to existing judiciary measures, defers the national action plan and rights-protection questions to the Minister for Legal Protection, and promises a letter before summer 2023 and a cabinet decision on ratification in Q1 2023.
I will first consult my cabinet colleagues and other stakeholders before coming with a joint response.
Ik ga eerst in gesprek mijn collega’s in het kabinet en andere betrokkenen alvorens ik met een gezamenlijke reactie kom.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sahla en Werner over het bericht ‘Te groot en vies, in veel gevallen mag de hulphond niet mee, zegt KNGF’

MPs Sahla and Werner asked whether refusals of assistance dogs in shops violate the Constitution and the UN disability convention, and what the minister will do to improve access, recognition and standards. The minister acknowledges reports of refusals, points to the College voor de Rechten van de Mens as a low-threshold, non-binding route with follow-up in most cases, and says a conformity certification scheme and European standards are under study without firm timelines.
For this reason it is important that such incidents can also be brought before the College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Om deze reden is het belangrijk dat dergelijke voorvallen ook kunnen worden voorgelegd aan het College van de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over bedreiging van cultureel erfgoed uit de periode 1965-1985

An MP asked the State Secretary for Culture whether post-1965 heritage such as buildings from 1965-1985 is under threat, and whether the Rijk will protect 100 or 200 such objects as it did for the postwar Reconstruction period. The State Secretary acknowledged the threat, said a limited designation programme (Post 65) is being prepared by the RCE with selection criteria, while leaving the number of objects open and noting municipalities also have protection duties.
Given the major spatial challenges facing the Netherlands in 2023 and their impact on heritage, I have now decided that a (limited) designation programme is nevertheless needed.
Vanwege de grote ruimtelijke opgaven waar Nederland anno 2023 voor staat en de impact daarvan op het erfgoed, heb ik inmiddels besloten dat een (beperkt) aanwijzingsprogramma nu toch nodig is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Agnes Mulder over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya, dat 6 jaar geleden is ontvoerd naar India

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about the case of Dutch girl Insiya, abducted to India six years ago, and what has been done to restore her contact with her mother and return her to the Netherlands. Minister Hoekstra answered that the government raises the case with Indian authorities, relies on Indian court proceedings with no timeline for return, and that India has said the father's pending cases cannot be pursued in the local courts.
Unfortunately, no timeframe can currently be given for Insiya's return.
Er is helaas op dit moment geen termijn te geven voor de terugkeer van Insiya.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘Duizenden ouderen hebben acuut verpleeghuisbed nodig, tekort groeit snel’

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport how the strain on care (acute shortage of nursing home beds, falls leading to hospital and nursing home admission, waiting lists for ouderen) should be understood and what the government will do. The Minister answered that care is under pressure from ageing, labour shortages and changing preferences, outlined waiting-list figures, and said she will consult the four largest Wlz insurers and regions and that funds will flow to regions for integrated home-based care.
Given ageing, labour shortages and older people's changing preferences, which is to keep control over their own lives for as long as possible and live in their own environment, a change is necessary.

Met het oog op de vergrijzing, de krapte op de arbeidsmarkt en de wijzigende voorkeuren van ouderen, die zo lang mogelijk de regie over hun eigen leven willen behouden en willen wonen in hun eigen omgeving, is een verandering noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Verliest De Mearmin haar status?’

MPs Werner and Van der Molen (CDA) asked the State Secretary whether the government intends to remove windmill De Mearmin from the national monuments register after it was moved to an open-air museum, and about the grounds, subsidies, and consequences. The State Secretary confirmed the plan, citing heritage policy that relocation to a museum ends monument status, while acknowledging the RCE advised against the move and stating that monument policy does not support museum operations.
It has long been customary that where buildings are moved to a museum, they lose their monumental status or are not designated.
Het is reeds lange tijd gebruikelijk dat daar waar panden worden verplaatst naar een museum deze hun monumentale status verliezen of niet worden aangewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht 'Boekenprogramma 'Brommer op zee' mocht toch doorgaan, maar dat hoorden de makers te laat'

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that the NPO influenced a VPRO book programme, its short-notice cancellation, and staff contracts, and whether programme success should be judged by ratings. The state secretary says the NPO and broadcasters jointly shape programmes within the Mediawet, that the government operates independently of broadcasters, that the NPO and VPRO communication is not reconstructable, and that she will discuss contracts and success measures with the NPO.
It is not for me to judge the considerations made in that interplay regarding programmes, in this case 'Brommer op zee'.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te geven over de afwegingen die in het genoemde samenspel ten aanzien van programma's, in dit geval «Brommer op zee», gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Hijink over Het bericht ‘Inval commerciële verpleeghuizen, ouderen verwaarloosd’

MPs Werner and Hijink asked about reports of police raids on Orpea's commercial care homes, private-equity involvement, profit disclosure to residents, property sale-and-leaseback, and IGJ supervision. The minister answered that providers must follow existing law, that the IGJ enforces care quality, and gave figures on private-equity concentrations and Orpea's growth, while declining to comment on ongoing inspections.
The IGJ does not make statements about whether investigations are ongoing.
De IGJ doet geen mededelingen over al dan niet lopend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner, Van der Molen en Geurts over het bericht ‘Kritiek op (on)toegankelijkheid Langeveldgebouw voor mensen met functiebeperking’

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers about reports that the Erasmus University Langeveld building is inaccessible for people with various disabilities, and about the diversity of accessibility standards. The minister acknowledged the problem, noted the university chose the stricter NEN-ISO 21542 standard, said formal inspection is due early next year, and described a forthcoming national NEN accessibility norm expected end 2023.
I have given NEN the assignment to do so.
Ik heb daartoe opdracht gegeven aan NEN.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht  ‘In de succesvolle tv-machine van DWDD werd menig redacteur vermalen’

An MP from the CDA asks the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science how grensoverschrijdend gedrag at DWDD, the broadcasters' response, the role of the NPO and the regeringscommissaris, and possible tightening of the Arbeidsomstandighedenwet are handled. The state secretary answers that the conduct is unacceptable, describes the NPO-commissioned external investigation and action plan, and says the Minister of SZW is examining regulatory tightening, but withholds details of confidential talks and says the precise investigation brief is not yet known.
Given the confidentiality of these conversations, I cannot go into what was concretely discussed.
Gezien de vertrouwelijkheid van deze gesprekken kan ik niet ingaan op wat er concreet is besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘Excuses voor misstanden bij NPO-klokkenluider’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about salary constructions at the public broadcaster NPO, circumventing pay norms via production companies, and the status of a Commissariaat voor de Media investigation. The State Secretary said the government opposes such constructions, that the Commissariaat's investigation (with KPMG) is due in Q1 2023, that it can compel information under the Awb, and that it can impose fines or penalty payments.
The Commissariaat voor de Media has announced it will investigate the NPO and national public broadcasters for financial (circumvention) constructions under the WNT and BPPO.
het Commissariaat) heeft aangekondigd onderzoek te zullen doen bij de NPO en landelijke publieke omroepen naar financiële (omzeilings-)constructies in het kader van de WNT en het BPPO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht 'Jo kan al maanden niet de deur uit omdat zijn geleidehond is afgepakt'

An MP asked the Minister of Health why a visually impaired man lost his guide dog and could not leave home for months, who owns such dogs, what rules apply when a user cannot care for the dog, and how complaints are handled. The minister answered that training schools usually own the dogs under loan agreements, that aftercare and take-back rules depend on contracts, and that complaint schemes exist and a sector-wide conformity and complaints framework is being explored.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Van der Molen over het artikel ‘Bestuurder scootmobiel raakt te water in Stadskanaal’

CDA MPs asked about rising scooter-mobility accidents, the SWOV safety recommendations, the relation between the Wegenverkeerswet and the Wmo, and mandatory training. The minister says reliable injury data are lacking, cites CBS fatality counts, says a new framework for mobility vehicles is being developed with SWOV and RDW input, and declines to make training mandatory.
There are no recent, reliable data available on the number of (seriously) injured traffic casualties among scooter-mobility users.
Er zijn geen recente, betrouwbare gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal (ernstig) verkeersgewonden onder scootmobielrijders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘Omroepen: er moet snel iets gebeuren met ON, na ‘beschamende’ uitzending’

An MP from the CDA asked whether Ongehoord Nederland crossed a line with a broadcast and what measures should be taken, and who is responsible for checking broadcasters' compliance with conditions. The State Secretary replied that editorial independence limits government involvement, that the NPO Ombudsman and Commissariaat voor de Media are reviewing the broadcast, and that no additional conditions were imposed beyond the Mediawet and NPO codes.
In the first instance it is for the NPO Ombudsman and the Commissariaat voor de Media to review the broadcast against the NPO journalistic code and the Mediawet respectively.
Het is in eerste instantie aan de NPO Ombudsman en het Commissariaat voor de Media om de uitzending te toetsen aan respectievelijk de journalistieke code van de NPO en de Mediawet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Engelse voetballer komt uit de kast, nu nog in Nederland’

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Long-term Care and Sport about the absence of openly gay professional male footballers in the Netherlands, low acceptance ratings in football, and the handling of homophobic remarks. The government acknowledged that homophobia does not belong in sport and pointed to existing programmes (OVIVI, the Alliantie Gelijkspelen) but committed to no new concrete action.
Homophobia and negative expressions do not belong in sport and therefore also not in football.
Homofobie en negatieve uitingen horen niet thuis in de sport en dus ook niet in het voetbal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht 'Groot deel van de musea in de rode cijfers'

An MP asked the state secretary about museum visitor declines, deficits and lack of reserves in 2021, and what support is available. The state secretary confirmed the drop to 11.8 million visitors, attributed it mainly to longer closures, pointed to support and a publicity campaign, and said municipalities are responsible for monitoring their own museums and that some data will follow later.
Municipalities are responsible for monitoring and supporting the institutions they finance.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het monitoren en ondersteunen van door hen gefinancierde instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Werner over kwetsbare ouderen die vaak geen gebruik maken van inkomensvoorzieningen

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Ministers for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions and for Long-term Care and Sport about vulnerable older people who often do not claim income support, citing a National Ombudsman report on complexity, distance from government and low trust. Minister Schouten largely agreed with the analysis, estimated roughly 30% potential non-take-up of the AIO (about 20,000 households), announced a data-exchange pilot between SVB and UWV/Tax Authority, and defended current application procedures while saying automatic allocation is complex and only sometimes feasible.
I broadly share the analysis of the National Ombudsman.
Ik deel de analyse van de Nationale ombudsman in grote lijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner, Inge van Dijk en Palland over het beschermen en behouden van maritiem erfgoed.

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about protecting maritime and sailing heritage, including historic houseboats, and about registration, legal anchoring and a plan of action. The State Secretary answered that the national government's role is mainly support and facilitation, that existing registers and designation tools are in place, and that the Erfgoedwet evaluation and a follow-up meeting with the sector will come later.
For the national government, that role lies mainly in support and facilitation in the field of knowledge and expertise.
Voor het Rijk ligt die vooral in ondersteuning en facilitering op het vlak van kennis en kunde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over jonge mantelzorgers

The MP asks the State Secretary about young carers, their visibility, numbers, difficulties, support and awareness-raising, and whether a letter will be sent before Prinsjesdag. The State Secretary answers that awareness and practical support are key, describes existing local and national support and the school pilot, and promises a vision letter before the budget debate.
Before the VWS budget debate I will send the House a letter setting out the cabinet's vision on informal care and its efforts to improve it for the coming cabinet period.
Ik zal voor de begrotingsbehandeling van VWS een brief naar de Kamer sturen met daarin de visie van het kabinet op mantelzorg en de inzet voor verbetering voor de komende kabinetsperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht 'Ook mensen met beperking moeten makkelijk biertje kunnen halen op festival'

MP Werner (CDA) asked the state secretary for Culture about the accessibility of music festivals for people with disabilities, including the number of accessible festivals, the #OnbeperktFeest campaign, and the routekaart for inclusive festivals. The state secretary answered that accessibility is improving, that data on accessible festivals is lacking and will be discussed with the sector association, and that talks with the VNG will follow with progress reported in a letter this autumn.
I am going to talk with the Dutch Association of Pop Venues and Festivals about how we can better map the number of accessible music festivals.
Ik ga in gesprek met Nederlandse Vereniging Poppodia en Festivals over hoe we het aantal toegankelijke muziekfestivals beter in kaart kunnen brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over de uitzending van Kassa over digitale toegankelijkheid en verdere verantwoordelijkheden rond een toegankelijke samenleving13-6-2022

MP Werner (CDA) asked the ministers about a Kassa broadcast on the digital inaccessibility of government websites and apps, the widening digital divide, enforcement of the 2018 accessibility decision, ministerial responsibility for an accessible society, support for businesses, and whether a government accessibility commissioner should be appointed. The minister acknowledges persistent accessibility problems, describes a step-by-step plan with strengthened supervision and an accessibility facilitator, but declines to appoint a separate commissioner.
To ensure that improvement measures actually lead to better accessibility, not only extra support is offered to government organisations, but supervision of compliance is also strengthened.

Om te waarborgen dat verbetermaatregelen daadwerkelijk leiden tot betere toegankelijkheid wordt niet alleen extra ondersteuning geboden aan overheidsorganisaties, maar ook het toezicht op de naleving versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over personeelstekorten in de wijkverpleging

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about staff shortages in community nursing, including whether insurers meet their duty of care, how the Integraal Zorgakkoord addresses labour market problems, and how administrative burdens can be reduced. The Minister answered that insurers show no structural under-contracting, outlined labour-market and registration-burden measures, and committed to an independent study on harmonising procurement and reporting requirements due in the third quarter of 2022.
I expect to be able to inform the House in the third quarter of this year about the outcomes of the study and the follow-up.
Ik verwacht uw kamer in het derde kwartaal van dit jaar over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek en de opvolging daarvan te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Recordaantal klachten en vragen over discriminatie in 2021'

Two CDA MPs asked the government about a report that discrimination complaints in 2021 were at a record high, mostly concerning disability and chronic illness, and about accessibility, measures under the UN Disability Convention, and the effects of COVID-19. The ministers answered that accessibility remains a matter of awareness, that 88% of respondents complied with rulings, that a 2022 policy approach continues implementation, and that they will continue inclusion efforts and housing and labour market initiatives.
88% of the respondent parties found to be in violation were willing to take measures following a ruling finding a breach of equal treatment legislation.

88% van de in het ongelijk gestelde verwerende partijen waren bereid om maatregelen te treffen naar aanleiding van een uitspraak waarin tot schending van de gelijke behandelingswetgeving werd geoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over Kwart musea dreigt in financiële problemen te komen

Rep. Werner (CDA) asked the state secretary whether a quarter of Dutch museums face financial trouble due to falling visitor numbers, whether smaller and municipally funded museums are most affected, what support is planned, whether volunteer shortages exist, and whether talks with the museum association and VNG will be held. The state secretary answered that visitor numbers lag in parts of the cultural sector, cited a museum association survey, said general corona support has ended, referred to coalition agreement work and a recent letter, noted municipalities are responsible for their funded institutions, and reported ongoing consultation with the taskforce, VNG and IPO.
I am currently working on elaborating the coalition agreement, with recovery of the cultural and creative sector after corona being the main focus.
Ik werk op dit moment aan de uitwerking van het coalitieakkoord, herstel van de culturele en creatieve sector na corona vormt daarbij het zwaartepunt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Mensen met handicap onterecht dubbel verzekerd'

Two CDA MPs asked the minister whether people with intellectual disabilities receiving care under the Wlz are wrongly double-insured with supplementary dental cover, and what should be done about it. The minister answered that Wlz data may not be shared with supplementary insurers for privacy reasons, that there is no legal double insurance, that the number affected is unknown, and that he will raise the role of insurers with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland.
Data on Wlz clients may, for privacy reasons, be shared only to a very limited extent.
Gegevens over Wlz-cliënten mogen – in verband met de privacy – slechts zeer beperkt worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het nieuwsitem in Hart van Nederland d.d. 11 februari 2022

An MP asked the minister whether the Ouderenfonds' decision to end the Zilverlijn phone service for lonely elderly, announced only a month in advance, was acceptable and whether the ministry would talk to the fund. The state secretary said the fund made an independent choice in which the ministry plays no role, that alternative phone services remain available, and that the ministry keeps in regular contact with the fund on loneliness initiatives.
Stopping the Zilverlijn and the way it was announced was an independent policy choice by the Ouderenfonds in which VWS played no role.
Het stoppen met de Zilverlijn en de wijze waarop dat bekend is gemaakt is een zelfstandige beleidskeuze geweest van het Ouderenfonds waarin VWS geen rol heeft gespeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Peters over het artikel 'Osse hospice Oase voert strijd tegen lagere subsidie: ‘Als direct gevolg corona volkomen onterecht gekort''

MPs Werner and Peters asked the minister about a regional report that Oss hospice Oase received lower palliative care subsidy for 2022 because the 2020 COVID-19 dip in client numbers was included in the calculation. The minister answered that the subsidy formula is based on actual client numbers over three years, that no case-specific adjustment is possible to keep the scheme simple, that 111 organisations gained and 90 lost subsidy, and that a one-off COVID compensation was given while 2021 will be considered for 2023.
Despite the coronavirus pandemic, it has been decided to keep the existing method of the subsidy scheme for subsidy year 2022.
Ondanks de coronapandemie is besloten om voor het subsidiejaar 2022 vast te houden aan de bestaande werkwijze van de subsidieregeling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht 'Mantelzorgers en professionals moeten het samen zien te rooien, ‘maar overheid moet dan ook iets bieden’

An MP asked whether a Maastricht hospital's 'Mantelzorgacademie' training patients and carers to perform medical tasks such as IV antibiotics, and whether carers face pressure to take over care, and who bears legal responsibility. The state secretary replied that training is voluntary, case-by-case, supervised by professionals, that carers performing such tasks are not acting professionally under the BIG Act, and that the government will keep working on formal-informal care cooperation.
If someone performs reserved acts non-professionally, the BIG Act does not apply to them.
Als iemand niet beroepsmatig voorbehouden handelingen uitvoert dan is de Wet BIG niet op hem van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over de bescherming van deelnemers van tv-programma’s zoals the Voice of Holland

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science how contestants on TV talent shows such as The Voice of Holland are protected against sexual misconduct and abuse of power, and about contract terms and the protection of minors. The State Secretary answered that she is convening a round table with the sector, has asked the Raad voor Cultuur for advice, notes that employers bear primary responsibility under the Arbo law, and says inspection and sanctions are available, while promising to inform parliament.
That is why, under our central direction, work is underway toward an integrated and coordinated approach to sexual boundary-crossing behaviour or violence.
Daarom wordt onder onze centrale regie toegewerkt naar een integrale en gecoördineerde aanpak van seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag of geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Werner over het bericht 'PGB-houders krijgen opeens minder uren'

An MP asks the State Secretary about reports that PGB holders receive fewer hours after insurers overrule district nurses' indications, and about rising complaints to the SKGZ. The minister answers that insurers may review indications but should consult the nurse first, that complaints in 2021 were not higher than 2020, and that no further investigation is planned for now.
As the answer to question 3 shows, the number of new complaints did not rise in 2021.
Zoals uit het antwoord op vraag 3 naar voren komt, is het aantal nieuwe klachten in 2021 niet gestegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Werner, De Neef en Tellegen over het toezicht van de gemeenten op de zorg
