MPs from CDA and VVD asked the state secretary about municipal supervision of care after reports that municipal oversight under the Wmo 2015 is failing, including staffing, coordination with national inspectorates, handling of reports, staff qualifications and fraud. The state secretary acknowledged the concerns, said municipalities have wide discretion and that a study on Wmo supervision is underway with a follow-up letter promised before 1 June 2022, while several answers referred to existing cooperation arrangements and noted that national data was unavailable.
That is why my predecessor decided to commission a study into the functioning of Wmo supervision.
Daarom heeft mijn ambtsvoorganger besloten een onderzoek in te stellen naar het functioneren van het Wmo-toezicht
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Westerveld, Hijink, Kuiken, Agema, Tellegen, Bikker, Van der Laan en Werner over bescherming medische gegevens in de intensieve kindzorg

MPs asked whether insurers sharing medical data of chronically ill children with third parties for efficiency checks, without parental consent, complies with GDPR article 9, and whether a consent requirement is needed. The minister answered that insurers remain controllers responsible for processors, that the AVG applies, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens supervises compliance, and that no consent requirement is planned.
It is not for me to assess a specific data processing operation. That is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de beoordeling van een specifieke gegevensverwerking. Dit is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het programma Undercover in Nederland

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether the IGJ had previously supervised care provider Zuster Norma for risky care, whether the same problems recur as shown in a Undercover in Nederland broadcast, and what the IGJ has done since. The Minister confirms the earlier supervision and lifting of the admission stop, says follow-up supervision took place in September 2021 and is ongoing, and states the IGJ applied hear-and-counter-hear and inspected both locations, with a report to be published once finalised.
In September 2021 follow-up supervision took place. This is an ongoing process, in which the images from the broadcast are being taken into account.
In september 2021 heeft vervolgtoezicht plaatsgevonden. Dit is een nog lopend traject, waarbij de beelden uit de uitzending worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Fort uit Tachtigjarige Oorlog staat op instorten'

Two CDA MPs asked the Education, Culture and Science Minister about reports that Fort Crèvecoeur from the Eighty Years' War is at risk of collapse, including its European heritage nomination, a dispute with 's-Hertogenbosch, the 2010 agreement, steps taken, municipal powers and repair costs. The minister answered that the Ministry of Defence and the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf are preparing a decision on urgent consolidation measures, that costs are commercially confidential, and that the municipality lacks enforcement powers because the fort is a national security matter under the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management.
The expected costs are for the time being commercially confidential.
De te verwachten kosten zijn vooralsnog commercieel vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘Medische kwalen gemist door tekort aan artsen voor verstandelijk gehandicapten’

An MP asked about reports that medical conditions of people with intellectual disabilities are missed due to a shortage of physicians for people with intellectual disabilities (AVG), and how access to care and training intake will be ensured. The minister acknowledges the shortage and low intake, describes a labour-market strategy, an agreement on cooperation, NZa exploration of funding adjustments, and follow-up with GPs and the training institution.
I intend to closely monitor this process.
Ik ben voornemens dit proces nauwgezet te blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Werner over het bericht ‘Schaapsherders in de knel: er zijn er nog maar een paar over en subsidie komt niet bij hen terecht’

MPs Boswijk and Werner asked whether only four independent shepherds remain, whether shepherding is on the national intangible heritage list, and how the government will secure their survival given that subsidies flow mainly to nature organisations and provinces. The minister answered that traditional flocks number about fifty, that shepherding is on the national inventory, that subsidies come mainly from provinces and the CAP grazing scheme, and that a national scheme for rare breeds is planned for 2023-2027, without guaranteeing survival of each flock.
The whole set of support for traditionally shepherded sheep flocks, as outlined in my letter of January 2019, contributes to the maintenance of shepherded sheep flocks in the Netherlands.
Het geheel aan ondersteuning van traditioneel gescheperde schaapskuddes, zoals geschetst in mijn brief van januari 2019, draagt bij aan de instandhouding van gescheperde schaapskuddes in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht 'SCP: samenleving nog steeds niet ingericht voor mensen met een lichamelijke beperking'

An MP from the CDA asked the minister for Medical Care about a SCP report finding that society is still not accessible for people with physical disabilities, including discrimination, whether ratifying the Optional Protocol to the UN Disability Convention would help, progress since 2016, measurability of commitments, municipal inclusion agendas and the accessibility website. The minister acknowledges remaining barriers, points to the Onbeperkt meedoen! programme, existing complaint bodies and a planned national discrimination coordinator, and says ratifying the Optional Protocol alone would not suffice.
The cabinet wants to appoint an NCDR who, together with parties in this broad field, will work on a multi-year national programme.
Het kabinet wil een NCDR aanstellen die samen met de partijen in dit brede veld aan de slag gaat met een meerjarig nationaal programma
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Werner over dynamische evenementenvergunningen

MPs from the CDA asked about the status of more flexible, phased event permit procedures (dynamic permits), why fairgrounds are classed as events rather than throughflow locations, differentiation by event category, municipal hesitancy, timelines, and a handreiking for municipalities. The Minister answered that permitting is primarily a municipal responsibility, that talks with the VNG are ongoing, that the government has communicated conditions for events to ease planning, and that answers were timed with the 11 June communication.
Issuing permits is primarily a local responsibility of the municipality, which is advised by the safety region, emergency services and other parties.
Het verstrekken van vergunningen is primair een lokale verantwoordelijkheid van gemeente, zij worden hierbij geadviseerd door de veiligheidsregio, hulpdiensten en andere partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht 'Andere Tijden verdwijnt na 21 jaar van de televisie'

An MP asks the minister whether the public broadcaster's plan to cut or move the programme Andere Tijden and other programmes (Radar, Opsporing Verzocht) online, reducing older viewers' access, serves public-broadcasting goals. The minister replies that programming decisions belong to the NPO and broadcasters, that government does not interfere with programme content or scheduling, and declines to discuss the matter with the NPO.

It is up to the NPO, in consultation with the broadcaster(s) concerned (the NTR in this case), to ensure that a programme can meet the quality requirements the public broadcaster sets for its own programming.

Het is aan de NPO om in samenspraak met de betreffende omroep(en) (de NTR in dit geval) ervoor te zorgen dat een programma kan voldoen aan de kwaliteitseisen die de publieke omroep aan de eigen programmering stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Peters over "studenten met een beperking die nog steeds te weinig studietoeslag krijgen"

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the individual student allowance (IST) for students with disabilities, noting only eleven of the 25 largest municipalities pay the promised 300 euro and few students know of it. The minister said the allowance is municipal responsibility, pointed to a pending bill (Breed Offensief) to harmonise the amount, committed to talks with student organisations and a reminder to municipalities to pay 300 euro from age 21.
The implementation and setting of the amount of the IST is the competence and responsibility of the college of mayor and aldermen.
De uitvoering en het bepalen van de hoogte van de IST is de bevoegd- en verantwoordelijkheid van het college van B&W.

m: Motie Kant over niet overgaan tot de verkoop van aandelen Essent door de aandeelhouders
Urges shareholders of Essent not to sell the shares to RWE for now.
urgently appeals to the shareholders of Essent not to proceed with the sale of the shares now
doet een dringend beroep op de aandeelhouders van Essent om nu niet tot deze verkoop van de aandelen over te gaan
Motie Kant c.s. over een eventueel besluit tot verkoop van de aandelen Essent aan RWE te vernietigen indien RWE niet is gesplitst
Motion asks the government to annul by Royal Decree any sale of Essent shares to RWE if RWE has not first split off its network.
requests the government, if shareholders sell Essent to RWE before RWE commits to divesting its network, to annul those decisions by Royal Decree

verzoekt de regering om indien de aandeelhouders Essent aan RWE verkopen voordat dit bedrijf zich heeft verplicht tot het afstoten van zijn netwerk aan een onafhankelijke partij, deze besluiten bij Koninklijk Besluit te vernietigen
Motie-Kant c.s. over een eventueel besluit tot verkoop van de aandelen Essent aan RWE te vernietigen indien RWE niet is gesplitst
Asks the government to annul by Royal Decree any sale of Essent shares to RWE if RWE has not first split off its network to an independent party.
requests the government, if shareholders sell Essent to RWE before RWE commits to divesting its network to an independent party, to annul these decisions by Royal Decree

verzoekt de regering om indien de aandeelhouders Essent aan RWE verkopen voordat dit bedrijf zich heeft verplicht tot het afstoten van zijn netwerk aan een onafhankelijke partij, deze besluiten bij Koninklijk Besluit te vernietigen
Motie-Kant over de aandeelhouders van Essent ertoe te bewegen, af te zien van de verkoop van de aandelen Essent aan RWE
Asks the government to talk with the Essent shareholder provinces and municipalities to persuade them not to sell their shares to RWE.
requests the government to enter into talks with the Essent shareholders to persuade them to refrain from the sale
verzoekt de regering om in gesprek te gaan met de aandeelhouders van Essent om hen ertoe te bewegen van de verkoop af te zien
Motie Sap/Kant over aanvullende maatregelen zodat mensen aan de onderkant er gemiddeld in 2009 niet op achteruitgaan
Asks the government to take additional measures so that people at the bottom of the income distribution do not on average fall behind in 2009.
requests the government to take additional measures so that people at the bottom do not on average fall behind in 2009
verzoekt de regering aanvullende maatregelen te nemen zodat mensen aan de onderkant er gemiddeld in 2009 niet op achteruitgaan
Motie Sap c.s. over duidelijkheid over het aantal langdurig uitkeringsgerechtigden en herintreedsters dat extra aan een baan geholpen wordt
Asks the government to inform the House before the budget debate on results and on its ambition for long-term unemployed and returners placed in jobs.
requests the government to inform the House before the budget debate about the results achieved
verzoekt de regering voor de behandeling van de begroting van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid de Kamer te informeren over de bereikte resultaten
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Elissen ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het tevens strafbaar maken van voorbereidinghandelingen die opzettelijk strijd met artikel 3, onder b of d, faciliteren en

Amends the Opium Act to make preparatory acts that facilitate intentional violations of article 3 criminal regardless of quantity or business purpose, and raises the maximum penalty for the underlying offence.

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Elissen ter vervanging van nr. 10 over het tevens strafbaar maken van voorbereidingshandelingen die opzettelijke strijd met artikel 3, onder d, faciliteren en het verh
Makes preparatory acts facilitating intentional breaches of the Opium Act's ban on producing List II substances punishable and raises the maximum penalty for the base offence.
This amendment ensures that preparatory acts facilitating intentional violation of article 3, under D, also become punishable
Dit amendement bewerkstelligt dat de voorbereidingshandelingen die opzettelijke strijd met artikel 3, onder D, faciliteren, tevens strafbaar worden
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Elissen ter vervanging van nr. 8 over het tevens strafbaar maken van voorbereidingshandelingen die opzettelijke strijd met artikel 3, onder b of d, faciliteren
Extends criminal liability for preparatory acts facilitating intentional violations of Opium Act prohibitions in article 3 b or d to all list II substances.
This amendment ensures that preparatory acts facilitating intentional violation of article 3, under B or D, are punishable
Dit amendement bewerkstelligt dat de voorbereidingshandelingen die opzettelijke strijd met artikel 3, onder B of D faciliteren
Amendement van het lid Elissen over het tevens strafbaar maken van voorbereidingshandelingen die opzettelijke strijd met artikel 3, onder d, faciliteren
Extends criminal liability for preparatory acts to facilitating intentional violation of the Opium Act ban on manufacturing for all List II substances, not only large quantities.
Through this amendment, in short, preparing the manufacture (article 3, part D) of all List II substances also becomes punishable.
Middels dit amendement wordt, kortom, ook het voorbereiden van het vervaardigen (artikel 3, onderdeel D) van alle stoffen van lijst-II strafbaar.
Amendement van het lid Elissen over het tevens strafbaar maken van voorbereidingshandelingen die opzettelijke strijd met artikel 3, onder B, C of D faciliteren

Amendment extends the new preparatory-acts offence in the Opiumwet so that preparing to facilitate intentional violations of article 3 B, C or D applies to all list II substances, not only large quantities.
This amendment ensures that preparatory acts facilitating intentional violation of article 3 B, C or D (as described in article 11(2) of the Opiumwet) also become punishable.

Dit amendement bewerkstelligt dat de voorbereidingshandelingen die opzettelijke strijd met artikel 3, onder B, C of D faciliteren (zoals beschreven in artikel 11, tweede lid, van de Opiumwet), tevens strafbaar worden.
Motie Slob c.s. over versterking van het brandpreventiebeleid
Asks the government to explore additional ways to strengthen fire prevention policy and report to the House.
requests the government, in consultation with relevant parties, to examine what additional options exist to further strengthen fire prevention policy
verzoekt de regering in overleg met betrokken partijen te onderzoeken welke aanvullende mogelijkheden er nog zijn
Motie Van der Burg c.s. over een deltaplan
Asks the government to present within three months a concrete Deltaplan ICT to fix problems in public-sector ICT projects, including deleting or simplifying rules and improving procurement.
requests the government to come within three months with a concrete ICT Deltaplan to tackle the ICT problems in government
verzoekt de regering binnen drie maanden met een concreet Deltaplan ICT te komen teneinde de ICT-problemen bij de overheid aan te pakken
Motie Elissen over de contributie aan de IPU
Asks the Presidium to push for a substantial cut in the Chamber's annual contribution to the IPU.
requests the Presidium to work towards a substantial reduction of the contribution the House of Representatives pays annually
verzoekt het Presidium in te zetten op een forse verlaging van de contributie die de Tweede Kamer jaarlijks betaalt
Motie Elissen over afsluiten van de werkkamers
Asks the Presidium to allow MPs and parties to install locks on their office doors at their own expense.
requests the Presidium to create the possibility for MPs and political parties to have locks installed on office doors at their own expense
verzoekt het Presidium de mogelijkheid te creëren voor Kamerleden en politieke partijen om eventueel op eigen kosten sloten aan te laten brengen in de deuren van de werkkamers
Motie Elissen over de Europese vlag
Asks the Presidium to fly the European flag at the Tweede Kamer building only on clear ceremonial occasions.
requests the Presidium to hoist the European flag only when there is a clear ceremonial occasion
verzoekt het Presidium de Europese vlag alleen dan te hijsen wanneer er een duidelijke ceremoniële aanleiding is
Motie Elissen over beëindiging van het diversiteitsbeleid
Asks the Presidium of the House to end all forms of diversity policy and related activities within the Tweede Kamer.
requests the Presidium to end every form of diversity policy and related activities
verzoekt het Presidium een einde te maken aan iedere vorm van diversiteitsbeleid en daaraan gelieerde activiteiten

Amendement van het lid Schouten c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 16 strekkende tot het handhaven van de eis dat bij direct marketing burgers telkens worden gewezen op de mogelijkheden tot het doen van verz
Retains the Wbp requirement that direct marketers must inform individuals of their right to object each time they are contacted.
Article 41, paragraph 4, Wbp, provides that the data subject is pointed to the possibility of objecting each time he is approached in connection with direct marketing.
Artikel 41, lid 4, Wbp, regelt dat betrokkene elke keer dat hij in verband met direct marketing wordt benaderd wordt gewezen op de mogelijkheid tot het doen van verzet.
Motie Van der Steur c.s. over kostenvergoedingen aan ISP's
Asks the government to take into account the interests of small, large and business internet service providers when setting cost compensation for data requests.
to take into account the justified interests of small, large and business ISPs within the existing financial frameworks
de gerechtvaardigde belangen van de kleine, grote en zakelijke ISP's te betrekken binnen de geldende financiële kaders
Motie Elissen c.s. over erkenning van de Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers als officiële gesprekspartner
Asks the government to recognise the Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers as an official conversation partner.
requests the government to recognise the Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers as an official conversation partner
verzoekt de regering om de Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers te erkennen als officiële gesprekspartner
Motie Hennis-Plasschaert c.s. over regionalisering van de brandweer
Asks the government to move towards regionalisation of the fire service within the Veiligheidsregio's law.
requests the government to proceed to regionalisation of the fire service within the Veiligheidsregio's law
verzoekt de regering over te gaan tot regionalisering van de brandweer binnen de wet Veiligheidsregio's
Motie Rouvoet c.s. over handhaving van de standaardbezetting van een eerstelijnsbrandweereenheid
Asks the government to keep the standard crew of six for a first-line fire unit, citing firefighter safety against the commission's cost-saving proposal.
requests the government to maintain the standard crew of six persons for a first-line fire unit
verzoekt de regering de standaardbezetting van een eerstelijnsbrandweereenheid van zes personen te handhaven
Motie Brinkman en Elissen over spoeddebatten op maandag of vrijdag
Asks the Presidium to propose that urgent debates not scheduled within a week can be placed on the agenda on a Monday or Friday.
requests the Presidium to propose that urgent debates which cannot be placed on regular meeting days within a week may be placed on Monday or Friday
verzoekt het Presidium te komen tot een voorstel, waarbij spoeddebatten die binnen een week niet op de reguliere vergaderdagen geplaatst kunnen worden
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elissen over ambulances die nog steeds niet over de busbaan mogen rijden

An MP asked ministers why ambulances still cannot use bus lanes despite a 2011 motion, and questioned the delay in implementing it. The minister acknowledges the delay, says overlap with a related Kamervragen answer caused it, and points to a reply sent to the Tweede Kamer stating no regulatory change is needed.
Unfortunately, a response to the motion and answering the questions from MP Wiegman required much consultation, which caused delays in handling.
Tot mijn spijt heeft een reactie op de motie en de beantwoording van de vragen van lid Wiegman veel overleg gekost, waardoor vertraging in de afhandeling is opgetreden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Elissen over het bericht dat ACTA terug is als CETA

An MP asked whether parts of the rejected ACTA text reappear in the EU-Canada trade agreement CETA, whether parliament will be informed of such recurrences, and whether similar treaties are planned. The minister replied that some ACTA-derived wording was in an earlier CETA draft but the Commission will respect the European Parliament's vote, that provisions will be reviewed or removed, and that parliament is involved in the usual way while negotiations stay confidential.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Elissen over de nieuw paspoorten die grote beveiligingsproblemen kennen

An MP from the PVV asked the Interior Minister whether he recognises serious security vulnerabilities in the new Dutch passports (chip can be remotely activated and data copied) and what measures will be taken against identity fraud and terrorism. The minister acknowledges the issues were already known and reported to parliament in 2005 and 2008, points to the Extended Access Control protection added in 2009, and stresses that fraud detection depends on proper document checks, without announcing new concrete measures.
I recall that your House has been informed about both aspects.
Ik memoreer dat over beide aspecten uw Kamer geïnformeerd is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Elissen over bizarre stijging parkeertarieven

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior whether the government would cap or unify municipal parking tariffs nationwide after a reported 15% rise in street parking prices, and whether a national parking law should be introduced. The Minister replied that parking tariffs fall under municipal autonomy, that councils are best placed to set them, and that he will not set limits or change policy on this basis.
The height of parking tariffs is part of municipal autonomy.
De hoogte van de parkeertarieven is onderdeel van de gemeentelijke autonomie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Elissen naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving eind mei jongstleden over de vermeende terreurcel van Al Shabaab in Nederland

The PVV MP Elissen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of a sleeper terror cell of Al-Shabaab in the Netherlands, whether this warranted investigation, whether residence permits or nationality had been revoked for Somalis linked to Al-Shabaab, and how journalists could interview a former Al-Shabaab commander. The minister replied that the intelligence services have no indications of sleeper cells, cannot comment publicly on specific measures, that no revocations linked to Al-Shabaab have occurred, and that he cannot discuss how the services operate.
However, I cannot make concrete public statements about how the services conduct these investigations and with whom they speak.
Ik kan in het openbaar echter geen concrete uitspraken doen over de wijze waarop de diensten deze onderzoeken uitvoeren en met wie zij spreken.
Antwoord vragen Elissen over een nieuwe, levensgevaarlijke drug

An MP asked the health and justice ministers whether a new dangerous drug ('badzout') linked to a fatal-looking incident in Miami should be scheduled, and why generic criminalisation of such drugs was not adopted, and how the motion on this is being implemented. The minister answered that the incident was abroad and only toxicology can confirm the substances, that scheduling requires the statutory criteria of Article 3a of the Opium Act, and that RIVM has been asked to study generic criminalisation with results to follow.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Elissen en De Jong over de RET die passagiers afluistert

PVV MPs Elissen and De Jong asked whether Rotterdam's RET tram operator secretly records passenger conversations, on what legal basis, how recordings are used and stored, and whether the minister will investigate. The state secretary answered that the audio question is for the privacy regulator CBP to judge, described RET's access protocol limited to police and justice, and referred back to earlier answers for retention periods and any investigation.
The final judgment on this, however, does not rest with me but with the CBP.
Het uiteindelijke oordeel hierover komt echter niet aan mij toe, maar aan het CBP.
Antwoord vragen Elissen en De Jong over grote problemen op het spoor

MPs Elissen and De Jong asked about union criticism of Keyrail, alleged manipulation of punctuality figures, safety on the Betuweroute, and the relationship between Keyrail and ProRail. The minister says there is no evidence of manipulation, describes the controls and the inspectorate's view that safety is comparable to ProRail's, and promises to keep the interfaces limited and to consider an audit.
ProRail is one of the three shareholders of Keyrail.
ProRail is één van de drie aandeelhouders van Keyrail.
Antwoord vragen Elissen en Fritsma over het bericht dat Roemenen en Bulgaren vaker betrokken zijn bij mensenhandel

MPs Elissen and Fritsma asked whether the rising share of Romanians and Bulgarians in human trafficking cases warrants 100% border checks on their nationals and a firm stance on Schengen accession. The minister answered that border controls are already applied, that the KMar pilot has been scaled up nationally, and that the Netherlands will judge Schengen accession only after the July 2012 CVM report.
The cabinet's position on the Schengen accession of Bulgaria and Romania is known.
Het standpunt van het kabinet inzake de Schengentoetreding van Bulgarije en Roemenie is bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Elissen en Graus over het bericht dat de luchtvaart in rep en roer is door een nieuwe methode van drugssmokkel

PVV MPs Elissen and Graus asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of the Interior about a reported case in which someone hid cocaine in an aircraft wing, asking about passenger risk, airport security measures, and the investigation. Minister Opstelten answered that the access itself is a serious security problem, that existing ICAO-based measures and 100% drug controls on flights from the overseas territories are considered adequate and will not be tightened, and that a joint investigation led by the Openbaar Ministerie is underway, though no further details can be given.
In the interest of the investigation, no further statements can be made about this.
In het belang van het onderzoek kunnen hierover geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elissen naar aanleiding van een nieuwsbericht over digitale spionage van China en Rusland

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about digital espionage by China and Russia against travellers and businesses, including device tampering, government protective measures and the risks posed. The minister answered that the risk is real, listed espionage methods and existing AIVD/MIVD advisory, awareness and information-security measures, while withholding country-specific details as classified.
I cannot provide further information on which countries engage in espionage, as this concerns the knowledge level and sources of the AIVD and MIVD.
Nadere informatie over landen die zich schuldig maken aan spionage kan ik niet verstrekken aangezien dat raakt aan het kennisniveau en de bronnen van de AIVD en de MIVD.
Antwoord vragen Elissen en Van Bemmel over het kwijtmaken van het archief van het Nationale Cyber Security Centrum

MPs Elissen and Van Bemmel asked whether Govcert/NCSC could no longer access its pre-2009 hacking incident records, whether SCADA systems had been hacked before 2009, and whether the archive handling complied with the Wob and Archiefwet. The minister replied that the pre-2009 records are accessible with extra effort, that the NCSC acted carefully and warned about SCADA risks, and that the Erfgoedinspectie found the archive sufficiently accessible under the Archiefwet.
The registration of incidents from before 2009 is accessible.
De registratie van incidenten van vóór 2009 is toegankelijk.
Antwoord vragen Elissen over het beleggen van “overtollig” geld van de provincie Noord-Holland

An MP asked whether the province of Noord-Holland invests surplus funds with private institutions and whether this breaches the schatkistbankieren (treasury banking) arrangement. The minister answered that the Nazorgfonds, a separate entity outside the arrangement, may invest under the Ruddo rules, that no agreement was breached, and that he will raise the topic with provincial associations.

The decision of the Gedeputeerde Staten of Noord-Holland to invest 70% of the Nazorgfonds N-H funds in fixed-income and 30% in equities falls within the legal framework, and therefore no agreement has been breached by Noord-Holland.

Het besluit van Gedeputeerde Staten van Noord-Holland om 70% van de middelen van het Nazorgfonds N-H te beleggen in vastrentende waarden en 30% in zakelijke waarden valt derhalve binnen de wettelijke kaders en er is derhalve geen afspraak door Noord-Holland geschonden.
Antwoord vragen Elissen over de gemeente Terneuzen die jarenlang een coffeeshop ondersteunde

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the municipality of Terneuzen, by supporting coffeeshop Checkpoint, took part in criminal acts, and what this means for other municipalities and coffeeshop policy. The minister answered that only the coffeeshop operator and staff are being prosecuted, that the courts judge the municipality and its officials, and that the Public Prosecution Service is appealing, so the implications cannot yet be stated.
It is for the judge to give a verdict on the conduct of the municipality and its administrators.
Het is aan de rechter om een oordeel te geven over het optreden door de gemeente en haar bestuurders.
Antwoord vragen Elissen en Van Vliet over stijgende WOZ-waarderingen

Two PVV MPs asked why WOZ property valuations keep rising while house prices fall, whether this creates municipal arbitrariness, and what will be done to protect homeowners. The minister answered that valuations lag market prices by a year, that municipal arbitrariness is not evidenced and the Waarderingskamer supervises, and that a bill to make WOZ values public and informal objection channels are planned.
I have not found any evidence that there is municipal arbitrariness.
Mij is niet gebleken dat er sprake is van gemeentelijke willekeur.
Antwoord vragen Bontes, Elissen en Van Bemmel van uw Kamer over het censureren van internet

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether court-ordered blocking of websites by internet providers (following the Brein case) is censorship, what steps will prevent it, whether compensation applies if the ruling is reversed, and why funds for internet freedom abroad are not used domestically. The state secretary declined to comment on the pending case, pointed to existing compensation law, noted that Dutch policy opposes censorship while funds are spent abroad, and said he is still considering a response to a related motion.
By letter I informed the House about the ruling of the Hague District Court of 11 January 2012 and indicated that I refrain from commenting on this case, because it is before the court.

Bij brief heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag van 11 januari 2012 en heb ik aangegeven dat ik mij onthoud van commentaar op deze zaak, omdat deze onder de rechter is.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de evaluatie van uitstapprogramma’s voor prostituees (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the handover of prostitution exit programmes to municipalities and the evaluation of the RUPS scheme were handled properly, including the vagueness of agreements, registration of participants, and reliance on estimates. The Minister defends the handover as a warm transfer, says written agreements and subsidy administration requirements apply, and admits the figures were estimates while maintaining they give a reliable picture.

Nevertheless, the results regarding inflow, throughflow and outflow are clearly presented in the RUPS evaluation report and give a reliable picture of the numbers of participants and those who exited.

Desalniettemin zijn de resultaten ten aanzien van de instroom, doorstroom en uitstroom overzichtelijk gepresenteerd in het evaluatierapport van de RUPS en geven zij een betrouwbaar beeld van de aantallen deelnemers en uitstappers.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de conferentie van OWASP (ingezonden 7 december 2011).

An MP asked the minister why no Govcert representative attended the OWASP Benelux security conference, whether the government would use OWASP's material, how the cost of that conference compared with the Govcert symposium, and whether it would engage more with the volunteer security community. The state secretary replied that Govcert is well connected to OWASP, already uses its material in the Raamwerk Beveiliging Webapplicaties, collaborates on a publication, and engages external experts within legal limits.
Govcert.nl is well connected to the initiatives arising from OWASP.
Govcert.nl is goed aangesloten op de initiatieven die voortvloeien uit OWASP.
Antwoord vragen Elissen en Hernandez over het functioneren van de AIVD

PVV MPs Elissen and Hernandez asked about a newspaper report of errors in AIVD recruitment and careless handling of sensitive information, whether the CTIVD oversees culture and information handling, and whether a klokkenluidersregeling exists. Minister Spies replied that the Hofstad investigation capacity issues were already addressed by the CTIVD and earlier reforms, that the AIVD operates around the clock, that internal care and whistleblower arrangements exist, and that a broad external oversight system (CTIVD, Rekenkamer, ombudsman, courts) applies.
The AIVD is operational and reachable 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.
De AIVD is 24 uur per dag, 7 dagen per week, 365 dagen per jaar operationeel en bereikbaar.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Olietanks slecht beveiligd» (ingezonden 12 december 2011).

MPs De Mos and Elissen asked the state secretary about a report that oil tanks were poorly secured and whether unauthorised people could approach them, and about security at other oil storage sites such as Rotterdam. The state secretary agreed access by unauthorised persons is unacceptable, described the permit, safety report and port security regime and inspection, but said no guarantee can be given that such an incident will never recur.
I share your view that it is unacceptable that unauthorised persons can get close to oil storage tanks.
Ik deel uw mening dat het onaanvaardbaar is, dat niet-bevoegde mensen dicht bij olieopslagtanks kunnen komen.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, De Mos en De Jong (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over giftreinen met onbekende ladingen (ingezonden 14 december 2011).

MPs Elissen, De Mos and De Jong asked ministers whether freight trains carrying hazardous substances are reliably documented, whether inspection covers this, and whether the Wob-request by De Pers was fully answered. The minister answered that inspections found 24 violations since February 2011, sanctions were imposed, documentation gaps persist, and inspection will continue closely.
Since February 2011, 24 violations have been identified to date.
Er zijn vanaf februari 2011 tot op heden 24 overtredingen geconstateerd.
Vragen van de leden Elissen en De Mos (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over inbraak in een kerncentrale door terreurcommando’s van Greenpeace (ingezonden 7 december 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Dutch nuclear plants will get extra protection after a Greenpeace intrusion into a French nuclear plant, whether Greenpeace should be excluded as a dialogue partner, and whether Dutch authorities will cooperate proactively with France. The minister replied that Dutch installations are adequately secured and tested through exercises, that Greenpeace is not listed as a terrorist organisation so there is no ground to exclude it, and that Dutch services will cooperate fully on request.
The Dutch nuclear installations are adequately secured, including against intrusion.
De Nederlandse nucleaire installaties zijn adequaat beveiligd, ook tegen binnendringing.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Elissen en Wilders over de islamitische hoofddoek van ons staatshoofd

Three PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum whether the Queen's headscarf during a mosque visit in Abu Dhabi legitimises the oppression of women and whether this could have been prevented. The government answered that when the Queen visits a place of worship the dress rules of that building are respected, without addressing the substance of the criticism.
When Her Majesty the Queen visits a house of worship, the associated dress regulations are respected.
Bij een bezoek van H.M. de Koningin aan een godshuis worden de daarbij behorende kledingvoorschriften gerespecteerd.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Gemeentelijke Basisadministratie (GBA) (ingezonden 6 december 2011december).

An MP from the PVV asks the minister of Interior about transparency of access to personal data in the municipal personal records database (GBA), the Rijks ICT-dashboard rating of the GBA modernisation programme, and related costs and reviews. The minister answers that citizens' data access rules are set out in law, that authorisation and access logs are kept decentrally by municipalities with overviews to be published by February 2012, and that the dashboard is an accountability tool and reviews have been sent to parliament.

Given this decentralised set-up of the GBA, there is no central overview of municipal authorisations, municipal authorisation procedures or consultations carried out in the municipal basic administrations.

Gezien deze decentrale opzet van de GBA is er op centraal niveau geen overzicht van gemeentelijke autorisaties, gemeentelijke autorisatieprocedures of van raadplegingen die in de gemeentelijke basisadministraties zijn gedaan.
Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de dreiging van een aanslag op Amsterdam (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether they were aware of a reported Al Qaeda plot against Amsterdam, how seriously the threat should be taken, and what security measures were taken. The minister confirmed awareness, said the threat is being investigated and gives no reason to change the threat level, and declined to disclose any security measures publicly.
I cannot make any public statements about security measures.
Over beveiligingsmaatregelen kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.

Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel, van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over 3500 gedwongen huwelijken die jaarlijks in Duitsland plaatsvind

An MP asked ministers about reports of 3,500 forced marriages a year in Germany, whether forced marriage should count as human trafficking, whether Dutch registration exists, and why the penalty proposal uses coercion rather than trafficking. The minister answered that forced marriage is prosecuted as coercion (art. 284 Sr), with a proposed maximum of two years, and that trafficking charges apply when exploitation or financial gain is present; no separate registration exists and the minister cannot speak to the German system.
I am not aware of how the German registration works and therefore cannot make statements about it.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de werking van de Duitse registratie, en kan daarover dus geen uitspraken doen.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de nieuwe politie applicatie (ingezonden 25 november 2011).

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice whether the police app 'De Politie zoekt' is an unacceptable privacy intrusion, given its broad phone permissions and the principle of privacy-by-design, and whether the Cbp was consulted. The minister denied spying, listed the limited data stored (IP address, page visited, time, browser), and announced further research into necessary data and storage, with measures to follow if warranted.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het registreren van routers (ingezonden 25 november 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the Dutch privacy law allows an opt-out instead of opt-in for collecting router (MAC and location) data, whether such collection could harm privacy, and whether companies like Microsoft, Apple, Blackberry and Skyhook are in violation and should be investigated. The State Secretary answered that Article 8(f) Wbp provides a basis for the processing, that the DPA (CBP) is the independent supervisor responsible for enforcement, that no criminal action is warranted, and that the government will address the opt-in/opt-out question in a forthcoming letter to parliament.
Whether the companies named in the article are in violation is a matter for the CBP.
Het oordeel of de in het artikel genoemde bedrijven in overtreding zijn is aan het CBP.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Van den Besselaar en De Jong (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de verschillen in adresgegevens van het UW

PVV MPs asked why UWV and Amsterdam hold different addresses for many benefit recipients, whether bulk data matching and benefit suspension for persons registered as untraceable are planned, and whether GBA address controls are sufficient. The minister said UWV may use correspondence addresses in limited cases, committed to legislation allowing benefit suspension and sharing of divergent addresses with municipalities, and to annual municipal address checks.
I consider it desirable that addresses can be shared between governments because citizens must never make themselves untraceable to the government, whether deliberately or not.
Ik vind het wenselijk dat adressen door overheden aan elkaar kunnen worden doorgegeven omdat burgers zich nooit – opzettelijk of onopzettelijk – onvindbaar mogen maken voor de overheid.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over falende overheid die feest viert (ingezonden 15 november 2011).

An MP asked the Interior Minister about municipalities losing DigiD connections, a Govcert symposium costing about 240,000 euro, commercial trainings at that event, and the government's ties to the firm Fox IT. The minister answered that the Rijksoverheid is supporting municipalities, that the symposium serves cyber security cooperation, that no commercial trainings were part of the official programme, and that the Fox IT relationship is an ordinary client-contractor one.
Logius and KING are discussing how support can be optimised so that municipalities can be reconnected as quickly as possible in the future.
Logius en KING overleggen hoe de ondersteuning kan worden geoptimaliseerd, om zo snel mogelijke heraansluiting van gemeenten in de toekomst te kunnen bevorderen.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over te beperkte controle op de AIVD (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

The PVV MP Elissen asked whether the CTIVD, which oversees the AIVD, has enough capacity and whether the AIVD acts unlawfully by not documenting its procedures, and whether the CTIVD should be evaluated and whether democratic control is adequate. Minister Donner replied that the CTIVD is independent and says it has sufficient capacity, that the AIVD will improve written record-keeping, that no CTIVD evaluation is planned, and that the government sees no need for new accountability arrangements.
The government sees no reason at present to prepare proposals on the accountability for and responsibility for the functioning of distinct parts of government.

De regering heeft geen aanleiding om thans voorstellen voor te bereiden met betrekking tot de aanspreekbaarheid op en verantwoordelijkheid voor het functioneren van onderscheiden delen van de overheid.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over het optreden van Prins Maurits in de uitzending van Pauw en Witteman van 11 november 2011 (ingezonden 16 nove

Two PVV MPs asked the prime minister whether Prince Maurits' criticism of government policy in a November 2011 television broadcast was acceptable and what it says about ministerial responsibility. The minister answered that the prince did not criticise government policy, since he spoke before the vote on an amendment, and that ministerial responsibility for royal family members concerns conduct affecting the public interest, which was not at stake.
Prince Maurits did not criticise government policy.
Prins Maurits heeft geen kritiek geuit op het regeringsbeleid.
Vragen van de leden Van Bemmel en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «ING hackt telefoons van klanten» (ingezonden 28 september 2011).

MPs Van Bemmel and Elissen asked whether ING and Dutch telecom providers exchanged customer data to detect SIM swaps, and whether the regulator OPTA had investigated. The minister responded that the exchange aims to prevent identity fraud, that legality is for the data protection authority CBP, that OPTA did not investigate, and that the CBP does not comment on ongoing investigations.
Whether this data exchange is permitted is not for me but for the College bescherming persoonsgegevens.
Of deze gegevensuitwisseling geoorloofd is, is niet aan mij, maar aan het College bescherming persoonsgegevens.
Vragen van de leden Elissen en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de tekortschietende beveiliging van de Koningin (ingezonden 6 september 2011).

MPs Elissen and Brinkman asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the protection of Queen Beatrix was adequate, given reports of individuals known to police getting close to her, including a disruption at a public concert. The minister replied that the security concept is based on threat analysis before each appearance, that the event was publicly accessible and not in danger according to the DKDB, and that checks on firearm permits were not part of the concept.
I have no reason to doubt their judgment.
Ik heb geen aanleiding om te twijfelen aan hun oordeel.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Elissen (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de hoeveelheid Nederlandse jihadisten (ingezonden 15 septe

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Justice how many Dutch passport holders take part in jihad abroad, whether they should be held in a terrorist ward on return, how many have dual nationality, and whether they should be denaturalised and expelled. The government answered that criminal investigations start on reasonable suspicion, that detention on a terrorist ward is possible under criteria, that AIVD data include Dutch, dual and foreign nationals, and that citizenship can be revoked for terrorist offences committed after 1 October 2010 provided it does not cause statelessness.
Under the Netherlands Nationality Act (RWN) it is possible to revoke Dutch nationality from a person irrevocably convicted of a terrorist offence.
Op basis van de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap (RWN) is het mogelijk om het Nederlanderschap te ontnemen van een persoon die onherroepelijk is veroordeeld wegens een terroristisch misdrijf.

Vragen van de leden Van Bemmel en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de berichtgeving betreffende supercookies (ingezonden 26 augustus 20

Two MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Justice whether self-reinstalling 'supercookies' reported in the press go beyond normal cookies, breach the cookie rules in the telecom decree, and should be banned as computer trespass. The minister replied that the cookie consent rules apply and that OPTA, the regulator, must judge concrete cases, and that whether computer trespass applies depends on the technical facts and is ultimately for a criminal court to decide.
It is up to OPTA, as the regulator, to judge in concrete cases whether this way of using cookies violates article 4.1 of the Decree on universal service and end-user interests.

Het is aan OPTA, als toezichthouder, om in concrete gevallen te oordelen of deze wijze van gebruik van cookies in strijd is met artikel 4.1 van het Besluit universele dienstverlening en eindgebruikersbelangen.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Van Vliet en De Mos (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over verouderde gasleidingen die tikkende tijdbommen in de Nederlan

PVV MPs asked whether outdated brittle gas pipes in the Dutch subsoil are ticking time bombs, whether risk assessments and replacement timelines of about thirty years are acceptable, and who is responsible for replacing about 10,000 km of cast iron. The minister answers that responsibility lies with regional grid operators supervised by SodM, that the most vulnerable pipes will be replaced within five years, that new safety rules took effect in 2011, and that most cast iron pipes will be replaced by 2041.
SodM supervises the implementation of the plans.
SodM houdt toezicht op de uitvoering van de plannen.
Vragen van de leden Elissen en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over fraude met DigiD (ingezonden 20 september 2011).

Two MPs asked the minister about DigiD fraude, including whether earlier claims of only a few cases were misleading, the number of cases, planned measures, whether DigiD is secure, and how victims will be helped. The state secretary answered that the fraud concerned benefit fraud enabled by the Tax Administration not checking DigiD ownership, that several hundred DigiD accounts were investigated, that a higher security level is under study with a decision promised later in the year, and that victims are supported through a single contact point and the CMI.
Measures are continuously being taken to prevent fraud with DigiD.
Er worden doorlopend maatregelen genomen om fraude met DigiD te voorkomen.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat Schiphol in 2007 aan een vliegramp is ontsnapt (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary why the safety board's report on a 2007 near-collision at Schiphol appeared nearly four years later, whether the inspectorate IVW failed in its supervision, why management meetings with LVNL were not recorded in writing, and whether LVNL needs a culture change. The state secretary defended the inspectorate's and LVNL's actions, citing audits, procedures and a prior internal study, and acknowledged one missing meeting report.
Unfortunately there is no report of the meeting on 5 September 2008, the meeting the Safety Board refers to.
Helaas is er geen verslag van het overleg op 5 september 2008, het overleg waar de Onderzoeksraad aan refereert.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over Europese data die beheerd wordt door Amerikaanse bedrijven (ingezonden 7 juli 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the US Patriot Act lets American authorities access Dutch and EU government data held by US cloud companies, and what policy exists to prevent foreign access. The minister answered that no specific policy exists yet, that the government must keep data within Dutch borders and use a closed government cloud, and that the conflict of laws must be resolved between governments.
No policy has yet been developed that specifically addresses the possible consequences of applying foreign legislation.
Er is nog geen beleid ontwikkeld dat specifiek gericht is op de mogelijke gevolgen van de toepassing van buitenlandse wetgeving.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat hulpverleners in Moerdijk onvoldoende beschermd waren (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

The MP Elissen asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the municipality and safety region in Moerdijk were prepared for the fire and whether all municipalities should be prepared for such disasters, and about national expertise and rescue units. The minister acknowledges inadequate preparation, reports measures already taken, a broader inspection study, the expert-region approach, and that the Arbeidsinspectie's safety points will be applied to police working conditions while safety regions are asked to act.

No, the inspection report from the Inspectorate for Public Order and Safety shows that the municipality of Moerdijk and the Midden- and West-Brabant Safety Region were insufficiently prepared for this fire.
Nee, uit het onderzoek van de Inspectie Openbare Orde en Veiligheid blijkt dat de gemeente Moerdijk en de Veiligheidsregio Midden-en West-Brabant onvoldoende waren voorbereid op deze brand.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Hernandez en Kortenoeven (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie, van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Defensie over een blunder bij Di

PVV MPs asked several ministers about the DigiNotar certificate authority breach, its effects on DigiD and government e-services, and whether Iran was involved. The government confirmed the hack, took over operational management of DigiNotar's certificate systems, announced a ministry investigation of the PKI-Overheid system and oversight, and said the Iran question was still under investigation.
As part of this, the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations is conducting an investigation into the entire PKI-Overheid system and process, including the supervision of it.
Als onderdeel daarvan voert het ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties een onderzoek uit naar het gehele stelsel en proces rondom PKI-Overheid, inclusief het toezicht daarop.

Vragen van de leden Hernandez en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Defensie en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het interview van de Russische cyberanalist Evgeny Kaspersky en het bericht dat e-mailadre

MPs Hernandez and Elissen asked the defence and justice ministers about a Russian-linked cybersecurity vendor's software used by a NATO member's defence ministry and about leaked email credentials of Dutch defence staff. The minister answered that the Kaspersky products are NATO-approved, pose no added risk to other networks, and that the leaked credentials carry only normal risk, with affected staff informed and the NATO e-bookshop closed.
Defence informed the holders of the compromised email addresses and advised them to change their password.
Defensie heeft de houders van de gecompromitteerde e-mailadressen geïnformeerd en geadviseerd het wachtwoord te vervangen.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over makkelijk verkrijgbare designerdrugs (ingezonden 17 mei 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether designer drugs with effects similar to banned drugs should be banned, whether the government's tools are sufficient, and why such drugs are easily orderable online. The state secretary answered that listing under the Opiumwet is possible if warranted, that a notification point for new substances is recommended, that the Geneesmiddelenwet already covers unlisted designer drugs, and that internet distribution will be raised at an international conference.
After the summer, the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport and I will inform the House about how the cabinet intends to act on this recommendation.
Na de zomer zullen de minister van Volkgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en ik uw Kamer informeren over de wijze waarop het kabinet voornemens is om te gaan met deze aanbeveling.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Elissen en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de bekostiging van een museumdeel door het Sult

MPs Van Klaveren, Elissen and Wilders asked how the Sultanate of Oman financed parts of the Oriëntalis museum park, including the Arab village and mosque, and whether a country applying sharia and ruled by a dictator should be co-responsible for Dutch museums, and questioned a royal attendance at the reopening. The government answered that Oman donated 500,000 euro in 2008 for the museum mosque, that it has no overview of Oman's contribution to the Arab village, that Oman's contribution is cultural and educational, and that the Princess's attendance fits government policy.
I have no insight into the contribution of the Sultanate of Oman to the Arab village, other than a donation in 2008 of 500,000 euro for the construction of the museum mosque.
Ik heb geen zicht op de bijdrage van het Sultanaat Oman voor het Arabisch dorp, anders dan een donatie in 2008 van € 500 000 voor de bouw van de museummoskee.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Verbijstering na politiepromotie» (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

PVV MPs Brinkman and Elissen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of a police promotion controversy involving officers linked to an OLAF investigation into a Europol selection procedure, asking whether promotions while investigations were ongoing were acceptable and what measures would be taken. The minister confirmed an internal KLPD investigation led to consequences for the officers concerned, declined to disclose OLAF's confidential findings or explain its duration, and said a prior transfer was a horizontal management measure rather than a promotion.
Given its confidential nature, the findings of the investigation carried out by OLAF cannot be made public.
Gezien het vertrouwelijke karakter kunnen de bevindingen van het door OLAF uitgevoerde onderzoek niet openbaar gemaakt worden.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de gemeente Eindhoven die op onverantwoorde wijze bankier speelt (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether Eindhoven's land transaction with PSV is an unsound financial risk, covert state aid, and unfair competition with commercial lenders, and whether measures will follow. The minister answers that financial risk and state-aid compliance are primarily municipal responsibilities, the Commission has been asked to explain, and the minister has no role in judging competition or taking action against the municipality.
Within the framework of the financial autonomy of decentralised governments, it is for the municipality itself to decide which policy it applies regarding professional top sport.
Het is, in het kader van de financiële autonomie van decentrale overheden, aan de gemeente zelf welk beleid zij hanteert met betrekking tot professionele topsport.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over slachtoffers van mensenhandel die maar in de helft van de gevallen aangifte doen (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why only half of human trafficking victims file a police report, whether further research will be done, and what will be done to raise reporting rates, and whether prosecution occurs when no report is filed. The minister referred to earlier answers on reporting, stated the Public Prosecution Service does not centrally record the percentage of prosecutions without a report, and explained that a report is not required for prosecution since evidence can come from other sources, with trafficking a Public Prosecution Service priority.
The Public Prosecution Service could not give me these percentages, because this data is not centrally registered.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij deze percentages niet kunnen geven, omdat deze gegevens niet centraal geregistreerd worden.

Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de AIVD die als vriendendienst medewerkers detacheert bij extreemlinkse terreurnetwerken (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether an AIVD infiltrant worked for decades in left-wing extremist networks, whether the AIVD supported such groups or helped organise violent actions, and how the AIVD relates to the Fortuyn murder and the Anti-Fascistische Aktie. The Minister declined to comment on the specific infiltrant and operations, citing the legal duty to protect sources, while confirming that the AIVD may legally instruct agents to take actions that could enable offences but that provocation is forbidden.
The AIVD is legally obliged to keep its sources secret.
De AIVD is wettelijk verplicht zijn bronnen geheim te houden.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de provincie Utrecht die een bedrijf opricht (ingezonden 20 mei 2011).

PVV MP Elissen asked the Interior Minister about Utrecht province founding a limited company (NV) to redevelop business parks, raising concerns about risk, state aid, unfair competition, democratic control and overhead costs. The minister approved the NV, argued the province retains oversight as sole shareholder, denied that funds would be clawed back from the provinciefonds, and said the province itself must assess state aid rules.

At least through the annual accounts, in particular the section on affiliated parties and any risks in the resilience section, Gedeputeerde Staten account annually to Provinciale Staten for the results of the participation.

Via tenminste de jaarstukken, in het bijzonder de paragraaf Verbonden Partijen en de in de paragraaf weerstandsvermogen opgenomen eventuele risico’s, legt Gedeputeerde Staten jaarlijks verantwoording af aan Provinciale Staten

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Van Bemmel (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over Deep Packet Inspection door telecomproviders en de aantasting van privacy (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about telecom providers' use of deep packet inspection, its privacy implications and possible criminal offences, and whether consequences, investigations or new consumer-information rules would follow. The government answered that DPI is lawful in principle but depends on the case, that the Public Prosecution Service and OPTA are investigating, and that existing privacy law already obliges providers to inform customers, so no new measures are planned.
Pending these investigations, I cannot say whether there may have been corporate espionage, interception of government communications, or deception of consumers.
Hangende deze onderzoeken kan ik niet zeggen of er sprake kan zijn geweest van (bedrijfs)spionage, het onderscheppen van overheidscommunicatie, of het misleiden van consumenten.
Vragen van de leden Bontes en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie naar aanleiding van het bericht «Privacywaakhond CBP schendt privacy» (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice whether it was scandalous that the data protection authority CBP published privacy-sensitive address data in a report on Google, and whether he would hold it to account or investigate its working methods. The State Secretary answered that the CBP had anonymised the report immediately, apologised to the affected persons, and that he considered this an adequate response, with the CBP able to draw its own lessons.
I consider that an adequate response, and I regard the CBP as sufficiently capable of drawing the right lessons from this incident itself to prevent a repetition.
Ik vind dat een adequate reactie en acht het CBP voldoende in staat uit dit incident zelf de juiste lessen te trekken om herhaling te voorkomen.
Vragen van de leden Elissen en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Veiligheid en Justitie over mogelijke onveiligheid op het spoor (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

MPs Elissen and De Jong asked ministers about cable theft endangering rail safety, whether ProRail and NS report all signals passed at danger (STS-passages) to the inspectorate, and whether the inspectorate has enough capacity. The minister answered that all STS-passages are reported, the inspectorate has sufficient capacity, rail safety is a priority, and ATB-Vv performs as a safety net, promising an evaluation to parliament in Q2 2011.
All incidents are reported to the IVW.
Alle incidenten worden aan de IVW gemeld.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «Beroering om beloning Joustra» (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

MPs Brinkman and Elissen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a newspaper report on the pay, car with driver and office renovation of the new chair of the Dutch Safety Board. The minister said the chair receives a fee equal to a salary at DG level (scale 19) based on three working days, a company car with driver is functional for this role, and he has no signals of an office renovation.
The chair is not employed by the council or the ministry, so there are no employment conditions.
De voorzitter is niet «in dienst» van de raad of het ministerie, waardoor geen sprake is van arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Vragen van de leden Elissen en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de passagier die na een valse bommelding gewoon werd vrijgelaten (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a passenger who caused a false bomb alert at Schiphol was released after questioning, and why detention options and cost recovery were not used. The Minister answered that the incident caused only a 15-minute check-in delay, that release after questioning was lawful as no further investigation was needed, that the Public Prosecution Service offered a 750 euro settlement, and that cost recovery was not appropriate.
Further deprivation of liberty of the suspect was not justified, because no further investigation was needed.
Verdere vrijheidsbeneming van de verdachte was niet gerechtvaardigd, omdat er geen verder onderzoek nodig was.
Vragen van de leden Helder en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de ministe van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Verdachten terreur krijgen vergoeding» (ingezonden 20 januari 2011).

PVV MPs Helder and Elissen asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the Public Prosecution Service paid compensation to nine of twelve Somali men arrested on Christmas Eve after an AIVD intelligence report, and whether this affects future AIVD reports and prosecutorial practice. The minister answered that the arrests were lawful on the facts known at the time, that the State is liable for harm found to be unlawful after further investigation, that the compensation does not change how AIVD reports are handled, and that no measures are needed.
Paying compensation has no consequences for the AIVD providing official reports to the Public Prosecution Service or for how the PPS handles those reports.
Het betalen van een schadevergoeding heeft geen gevolgen voor het verstrekken van ambtsberichten door de AIVD aan het OM of de wijze waarop het OM met die ambtsberichten omgaat.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Infrastructuur en Milieu, over het niet mogen gebruiken van busbanen door ambulances (ingezonden 2

Two PVV MPs asked why ambulances in Zuid-Holland may not use bus lanes outside emergencies, and whether the law should be changed so ambulances can drive and stop anywhere. The ministers answered that emergency vehicles already have wider access than taxis, that provinces can grant exemptions for bus lanes, and that they see no need to change the law or centralise this power.
No. The current legislation is sufficient.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over burgers in nood die onnodig wachten op hulp wanneer zij 112 bellen (i

Two PVV MPs asked why mobile 112 emergency calls are routed through the national control room in Driebergen before reaching the regional control room, unlike fixed-line calls, and whether this wastes time. The minister replied that mobile location cannot be determined precisely enough automatically, that the centralised process serves efficiency, misuse filtering and service quality, and that the meldkamer process will be made more efficient in consultation with the Veiligheidsberaad, promising to report further.
I share your view that every second counts and that citizens in distress must receive professional help as quickly as possible.
Ik deel uw mening dat elke seconde telt en dat de burger in nood zo snel mogelijk professionele hulp dient te krijgen.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de peperdure website van de gemeente Breda (ingezonden 27 januari 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether a 4-million-euro municipal website in Breda is absurd, how it was financed, whether the Rijk will scrutinise ICT funding requests more critically, and whether national rules make websites more expensive. The Minister replies that costs and ICT spending fall within municipal autonomy and the council's responsibility, that no national grants go to Breda, and that no national requirements inflate website costs.
Decisions on spending on ICT projects fall within municipal autonomy.
De afwegingen met betrekking tot uitgaven aan ICT-projecten behoren tot de gemeentelijke autonomie.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Helder en Kortenoeven (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Nederlandse hoofdrol o

PVV MPs asked ministers whether an investigation exists into the people behind radical extremist websites, whether citizenship could be revoked and they could be expelled, and whether such extremists increasingly operate from the Netherlands. The minister declined to give operational details citing the interests of investigation, said nationality revocation is only possible under narrow conditions and lacks sufficient data for a judgement, and referred to earlier answers for the remaining questions.
In the interest of the investigation I cannot give information about any ongoing criminal investigations or about the number of persons involved.
Ik kan in het belang van de opsporing geen mededelingen doen over eventueel lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken of over het aantal betrokkenen.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Fritsma, Kortenoeven en Bontes (allen PVV) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Veiligheid en Justitie, Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de

PVV MPs asked whether members of terrorist organisations should be denied or stripped of refugee status, citing a 2010 EU Court ruling and asking for screening and a revised EU directive. The government answered that the AIVD and IND can refuse or revoke status for national-security risks or serious non-political crimes after individual assessment, that mere membership is not enough, and that the current Qualification Directive already allows denying residence to those actually involved in terrorism.
The EU Court of Justice holds that a person who belonged to an organisation using terrorist methods can only be excluded from refugee status after an individual examination.

Het Hof van Justitie van de EU overweegt dat een persoon die heeft behoord tot een organisatie die terroristische methoden toepast, slechts van de vluchtelingenstatus kan worden uitgesloten na een individueel onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht »Brandweer klust bij als vrijwilliger» (ingezonden 24 september 2010).

An MP asks the Interior Minister about reports that firefighters, including volunteers, are overworked and rest-time rules are ignored, and whether commanders misuse volunteers. The minister denies a structural problem, says rest-time responsibility lies with employers (regions and municipalities), notes the Labour Inspectorate already acted at Limburg-Zuid, and declines to intensify inspections for now.
For now I see no reason to ask the Minister of Social Affairs, who is responsible for directing the Labour Inspectorate, to intensify inspections at the fire service.
Vooralsnog zie ik hierin geen aanleiding om de minister van SZW, die verantwoordelijk is voor de aansturing van de Arbeidsinspectie, te verzoeken de inspecties bij de brandweer te intensiveren.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Helder, Kortenoeven en Fritsma (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de vrijlating van Wesam al D., die in Amerika voor 25 jaar gevangenisstra

PVV MPs asked why Wesam al D., sentenced in the US to 25 years for plotting attacks on American soldiers, was released early after a Dutch court substantially reduced his sentence due to detention conditions, and whether they would prevent such reductions and revoke his Dutch nationality. The ministers answered that the court weighed additional information, that the case is exceptional and warrants no new measures, and that nationality revocation is not possible here because the relevant provision does not apply to offences committed before its entry into force.
As a rule, there is no reason for a judge converting a foreign sentence to moderate that foreign sentence on account of detention conditions.
In de regel is er voor de rechter bij de omzetting van een buitenlandse straf geen aanleiding voor matiging van de buitenlandse straf wegens detentieomstandigheden.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Scholen gewaarschuwd voor dierenactivisme» (ingezonden 16 september 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the education minister whether she knew of reports that schools were warned about animal activism, what measures were taken after an AIVD warning, whether schools should refrain from animal-activist lessons, and whether public donations to such activists should be banned. The minister confirmed awareness, said the ministry informed school boards based on AIVD information, left the choice of speakers to school boards, and stated schools' public funding is not meant for donations to third parties.
The choice of whether or not to admit an organisation for an information session, and the conditions under which, is for the boards of educational institutions to decide.
De keuze van het wel of niet toelaten van een organisatie voor een voorlichtingsbijeenkomst en de voorwaarden waaronder, is ter beoordeling aan de besturen van onderwijsinstellingen.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Justitie, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Hulp dekmantel voor terreur» (ingezonden 13 sept

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Justice, Interior and Foreign Affairs about the EU terrorist listing of Al-Aqsa, the Dutch decision to withdraw its national sanctions regime, and measures against fundraising for Hamas-linked groups. The government explained the withdrawal for regulatory consistency, noted the court ruling against the EU listing, said the national procedure was adapted in April 2010, and described existing anti-terror-financing measures while declining to report on ongoing investigations.
No statements are made about investigations carried out in this area, in the interest of those investigations.
Over onderzoeken die op dit vlak worden gedaan, worden in het belang van deze onderzoeken geen mededelingen gedaan.
Vragen van de leden Helder, Brinkman en Elissen (allen PVV) aan de minister van Justitie over het bericht «Geen cel voor agent die spioneerde voor Marokko» (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a former police detective who passed secret police information to Morocco was really given only a 240-hour community sentence, whether that undermines the credibility of the justice system, whether community sentences should be available for such offences, and whether he also leaked information about an SP MP. The minister confirmed the sentence, declined to judge the independent court, said the sentence reflects the statutory framework and personal circumstances, noted a pending bill restricting community sentences for serious sex and violence offences, and declined to name the persons whose information was passed on, citing privacy.
For privacy reasons I make no statements about the persons about whom the convicted person provided information.
Uit privacyoverwegingen doe ik geen mededelingen over de personen over wie de veroordeelde informatie heeft verstrekt.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Driessen en Van Vliet (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Justitie, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over het bericht dat Duitsland de Inter
