PVV MPs asked ministers whether the Dutch branch of the IHH aid organisation, banned in Germany over alleged Hamas funding, should be scrutinised, de-listed as an ANBI charity, or designated as terrorist. The government said it has no indications of IHH Netherlands financing Hamas, that AIVD assesses risks, that the ANBI integrity test is limited to criminal convictions, and that further study of Union of Good is promised.
The AIVD assesses and interprets any indications of risks from the perspective of national security.
De AIVD beoordeelt en duidt eventuele aanwijzingen voor risico's vanuit het belang van de nationale veiligheid.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Geleijnse en Ploumen ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het opnemen van een evaluatiebepaling
Requires the minister to send parliament a report within three years on the effectiveness and effects of the law, especially on drug prices and availability.
Our Minister for Medical Care shall send the States General a report within three years of the entry into force of this law on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice.
Onze Minister voor Medische Zorg zendt binnen drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Amendement van de leden Geleijnse en Ploumen over het opnemen van een evaluatiebepaling
Adds an evaluation clause requiring the minister to report to parliament within three years on the effectiveness and effects of the pharmacy law in practice.
The Minister for Medical Care sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice within three years of its entry into force
Onze Minister voor Medische Zorg zendt binnen drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk
Motie van het lid Hijink c.s. over knelpunten bij een deugdelijke uitvoering van het abonnementstarief
Asks the government to take measures with municipalities if monitoring shows implementation problems with the Wmo subscription tariff.
requests the government, based on the monitor results and in consultation with municipalities, to take measures
verzoekt de regering, om aan de hand van de uitkomsten van de monitor in samenspraak met gemeenten maatregelen te treffen
Motie van het lid Geleijnse over de communicatie over het nieuwe Wmo-tarief
Asks government, municipalities and CAK to improve communication about the new Wmo tariff, following the Ombudsman's observation of confusion.
noting that the Ombudsman indicates there is much unclarity about the new tariff in the Social Support Act
constaterende dat de Ombudsman aangeeft dat er veel onduidelijkheid bestaat over het nieuwe tarief in de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning
Motie van het lid Geleijnse over de inkomenseffecten van maatregelen ter beperking van een zorgkostenstapeling
Asks the government to give factual insight into the income effects of measures against stacking of care costs for different target groups and inform the House.
requests the government to provide factual insight into the income effects of the package of measures for different target groups and to inform the House about it
verzoekt de regering, feitelijk inzicht te geven in de inkomenseffecten van het pakket aan maatregelen voor verschillende doelgroepen en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Amendement van het lid Geleijnse over extra subsidie voor 'Inclusief sporten'
Adds 8 million euro to the Inclusive Sports subsidy for coaches running fall-prevention exercise programmes for older people.
the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 8,000 (x 1,000) euros
worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 8.000 (x € 1.000)
Motie van de leden Van Brenk en Geleijnse over het voldoen aan de beweegrichtlijnen door ouderen
Asks the government to investigate the causes of the sharp drop in older people meeting exercise guidelines.
requests the government to investigate what the cause of this strong decline is
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken wat de oorzaak is van deze sterke daling
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk, Geleijnse en Krol over leeftijd-onderscheid bij verzekeringen

Three MPs from 50PLUS asked the Justice and Finance Ministers about a 75-year age ceiling in an American Express travel insurance policy linked to Flying Blue, and whether it amounts to age discrimination and insufficient disclosure. The government declined to judge the contracts, noted that American Express has removed the age ceiling, and pointed to complaint routes and the AFM's supervisory role over information duties.
It is not for me to pass judgement on the assessment of contracts.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de beoordeling van overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over de uitzending Meldpunt van 7 juni 2019 inzake wachtlijsten

Opposition MP Geleijnse asked the Minister of Health about waiting lists for nursing home places raised by a Meldpunt broadcast, including causes, forecasts, real estate, and short-term measures. The minister acknowledged rising waiting lists driven by demographics, listed funding and workforce measures, and largely deferred capacity and real estate questions to a forthcoming letter.
I will ask the Zorginstituut to make these publicly available via their website.
Ik zal het Zorginstituut vragen deze via hun site openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Geleijnse over de berichtgeving betreffende dry-misting-apparaten in supermarkten

Two 50PLUS MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about media reports on dry-misting devices in supermarkets, including legionella risks, the lack of independent control, and the lack of clear rules and responsibility. The minister answered that operators and suppliers are responsible for legionella management, that existing rules apply, that NVWA and ILT provide general oversight, and that he will consult departments and supervisors to clarify who is responsible for independent oversight.
I am consulting with the most relevant departments and supervisors to quickly create clarity on how independent supervision of the use of misting devices in supermarkets can best be organised.

Ik ga in overleg met de meest betrokken departementen en toezichthouders om snel duidelijkheid te scheppen over de vraag hoe onafhankelijk toezicht op het gebruik van mistapparaten in supermarkten het beste kan worden vormgegeven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over de VPRO-serie ‘Uitgewoond’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Health about a VPRO documentary on forced relocations of nursing home residents, including the Inspectorate's involvement, whether it should be notified early of relocations, and how residents and client councils should be involved. The minister agreed to commission research on the effects of relocations via SANO, stated the Inspectorate had reviewed the case and found sufficient care by the provider, and declined to involve the Inspectorate in every relocation.
No. It is the responsibility of a care provider to provide good, person-centred and safe care, including during a relocation.
Nee. Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van een zorgaanbieder om goede, persoonsgerichte en veilige zorg te geven, ook bij een verhuizing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Geleijnse over hoge parkeertarieven bij ziekenhuizen

MPs Ploumen and Geleijnse asked the Minister whether hospitals profit from parking revenue, whether they inform patients about ways to limit parking costs, and whether insurers will act. The Minister said he keeps no overview of parking revenue, that parking policy is the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities, and that the issue was raised with hospitals in consultation without any firm commitment to further investigation.
I do not keep an overview of the revenues from parking fees at hospitals or whether hospitals keep money from them.
Ik houd geen overzicht bij van de opbrengsten van parkeertarieven bij ziekenhuizen en of ziekenhuizen daar geld aan overhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Geleijnse over het bericht ‘De Autoriteit Consument en Markt heeft geen gelijk, wettelijke bescherming geldt voor meer zzp’ers’

Two MPs from 50PLUS asked the ministers whether the competition authority ACM applies EU competition rules to self-employed workers too strictly, preventing them from negotiating collective rates, and whether this fosters social dumping. The state secretary answered that the ACM follows the Court of Justice's FNV KIEM ruling, that it is preparing a revised guideline on collective tariff agreements for self-employed workers around summer 2019, and that the Commission on the regulation of work will report by 1 November 2019.
The ACM has indicated that it aims to consult on the new guideline around summer 2019.
De ACM heeft aangegeven dat zij ernaar streeft om de nieuwe leidraad rond de zomer van 2019 te consulteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over de VPROserie ‘Uitgewoond’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the health minister about a VPRO series on elderly residents of De Drie Hoven forced to relocate, covering transfer rules, care standards, oversight, and planning of nursing capacity. The minister answered that the inspectorate found the move handled correctly, that existing quality standards suffice, and promised further research and a report by year end on building condition and capacity.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over het artikel ‘Energielabels vaak onjuist, online winkels vaak helemaal geen label’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about an NOS report that about one in five household appliances carry incorrect energy labels and many online shops show no label at all, and what will be done about enforcement, business awareness and consumer information. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to planned legislation giving the NVWA administrative fining powers, EU measures such as a product database, and a communication campaign, without giving a firm date for the bill beyond later this year.
I am working to improve this. I am doing so, among other things, through a legislative amendment to make the NVWA's enforcement powers more efficient.
Ik ben bezig om dit te verbeteren. Dit doe ik onder meer met een wetswijziging om de handhavingsmogelijkheden van de NVWA efficiënter te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over het bericht ‘Private equity mengt zich steeds meer in de zorg’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the health minister about reports that private equity is increasingly investing in Dutch healthcare, including risks to quality of care and to sensitive medical data held by foreign investors, and whether the NZa should get a care-content review power over mergers. The minister answered that existing quality and privacy rules apply equally to investors, that the government is studying sharpened merger oversight with ACM, NZa and IGJ and will inform parliament before summer, and that marketisation will be addressed in a forthcoming letter.

As I informed your House in my letter of 22 October 2018, the Minister for Medical Care and Sport, the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport and I are currently examining concrete suggestions from the ACM, NZa and IGJ to sharpen care-specific merger oversight.

Zoals ik uw Kamer heb geïnformeerd in mijn brief van 22 oktober 2018, onderzoeken de Minister voor Medische Zorg en Sport, de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en ik momenteel concrete suggesties van de ACM, de NZa en de IGJ om het zorgspecifieke fusietoezicht aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over het bericht dat de energierekening volgend jaar fors stijgt

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports that household energy bills would rise sharply in 2019, and whether the State Secretary's figures were outdated or inaccurate. The Minister defends the Netherlands Energy Outlook (NEV) 2017 as the government's baseline, acknowledges that 2019 tariffs may come in higher, and says a review of the levy burden will follow.
To this end, the cabinet has announced a review of the distribution of the burden of the SDE levy between households and businesses.
Daartoe heeft het kabinet een verkenning aangekondigd naar de lastenverdeling in de ODE tussen huishoudens en bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Geleijnse over het artikel 'Schadelijke lekkage dreigt bij duurzame aardwarmte'

MPs Van Brenk and Geleijnse asked about press reports that geothermal wells risk leakage, that three installations were already halted, and about contamination, monitoring and upcoming safety rules. The minister acknowledges the sector is young, says three operators voluntarily halted wells, notes no confirmed contamination yet, and promises new legislation, SodM requirements and forthcoming RIVM and SodM reports.
I therefore also endorse SodM's position that additional requirements for well design and monitoring must be implemented as soon as possible.
Ik onderschrijf daarom ook het standpunt van SodM dat extra eisen voor putontwerp en monitoring zo snel mogelijk geïmplementeerd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over het bericht dat zorg in kleine woonvormen voor ouderen niet altijd goed geregeld is

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Health about reports that care in small-scale housing for the elderly is not always well organised, including insufficient staff knowledge, late specialist involvement, and new providers not registering with CIBG. The Minister acknowledged the problem and pointed to the Wtza bill, which introduces a mandatory registration duty and licensing for providers, and to the quality framework requiring 24/7 doctor and specialist availability.

With the bill on the Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders (Wtza), there will be a registration duty for all new care providers falling under the scope of the Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg (Wkkgz).
Met het wetsvoorstel Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders (Wtza) komt er een meldplicht voor alle nieuwe zorgaanbieders onder de reikwijdte van de Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg (Wkkgz).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over het bericht ‘Witte hesjes, zorg dat de gezondheidszorg weer zorg wordt’

MP Geleijnse asked the Minister of Health whether VWS should develop and enforce cost standards for hospitals, require doctors and NZa/IGJ representatives on hospital boards, and whether insurers should lack decisive influence over hospital treatment through price agreements. The minister rejected all three ideas, saying hospitals are responsible for their own financial management, that NZa/IGJ members on boards would undermine their independence, and that insurers negotiate prices on behalf of insured people.
Based on that premise, I do not agree with this statement.
Vanuit dat gegeven ga ik niet mee met deze stelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk, Van Rooijen en Geleijnse over berichten dat de Scandinavische schuldenindustrie zich met woekerrentes richt op de Nederlandse zzp'er

Three 50PLUS MPs asked the ministers whether Scandinavian lenders charging 18% to 200% interest to Dutch self-employed people (zzp'ers) are a problem requiring a rate cap, a duty of care, AFM supervision and standard creditworthiness checks. The Finance Minister answered that the government takes such signals seriously but that the scale of the problem is unclear, so it will first map the issue and rely on the industry's self-regulatory code for now, with no concrete measures yet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Geleijnse over taperingstrips en blunder met niet bestaand onderzoek

MPs Van Gerven and Geleijnse asked the health minister about tapering strips for psychiatric drug withdrawal, a Follow the Money report alleging misleading information from Zilveren Kruis Achmea, and insurer coverage rules. The minister denied being misinformed, said the insurer's conduct is its own responsibility, and stated that insurers may reimburse only rational pharmacotherapy under the basic package.
It is up to the health insurer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over de werkdruk in de thuiszorg

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Health about reports of heavy workload in home care, including missed mandatory breaks, unpaid travel time and accrued minus-hours, and asked about Actiz talks and the sector's tariff structure. The minister said the signals concern employers not honouring CAO agreements, that workers should first raise it with their employer and can seek help from unions or legal aid, and that the Actiz contact will be followed up with members.
If an employer does not honour the CAO agreements, the first step is for the employee concerned to raise it with the employer.
Als een werkgever de cao-afspraken niet nakomt, is het in eerste instantie zaak dat hij daarop wordt aangesproken door de betreffende medewerker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over pleegzorg door grootouders

An MP asked the health minister whether he agrees that more grandparents could take in children in foster care, whether a codicil should be introduced, and whether legal barriers exist. The minister said the network is already considered first, that he will work with Jeugdzorg Nederland on recruitment and review fiscal and legal obstacles, but does not see a role in introducing a codicil nationally.
In light of this, I currently see no role for myself in introducing such a codicil nationally.
Mede tegen deze achtergrond zie ik vooralsnog geen rol voor mij om een dergelijk codicil landelijk in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bijenhof over het bericht “Europese regio’s Oost-Nederland en Noordrijn-Westfalen versterken economische banden voor innovatie en duurzaamheid”

MP Bijenhof asked the Minister of Interior about the intensified Dutch-German cross-border cooperation in Twente and North Rhine-Westphalia, the status of the Dutch-German Innovation and Technology Pact, and how bottom-up regional initiatives can link to it. The minister confirmed awareness, referred to the Twente Regio Deal II and the pact's themes, and said cooperation is coordinated through ROMs, government consultations and the Regions at the Border programme, without committing to new concrete steps.
Yes, I am aware that the border regions of East Netherlands and North Rhine-Westphalia are going to cooperate more intensively to accelerate innovation for a sustainable future.
Ja, het is voor mij bekend dat de grensregio's Oost-Nederland en Noordrijn-Westfalen intensiever gaan samenwerken om innovaties te versnellen voor een duurzame toekomst.
